job.title: Ecommerce Trading Manager (FTC)
job.location: Arsenal Football Club, London, N5 1BU, GB
job.html_description:
The Role

We're looking for an Ecommerce Trading Manager to lead the day-to-day trading and optimisation of Arsenal Direct. Working closely with the Senior Ecommerce Trading Manager and a wide range of colleagues across our club, you'll use data, customer insight and commercial awareness to enhance the online experience for supporters and visitors around the world.

This is a fast-paced and rewarding leadership role where you'll influence trading strategy, lead a talented team and help deliver key commercial moments across our ecommerce channels. You'll play a vital role in ensuring products are easy to discover, campaigns are seamlessly executed, and every online journey is engaging and customer-focused.

12-month fixed-term contract.

Who we are

We are one of the most famous clubs in world football, with a rich heritage and history of success – read more about our history, here.

Beyond that, we are passionate about our local community and, behind the scenes, we have a wide variety of opportunities and career paths for all. We have a very defined purpose: to act for a winning team, culture and community. We achieve this by ensuring we are courageous in the pursuit of progress, we champion our community and each other, and that we do the right thing (even when no one is looking).

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed to ensuring that our environments for children, young people and adults at risk remain safe and inclusive. We therefore require successful candidates to complete a DBS check and other essential background checks prior to starting their employment. Depending on the responsibilities of the role, a DBS will be either a basic, standard, or enhanced check.

Your day-to-day

  • Lead our online trading plan - you'll develop and deliver trading activity across Arsenal Direct, using performance data, customer insight and commercial priorities to drive growth

  • Maximise trading opportunities - you will proactively identify opportunities to improve product visibility, conversion and revenue performance, acting quickly when opportunities arise

  • Deliver key ecommerce moments - you'll coordinate major product launches, campaigns and trading events, ensuring supporters enjoy a seamless online experience

  • Turn insight into action - you will monitor performance and customer behaviour, providing clear recommendations that help shape future trading decisions

  • Drive reporting excellence - you'll take ownership of trading reports and dashboards, ensuring stakeholders have access to accurate and meaningful insights

  • Enhance the online customer journey - you will work collaboratively to improve product presentation, merchandising and site experiences that encourage conversion

  • Build effective partnerships - you'll collaborate closely with Buying, Merchandising, Marketing, Content and Digital Product teams to deliver joined-up commercial activity

  • Lead and develop your team - you will coach, support and empower colleagues, helping them deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced environment

What we are looking for

  • Experience in ecommerce trading or digital retail - you can draw upon significant experience improving online performance, customer experience and commercial results

  • Proven success delivering trading strategies - you're well versed in managing high-profile trading periods such as Black Friday, Cyber Week, Christmas or other major commercial moments

  • Demonstrated analytical capabilities - you possess the ability to interpret performance data and customer insight, turning findings into impactful actions and recommendations

  • Customer-first mindset - you balance supporter needs with commercial priorities and consistently focus on delivering exceptional online experiences

  • Collaborative approach - you can build effective, trusted relationships across teams and deliver shared objectives through cross-functional collaboration

  • Outstanding ecommerce and merchandising knowledge - you understand the levers that influence conversion, revenue growth and customer engagement across ecommerce platforms

  • Excellent organisation and communication skills - you thrive when managing multiple priorities and can communicate confidently with a wide range of stakeholders

  • People leadership experience - you enjoy supporting development and can coach, guide and support colleagues to deliver accurate, high-quality work

Why choose us

At Arsenal, we want everyone to feel a sense of trust and belonging, so we are proud of both our club values and also what we offer to our employees. As one of our Gunners, you will receive:

  • An exciting reward and recognition scheme

  • Generous holiday allowance which increases with your length of service

  • Great internal learning and development programmes

  • A flexible hybrid working model

  • Priority access to apply for match tickets

  • A competitive health and wellbeing benefits package

  • A leading Employee Assistance Programme

  • Great discounts with some of our Partners

  • An opportunity to play a vital role in delivering our ED&I strategy by joining one of our Employee Networks

Discover why ‘Our Gunners’ are proud to be part of our team - view their stories here.

Arsenal for Everyone

Arsenal for Everyone is our commitment to promoting and embracing equality, diversity and inclusion, so that everyone connected to the club feels like they belong to the same Arsenal family. We believe that diversity of background, skills and experience drives our success on and off the pitch. 


Disability Confident Leader

We are a Disability Confident Leader. We actively welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions. If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a ‘disabled person’ according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment decisions.


Application Closing Date - Friday 11th September 2026

Please note: we reserve the right to close the position early if application volumes are particularly high. We encourage you to get your application in sooner rather than later.

Updates on the status of your application will be sent via email, please routinely check your spam and junk folders, as occasionally emails sent via the Teamtailor platform will find themselves there.

Good luck!

job.title: Academy Full-Time Model Lead and Technical Coach
job.html_description:
The Role

We are looking for an Academy Full-Time Model Lead and Technical Coach to enthusiastically deliver our full-time training model coaching remit, leading on an effective coaching programme for all players attending our full-time education programme.

In this exciting role, you will be delivering and developing performance pathways and plans and creating an optimum environment for players to develop and grow, with the biggest focus being on the four pillars of our Academy; creating effective team players, lifelong learners and most efficient movers with a champion mentality.

 

Who we are

We are one of the most famous clubs in world football, with a rich heritage and history of success – read more about our history, here.

Beyond that, we are passionate about our local community and, behind the scenes, we have a wide variety of opportunities and career paths for all. We have a very defined purpose: to act for a winning team, culture and community. We achieve this by ensuring we are courageous in the pursuit of progress, we champion our community and each other, and that we do the right thing (even when no one is looking).

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed to ensuring that our environments for children, young people and adults at risk remain safe and inclusive. We therefore require successful candidates to complete a DBS check and other essential background checks prior to starting their employment. Depending on the responsibilities of the role, a DBS will be either a basic, standard, or enhanced check.

Your day-to-day

  • Lead the full-time training model - you will passionately drive our full-time training model and its players, coordinating all individual and team training sessions to cater to the needs of the players in order to maximise their potential in line with our playing style and identity

  • Act as the primary point of contact for players - you’ll be actively on-hand to support the players and coordinate the full-time programme and you’ll effectively lead a variety of sessions

  • Partner with senior colleagues - you’ll collaborate with the Head of Academy Coaching to comply with Premier League, FA and Elite Player Performance Plan rules and requirements, and ensure that the Football Intelligence Platform is kept up to date

  • Provide impactful feedback and reports - you will take pride in giving valuable constructive feedback to players at the end of each term and you’ll work closely with the relevant phase coaching team to implement it

  • Evolve our coaching programme - you’ll proactively seek out ways to improve our coaching programme and assist with the implementation and operation of these ideas, alongside the Head of Academy Coaching, the Academy Coach Developer and Lead Academy Coaches

  • Prioritise player progression - you’ll make vital contributions to player progress meetings and you’ll support our Head of Academy Coaching with the programme of Continuous Professional Development for the Academy Coaching team

  • Unite with our wider club - you will lean on the expertise across our club and form crucial relationships with colleagues across our Performance, Medical, Player Care, Education and Operations teams to coordinate the full-time training model effectively

 

What we are looking for

  • Proven experience in academy coaching - you come with extensive experience of coaching high level players and/or talented young players and you hold a UEFA B Licence and an FA Advanced Youth Award for Coaching

  • Excellent track record of developing professional players - you've got an admirable history of coaching players at youth level who have progressed to play professional football in the Premier League or the Football League

  • Credible expertise - you've got clear knowledge of the Elite Player Performance Plan and Football Intelligence Platforms and you hold an FA Safeguarding Certificate and First Aid Certification

  • Proud ambassador for our club - you courageously act as a role model at all times, embodying our Academy's values of discipline, humility and respect as well as our wider club values 

  • Effective communication skills - you take pride in building strong rapport with players and you're able to set understandable and realistic goals for them, as well communicate technical messages in coaching sessions

  • Impactful team player - you possess an exceptional ability to work as part of a Coaching team and play a critical role within it

  • Best-in-class organisational skills - you handle an ever changing workload with ease and you're able to manage time and projects with maximum efficiency 

Position of Trust - As someone in a position of trust role involving regular, direct contact with children or vulnerable adults you will be expected to uphold high standards of conduct to prevent abuse, including sexual, physical, or emotional harm. This role requires you to keep updated with both Club and FA Safeguarding training and education


Why choose us

At Arsenal, we want everyone to feel a sense of trust and belonging, so we are proud of both our club values and also what we offer to our employees. As one of our Gunners, you will receive:

  • An exciting reward and recognition scheme

  • Generous holiday allowance which increases with your length of service

  • Great internal learning and development programmes

  • A flexible hybrid working model

  • Priority access to apply for match tickets

  • A competitive health and wellbeing benefits package

  • A leading Employee Assistance Programme

  • Great discounts with some of our Partners


Arsenal for Everyone

Arsenal for Everyone is our commitment to promoting and embracing equality, diversity and inclusion, so that everyone connected to the club feels like they belong to the same Arsenal family. We believe that diversity of background, skills and experience drives our success on and off the pitch. 


Disability Confident Leader

We are a Disability Confident Leader. We actively welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions. If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a ‘disabled person’ according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment decisions.


Application Closing Date - Sunday 20th September 2026

Please note: we reserve the right to close the position early if application volumes are particularly high. We encourage you to get your application in sooner rather than later.

Good luck!

job.title: Casual Sessional Fitness Coach – Health and Wellbeing
job.html_description:
The Role

We’re looking for a passionate Sessional Fitness Coach to join our Arsenal in the Community team on a casual basis, delivering inclusive and accessible physical fitness sessions and health interventions with a keen focus on our women's community groups. You’ll work with participants of different ages, backgrounds and abilities, creating positive and impactful experiences that support the health and wellbeing of our community.

You'll plan and deliver a variety of sessions, including our women's Shape Up programme, Strength & Balance sessions, and Older Adults programme. While leading these sessions, you'll be an ambassador for our club, maintaining high standards of professional behaviour and building positive, impactful relationships with all participants.

Who we are

We are one of the most famous clubs in world football, with a rich heritage and history of success – read more about our history, here.

Beyond that, we are passionate about our local community and, behind the scenes, we have a wide variety of opportunities and career paths for all. We have a very defined purpose: to act for a winning team, culture and community. We achieve this by ensuring we are courageous in the pursuit of progress, we champion our community and each other, and that we do the right thing (even when no one is looking).

Discover why ‘Our Gunners’ are proud to be part of our team - view their stories here.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed to ensuring that our environments for children, young people and adults at risk remain safe and inclusive. We therefore require successful candidates to complete a DBS check and other essential background checks prior to starting their employment. Depending on the responsibilities of the role, a DBS will be either a basic, standard, or enhanced check.

Your day-to-day

  • Deliver inclusive fitness sessions - you’ll confidently plan and lead engaging, age-appropriate fitness activities and wellbeing interventions that respond to the needs of individuals and groups

  • Create welcoming experiences - you will build professional and supportive relationships with participants from a wide range of backgrounds, abilities, ages and fitness levels

  • Prepare safe and effective environments - you will carry, set up and use a variety of fitness equipment, checking equipment safety before each session and taking responsibility for the correct use and upkeep of facilities

  • Champion high professional standards - you’ll be a proud ambassador, representing our club positively and respectfully when working with participants, colleagues and stakeholders

  • Maintain accurate session records - you will proactively update registers, consent forms, incident and accident documentation, and records of participant outcomes

  • Keep developing your expertise - you’ll embrace opportunities to attend professional development days and continue building your coaching knowledge

  • Adhere to health and safety regulations - you will consistently follow safeguarding, health and safety, emergency and venue procedures to help provide a safe and inclusive environment for everyone

Position of Trust - As someone in a position of trust role involving regular, direct contact with children or vulnerable adults you will be expected to uphold high standards of conduct to prevent abuse, including sexual, physical, or emotional harm. This role requires you to keep updated with both Club and FA Safeguarding training and education. 

What we are looking for

  • Level 3 Fitness Instructor qualification - you hold a recognised Level 3 qualification that equips you to plan and deliver safe and effective fitness sessions

  • Expert fitness and nutrition knowledge - you possess a competent understanding of exercise and nutrition and can use this to support participants’ health and wellbeing

  • Inclusive coaching expertise - you understand how to adapt exercise for different needs and medical conditions, with experience of supporting people of all ages and abilities

  • Confident communication skills - you can explain activities clearly, build trusting relationships and engage positively with individuals and groups

  • Community-focused approach - you have experience of working in community settings with an eagerness to develop your knowledge in this area

  • Commitment to safe practice - you demonstrate a clear understanding of safeguarding, health and safety and appropriate emergency procedures

  • Passion for continued development - you take ownership of your learning and are motivated to strengthen your professional knowledge and coaching practice

Arsenal for Everyone

Arsenal for Everyone is our commitment to promoting and embracing equality, diversity and inclusion, so that everyone connected to the club feels like they belong to the same Arsenal family. We believe that diversity of background, skills and experience drives our success on and off the pitch. 

Disability Confident Leader

We are a Disability Confident Leader. We actively welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions. If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a ‘disabled person’ according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment decisions.

Application Closing Date - 18th September 2026

Please note: we reserve the right to close the position early if application volumes are particularly high. We encourage you to get your application in sooner rather than later.

Updates on the status of your application will be sent via email, please routinely check your spam and junk folders, as occasionally emails sent via the Teamtailor platform will find themselves there.

Good luck!

job.title: AWFC Academy Sports Scientist (Casual Role)
job.location: The Hive London, London, HA8 6AG, GB
job.html_description:
The Role

We are looking for an Academy Sports Scientist to work with us at AWFC on a casual basis.

In this exciting casual role, you'll deliver an effective interpretation of data collected via Global Positioning System (GPS) in a way that Coaches can interpret and understand. You'll play a crucial role in producing players who are durable, resilient from injury, and possess a level of physicality that enables them to express the technical and tactical skills required to transition to the Women's First Team.

You will be entrusted to develop ideas that can complement the AWFC long term athletic development model to progress the athleticism of players in our Academy, delivering information and guidance in relation to the maturational status of players through their growth.

Who we are

We are one of the most famous clubs in world football, with a rich heritage and history of success – read more about our history, here.

Beyond that, we are passionate about our local community and, behind the scenes, we have a wide variety of opportunities and career paths for all. We have a very defined purpose: to act for a winning team, culture and community. We achieve this by ensuring we are courageous in the pursuit of progress, we champion our community and each other, and that we do the right thing (even when no one is looking).

Discover why ‘Our Gunners’ are proud to be part of our team - view their stories here.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed to ensuring that our environments for children, young people and adults at risk remain safe and inclusive. We therefore require successful candidates to complete an enhanced DBS check and other essential background checks prior to starting their employment.

Your day-to-day

  • Leverage data to drive positive impact - you'll bridge the physical gap to our Women's First Team via data collection and interpretation, informing and adapting sessions, whilst working in line with our Women's Academy game model, and you will lead and oversee the GPS management on a day-to-day basis, including daily live data feedback and plotting future targets

  • Oversee player fitness profiling and growth - you will support and develop our Academy fitness profiling and ensure that it is age-specific, comprehensive and in line with FA requirements, and you'll develop an understanding of where players maturational status is, and how we can support them through all stages of their growth

  • Champion individual development - you'll implement an individual development approach, with regular touch points to review the previous block and constantly development our athletes as well as developing the team as a whole

  • Support the development of our Academy programme - you will attend reviews and contribute to reports with key stakeholders throughout the season, to have input into the development of our Women's Academy programme

  • Assist in the education of colleagues - you'll help Academy colleagues to understand the requirements of robustness and resilience amongst athletes, through the physical guidance of sessions

  • Create and implement sports science strategies - you will collaborate with our multidisciplinary team to optimise the squads' abilities to perform throughout the season, and you'll demonstrate the desire to develop the provision within the programme through education and learning strategies

  • Feed into talent ID processes - you'll support the development of talent ID profiles for age and position appropriate information to inform our decision-making process using data collection
     

What we are looking for

  • History of working with elite athletes - you're proud of your previous success of working with elite footballers and/or athletes domestically and internationally, and you have a natural enthusiasm for coaching and mentoring elite young and senior players

  • Credible expertise - you hold a degree level qualification (or equivalent) in Sports Science or Strength and Conditioning, as well as an FA Safeguarding Children Certificate

  • Experience working as a key part of a multidisciplinary team - you have a track record of operating within a multidisciplinary performance team and providing strength and conditioning, sports science, or physiotherapy services to elite players, to improve performance, prevent injuries and ensure timely recoveries

  • Background in Women's football - you have knowledge of the FA Girls' Talent Pathway and WSL Academy structure

  • Data competency - you are confident in using and interpreting GPS data, ideally in a football or sport context

  • Best-in-class communication skills - you're an effective communicator with the ability to build meaningful, impactful strategic relationships with colleagues and players

  • Organised and adaptable approach - you can demonstrate excellent session planning and organisational skills

  • Flexible and adaptable mindset - you possess a willingness to work weekends and can be flexible to the needs of an ever-changing schedule, and you are able to travel independently

Position of Trust - As someone in a position of trust role involving regular, direct contact with children or vulnerable adults you will be expected to uphold high standards of conduct to prevent abuse, including sexual, physical, or emotional harm. This role requires you to keep updated with both Club and FA Safeguarding training and education

Arsenal for Everyone

Arsenal for Everyone is our commitment to promoting and embracing equality, diversity and inclusion, so that everyone connected to the club feels like they belong to the same Arsenal family. We believe that diversity of background, skills and experience drives our success on and off the pitch. 


Disability Confident Leader

We are a Disability Confident Leader. We actively welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions. If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a ‘disabled person’ according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment decisions.

Application Closing Date - Wednesday 23rd September 2026

Please note: we reserve the right to close the position early if application volumes are particularly high. We encourage you to get your application in sooner rather than later.

Updates on the status of your application will be sent via email, please routinely check your spam and junk folders, as occasionally emails sent via the Teamtailor platform will find themselves there.

Good luck!

job.title: Pre-Academy Regional Centre Coordinator (Casual Role)
job.location: Hale End, Woodford Green, IG8 9LL, GB
job.html_description:
The Role

We are looking for a Pre-Academy Regional Centre Coordinator on a casual, part-time basis, who will be entrusted to oversee and deliver the operations and training programme for the Under 6 to Under 8 groups at our regional centres, whilst working closely with support departments to deliver both on and off field success.

 

Who we are

We are one of the most famous clubs in world football, with a rich heritage and history of success – read more about our history, here.

Beyond that, we are passionate about our local community and, behind the scenes, we have a wide variety of opportunities and career paths for all. We have a very defined purpose: to act for a winning team, culture and community. We achieve this by ensuring we are courageous in the pursuit of progress, we champion our community and each other, and that we do the right thing (even when no one is looking).

Discover why ‘Our Gunners’ are proud to be part of our team - view their stories here.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed to ensuring that our environments for children, young people and adults at risk remain safe and inclusive. We therefore require successful candidates to complete a DBS check and other essential background checks prior to starting their employment. Depending on the responsibilities of the role, a DBS will be either a basic, standard, or enhanced check.

Your day-to-day

  • Align with our Talent ID team - you will be linking with our Scouts to invite players from grassroots football to train with us at our regional centres

  • Design and present coaching strategies - you'll passionately deliver coaching strategies for all players from our Pre-Academy coaching programme whilst ensuring the agreed approaches are implemented within agreed timescales

  • Prepare and submit appraisals - you will create player appraisals ahead of discussions with our Pre-Academy leadership team

  • Produce critical documentation - you'll diligently plan and submit session plans, match and attendance reports and reviews

  • Uphold our high standards - you will take responsibility for ensuring our Pre-Academy equipment is efficiently managed and utilised

  • Conduct vital player reviews - you'll collaborate with our Pre-Academy Leads and undertake regular player reviews communicating with players, parents and our Pre-Academy workforce

  • Contribute to important future-focused discussions - you will partner with our Recruitment team and be an active participant in defining retain and release strategies

What we are looking for

  • In-depth knowledge of football - you possess thorough knowledge of the football industry, the rules and regulations governing players and recruitment within it, and you're up to date with current coaching and training processes

  • Credible expertise - you hold either a UEFA B Licence, Advanced Youth Award, UEFA A Licence or a UEFA Pro Licence and an FA Talent ID qualification and FA Safeguarding Children Certificate

  • Effective communication skills - you're able to build and maintain impactful relationships with parents/guardians, coaches and players of varying ages, tailoring your approach as necessary

  • Passion for talent development - you have enthusiasm for player and staff development and you're an excellent role model for young players

  • Best-in-class attention to detail - you're well versed in producing insightful written reports and delivering verbal feedback with the utmost clarity, and you constantly ensure that FA and Premier League guidelines and regulations are adhered to

    Position of Trust - As someone in a position of trust role involving regular, direct contact with children or vulnerable adults you will be expected to uphold high standards of conduct to prevent abuse, including sexual, physical, or emotional harm. This role requires you to keep updated with both Club and FA Safeguarding training and education

    Please note: this role will require you to hold a valid driving license

Arsenal for Everyone

Arsenal for Everyone is our commitment to promoting and embracing equality, diversity and inclusion, so that everyone connected to the club feels like they belong to the same Arsenal family. We believe that diversity of background, skills and experience drives our success on and off the pitch. 


Disability Confident Leader

We are a Disability Confident Leader. We actively welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions. If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a ‘disabled person’ according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment decisions.

Application Closing Date - Friday 18th September 2026

Please note: we reserve the right to close the position early if application volumes are particularly high. We encourage you to get your application in sooner rather than later.

Updates on the status of your application will be sent via email, please routinely check your spam and junk folders, as occasionally emails sent via the Teamtailor platform will find themselves there.

Good luck!

job.title: Women's Team Medical and Performance Manager
job.location: AFC Bournemouth Performance Centre, Wimborne, Wimborne, Dorset
job.html_description:
AFC Bournemouth Women are looking to recruit a Medical and Performance Manager to coordinate the effective delivery of Medical & Performance services across the First Team and Development Squad. Reporting to both the Director of Medical and Performance and Head of Women’s Football, this role acts as a central point of co-ordination between medical, rehabilitation, physical performance and wider player-support practitioners, helping ensure clear communication, effective processes and consistent standards across the programme. The role supports an integrated multidisciplinary approach that promotes player health, availability, development and performance, while enabling individual practitioners to focus on delivering high quality support within their respective areas of expertise.

 WOMEN’S TEAM VALUES 
  • Professionalism: Always acting with integrity and respect for the badge in a competent and reliable manner.
  • Togetherness: Working collaboratively through high levels of communication in a manner that supports an environment where everyone feels included, respected and valued. 
  • Opportunity: Providing fair and equitable chances to all individuals by encouraging a growth mindset through empowering the natural abilities of others in service of the overall mission. 
  • Team First: Prioritising the team beyond personal or individual interests. 
  • Co-ordinate the day-to-day Medical & Performance provision across the Women's First Team and Development Squad. 
  • Act as the central communication point between Medical & Performance practitioners, football staff and the wider Club. 
  • Co-ordinate regular multidisciplinary meetings, ensuring clear information sharing, agreed actions and appropriate follow-up. 
  • Support effective planning and integration of medical, rehabilitation, physical performance and player-support services. 
  • Ensure appropriate processes are in place for player availability, screening, rehabilitation, referrals, appointments and return-to-play coordination. 
  • Support consistent documentation, professional standards and governance across the programme, escalating matters where appropriate. 
  • Co-ordinate player medical and performance processes associated with recruitment and signing, in collaboration with relevant practitioners and Club leadership. 
  • Work with the Director of Medical & Performance and wider AFCB Medical & Performance department to align appropriate systems, standards and best practice. 
  • Support the organisation of equipment, facilities, technology and external services required for effective delivery. 
  • Foster an integrated and collaborative environment in which practitioners are enabled to focus on their professional responsibilities and players receive coordinated support.
  • Depending on experience and organisational requirements, provide appropriate coordination, supervision and/or line-management support to members of the Women's Medical & Performance team 
  • As a member of staff to ensure in all matters, you follow and actively promote the club’s mental health policies and practices to ensure an open, non-judgmental and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club. 
  • As a member of staff to ensure that you adhere to the club’s safeguarding policies and procedures and are committed to our safeguarding values, creating a safe and positive environment for all those who interact with the club.
  • Obligation to adhere to the club’s health and safety policy and procedures. 
  • Responsibility to comply with the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974, the Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005, and all related Company policies, taking reasonable care for their own safety and that of others, reporting hazards or incidents, following safe systems of work, and co-operating with all training and emergency procedures.
  • As a member of staff to ensure in all matters you follow and actively promote the club’s equality policies and practices to ensure a welcoming, safe and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club. 
The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.
 Essential 
  • Degree in at least one relevant medical or performance discipline, which may include medicine, physiotherapy, sports therapy, rehabilitation, sport science, strength and conditioning, psychology, wellbeing or a related field. 
  • Relevant professional registration, accreditation or membership appropriate to the candidate’s primary discipline. 
  • Experience working within elite football or a comparable high-performance sporting environment. 
  • Safeguarding and appropriate DBS clearance. 
  • Strong understanding of professional boundaries, clinical governance, confidentiality, safeguarding and duty of care. 
Desirable 
  • Postgraduate qualification in a relevant medical, performance, psychology, wellbeing, leadership or management discipline. 
  • Knowledge of relevant FA, WNL and WSL medical and performance support requirements. 
  • Experience working within Women’s National or Super Leagues. 
  • Experience leading, managing or coordinating a multidisciplinary medical and performance team. 
  • UK Anti-Doping Introduction to Clean Sport certificate, or willingness to complete.
Key Competencies
  • Ability to coordinate people and processes effectively within a multidisciplinary environment. 
  • Strong organisational, communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to prioritise effectively in a dynamic environment. 
  • High level of written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to foster strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders. 
  • Previous experience of line management or multidisciplinary team leadership. 
  • Free onsite parking.
  • Season ticket and allocation of complimentary/purchased tickets (subject to availability).
  • Subsidised lunches and complimentary healthy snacks throughout the day.
  • Discounts at the club Superstore.
  • Access to Health Cash Plan with Simplyhealth.
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Contribution towards eye tests and glasses.
  • Discounts and benefits from partners and local businesses.
  • Club pension & Life Assurance Scheme.
  • Paid parental leave (bank of five days per year).
  • Club events or other social events throughout the year run by our club social team.
  • Paid volunteer opportunities (2 days per year).
  • Paid day’s leave on your birthday.

job.title: Academy Driver (Casual)
job.location: AFC Bournemouth Performance Centre, Wimborne, Wimborne, Dorset
job.html_description:
To transport Academy players to and from all Academy activity, around Bournemouth and nationally.

Academy Values: 
  • Players First: every player valued. Every decision made with care. 
  • Togetherness: working in a prosocial manner as part of a wider team – willing to contribute beyond own interests. 
  • Integrity: carrying out academy and club values in an open and honest manner. 
  • Accountability: willing to take responsibility for actions in a manner which allows learning, growth and reflection. 

  • Transport Academy Players from various pick-up points in the Bournemouth area to and from AFC Bournemouth Performance Centre. Pick up points include but are not limited to: Vitality Stadium, Bournemouth Train Station, Player Accommodation.  
  • Be available to transport Academy players to venues around the country for away fixtures at weekends. 
  • To be available to transport Academy players to other venues as and when needed. 
  • Liaise with the Academy Operations & Player Care teams around weekly schedules and bus registers.  
  • Daily & weekly vehicle checks to be undertaken prior to any journey. Any faults are to be reported in the first instance to the Academy, and maintain the cleanliness of the vehicles. 
  • Provide transport for Academy Players in a safe and lawful manner, fully compliant with the Highway Code and other regulations applying to passenger and minibus transport.  
  • As a casual member of staff to ensure in all matters, you follow and actively promote the club’s mental health policies and practices to ensure an open, non-judgmental and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club. 
  • As a casual member of staff to ensure that you to adhere to the club’s safeguarding policies and procedures and are committed to our safeguarding values, creating a safe and positive environment for all those who interact with the club. 
  • Obligation to adhere to the club’s health and safety policy and procedures. 
  • Responsibility to comply with the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974, the Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005, and all related Company policies, taking reasonable care for their own safety and that of others, reporting hazards or incidents, following safe systems of work, and co-operating with all training and emergency procedures.
  • As a casual member of staff to ensure in all matters you follow and actively promote the club’s equality policies and practices to ensure a welcoming, safe and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club. 
The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.
  • Valid UK Driving Licence, including D1 
  • Experience in driving 17-seater minibuses 
  • Experience in driving sports teams or young people (desirable)

Any faults are to be reported in the first instance to the Academy, and maintain the cleanliness of the vehicles. - Provide transport for Academy Players in a safe and lawful manner, fully compliant with the Highway Code and other regulations applying to passenger and minibus transport. - As a casual member of staff to ensure in all matters, you follow and actively promote the club’s mental health policies and practices to ensure an open, non-judgmental and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club. - As a casual member of staff to ensure that you to adhere to the club’s safeguarding policies and procedures and are committed to our safeguarding values, creating a safe and positive environment for all those who interact with the club. - Obligation to adhere to the club’s health and safety policy and procedures. - Responsibility to comply with the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974, the Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005, and all related Company policies, taking reasonable care for their own safety and that of others, reporting hazards or incidents, following safe systems of work, and co-operating with all training and emergency procedures. - As a casual member of staff to ensure in all matters you follow and actively promote the club’s equality policies and practices to ensure a welcoming, safe and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club.
The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.

job.title: Concourse Bar Staff (Casual)
job.html_description:
We are recruiting staff to serve food, confectionery, hot /cold drinks, etc.
 The shifts are approx. 4 - 6 hours home match day only (usually Saturday ko. 3.00pm.).
Staff will be expected to work at a fast pace as we only have a smalltime frame to serve the supporters.

job.title: Brand Ambassadors - Marketing CLTFC
job.html_description:
Position:                                   Brand Ambassador - CLTFC
Department:                             Marketing
Reporting Relationship:          Reports to Marketing Activation Coordinator
Status:                                       Part-Time (Non-exempt)
 
About Charlotte FC
Charlotte Football Club is the Major League Soccer Club in the Carolinas. The Club’s mission is to be a unifying force that is bigger than one city and encourage a sense of belonging through a progressive, collective, and ambitious approach that guides efforts on and off the pitch. CLTFC is committed to driving growth through the sport and community outreach. Charlotte FC is owned by David Tepper and is a part of Tepper Sports & Entertainment, which also includes Bank of America Stadium and the Carolina Panthers. For more information, visit CharlotteFootballClub.com.
 
Position Summary
The Crown Crew serves as brand ambassadors for Charlotte FC at events around the Carolinas including community festivals, internal club events, and more. Additionally, throughout the MLS season, the Crown Crew will play a pivotal role in enriching the matchday experience for Charlotte FC. This position is within Charlotte FC’s Marketing Department where the team will be tasked with empowering and connecting with avid, casual, and new fans.  
 
Primary Responsibilities
  • Promote Charlotte FC at various events throughout the year, including fairs, festivals, sporting events, parades, and more.
  • Assist in the execution of matchday and non-matchday internal events.
  • Interact with avid, casual, and new fans to educate/inform the community of important Charlotte FC messages (specific promotions, ticket updates/offers, team information, etc.)
  • Responsible for setup and breakdown of events.
  • Create a fun, loud, and positive atmosphere at events by interacting with fans, distributing giveaways, and encouraging fans to support the team.
  • On-site support for execution of community and grassroots activations and Charlotte FC-led events.
  • Additional related duties as assigned.
 
Experience & Required Skills
  • Applicants must currently reside in the Carolinas, preferably near major metro areas or be willing to commute.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • Outgoing and engaging personality
  • Knowledge of Major League Soccer, specifically Charlotte FC
  • Punctual, professional and mature demeanor
  • Must have a valid driver’s license and reliable transportation
  • Must be a team player
  • Spanish-speaking skills are a plus but not required
 
Work Environment and Physical Requirements
This position operates in a professional office environment and outside in a stadium facility.  Local travel to events may be required.  This position works no more than 30 hours per week. 
  • Must be able and willing to work in all Charlotte FC home matches.
  • Must be able and willing to work a minimum of one Crown Crew shift per month, including Charlotte FC home matches, grassroots activations and Charlotte FC-led events.
  • Must be able and willing to work non-traditional hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays as needed.
  • Must be able to lift and carry at least 50 lbs.
  • Ability to remain standing/walking for 8 to 10 hours.
  • Ability to climb stairs.
  • Ability to work both indoors and outdoors, and endure weather conditions, including rain, wind, high and low temperatures, etc.
 
We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Coordinator - Digital Platforms CLTFC
job.html_description:
Position:                                   Digital Platforms Coordinator – CLTFC 
Department:                           Marketing
Reporting Relationship:      Reports to Senior Manager, Digital Platforms 
Status:                                       Full-Time (Exempt)    

About Charlotte FC
Charlotte Football Club is the Major League Soccer Club in the Carolinas. The Club’s mission is to be a unifying force that is bigger than one city and encourage a sense of belonging through a progressive, collective, and ambitious approach that guides efforts on and off the pitch. CLTFC is committed to driving growth through the sport and community outreach. Charlotte FC is owned by David Tepper and is a part of Tepper Sports & Entertainment, which also includes Bank of America Stadium and the Carolina Panthers. For more information, visit CharlotteFootballClub.com.

Position Summary
Charlotte Football Club is the Major League Soccer Club in the Carolinas. The Club’s mission is to be a unifying force bigger than one city and encourage a sense of belonging through a progressive, collective, and ambitious approach that guides efforts on and off the pitch. Owned by David Tepper, Charlotte FC is a part of Tepper Sports & Entertainment, including Bank of America Stadium and the Carolina Panthers.
Charlotte FC is looking for an experienced Digital Platforms Coordinator to manage key components of two of the Club's digital platforms, the website and mobile app. This role will collaborate closely with both the marketing & digital content teams and report to the Senior Manager of Digital Platforms. The primary goals of this role are to enhance user experiences on the web and app and support in improving key performance indicators (KPIs). The coordinator will focus on creating personalized journeys for fans to deepen their engagement with the brand, as well as contribute to developing, innovating, and optimizing fan experiences on these platforms.
 
Primary Responsibilities
·         Day-to-day support on Charlotte FC digital platforms – first team websites & app – including but not limited to posting videos, photo albums, articles, SEO optimization, page building, etc.
·         Work with the larger marketing team to ideate and integrate new platforms and products to enhance the user experience, increase fans’ overall knowledge, and open new revenue streams
·         Create lead generation forms and campaign landing pages with relevant tracking tags for source attribution
·         Support and execute sponsored activations and digital experiences for fan engagement across platforms
·         Provide detailed analytics and KPI reports on site performance, with recommended actions for several stakeholders for precise responses and improvement
·         Collaborate with partnerships to create sponsored and engaging features that enhance the brand to generate leads, and use the digital platforms to create custom user journeys for fans to become more engaged with the brand
·         Matchday web and app content management
·         Other duties as assigned by manager
 
Minimum Qualifications
·         BA/BS degree in marketing, business, or communications 
·         1-3 years’ experience running large-scale websites or apps for a professional organization (previous sports team experience is a plus, but not mandatory)  
·         Experience creating compelling digital experiences - on websites and mobile apps 
·         Knowledge of website back-end content management systems
·         Full understanding of the MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) 
·         Experience with page building and UI/UX best practices  
·         Must pass pre-employment screens
 
Preferred Qualifications
·         Proven experience using data-driven insights to understand what is working and what needs improvement within the digital space
·         Complete working knowledge within website content management systems – WordPress, Drupal, pocket, custom-coded CMS, Forge, etc.
·         Editorial or long-form exposure experience
·         Familiarity with the overall mobile app ecosystem and can optimize user experience on mobile app platforms
·         Experience within a fast-paced industry
 
Essential Functions
·         Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve the desired outcome
·         Self-starter with a hands-on approach, good instincts for prioritization, and the ability to work under a high-pressure, fast-paced environment
·         Strong analytical, project management, and communication skills
·         Agile and able to respond effectively to the rapidly changing needs of a fast-paced / high-growth organization
·         Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment
·         Must be able to handle confidential, privileged, and/or sensitive information with carefully and with sensitivity.
 
Physical Requirements
·         Ability to sit, walk, and stand for extended periods of time throughout the day.
·         Ability to focus on projects for periods of time.
·         Role routinely uses standard office equipment 
 
Work Environment
This job operates in a professional office environment (mostly office environment, outside in a stadium facility at times, which may include inclement weather conditions) and remotely as assigned by management and based on current business needs.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Manager-Marketing Activation & Events CLTFC
job.html_description:
Position:                                 Manager-Marketing Activation & Events, CLTFC
Department:                         Marketing
Reporting Relationship:    Reports to Head of Marketing, CLTFC
Status:                                     Full-Time (Exempt)
 
About Charlotte FC
Charlotte Football Club is the Major League Soccer Club in the Carolinas. The Club’s mission is to be a unifying force that is bigger than one city and encourage a sense of belonging through a progressive, collective, and ambitious approach that guides efforts on and off the pitch. CLTFC is committed to driving growth through the sport and community outreach. Charlotte FC is owned by David Tepper and is a part of Tepper Sports & Entertainment, which also includes Bank of America Stadium and the Carolina Panthers. For more information, visit CharlotteFootballClub.com.
 
Position Summary
The Manager, Marketing Activation & Events, is a lead marketing role for Charlotte FC and a key member of the Club’s leadership team. The role oversees events, experiential marketing, influencer, and other targeted tactics designed to grow CLTFC awareness and fandom. Priorities include developing and executing comprehensive marketing activation strategies to strengthen the brand; fueling fandom and engagement through compelling campaigns; and capturing new potential fans through marketing tactics designed to meet potential fans where they are. This person thrives on building and maintaining strong working alliances with other leaders, internally and externally. The role requires constant communication with teammates in ticketing, partnerships, facility operations, community engagement, communications, and soccer operations, along with external vendors and partners to host and execute marketing activations and events. The Manager, Marketing Activation & Events, is naturally curious about what will take the CLTFC brand to the next level and is an expert collaborator with a history of breakthrough activations.
 
Primary Responsibilities
  • Lead the development of large-scale, club-owned brand events.
  • Work with the Ticketing team to execute Season Ticket Member appreciation programs and support the planning and delivery of other departmental events to ensure consistent brand representation. 
  • Manage the club-wide event calendar, including management of promotional items to support key dates and events.
  • Lead the strategy and planning for viewing parties, in collaboration with the Partnerships Marketing team.
  • Lead matchday fan experience marketing initiatives including pre-match/post-match activations and events, and gate giveaway planning and distribution in collaboration with the Partnerships Marketing team. 
  • Lead influencer campaigns and activations around our events and matches.
  • Serve as the central point of contact for the club-wide apparel ordering program.
  • Lead and manage a team of one coordinator and one intern to support department efforts.
  • Grow fan affinity & fan sentiment; Deliver talked about events & experiences across the enterprise both on gameday / match day and year-round. 
  • Evolve existing and create new products, services & benefits that fans value. 
  • Grow the brand regionally, nationally, and globally & ultimately become one of the most loved brands in sports. 
  • Work with internal clients to drive campaign performance from ideation to execution. 
  • Work alongside Head of Marketing and other Marketing leaders to develop comprehensive annual marketing strategies, including promotional calendars and media strategies with the ticket sales team that support campaigns, tell the brand story, and focus on call to action. 
  • Build experiential lead generation campaigns that drive ticket sales.
  • Establish and monitor staff performance, development goals and department priorities 
  • Partner with Community Outreach team to develop collaborative events and live engagement strategies. 
  • Other duties assigned as necessary. 

Qualifications, Skills and Education Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, sports, business management, communications, or related field.
  • Minimum 5+ years of progressive experience in marketing activation, experiential marketing, events, or related fields.
  • 1 - 2 years+ direct managerial experience
  • Knowledge of soccer, professional soccer leagues, and MLS
  • Native Spanish language speaker (bilingual English + Spanish) strongly preferred
  • Sports & entertainment, property, or agency experience.
  • Collaborative Business Partner
 
Leadership, Work Ethic, and Culture
  • Strong leadership skills and business acumen.
  • Exhibits a team-oriented approach, always prioritizing team above self.
  • High energy leader with a strong work ethic and a desire to enhance the culture of the organization.
  • Demonstrates commitment to the organization’s vision, mission, and core values.
  • Projects a positive image as well as inspiring trust and credibility with stakeholders.
  • Embraces the start-up nature of the early brand stage of the organization.
  • Demonstrates ability to adapt and adjust to changing needs of the business while demonstrating a positive attitude.
 
Judgment, Decision-Making and Sense of Urgency
  • Demonstrates exceptional judgment in carrying out duties.
  • Demonstrates strategic thinking capabilities.
  • Able to clearly define complex issues; identifies and discusses potential solutions with key stakeholders; shapes opinions and works to build consensus as appropriate; uses broad knowledge and common sense.
  • Acts with purpose and urgency in making timely recommendations and decisions.
 
Communication
  • Communicates clearly and effectively; possesses excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Keeps leadership informed of important issues/aspects of the marketing performance.
  • Uses effective communication tactics regarding the manner of communication, tone, and channel in all circumstances.
  • Embraces an inclusive style of communication; actively listens and acknowledges conflicting points of view and treats all points of view with respect.
 
Work Environment
This job operates mostly in an office environment and outside in a stadium facility at times which may include inclement weather conditions.  This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.  Some travel may be required to away games or for other business purposes. 
 
We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.
job.plain_text_description:
Position: Manager-Marketing Activation & Events, CLTFC
Department: Marketing
Reporting Relationship: Reports to Head of Marketing, CLTFC
Status: Full-Time (Exempt)
About Charlotte FC
Charlotte Football Club is the Major League Soccer Club in the Carolinas. The Club’s mission is to be a unifying force that is bigger than one city and encourage a sense of belonging through a progressive, collective, and ambitious approach that guides efforts on and off the pitch. CLTFC is committed to driving growth through the sport and community outreach. Charlotte FC is owned by David Tepper and is a part of Tepper Sports & Entertainment, which also includes Bank of America Stadium and the Carolina Panthers. For more information, visit CharlotteFootballClub.com.
Position Summary
The Manager, Marketing Activation & Events, is a lead marketing role for Charlotte FC and a key member of the Club’s leadership team. The role oversees events, experiential marketing, influencer, and other targeted tactics designed to grow CLTFC awareness and fandom. Priorities include developing and executing comprehensive marketing activation strategies to strengthen the brand; fueling fandom and engagement through compelling campaigns; and capturing new potential fans through marketing tactics designed to meet potential fans where they are. This person thrives on building and maintaining strong working alliances with other leaders, internally and externally. The role requires constant communication with teammates in ticketing, partnerships, facility operations, community engagement, communications, and soccer operations, along with external vendors and partners to host and execute marketing activations and events. The Manager, Marketing Activation & Events, is naturally curious about what will take the CLTFC brand to the next level and is an expert collaborator with a history of breakthrough activations.
Primary Responsibilities
- Lead the development of large-scale, club-owned brand events. - Work with the Ticketing team to execute Season Ticket Member appreciation programs and support the planning and delivery of other departmental events to ensure consistent brand representation. - Manage the club-wide event calendar, including management of promotional items to support key dates and events. - Lead the strategy and planning for viewing parties, in collaboration with the Partnerships Marketing team. - Lead matchday fan experience marketing initiatives including pre-match/post-match activations and events, and gate giveaway planning and distribution in collaboration with the Partnerships Marketing team. - Lead influencer campaigns and activations around our events and matches. - Serve as the central point of contact for the club-wide apparel ordering program. - Lead and manage a team of one coordinator and one intern to support department efforts. - Grow fan affinity & fan sentiment; Deliver talked about events & experiences across the enterprise both on gameday / match day and year-round. - Evolve existing and create new products, services & benefits that fans value. - Grow the brand regionally, nationally, and globally & ultimately become one of the most loved brands in sports. - Work with internal clients to drive campaign performance from ideation to execution. - Work alongside Head of Marketing and other Marketing leaders to develop comprehensive annual marketing strategies, including promotional calendars and media strategies with the ticket sales team that support campaigns, tell the brand story, and focus on call to action. - Build experiential lead generation campaigns that drive ticket sales. - Establish and monitor staff performance, development goals and department priorities - Partner with Community Outreach team to develop collaborative events and live engagement strategies. - Other duties assigned as necessary.
Qualifications, Skills and Education Requirements
- Bachelor’s degree in marketing, sports, business management, communications, or related field. - Minimum 5+ years of progressive experience in marketing activation, experiential marketing, events, or related fields. - 1 - 2 years+ direct managerial experience - Knowledge of soccer, professional soccer leagues, and MLS - Native Spanish language speaker (bilingual English + Spanish) strongly preferred - Sports & entertainment, property, or agency experience. - Collaborative Business Partner
Leadership, Work Ethic, and Culture
- Strong leadership skills and business acumen. - Exhibits a team-oriented approach, always prioritizing team above self. - High energy leader with a strong work ethic and a desire to enhance the culture of the organization. - Demonstrates commitment to the organization’s vision, mission, and core values. - Projects a positive image as well as inspiring trust and credibility with stakeholders. - Embraces the start-up nature of the early brand stage of the organization. - Demonstrates ability to adapt and adjust to changing needs of the business while demonstrating a positive attitude.
Judgment, Decision-Making and Sense of Urgency
- Demonstrates exceptional judgment in carrying out duties. - Demonstrates strategic thinking capabilities. - Able to clearly define complex issues; identifies and discusses potential solutions with key stakeholders; shapes opinions and works to build consensus as appropriate; uses broad knowledge and common sense. - Acts with purpose and urgency in making timely recommendations and decisions.
Communication
- Communicates clearly and effectively; possesses excellent interpersonal skills. - Keeps leadership informed of important issues/aspects of the marketing performance. - Uses effective communication tactics regarding the manner of communication, tone, and channel in all circumstances. - Embraces an inclusive style of communication; actively listens and acknowledges conflicting points of view and treats all points of view with respect.
Work Environment
This job operates mostly in an office environment and outside in a stadium facility at times which may include inclement weather conditions. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines. Some travel may be required to away games or for other business purposes.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Security Console Operators
job.html_description:
Position:                                 Security Console Operator
Department:                        Venue Operations – Security
Reporting Relationship:   Manager – Venue Security
Status:                                    Full Time (Non-Exempt)
 
Position Summary
The Security Console Operator is responsible for ensuring the safety and security of the venue’s physical infrastructure, assets, and access control systems. This role focuses on daily operational oversight of security technologies, procedures, and protocols to maintain a secure environment for guests, staff, and vendors. This position does not include supervisory responsibilities.
 
Primary Responsibilities 
  • Monitor and maintain physical security systems including surveillance cameras, access control, alarms, and perimeter protection.
  • Ensure regular inspections of doors, gates, locks, and other physical barriers to ensure integrity and functionality.
  • Ensure compliance with internal and external security protocols, standards, and regulations.
  • Respond to and investigate security incidents, breaches, or alarms, documenting findings and escalating as needed.
  • Respond in real time to emergency situations, including security breaches, alarms, and safety incidents.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot security equipment to ensure optimal performance and uptime.
  • Collaborate with venue operations and external security vendors to ensure alignment with safety protocols.
  • Document and report security incidents, system malfunctions, and maintenance activities.
  • Maintain accurate records of security activities, incident reports, and system maintenance logs.
  • Support credentialing and access control for events, contractors, and deliveries.
  • Stay current with industry best practices and emerging technologies in physical security.
 
Minimum Qualifications
  • Associates or bachelor’s degree in criminal justice, security management, or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in physical security, facilities protection, or a related role.
  • Familiarity with security systems such as CCTV, access control, and alarm monitoring.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify vulnerabilities in physical infrastructure.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and respond effectively under pressure.
 
Skills for Success
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Works well under pressure and is flexible when necessary.
  • Ability to adapt and adjust to changing needs of the business while maintaining a positive attitude.
  • Must possess excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
 
Essential Functions
  • Standing for extended periods of time.
  • Lift at least 30 pounds.
 
Work Environment(s)
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays as required for events and 24-hour security operations.
  • Position may require standing for long periods and responding to on-site security situations.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Account Executive – Membership Services CLTFC
job.html_description:
Position:                                  Account Executive – Membership Services CLTFC
Department:                          Ticket Sales & Services
Reporting Relationship:     Reports to Senior Manager - Membership Services
Status:                                      Full-Time (Non-Exempt)   
 
Summary
The Account Executive – Membership Services will be part of the team responsible for retaining and growing our PSL owner base through delivering first-class customer service, relationship building, and benefit development.
 
Primary Responsibilities
·         Deliver exceptional customer service to an assigned portfolio of PSL Owners by proactively communicating relevant team updates, events, benefits, and stadium information.
·         Lead PSL Owners through annual season ticket renewals and Silver Club extensions, consistently meeting or exceeding retention goals.
·         Maintain detailed and accurate customer records in CRM, documenting all interactions, touchpoints, and pertinent account information.
·         Proactively reach out to PSL Owners via phone, email, and SMS to share updates on exclusive experiences, request payments, and communicate operational or stadium changes.
·         Fulfill game day responsibilities including, but not limited to, in-seat visits, assisting with special promotions, addressing PSL Owner inquiries, and delivering Fan Packs.
·         Resolve event day ticketing and seating issues in collaboration with gameday operations staff.
·         Support PSL Owners and buyers in posting or securing tickets through league-approved secondary marketplaces.
·         Plan and execute retention-focused events and experiences that add value to the PSL Owner experience.
·         Provide customer service support for Bank of America Stadium events beyond game days, ensuring a seamless experience for all attendees.
·         Assist in the execution of ticketed team events including Draft Day, Training Camp, and other exclusive season ticket member experiences.
·         Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned by Ticketing leadership to support department objectives and enhance the overall member experience.
·         Other duties as assigned.
 
Additional Responsibilities
·         Committed to the support of Department goals and objectives in all areas
·         Represent the organization at various organizational networking and/or events in a professional manner
·         Involvement in game day activities, promotions, and sales events
·         Facilitate special projects as assigned
 
Minimum Qualifications
·         Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in the sports or hospitality service industry.
·         Prior sales/services experience in the sports or hospitality industry
·         Demonstrated ability in the areas of relationship building, communication, time management, and organization
·         Knowledge of accounts payable and billing
·         Must be able to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends and holidays, as necessary
·         Must pass pre-employment screens.
 
Preferred Qualifications
·         Working knowledge of Ticketmaster mobile ticketing and Archtics is preferred.
 
Skills for Success
·         Strength in teamwork, professionalism, and time management.
·         Must possess excellent oral, written, organizational and proofreading skills.
·         Must, at all times, display the character and values of the Tepper Sports and Entertainment brand.
·         Must be detail-oriented and must be able to multi-task while managing time successfully.
·         Works well under pressure and flexible when necessary.
·         Must be able to handle confidential, privileged, and/or sensitive information with carefully and with sensitivity.
·         Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve desired outcome.
·         Self-starter with a hands-on approach, good instincts for prioritization and the ability to work under a high-pressure, fast-paced environment.
 
Physical Requirements
·         Standing for extended periods of time.
·         Sitting and working at desk on a computer.
·         Walking throughout the stadium may include stairs.
·         Lift at least 30 pounds.
 
Work Environment
·         This job operates mostly in an office environment and outside in a stadium facility at times which may include inclement weather conditions.
 
We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

Position:                                    Associate – Media Relations CLTFC
Department:                            Communications
Reporting Relationship:       Reports to the Senior Coordinator - Communications
Status:                                       Seasonal/Part-Time (Non-Exempt)

About Charlotte FC
Charlotte Football Club is the Major League Soccer Club in the Carolinas. The Club’s mission is to be a unifying force that is bigger than one city and encourage a sense of belonging through a progressive, collective, and ambitious approach that guides efforts on and off the pitch. CLTFC is committed to driving growth through the sport and community outreach. Charlotte FC is owned by David Tepper and is a part of Tepper Sports & Entertainment, which also includes Bank of America Stadium and the Carolina Panthers. For more information, visit CharlotteFootballClub.com.

Job Summary
The Associate - Media Relations works as Matchday Event Staff assisting the communications department in all aspects of matchdays, which includes press box management, photo marshaling, media will call, and other duties.

Primary Responsibilities:
• Assist in distributing, managing, and logging credentials to all media attending Charlotte FC home games.
• Assist in providing media relations support for all Charlotte FC home games.
• Assist in setup, teardown, and management of media operations spaces, including press conference room, press box, field photography areas and photo work room.
• Assist in post-match press syndications and transcriptions.
• Assist with other duties as needed.

Qualifications and Education Requirements:
• Prior internships, volunteer work, or any work experience in Public Relations, Communications, Sport Management or related field is preferred.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to establish effective working relationships with a variety of media contacts.
• Must be available to work during evenings, weekends, and holidays when necessary.

Essential Functions:
• Ability to meet the physical demands of the job which include lifting (up to 25 lbs.), standing, stooping, and walking for an extended period of time.
• Ability to work indoors and in outdoor stadium environments which may include inclement weather.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.
