job.title: Graphic Designer - CLTFC
job.html_description:
JOB TITLE:                                      Graphic Designer
DEPARTMENT/GROUP:              Creative Content / Marketing
REPORTING RELATIONSHIP:    Reports to Senior Graphic Designer
STATUS:                                          Full-Time (Exempt)
 
About Charlotte FC
Charlotte Football Club is the Major League Soccer Club in the Carolinas. The Club’s mission is to be a unifying force that is bigger than one city and encourage a sense of belonging through a progressive, collective, and ambitious approach that guides efforts on and off the pitch. CLTFC is committed to driving growth through the sport and community outreach. Charlotte FC is owned by David Tepper and is a part of Tepper Sports & Entertainment, which also includes Bank of America Stadium and the Carolina Panthers. For more information, visit CharlotteFootballClub.com.
 
POSITION SUMMARY:
Charlotte Football Club is seeking a talented Graphic Designer with experience producing graphics for digital and printing publications. The ideal candidate should have a strong design-forward skill set to innovative design, branding and content creation. This position will have an impact across the business with a focus on supporting marketing and brand initiatives. Graphic Designers are at the entry level and work closely with the Lead Graphic Designer on a day-to-day basis, reporting to the Creative Director.
 
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Assist the development of the visual brand identity of Charlotte Football Club and Crown Legacy Football Club, maintaining brand standards to create designs that reinforce brand style and voice across various visual touchpoints.
  • Collaborate with marketing, sponsorship, digital, ticketing, community, partnerships, stadium ops, premium services, content, technical staff, human resources, executive leadership and other departments within the organization to consistently produce requested deliverables in a timely and effective manner.
  • Work directly with the creative team on brainstorming, developing, and executing design work for the organization. These include but are not limited to marketing materials, logos, signage, environmental, installations, promotional items, advertisements, brochures, flyers, digital/social content, etc.
  • Deliver real-time content on matchdays and assist in the development of content as needed
  • Constantly develop skills and explore new creative techniques.
  • Communicate creative ideas within a collaborative environment.
  • Assist with organizing and adding to a brand asset management system.
  • Other duties as assigned.
 
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS:
  • 1-2 years of experience creating various types of media including digital and print
  • Must be experienced with using Adobe’s Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, etc.)
  • Strong understanding of layout (i.e. typography, balance, scale) and other fundamental design techniques
  • Must be able to design projects from concept to completion and use project management software to track workflow
  • Experience in taking creative ideas and translating them to visual presentations
  • Prior knowledge of creating print ready materials for marketing and ticketing purposes.
  • Must be technically knowledgeable and savvy in a digital and Apple environment
 
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Knowledge of photo editing using Lightroom or Photoshop/Camera RAW
  • Knowledge of motion design techniques using After Effects.
 
SKILLS FOR SUCCESS:
  • Strong work ethic and attention to detail
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Works well within a collaborative, team-driven, and goal-based environment
  • Works well under pressure while maintaining a positive attitude
  • Must be a team player, reliable, and dependable with a can-do attitude
  • Must maintain complete confidentiality of privileged, and/or sensitive information
  • Must, at all times, display the character and values of the Tepper Sports & Entertainment brand
  • The ability to prioritize workload to manage time and tasks
  • Be willing to accept or be open to feedback and critique related to design projects
 
WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:
  • Must be able to work in Charlotte FC matches
  • Ability to sit at a desk and work on a computer for extended periods (up to 8 hours per day).
  • Manual dexterity to operate a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other digital tools.
  • Occasional lifting and carrying equipment or printed materials (up to 20 pounds).
  • Visual acuity to accurately review design work, including color accuracy and detail.
  • Ability to work both indoors and outdoors, and endure weather conditions, including rain, wind, high and low temperatures, etc.
  • Must be able to work in non-traditional settings, and work non-traditional hours including nights, weekends, and holidays as needed

job.title: Coordinator, Ticket Operations
job.html_description:
There has never been a more exciting time to join Chicago Fire FC.

As one of Major League Soccer's original clubs, Chicago Fire FC is in the midst of an exciting era fueled by tremendous investment, ambition, and growth. With a new $100M state-of-the-art Endeavor Health Performance Center now open, new offices in Chicago's iconic Wrigley Building, and plans underway for a privately-funded $750M+ soccer-specific stadium set to open in 2028 in the heart of Chicago, the Club is building the future of soccer in one of the world's great sports cities.

Chicago Fire FC is becoming a cultural force in Chicago by connecting communities, shaping experiences, and creating new ways for fans to engage with the game and the city. The Club's future home, McDonald’s Park, will anchor Chicago's newest neighborhood and serve as a catalyst of growth for the next chapter of professional sports and entertainment in the city.

Joining Chicago Fire FC today means joining an organization on the rise. Our growth creates once-in-a-lifetime opportunities for ambitious professionals to generate meaningful impact and help shape the future of our Club. Whether on the pitch working match day or in the front office, every team member plays a role in building something incredibly special. 

At Chicago Fire FC, our mission is to entertain, serve, and unite Chicago through world-class experiences and a relentless pursuit of excellence. We are guided by our core values: Integrity, Respect, Innovation, Accountability, and a commitment to Never Settle.

If you're looking for a place where your work will matter, your ideas will be heard, and your career can grow alongside one of the most ambitious projects in professional sports, we'd love to hear from you.

Position Overview:  
The Coordinator, Ticket Operations supports the day-to-day execution of ticket operations for Chicago Fire FC, including ticketing systems, ticket inventory, reporting, payment processing, and matchday operations. 
 
This position serves as a key liaison between the Ticket Sales and Service team, Stadium, and Box Office, while helping ensure a high level of service for internal and external customers. The Coordinator will support the Club's current Ticketmaster Archtics environment while gaining exposure to SeatGeek Unify as Chicago Fire FC prepares for the opening of McDonald's Park in 2028. 
 
This role will report to the Director, Ticket Operations and will support matchday staff and temporary ticketing personnel as needed. 
 
Job Responsibilities: 
  • Process group and plan orders, print and pay all ticket orders as requested by Chicago Fire FC front office staff 
  • Build, maintain and develop a positive working relationship with all Ticketmaster and SeatGeek client support teams 
  • Work hand-in-hand with all Ticketmaster and SeatGeek client support staff regarding software management, troubleshooting system issues, event creation, event marketing and financial reporting 
  • Formulate and update existing daily, weekly, monthly and match day reports in a timely manner as assigned by the Director of Ticket Operations and MLS League Office 
  • Facilitate a complex network of payment plans, investigate and respond to any chargebacks related to ticket payments and work closely with the Ticket Services department to ensure account compliance 
  • Assist with the building of price codes, plans, promo codes, and other TM/Archtics and SeakGeek/Unify programming needs 
  • Assist in the set-up, trouble shooting and maintaining of events in Archtics and Host, and overtime, SeatGeek Unify  
  • Serve as a resource for all departments as it relates to Ticketmaster Advanced Products 
  • Help maintain a culture that’s focused on a high standard of customer service for both internal and external customers  
  • Maintain a positive, high performance culture in the Ticket Operations department, while building a positive rapport with all other departments on a daily basis 
  • Act as a higher point of contact for all elevated customer service occurrences on match day 
  • Assist with Will Call responsibilities and ticket troubleshooting needs on match day 
 
Required Qualifications: 
  • 2+ years of ticket operations experience  
  • Working knowledge of Ticketmaster Archtics preferred, and experience with SeatGeek Unify or another enterprise ticketing platform is a plus  
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel 
  • Experience with high level, time sensitive reporting 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with internal staff, venue personnel, and customers. 
  • Must have the ability to work independently without supervision, be self-directed and demonstrate initiative 
  • Ability to manage daily and weekly responsibilities with limited oversight 
  • Experience handling cash and balancing deposits is a plus 
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including but not limited to evenings, weekends and holidays  
 
Preferred Qualifications: 
  • Bachelor’s degree   
  • Experience working in professional sports, live entertainment, or venue operations  
  • Fluent in Spanish 
 
Compensation: 
  • This role offers a hourly range of $20.00 - $21.00, and is determined by carefully considering the applicant's background, experience, and qualifications. Base pay may vary significantly based on geographic location, job-specific knowledge, skills, and overall experience. This role is classified as Part-time, non-exempt 
  • Additional benefits & perks: Official Chicago Fire FC Website 

Please note: 
  • Chicago Fire FC is committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, accessibility, and inclusion. Our diversity initiatives start with the recruitment and selection process; therefore, we’d like to welcome all diverse candidates to apply to opportunities within our Club.  
  • CFFC is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and maintaining a workplace for employees and applicants for employment that is free from discrimination. The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, citizenship, age, veteran or military status, disability, sexual orientation, sexual orientation or expression, marital status or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, compensation, discipline, termination, and access to benefits and training.   
  • If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please contact the People and Culture Department at Peopleandculture@chicagofirefc.com to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.  
 
MLS Privacy Policy:  
  • By clicking apply, you agree to the terms of the MLS Privacy Policy.

job.html_description:

As one of Major League Soccer's original clubs, Chicago Fire FC is in the midst of an exciting era fueled by tremendous investment, ambition, and growth. With a new $100M state-of-the-art Endeavor Health Performance Center now open, new offices in Chicago's iconic Wrigley Building, and plans underway for a privately-funded $750M+ soccer-specific stadium set to open in 2028 in the heart of Chicago, the Club is building the future of soccer in one of the world's great sports cities.

If you're looking for a place where your work will matter, your ideas will be heard, and your career can grow alongside one of the most ambitious projects in professional sports, we'd love to hear from you.
 
Job Overview:
Chicago Fire Football Club is seeking a dedicated Athletic Trainer to join our team! Reporting to the Head of Physical Performance & Player Wellness (Academy & Fire II) and the Head of Medical, this individual will work closely with a wider multidisciplinary team to ensure optimal player care under the direction and supervision of Chief Medical Officer. The ideal candidate should be motivated to support developing soccer players, possessing a strong understanding of sports-related injuries and treatments. A successful candidate will possess excellent communication skills, a strong work ethic, and the ability to adapt to a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Job Responsibilities:
  • Provide daily medical coverage to selected Academy teams (U13 – U18) and support the MLSNP team as needed
  • Act as a Certified Athletic Trainer in managing the health care of players. Health care includes but is not limited to first aid/emergency care, on-site injury evaluation, application of appropriate modalities, developing rehabilitation and prevention programs, as well as conducting rehabilitation and making medical referrals
  • Setup, breakdown, field coverage, and clinic coverage as assigned
  • Maintain a complete and up-to-date roster of player health documents
  • Attend medical meetings to discuss reports, player progress, etc
  • Work in an interdisciplinary manner, being proactive with player care and holistic development
  • Play an active role in creating a professional environment within the Academy through player interactions, maintaining the standard, and driving club culture
  • Provide reports and communicate player updates to authorized personnel, parents, and Safeguard committee members
  • Demonstrate excellent interpersonal skills required to work effectively with players, coaches, other team personnel
  • Maintain safety and cleanliness of athletic training clinic daily
  • Travel and ability to work weekends/flexible hours required
  • Comply with OSHA standards regarding blood borne pathogens
  • Order, maintain, and manage inventory of supplies and clinical equipment
  • Keep athletic training room and clinic area safe, clean, and organized
  • Organize physical examinations as required by league regulations
  • Collaborate with Strength & Conditioning/Performance on data collected for athlete health & safety measure
  • Comply with all league medical policies & protocols
  • Perform other duties as assigned

 Required Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Athletic Training, Physical Therapy, or related health care field
  • Strong interpersonal & communication skills
  • CPR Certification for Health Care Provider
  • NATABOC (or CATA) Certified Athletic Trainer
  • In good standing with NATABOC
  • Ability to work non-traditional hours, in non-traditional settings, including all home games (or other work events) that fall on nights, weekends, and/or holidays
 
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Master’s Degree in Athletic Training, Physical Therapy or related health care field from a CAATE recognized school and valid state license
  • Minimum of 2 years’ experience as a certified Athletic Trainer
  • Preferred Certification: CSCS, PES, LMT
  • Strong knowledge and experience in Soccer
 
Compensation:  
  • This role offers a salary range of $55,000.00 - $60,000.00 
  • The final salary is determined by carefully considering the applicant's background, experience, and qualifications. Base pay may vary significantly based on geographic location, job-specific knowledge, skills, and overall experience. This role is classified as Full-time, exempt 
  • This role is bonus eligible based on club wide goals 
  • Additional benefits & perks: https://www.chicagofirefc.com/careers

Job Overview:
Chicago Fire Football Club is seeking a dedicated Athletic Trainer to join our team! Reporting to the Head of Physical Performance & Player Wellness (Academy & Fire II) and the Head of Medical, this individual will work closely with a wider multidisciplinary team to ensure optimal player care under the direction and supervision of Chief Medical Officer. The ideal candidate should be motivated to support developing soccer players, possessing a strong understanding of sports-related injuries and treatments. A successful candidate will possess excellent communication skills, a strong work ethic, and the ability to adapt to a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Job Responsibilities:
- Provide daily medical coverage to selected Academy teams (U13 – U18) and support the MLSNP team as needed - Act as a Certified Athletic Trainer in managing the health care of players. Health care includes but is not limited to first aid/emergency care, on-site injury evaluation, application of appropriate modalities, developing rehabilitation and prevention programs, as well as conducting rehabilitation and making medical referrals - Setup, breakdown, field coverage, and clinic coverage as assigned - Maintain a complete and up-to-date roster of player health documents - Attend medical meetings to discuss reports, player progress, etc - Work in an interdisciplinary manner, being proactive with player care and holistic development - Play an active role in creating a professional environment within the Academy through player interactions, maintaining the standard, and driving club culture - Provide reports and communicate player updates to authorized personnel, parents, and Safeguard committee members - Demonstrate excellent interpersonal skills required to work effectively with players, coaches, other team personnel - Maintain safety and cleanliness of athletic training clinic daily - Travel and ability to work weekends/flexible hours required - Comply with OSHA standards regarding blood borne pathogens - Order, maintain, and manage inventory of supplies and clinical equipment - Keep athletic training room and clinic area safe, clean, and organized - Organize physical examinations as required by league regulations - Collaborate with Strength & Conditioning/Performance on data collected for athlete health & safety measure - Comply with all league medical policies & protocols - Perform other duties as assigned
Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in Athletic Training, Physical Therapy, or related health care field - Strong interpersonal & communication skills - CPR Certification for Health Care Provider - NATABOC (or CATA) Certified Athletic Trainer - In good standing with NATABOC - Ability to work non-traditional hours, in non-traditional settings, including all home games (or other work events) that fall on nights, weekends, and/or holidays
Preferred Qualifications:
- Master’s Degree in Athletic Training, Physical Therapy or related health care field from a CAATE recognized school and valid state license - Minimum of 2 years’ experience as a certified Athletic Trainer - Preferred Certification: CSCS, PES, LMT - Strong knowledge and experience in Soccer

Position Overview:
The Director of Development and Foundation Programs provides direction for all fundraising, development, and programmatic initiatives of the Chicago Fire Foundation (CFF). This role will drive sustainable growth through diverse fundraising streams, innovative programming, and meaningful community partnerships that advance the Foundation’s mission to build a stronger, more inclusive Chicago.

The ideal candidate is a visionary leader, skilled fundraiser, and collaborative partner who thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. The Director, Development and Foundation Programs will report directly to the VP, Community Relations/Executive Director, Chicago Fire Foundation.

Job Responsibilities:
  • Develop and execute a comprehensive fundraising strategy encompassing individual, corporate, and foundation giving; grants; sponsorships; and special events.
  • Cultivate and steward donor, partner, and sponsor relationships to expand the Foundation’s network and revenue base.
  • Lead planning and execution of key fundraising events (e.g., Foundation Luncheon, White Party, etc.) with excellence.
  • Oversee fundraising communications to strengthen visibility, storytelling, and impact.
  • Lead the planning, implementation, and evaluation of all Foundation programs, including P.L.A.Y.S. and other signature initiatives.
  • Oversee data collection, tracking, and reporting to measure program outcomes and fundraising performance.
  • Serve as primary liaison to the Foundation Board Chair and Board of Directors, including oversight of meeting agendas, communications, and reporting.
  • Assist with oversight of department finances and fundraising including CFF budget management, forecasting, and revenue/expense tracking.
  • Supervise and mentor Foundation staff, fostering a collaborative, innovative, and mission-driven culture providing professional development and accountability for team members.
  • Work cross-functionally to integrate Foundation initiatives with broader club and community engagement strategies.
  • Complete other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications:
  • 6-8 years of experience in nonprofit development, fundraising, and/or program leadership.
  • Minimum 3 years of people management experience.
  • Proven track record in securing significant gifts, sponsorships, and grants.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Highly organized and detail oriented with the ability to work independently.
  • Strong project management, leadership, and budgeting skills.
  • Passion for community impact and alignment with the values and mission of Chicago Fire.
  • Ability to work non-traditional hours, in non-traditional settings, including all home games (or other work events) that fall on nights, weekends, and/or holidays. 

Preferred Qualifications:
  • Spanish language fluency
  • Bachelor’s degree in related field
  • Advanced degree or nonprofit management certification
  • Deep understanding of the Chicago philanthropic and community landscape
  • Experience working in a fast paced or start up environment

Compensation:
  • This role offers a salary range of $90,000-$100,000. Final salary is determined by carefully considering the applicant's background, experience, and qualifications. Base pay may vary significantly based on geographic location, job-specific knowledge, skills, and overall experience. This role is classified as Full-time, exempt.
  • This role is bonus eligible based on club-wide goals
  • Additional benefits & perks: Official Chicago Fire FC Website.

Position Overview:
Chicago Fire Football Club is seeking a dedicated Academy Assistant Coach to join our team! The Academy Assistant Coach will report to the Academy Head Coach. We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented individual that will work closely with our Academy players and support the Academy Youth Development Coaching Program.
 
Job Responsibilities:
  • In conjunction with Chicago Fire FC’s Developmental (MLS Next Pro and Academy) coaches, player development system, players, and standards of play: 
  • Support the design, implementation, and management of the Academy’s Youth Development Coaching Program
  • Assist the Academy Head Coach in the planning and execution of daily training sessions, games, and performance assessments
  • Assist and support Academy Head Coach in the general control, management, and conduct of Academy players, ensuring adherence to the Academy Code of Conduct
  • Liaise with the Academy management team in relation to the multi-disciplinary requirements of all Youth Development players at the Academy
  • Support player development and motivation by providing positive and constructive feedback that is delivered in an appropriate method 
  • Use session planning tools, individual performance planning, and video platform to ensure that all relevant player data is recorded
  • Demonstrate a willingness to further personal knowledge and development
  • Carry out responsibilities in accordance with the club’s policies and all applicable laws, particularly regarding the safeguarding of youth/minor players
  • Establish and implement the Club’s culture within the team, creating an environment that reflects the values and standards of the Chicago Fire FC
  • Other duties as assigned by the Academy Head Coach or Academy Technical Director 

Required Qualifications: 
  • Must possess a USSF B License or equivalent
  • Previous experience coaching in an amateur, professional level, or other reputable development team
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain positive, cross-functional relationships with stakeholders
  • Experience in utilizing and understanding Match Analysis
  • Demonstrated leadership and motivational skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • A strong sense of self-awareness and emotional intelligence
  • An understanding of the pressures and commitments required for youth players involved in high level youth soccer (or other elite youth sports development awareness)
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion when privy to sensitive information
  • Willingness to learn in a fast-paced, performance-driven work environment
  • Ability to work non-traditional hours, in non-traditional settings, including all home games (or other work events) that fall on nights, weekends, and/or holidays
 
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Must possess a USSF A License
  • Must possess a EFCL License
  • Bilingual (Spanish/English) or multi-lingual fluency 
 
Compensation:
  • This role offers a salary range of $55,000.00 - $65,000.00
  • Final salary is determined by carefully considering the applicant's background, experience, and qualifications. Base pay may vary significantly based on geographic location, job-specific knowledge, skills, and overall experience. This role is classified as Full-time, exempt
  • This role is bonus eligible based on club-wide goals

Position Overview: 
The Chicago Fire Football Club (CFFC) is seeking a highly motivated and responsible individual to deliver and/or assist in academic support for the u16 and u18 Academy Day Program for the Fall 2026 season, which runs from August through December (with a spring semester extension available).  
  
The Intern must be a role model to student athletes and work collaboratively with Academy staff. The person must embody the vision, mission, and core values of the Chicago Fire Football Club and needs to be adaptable and organized to effectively execute daily/weekly/monthly job tasks at the Endeavor Health Performance Center (Chicago, IL). 

Job Responsibilities:
  • Supervise and facilitate educational support in various academic spaces while encouraging the continued progress of the student athletes, (focus on high school core classes): Algebra, Chemistry, Geometry, Physics, and English  
  • Specialize in positive redirection and continued encouragement of completion of academic assignments  
  • Monitor players’ daily progress though core curriculum and encourage increased levels of productivity 
  • Frequently conduct 1:1 checks in with student athletes that have been falling behind in work completion  
  • Work with smaller groups of students for reinforcing the learning process  
  • Lead application and usage of tutoring resources provided by online schooling platforms and Chicago Fire Academy  
  • Report any alteration to student athletes’ behavior that may be cause for concern to coaches and additional Academy staff  
  • Support Academy staff in the delivery of any relevant mental performance, culture, and character-building initiatives  
  • Adaptable to changing work environment, location, and classroom size  
  • Daily attendance tracking  
  • Supportive in the communication of changing schedules, times, locations as they happen  
  • Aid the flow of student athletes from academic space to performance space in a timely manner  
 
Qualifications: 
  • Previous educational experience  
  • Ability to work independently on projects and work efficiently and effectively in group settings  
  • Strong understanding of Microsoft Office, Google Drive, Power Point/Slides and basic IT knowledge  
  • Must have reliable means of transport to commute throughout Chicagoland  
  • Ability to work non-traditional hours, in non-traditional settings, including all home games (or other work events) that fall on nights, weekends, and/or holidays  
  • Strong proven experience working with student athletes  
  • Familiarity with school administrative tasks and learning methods  
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Ability to remain composed, professional, and positive in a fast-paced environment

Preferred Qualifications:
  • Pursuing post-graduate degree in education, youth development, educational psychology, or counseling from accredited college or university
 
Compensation:
  • This role offers an hourly rate of $17.05

Position Overview:
The Chicago Fire Football Club (CFFC) is seeking a highly motivated and responsible individual to deliver and/or assist in academic support for the u16 and u18 Academy Day Program for the Fall 2026 season, which runs from August through December (with a spring semester extension available).
The Intern must be a role model to student athletes and work collaboratively with Academy staff. The person must embody the vision, mission, and core values of the Chicago Fire Football Club and needs to be adaptable and organized to effectively execute daily/weekly/monthly job tasks at the Endeavor Health Performance Center (Chicago, IL).
Job Responsibilities:
- Supervise and facilitate educational support in various academic spaces while encouraging the continued progress of the student athletes, (focus on high school core classes): Algebra, Chemistry, Geometry, Physics, and English - Specialize in positive redirection and continued encouragement of completion of academic assignments - Monitor players’ daily progress though core curriculum and encourage increased levels of productivity - Frequently conduct 1:1 checks in with student athletes that have been falling behind in work completion - Work with smaller groups of students for reinforcing the learning process - Lead application and usage of tutoring resources provided by online schooling platforms and Chicago Fire Academy - Report any alteration to student athletes’ behavior that may be cause for concern to coaches and additional Academy staff - Support Academy staff in the delivery of any relevant mental performance, culture, and character-building initiatives - Adaptable to changing work environment, location, and classroom size - Daily attendance tracking - Supportive in the communication of changing schedules, times, locations as they happen - Aid the flow of student athletes from academic space to performance space in a timely manner
Qualifications:
- Previous educational experience - Ability to work independently on projects and work efficiently and effectively in group settings - Strong understanding of Microsoft Office, Google Drive, Power Point/Slides and basic IT knowledge - Must have reliable means of transport to commute throughout Chicagoland - Ability to work non-traditional hours, in non-traditional settings, including all home games (or other work events) that fall on nights, weekends, and/or holidays - Strong proven experience working with student athletes - Familiarity with school administrative tasks and learning methods - Strong communication and organizational skills - Ability to remain composed, professional, and positive in a fast-paced environment
Preferred Qualifications:
- Pursuing post-graduate degree in education, youth development, educational psychology, or counseling from accredited college or university

- This role offers an hourly rate of $17.05

job.html_description:

At Chicago Fire FC, our mission is to entertain, serve, and unite Chicago through world-class experiences and a relentless pursuit of excellence. We are guided by our core values: Integrity, Respect, Innovation, Accountability, and a commitment to Never Settle.

If you're looking for a place where your work will matter, your ideas will be heard, and your career can grow alongside one of the most ambitious projects in professional sports, we'd love to hear from you.
 
Position Overview:
Chicago Fire Football Club is seeking a Maintenance Associate for Chicago Fire Pitch, the Club’s premier indoor/outdoor community soccer facility. Located on the north side of Chicago, Fire Pitch welcomes 300,000+ visitors each year, providing year-round playing opportunities for youth and adult players of all skill levels.

We aim to provide the best possible experience for our guests, and we are excited to welcome a Maintenance Associate to our team. With oversight and support from the Facility Manager, the focus for this position will be placed on delivering a safe, clean, friendly, soccer-first atmosphere on a daily basis.

 
Job Responsibilities:
The Maintenance Associate will work with the Facility Manager to execute the facility’s maintenance and operations plan. Specific duties include, but are not limited to:
  •  Oversee trash removal around the facility, maintaining a litter-free environment on the playing fields, in the parking lots, and all public-facing areas.
  •  Supplement work of vendors to ensure all aspects of the facility meet our high standard for cleanliness and safety.
  •  Perform general equipment maintenance, ensuring equipment is kept in good working order, reporting all significant mechanical issues to the Operations Manager.
  • Refill supplies throughout the facility as needed, including the restrooms, locker rooms, front desk, and office areas. Coordinate re-order needs with Facility Manager.
  •  Ensure closets, shed, off-site storage, and dumpster enclosure are kept clean and organized.
  • Assist snow removal process around seasonal dome, supporting Operations Manager and external snow removal team to ensure snow removal standards are met.
  • Perform all aspects of field maintenance, inclusive of grooming, line painting, and turf repairs.
  •  Participate in semi-annual dome conversion process, transitioning facility from outdoor-to-indoor in November, and from indoor-to-outdoor in April.
  •  Support all event operations efforts, including assistance with set-up, tear-down, and clean-up.
  •  Fulfill weekly Manager on Duty responsibilities, ensuring the facility runs in a smooth, professional, and safe manner during programming hours. MOD responsibilities require an ability to engage and interact with visitors throughout the facility.
  • Serve as Club ambassador, delivering passion for soccer and the Chicago Fire Football Club on a daily basis.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • 2+ years’ experience conducting maintenance and operation-oriented tasks preferred, previous experience working as a janitor/handyman a plus.
  •  Basic mechanical knowledge and enthusiasm for learning new skills.
  • Strong attention to detail is a must.
  •  Proactive self-starter, with a demonstrated history of problem solving.
  • No job is too big or too small – unafraid to get hands dirty, able to wear multiple hats, and at times work outside the job description.
  • Comfortable using power tools and machinery.
  •  Good communication skills and ability to quickly build relationships.
  •  Proven ability to interact and work within a team setting.
  • Well-organized with an ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
  • Punctuality, reliability, and flexibility are important in this fast-paced work environment.
  •  Comfortable in customer-facing situations, providing friendly customer service to both children and adults.
  • Desire to create an inclusive and cooperative work environment.
  • Passion for the Chicago Fire Football Club, MLS, and soccer as a whole.

Requirements
  • Must be able to work flexible hours - nights, weekends, and holidays are required.
  • This job consists of manual labor. Must have physical ability to lift 50 pounds and spend long hours on feet. Frequent bending, sitting, standing, exposure to elements (cold/heat), climbing ladders, walking, and carrying items.
  • Must have driver’s license. Access to vehicle strongly preferred.
  •  Forklift Certification or willingness to gain certification within specified time.

Compensation:
  • This role offers an hourly rate range of $20-22/hr (rate depends on qualifications, experience, education, etc.)
  •  This role is classified as Full-time, non-exempt
  • This role is bonus eligible based on individual and club-wide goals
  • Additional benefits & perks: https://www.chicagofirefc.com/careers

Please note:
  • Chicago Fire FC is committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, accessibility, and inclusion. Our diversity initiatives start with the recruitment and selection process; therefore, we’d like to welcome all diverse candidates to apply to opportunities within our Club.  
  • CFFC is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and maintaining a workplace for employees and applicants for employment that is free from discrimination. The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, citizenship, age, veteran or military status, disability, sexual orientation, sexual orientation or expression, marital status or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, compensation, discipline, termination, and access to benefits and training.   
  • If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please contact the People and Culture Department at peopleandculture@chicagofirefc.com to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.   

MLS Privacy Policy:  
  • By clicking apply, you agree to the terms of the MLS Privacy Policy

job.title: Chef de Partie (Part Time)
job.html_description:
Join Manchester City Women in a key culinary role supporting elite athletes with high-quality, performance-focused food preparation. Based at the Women’s 1st Team Facility in Manchester, this part-time role offers the opportunity to work in a collaborative environment focused on player wellbeing, recovery and performance.

 

Who We Are

 

At Manchester City Women, we are proud to be part of City Football Group and one of the leading clubs in women’s football, competing at the highest level in the Women’s Super League, domestic cups, and European competition. Based at the Etihad Campus in Manchester, our team is built on ambition, innovation, and a commitment to excellence both on and off the pitch. We are passionate about developing the women’s game, inspiring the next generation of players and fans, and fostering an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

 

Our Women’s Team facility team plays an important role in creating a high-performance environment where players and staff can thrive. From daily preparation to match travel support, the team works collaboratively to deliver an exceptional experience that supports health, wellbeing and performance.

 

The Role

 

As Chef de Partie, you will support the delivery of nutritious, high-quality meals tailored to the needs of elite athletes and staff. Working closely with the Head Chef, Sous Chef and Nutrition team, you will help ensure food preparation and presentation consistently meets the highest professional standards.

You will contribute to menu development, support smooth day-to-day kitchen operations and help maintain excellent hygiene and food safety practices. The role also includes supporting stock management, reducing waste and maintaining kitchen equipment and service areas.

This is a collaborative role where flexibility and teamwork are essential, including supporting domestic and international travel where required to provide team-standard catering services.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ Experience preparing and presenting food within a professional hospitality or elite sporting environment
⚽ Strong communication and customer service skills with the ability to build positive working relationships
⚽ Knowledge of food safety standards, including HACCP and Food Safety Level 3

⚽ Ability to organise workloads, manage priorities and adapt positively in a fast-paced environment
⚽ Creativity and attention to detail when preparing and presenting food
⚽ Experience supporting stock control, supplier management and minimising food waste

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City Women means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by Tuesday 22nd September 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group is committed to achieving workforce diversity and we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, national origin, race, age, sex, gender identity, disability - physical or hidden, sexual orientation, veteran status, religious belief, or any other characteristics protected by law. We provide a fully inclusive and accessible recruitment process. We encourage all applicants to reach out if they require any support or accommodations to enable them to thrive throughout our recruitment process. Please contact Hiring@cityfootball.com. Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: MCFC Education Tutor
job.html_description:
Based at the City Football Academy in Manchester, this fixed-term, part-time role supports the planning, teaching and administration of education programmes for players across the Professional Development Phase and beyond. Working predominantly four afternoons and one morning each week, you will help players stay on track with their learning through high-quality teaching, tailored support and close collaboration with schools and internal stakeholders.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within our Academy Education Team, we support players as they balance football with study, creating a learning environment that is well-planned, carefully tracked and firmly connected to each player’s development. We work closely with academy colleagues, schools, colleges and families to make sure every learner has the support they need to progress.

 

The Role

 

You will take ownership of education delivery for players in the Professional Development Phase, helping them achieve their target grades while keeping their wider football commitments in view. The role combines teaching, assessment and planning, with a strong focus on making learning relevant, motivating and properly supported.

A key part of the job is delivering BTEC Sport and other appropriate qualifications, then keeping progress under review through accurate tracking, reporting and day-to-day administration.

 

You will help identify where extra support is needed and work with others to put practical plans in place that keep players moving forward.

 

This is a collaborative role with regular contact across the academy, schools, colleges and other stakeholders involved in each player’s development. You will need a flexible approach to working around training schedules and academy commitments, while contributing positively to the Academy values of Graft, Pride, Ambition and Respect.

 

What You'll Bring

 

 

⚽Experience teaching or tutoring young people in an education, academy, sport or post-16 setting.

⚽A recognised teaching qualification such as PGCE, QTS or QTLS, or equivalent relevant professional qualification.

⚽Knowledge of BTEC Sport and/or other relevant education programmes, with the ability to plan, deliver and assess learning effectively.

⚽Organisational skills and confidence managing reports, records, deadlines and day-to-day administration accurately.

⚽Clear communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively with players, schools, families and colleagues.

⚽Confidence using Microsoft Office and digital tools, with a flexible approach to working around training schedules and academy commitments.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 22nd September 2026 We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview.

 

If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team.

 

Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Product Designer
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester, this permanent role gives you the opportunity to shape new product ideas before they move into scaled technology delivery. Working across prototypes, journeys and early concept validation, you will help turn strategy into clear, testable and technically considered product experiences that are ready for build.

 

Who We Are

 

Founded in 2013, City Football Group is the world’s leading private owner and operator of football clubs, with teams across the globe connected by a shared belief in doing things differently. Alongside our clubs, we invest in football-related businesses and build partnerships that help the game, and the communities around it, thrive. Everything we do is guided by our purpose: empowering better lives through football. Rooted in more than a century of “City” football, we are proud of the role our clubs play locally and globally, creating positive impact on and off the pitch.

 

Within our Product team, we work to turn approved ideas into experiences that are clear, useful and ready for delivery. This role sits close to Product Managers, Technology Solutions and operational colleagues, helping us reduce ambiguity early, test assumptions quickly and make sure product concepts are well defined before scaled implementation begins.

 

The Role

 

The Product Designer will work with Product Managers and operational colleagues to explore new opportunities, understand customer and business needs, and turn early ideas into clearly defined product concepts.

 

You will use journey mapping, service mapping, wireframes, interaction models and prototypes to make ideas tangible, testable and easier to understand.

 

A key part of the role is working closely with Technology Solutions and engineers to assess feasibility, explore solution options and identify constraints, dependencies, risks and likely delivery effort.

 

You will help translate product vision into a shared understanding of how a solution could work, what needs to be built and where further investigation or development is required.

 

You will support the transition from discovery into scaled delivery by clearly articulating the problem, proposed experience, requirements and technical considerations.

 

Acting as a translator between Product and Technology Solutions, you will help improve product readiness, reduce rework and give delivery teams a stronger foundation from which to build scalable products. 

 

What You’ll Bring

 

You will be a collaborative and pragmatic product thinker who can connect customer experience, product strategy, operational reality and technology delivery. You will be comfortable working in ambiguity, communicating with a wide range of stakeholders and helping teams turn good ideas into well-defined opportunities.

 

⚽ Experience shaping digital products, services, user journeys or customer experiences within product, digital, commerce or technology environments.

⚽ Strong capability in discovery, ideation, journey mapping, service mapping, wireframing, interaction design, prototyping and concept validation.

⚽ The ability to translate between business, product, design and technology audiences, making complex ideas clear and creating shared understanding.

⚽ Experience working with Product Managers, engineers, architects or technology teams to explore feasibility, shape requirements and define potential solutions.

⚽ Strong technical understanding to identify dependencies, constraints, risks and implications of design decisions, without needing to be an engineer.

⚽ A structured, clear and pragmatic approach to problem-solving, with the confidence to challenge assumptions, use insight and data to refine concepts, and identify what must be understood before a project is ready for build.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at City Football Group means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 22 September 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Football Coach UAE - Manchester City Football Education
job.html_description:
Closing Date: 16 September 2026
Assessment Date: 26 September 2026

Assessment Location: City Football Academy, Manchester

 

Based in the United Arab Emirates, this full-time opportunity offers coaches the chance to take their career onto a global stage with Manchester City. You will help deliver high-quality coaching programmes while developing your own coaching identity within a diverse and fast-growing football environment. It is an opportunity to learn, grow and contribute to a world-class football organisation, gaining international experience while making a meaningful impact on player development.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Our Football Education team delivers programmes around the world, bringing Manchester City’s coaching philosophy to life across a range of environments. In the UAE, our programmes continue to grow, offering coaches the chance to work in a dynamic, multicultural setting while supporting the development of players of all abilities.

 

The Role

 

You will join a collaborative coaching team delivering programmes that reflect Manchester City’s coaching philosophy, standards and approach. Working across a range of age groups and abilities, you will help create engaging, high-quality sessions that support both player development and enjoyment of the game.

 

Alongside delivery, you will contribute to the ongoing development of programmes by supporting session planning, reviews and continuous improvement. You will work closely with colleagues to ensure consistency in delivery, while also adapting your approach to meet the needs of different players and environments.

 

You will also play an important role in representing Manchester City both on and off the pitch, building positive relationships with players, families and local stakeholders, and contributing to wider programme activations across the region.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ FA Level 2 or UEFA C coaching qualification (minimum)
⚽ Membership of a recognised FA or international equivalent
⚽ Experience delivering coaching sessions within a football environment
⚽ Ability to communicate clearly and build positive relationships with players and colleagues
⚽ Experience working with players from a range of backgrounds and abilities
⚽ Commitment to learning, development and continuous improvement

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at City Football Group means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

This role offers a comprehensive international relocation package, including housing, medical cover, transport allowance, flights and visa sponsorship, alongside the opportunity to gain valuable global coaching experience.

 

Find out more about our UAE programs

 

  • Abu Dhabi Cup 2025
    https://www.mancity.com/city-football-schools/abu-dhabi-cup/venue
  • Abu Dhabi League 2024
    https://www.mancity.com/city-football-schools/abu-dhabi-league
  • Manchester City Football Schools – UAE
    https://www.mancity.com/learn-football/football-school-united-arab-emirates

 

Follow us

 

  • Man City Abu Dhabi League
    https://www.instagram.com/cityabudhabileague/profilecard/?igsh=Z3UzcjlwbzBid21p
  • City Football Schools – UAE
    https://www.instagram.com/cityfootballschools/profilecard/?igsh=MTZ2bDlwZHplM3Y2
  • Man City Abu Dhabi Cup
    https://www.instagram.com/abudhabicup

 

How to Apply

 

If you’re ready to take the next step in your coaching career and explore an international opportunity with Manchester City, we’d love to hear from you. Please click Apply and submit your CV by 25 August.

 

The assessment day will take place on Saturday 29 August 2026 or Saturday 5 September 2026 at the City Football Academy, Manchester.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Casual Academy Driver
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester, this casual role supports the Academy transport programme by safely moving players and, where required, staff between their homes, schools, training venues, match locations and other approved destinations. Working hours vary with the Academy training and fixture schedule, including evenings, weekends and early-morning or daytime shifts, so the role suits someone who can bring reliability, flexibility and a calm professional approach.

 

Weekend and evening availability is an essential requirement.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within our Academy transport team, we play an important part in helping young players travel safely and reliably as they move between home, school, training and fixtures. The department works closely with colleagues across the Academy to create a dependable, well-run service that supports both the daily routine and the wider development environment.

 

The Role

 

This role is central to the smooth running of Academy transport. You will help ensure players, staff and other authorised passengers travel safely, on time and in line with the standards expected across Manchester City, making sure every journey is delivered with care, professionalism and respect.

 

Your day-to-day work will include following approved routes and transport instructions, carrying out vehicle checks, keeping the vehicle clean and presentable, using satellite navigation and journey-planning systems, and completing the administrative tasks that help keep operations organised. The work is varied and can include early starts, evenings, weekends and matchday travel depending on the Academy schedule.

 

You will also work closely with colleagues, families, players and visitors, sharing updates clearly, reporting delays or incidents promptly and following safeguarding, health and safety and transport procedures at all times. In doing so, you will help create a reliable service that supports the Academy environment and the young people who rely on it.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

  • A valid UK driving licence and the ability to meet the role’s licence-check and insurer requirements
  • Availability to work evenings, weekends, early mornings and other variable shifts in line with Academy needs.
  • Clear and effective communication skills when working with young people, families, colleagues and visitors.
  • Confidence using satellite navigation, journey-planning tools and basic Microsoft Office or administrative systems.
  • A professional, safeguarding-aware approach, with attention to detail in vehicle checks, cleanliness and records.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Casual Football Coach - Perth, MCFC Football Education Australia
job.html_description:
Based in Perth, Australia, this casual role gives you the chance to deliver engaging football education sessions for children across the Manchester City Perth Football Education Program. You will help create a positive, inclusive and development-focused environment where young players can enjoy the game, build confidence and learn through high-quality coaching.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within the Manchester City Perth Football Education Program, we deliver football experiences that are welcoming, well-structured and enjoyable for children and families across Western Australia. Our coaches play an important part in bringing the Club's philosophy to life through sessions that support confidence, learning and a love of the game.

 

The Role

 

This role sits at the heart of the Perth program and is focused on delivering high-quality football education sessions for children in a way that feels inclusive, fun and purposeful. You will help young players develop their skills, enjoy their football and feel supported in an environment that reflects Manchester City's coaching values.

 

You will plan and deliver age-appropriate sessions aligned to the Manchester City coaching philosophy and curriculum, working across multiple venues in Perth as required. Day to day, you will keep sessions organised, safe and engaging, while also supporting player progress through simple reporting, reflection and feedback.

 

You will work closely with the Head Coach and wider programme team to maintain consistent standards and a positive experience for children, parents and carers. This role also involves communicating clearly with families, contributing to programme improvement and taking part in ongoing learning and development as the programme grows.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ A recognised coaching qualification, with a minimum UEFA C or AFC C Licence.

⚽ Experience coaching children or young players in a grassroots, community or football education setting.

⚽ Ability to plan and deliver inclusive, engaging sessions that support enjoyment, learning and confidence.

⚽ Clear and effective communication skills when working with children, parents, carers and colleagues.

⚽ Ability to work flexibly across afternoons, evenings and weekends, and to travel between Perth venues as required.

⚽ A valid Western Australian Working With Children Check, or willingness to obtain one, together with the ability to work exclusively for Manchester City in Western Australia and not with other football or coaching organisations while in this role.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our Perth Football Education Program, you will have the opportunity to coach within a global football environment that values player development, inclusion and quality delivery. You will be supported to bring the Manchester City coaching philosophy to life for children and families across Western Australia.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

Please note that successful applicants will be expected to work exclusively for Manchester City in Western Australia and not provide coaching services for other football or coaching organisations while engaged in this role.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in Australia.

Due to our safeguarding promise, all Perth-based CFG roles will be subject to any relevant safeguarding or working-with-children checks required for the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Heating Ventilation Air Conditioning Engineer
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester, this permanent role plays an important part in keeping our campus facilities running safely, reliably and to a high standard. You will help maintain and support the mechanical and HVAC systems that underpin day-to-day operations, contributing to a well-managed environment for colleagues and visitors across City Football Group. This role includes occasional weekend and evening work to support football fixtures and events.

 

Who We Are

 

Founded in 2013, City Football Group is the world’s leading private owner and operator of football clubs, with teams across the globe connected by a shared belief in doing things differently. Alongside our clubs, we invest in football-related businesses and build partnerships that help the game, and the communities around it, thrive. Everything we do is guided by our purpose: empowering better lives through football. Rooted in more than a century of “City” football, we are proud of the role our clubs play locally and globally, creating positive impact on and off the pitch.

 

Within our maintenance team, we look after the systems and spaces that help the site operate smoothly every day. We work with care, pace and accountability, bringing together practical expertise and collaboration to support a safe, reliable and high-quality environment across the campus.

 

The Role

 

At City Football Group, the maintenance team plays a vital part in keeping our buildings and plant in excellent working order. As Heating Ventilation Air Conditioning Engineer, you will help deliver the maintenance services that support safe, efficient operations across the campus, with a clear focus on standards, safety and reliability.

 

Your work will cover planned preventive maintenance, reactive maintenance and day-to-day inspection of heating, ventilation and air conditioning assets. You will respond promptly to breakdowns, fault-find carefully and support minor installation, upgrade and adaptation works where needed.

 

Working closely with other trades and Maintenance Managers, you will contribute to planned maintenance and life cycle schedules for the buildings on site. This is a hands-on role where good judgement, teamwork and a consistent approach all help keep the campus operating at its best.

 

What You’ll Bring

 NVQ Level 3 in HVAC, Mechanical Engineering or an equivalent qualification

 Valid F-Gas Category 1 certification

 NVQ Level 2 or Level 3 in Refrigeration and Air Conditioning, or an equivalent qualification

 Experience maintaining commercial air conditioning and refrigeration systems

 Experience carrying out planned preventive maintenance and reactive maintenance

 Ability to diagnose faults and respond safely to breakdowns, with a sound understanding of HVAC controls and building services

 

We are also keen to hear from applicants who have the following skills;

  • BMS Knowledge
  • IPAF Licence.
  • PASMA Certification.
  • Experience using CAFM systems.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at City Football Group means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 1 September 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We will review applications after the closing date and contact shortlisted candidates about the next stage of the process.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.
