job.title: Etihad Stadium Facilities Supervisor
job.html_description:
Based at the Etihad Stadium in Manchester, this permanent, full time Facilities Supervisor role plays a key part in keeping the site safe, welcoming and operating to a high standard for colleagues, partners and visitors. Working on a 5 days over 7 pattern with regular evenings and weekends, you will help deliver excellent facilities support across a busy multi-use environment.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Our Facilities Management team helps keep the Etihad Stadium and wider site ready for the many different demands of each day and each season. From maintaining safe, clean and welcoming spaces to supporting matchday preparation, contractor coordination and guest standards, the team plays an important part in creating a professional environment that works for everyone who uses it.

 

The Role

 

This role sits at the heart of day-to-day site operations, helping to make sure facilities services are delivered to a high standard and that the building environment supports colleagues, partners and customers. You will help maintain the quality, safety and consistency of the site, bringing a practical and thoughtful approach to the work that keeps everything running smoothly.

 

Your focus will include daily checks and operational support across cleaning, health and safety, building maintenance, grounds, security and energy management. You will also help coordinate planning and day-to-day use of the site, support accommodation standards, contribute to audits and inspections, and work alongside others to make sure facilities meet the needs of a varied and busy environment.

 

You will work closely with colleagues, partners and contractors, helping to build positive relationships and support continuous improvement across the site. The role also involves supporting the wider Facilities Management team on meetings, events, infrastructure projects and matchday or safety-related activity when required, so flexibility, good judgement and clear communication are important throughout.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ Experience in facilities management or a similar supervisory role within a multi-faceted building or operational environment.

⚽ Ability to supervise and support cleaning, security or other site service teams to maintain high standards.

⚽ Clear and effective communication skills, with the confidence to influence colleagues, contractors and stakeholders.

⚽ Good computer literacy, with the ability to maintain records, complete administration and produce reports accurately.

⚽ Ability to manage day-to-day operations, follow procedures and contribute to continuous improvement.

⚽ A good standard of education or relevant qualifications, with the flexibility to work a 5 days over 7 pattern including regular evenings and weekends.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 13 September 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

The selection process is expected to include TA screening and CV review, an initial informal introductory call, and a second-stage task-based assessment and face-to-face interview.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Real Estate PMO Manager
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester on a hybrid, permanent basis, this senior PMO role will bring structure, governance and executive clarity to a global real estate and infrastructure portfolio. You will work directly with project directors and regional leads across Europe and the rest of the world, turning complex project, risk and finance information into insight the business can use to steer delivery with confidence.

 

Who We Are

 

Founded in 2013, City Football Group is the world’s leading private owner and operator of football clubs, with teams across the globe connected by a shared belief in doing things differently. Alongside our clubs, we invest in football-related businesses and build partnerships that help the game, and the communities around it, thrive. Everything we do is guided by our purpose: empowering better lives through football. Rooted in more than a century of “City” football, we are proud of the role our clubs play locally and globally, creating positive impact on and off the pitch.

 

Our Global Real Estate team enables the planning and delivery of capital and infrastructure projects across the City Football Group network. The PMO sits close to senior project directors helping bring together information from different territories, systems and delivery teams so there is one clear view of progress, risk and governance across the portfolio.

 

The Role

 

This is a hands-on PMO position with real influence across a complex infrastructure portfolio. Alongside consolidating reporting: you will help shape how information is understood, how methodology is optimized and how governance is adhered to.  You will use your experience in construction or real estate development to add insight and impact.

 

Working with project directors, project teams, and external project consultants, you will bring together data in standardised reporting templates, controls and meeting rhythms, while keeping a close eye on risks, actions and delivery issues.

 

The role will suit someone who wants to stay close to live projects, understand the detail and turn technical information into something clear, actionable and decision-ready. You will use your judgement to spot gaps, improve ways of working and support a PMO environment that sets the pace for delivery rather than reflecting it.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

  • A recognised PMO, project management or project controls qualification, or equivalent senior experience, with the ability to interpret complex information and present it clearly for senior audiences.
  • Significant PMO, project controls or portfolio management experience within construction or a real estate environment.
  • Proven ability to work with project directors and senior stakeholders, optimizing methodology, embedding governance and supporting delivery risks.  
  • Experience producing board, finance or executive reporting, with confidence turning technical detail into clear, structured insight.
  • Strong understanding of risk management, portfolio controls, templates and standardised reporting processes.
  • Comfort working across different technologies, organisational systems and consultants, with good judgement and attention to detail.

 

 

Why Choose Us

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 13 September 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

Rooted in more than a century of “City” football, we are proud of the role our clubs play locally and globally, creating positive impact on and off the pitch.
Our Global Real Estate team enables the planning and delivery of capital and infrastructure projects across the City Football Group network. The PMO sits close to senior project directors helping bring together information from different territories, systems and delivery teams so there is one clear view of progress, risk and governance across the portfolio.
The Role
This is a hands-on PMO position with real influence across a complex infrastructure portfolio. Alongside consolidating reporting: you will help shape how information is understood, how methodology is optimized and how governance is adhered to. You will use your experience in construction or real estate development to add insight and impact.
Working with project directors, project teams, and external project consultants, you will bring together data in standardised reporting templates, controls and meeting rhythms, while keeping a close eye on risks, actions and delivery issues.
The role will suit someone who wants to stay close to live projects, understand the detail and turn technical information into something clear, actionable and decision-ready. You will use your judgement to spot gaps, improve ways of working and support a PMO environment that sets the pace for delivery rather than reflecting it.
What You’ll Bring
- A recognised PMO, project management or project controls qualification, or equivalent senior experience, with the ability to interpret complex information and present it clearly for senior audiences. - Significant PMO, project controls or portfolio management experience within construction or a real estate environment. - Proven ability to work with project directors and senior stakeholders, optimizing methodology, embedding governance and supporting delivery risks. - Experience producing board, finance or executive reporting, with confidence turning technical detail into clear, structured insight. - Strong understanding of risk management, portfolio controls, templates and standardised reporting processes. - Comfort working across different technologies, organisational systems and consultants, with good judgement and attention to detail.
Why Choose Us
As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.
Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.
You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.
How to Apply
If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 13 September 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.
We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.
Equal Opportunities
City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.
We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

job.title: Recruitment Coaching and Development Manager - Junior Academy
job.html_description:
Based at City Football Academy in Manchester, this permanent full-time role leads the planning, delivery and development of recruitment coaching across the Junior Academy. You will shape the quality of sessions, support and mentor recruitment coaches, and help ensure every stage of the recruitment pathway reflects the Academy's coaching philosophy, player development model and talent identification priorities.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within the Junior Academy, our recruitment environment plays an important role in identifying and supporting young players with the potential to thrive in the City pathway. This team works closely with coaching, talent identification and family contacts to make sure the experience is well organised, development focused and aligned to the standards of the Club.

 

The Role

 

The Recruitment Coaching and Development Manager will lead the day-to-day delivery of recruitment coaching across the Junior Academy, setting a clear standard for session quality, organisation and player experience. The role sits at the centre of the recruitment pathway, helping to make sure coaching delivery supports both talent identification and long-term player development.

 

You will manage and coordinate the local Recruitment Coaching team, plan and deliver recruitment sessions and events, and allocate appropriately qualified coaches across the programme. A key part of the role is supporting and mentoring coaches through observation, feedback and ongoing development, while also keeping coaching records, online systems and session logging accurate and up to date.

 

Working closely with the Academy Talent ID team, you will help ensure that coaches understand profiling requirements, reporting standards and selection criteria. You will also act as a clear and approachable link for parents within the recruitment phase, sharing information, gathering feedback and helping the team continually improve how the pathway is delivered.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

  • FA Advanced Youth Award and UEFA B Licence, with FA Talent Identification Level 2 or equivalent
  • Experience working within an academy or structured player development environment
  • Experience leading or coordinating coaching staff and supporting their development
  • Ability to deliver high-quality coaching sessions in line with a clear player development framework
  • Clear and effective communication skills, including confidence working with parents and young players
  • Strong organisation and administrative skills, with the ability to plan multiple recruitment activities and use online systems accurately

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 17 September 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Head of Internal Communications
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester on a 12 month fixed term contract to cover maternity leave, this senior Internal Communications role will lead the function across City Football Group, connecting colleagues to our commitments, culture and ambitions. 

 

Who We Are 

 

Founded in 2013, City Football Group is a global football organisation with clubs, teams and businesses across the world, connected by a shared belief in the power of football and sport to bring people together. 

 

Our People Team supports colleagues and leaders across CFG to create an inclusive, high-performing environment where people can do their best work. Internal Communications plays an important role in connecting our global workforce to CFG’s strategy, culture and everyday activity. 

 

The Role 

 

As Head of Internal Communications, you will lead and deliver the CFG Internal Communications plan, aligned to business and People priorities. You will establish a strong communications rhythm across the organisation, balancing planned activity with emerging business needs and ensuring communications are clear, engaging and appropriate for different employee audiences. 

 

You will act as a trusted communications adviser to senior leaders, providing counsel on messaging, employee communications and engagement, including complex, sensitive and high-profile matters. You will lead and develop a small Internal Communications team, set priorities, maintain high standards and oversee internal video production, digital content and key employee communications. 

 

You will also lead employee listening and feedback, support the development and activation of CFG’s employee value proposition and employee brand, manage Internal Communications spend and build strong relationships with Communications and People teams across CFG’s clubs and locations. You will identify responsible, practical opportunities to use AI and emerging technologies to improve efficiency and impact. 

 

What You’ll Bring 

 

  • Senior-level Internal Communications experience within a complex, multi-stakeholder organisation, combining strategic leadership with hands-on delivery. 

  • Experience developing and delivering Internal Communications strategies and plans aligned to organisational and People priorities. 

  • Credibility and judgement to advise and influence senior leaders on complex and high-profile communications. 

  • Experience leading and developing a communications team, setting clear priorities and maintaining high standards of delivery. 

  • Excellent written, verbal and editorial communication skills, with the ability to translate complex information into clear, engaging and audience-appropriate communications. 

  • Knowledge of communications channels, content planning and multimedia production, including overseeing video and digital content. 

 

Why Choose Us 

 

Working at City Football Group means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to creating an inclusive and collaborative environment where people can contribute, grow and make an impact. 

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus where applicable. 

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs. 

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store and a free City+ subscription. 

 

How to Apply 

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 14 September 2026. We encourage you to apply early as we may close the role before the advertised closing date if sufficient applications are received. 

 

The recruitment process for this role will be a two stage process. 

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application. 

 

Equal Opportunities 

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or any other protected characteristic. 

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the recruitment process and encourage you to let us know if you need any adjustments. Please contact Hiring@cityfootball.com if you require support. 

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email addresses claiming to represent CFG, please treat them as fraudulent. 

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to an appropriate DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the role.

job.title: Casual Applied Data Analyst
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester, this part-time, casual role is a great opportunity for a current Master’s or PhD student to gain hands-on experience in applied data analysis within an elite sporting environment. You will support Manchester City Women’s Performance Services team by helping to collect, clean, analyse and report on health and performance data that informs day-to-day decision-making and supports player availability and on-pitch performance.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City Women is a team driven by ambition, belief and a desire to keep pushing the game forward. Founded in 1988 and relaunched in 2014, we have grown into a consistent force in the women’s game, competing at the highest level in the UK and Europe. Progress, performance and pride sit at the heart of everything we do. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are building what comes next, the City way.

Within our Performance Services team, we work closely with practitioners and CFG Football Intelligence colleagues to support player health, physical performance and decision-making through reliable data and meaningful insight. We are focused on building clear, well-governed reporting that helps the team make informed decisions every day.

 

The Role

 

This role plays an important part in helping our Performance Services team capture, manage and interpret the data that supports player health and physical performance. You will work with practitioners to make sure information is accurate, timely and well organised, giving the team confidence in the data they use to inform decisions.

Day to day, you will support the collection, cleaning, validation and analysis of performance data from core systems, tests and outputs. You will help maintain athlete management systems, produce clear reports and summaries, and contribute to the development of frameworks and methods that make our analysis more useful in practice.

You will also work closely with Manchester City Women’s Performance Services team and CFG Football Intelligence colleagues to turn data into practical insight, with a particular focus on female athlete health and performance. Careful handling of sensitive information, clear communication and a thoughtful approach to context will all be central to how you support the wider team.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽You will be a careful, collaborative and curious analyst who enjoys working with data in a performance environment. You will be comfortable balancing detail with pace, communicating clearly and turning information into practical insight for practitioners.

⚽Currently studying towards a relevant Master’s degree or PhD in a quantitative discipline such as data science, sports science, statistics, mathematics, computer science, epidemiology or a related area.

⚽An understanding of core data-analysis and statistical concepts.

⚽ Experience using at least one analytical tool or programming language, such as Python, R, SQL, MATLAB or a similar platform.

⚽ Competence using Microsoft Excel or similar spreadsheet software for data cleaning, organisation and analysis.

⚽ Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to a non-technical audience and work collaboratively with a range of practitioners.

⚽A careful, methodical approach to data entry, validation and quality assurance, with the ability to organise work effectively and manage recurring tasks alongside academic commitments.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by Wednesday 23rd September. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: 2025 Marketing Matchday Activation Intern
job.html_description:
Columbus Crew Job Opportunity



Description

Do you have a passion for marketing, promotions, and fan development? The Columbus Crew is looking for outgoing and engaging college students to serve as Marketing Matchday Activation interns for the 2025 MLS season. This position provides a variety of sports-marketing related learning experiences, specifically in event production and fan experience.

 

Opportunities & Responsibilities
  • Execute matchday activations including coordinating with on-site vendors, placing banners, setting up tents, tables, and running supporter engagement stations
  • Demonstrate and maintain Crew brand standards while serving as an ambassador of the brand
  • Assist in executing in-match experiences, halftime contests and pre/post-match activations
  • Provide a fun, entertaining and positive experience by interacting and engaging with Lower.com Field guests
  • Promote the Crew by creating a positive and exciting atmosphere while interacting with guests, sponsors, and supporters
  • Assist guests with various Matchday elements
  • Assist with additional Crew grassroots and marketing events as needed

 

Required skills, experience & abilities
  • Available for the entire 2025 MLS Season
  • Max of 20 hours per match week paid hourly
  • Must be a minimum of 18 years of age and an active student or recent graduate of a college or university program
  • Ability to attend ALL regular and post-season Crew home matches, including evening and weekend assignments
  • Must be able to lift and maneuver a minimum of 50 pounds
  • Must be able to climb ladders, carry, walk, sit, push, pull and move continuously during work hours
  • Must be able to work outdoors in varying weather conditions
  • Ability to communicate effectively with a diverse population, including strong verbal communication skills. Customer service experience a plus
  • Able to work independently and with a team
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays

- Execute matchday activations including coordinating with on-site vendors, placing banners, setting up tents, tables, and running supporter engagement stations - Demonstrate and maintain Crew brand standards while serving as an ambassador of the brand - Assist in executing in-match experiences, halftime contests and pre/post-match activations - Provide a fun, entertaining and positive experience by interacting and engaging with Lower.com Field guests - Promote the Crew by creating a positive and exciting atmosphere while interacting with guests, sponsors, and supporters - Assist guests with various Matchday elements - Assist with additional Crew grassroots and marketing events as needed
Required skills, experience & abilities
- Available for the entire 2025 MLS Season - Max of 20 hours per match week paid hourly - Must be a minimum of 18 years of age and an active student or recent graduate of a college or university program - Ability to attend ALL regular and post-season Crew home matches, including evening and weekend assignments - Must be able to lift and maneuver a minimum of 50 pounds - Must be able to climb ladders, carry, walk, sit, push, pull and move continuously during work hours - Must be able to work outdoors in varying weather conditions - Ability to communicate effectively with a diverse population, including strong verbal communication skills. Customer service experience a plus - Able to work independently and with a team - Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment - Ability to work a flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays

job.title: Director, Guest Experience
job.html_description:
Description
Columbus Crew is seeking a Director, Guest Experience that will be responsible for all guests and team members receiving world class experience when visiting all venues operated by the Columbus Crew. Under the direction of the Vice President, Operations, the Director oversees the day-to-day and event operations of the Guest Experience department ensuring the safety and comfort for all through strong training programs, policies, and procedures.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities
  • Guest Experience
    • Responsible for all Guest Experience operations across all Club facilities and events; including but not limited to Columbus Crew matches, future Columbus NWSL matches, concerts, third-party events, etc.
    • Lead an informed, motivated, and energetic staff and maintain a consistent focus on curating a best-in-class experience throughout every Club and third-party event.
    • Maintain cross-departmental connection to ensure the Guest Experience staff and general processes are supporting and enhancing broader club focuses and initiatives
    • Monitor all channels of guest communication (email, telephone, in-person, guest survey, and social media). Provide reports, identify trends and institute operational improvements. 
    • Ensure that guest information channels always have the appropriate information (Stadium Maps, Know Before You Go, Columbus Crew social media accounts and Columbus Crew website).
    • Collaborate with Safety and Security leadership to maintain emergency preparedness and have a working knowledge of all applicable safety regulations and security procedures for Columbus Crew Venues
  • Recruitment and Training
    • Develop department training and staffing plan based on service strategy, event budget and staffing matrix in collaboration with Vice President, Operations. Identify appropriate staffing levels, recruitment processes, and desired target areas to maintain the highest level of retention and service. 
    • Develop and conduct an effective and efficient recruiting, interviewing and onboarding program
    • Develop, maintain, and facilitate (as appropriate) department new hire and veteran training programs, create specialty training programs for supervisors, specialty positions and team member development opportunities. Maintain a strong presence with the service department management and frontline team members. 
  • Team Member Management
    • Create and consistently emphasize a service strategy to empower team members to provide world class service and meet organizational goals. 
    • Foster a fun and fulfilling work environment for team members.
    • Oversee scheduling and payroll on a weekly basis.
    • Create and implement staff incentive programs.
  • Effectively communicate with frontline team members to establish policies, procedures, standards, expectations, goals, and objectives.
  • Ensure fair, consistent, and timely enforcement of policies and procedures (including tracking call-offs, no-shows and overall attendance)
  • Conduct ongoing performance coaching and evaluation, identifying growth opportunities.
 
Required Skills and Experience
  • Minimum of 3 -5 years leadership experience managing teams of PT frontline event staff. Preferably, in a public assembly facility.
  • Minimum four-year college degree or equivalent experience.
  • Exceptional customer service and leadership skills, including but not limited to de-escalation, service recovery, coaching, people management, recruitment, training, and the ability to motivate a diverse workforce. 
  • Must possess strong problem solving, analysis and communication skills, both written and oral. 
  • Extremely organized, detail-orientated and able to multi-task in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Must be able to create and deliver informative and engaging presentations to large groups of people.
  • Ability to read, interpret, update, and create training programs utilizing documents such as strategy documents, safety rules, operating and maintenance guides, application instructions, and procedure manuals.
  • Familiarity with payroll and scheduling systems 
  • Clear understanding and implementation of all department and company policies and procedures
  • Must be available on varied schedules including nights, weekends, and holidays. 
  • Ability to walk, stand, and climb stairs and ramps during entire shift (8 – 12 hours)
  • Ability and willingness to work outdoors in elements for entire shift (8 – 12 hours)
  • Ability to lift, carry, and transport large boxes and items in excess of 25 lbs.
  • Ability to work long and irregular hours including nights, weekends, holidays, events including but not limited to soccer, football, concerts and private events.

job.title: Account Executive, Season Ticket Sales
job.html_description:
Position Summary: 
Columbus Crew is seeking a driven and self-motivated Account Executive, Season Ticket Sales committed to growing his/her career in the sports industry. This person will be a member of the Ticket Sales team, responsible for leading new business generation efforts across all ticketing products. The Account Executive will be responsible for selling a full menu of season tickets, premium hospitality packages, group tickets and partial season plans for the Columbus Crew. 

Essential Duties & Responsibilities: 
  • Prospect, establish, research and close ticket sales leads through cold-calling, in-person appointments and networking
  • Conduct a high volume of in person sales meetings, including stadium tours, to close new business
  • Adhere to department guidelines in relation to call volume and outside networking opportunities and key performance metrics
  • Work closely with Ticket Operations and Membership Services departments to achieve sales and prospecting goals
  • Consistently enter client data into CRM and Archtics ticketing system to aid in information sharing between sales and service as well as analytical data aimed at enhancing the Crews sales processes
  • Consistently maintain a strong sales pipeline and display the capability to manage a sales funnel effectively
  • Maintain high level of customer service to existing and new clients of the Columbus Crew
  • Participate in various sales, team and community events as assigned
  • Represent organization at various networking events and/or offsite community events promoting ticket sale's active role in the Columbus Crew game day experience
 
Required Skills, Experience & Abilities: 
  • College graduate (4) year degree required
  • Minimum of one (1) year of professional experience in sports or entertainment ticket sales 
  • Strong customer service and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work weekends, nights, and holidays as dictated by games and events 
  • Strong ability to quickly and effectively establish rapport and build new relationships 
  • Willingness to learn, receive coaching and be competitive 
  • Highly developed professional attitude, appearance and inter-personal skills 
  • A solutions-based, consultative approach to solving problems 
  • Ability to confidently deliver information, analysis and recommendations to senior business leaders (both internally and externally) 
  • Strong individual organization, time-management and communication skills

job.title: IT Matchday
job.html_description:
What is Wicket Software?

Wicket is a facial authentication software company that allows fans to enter a venue in a touchless, secure fashion. By pairing a picture to their Ticketmaster account, fans can easily enter stadiums by approaching express entry lanes and allowing Wicket's technology to correctly detect their face.


Job Details:

Assist with Wicket's facial authentication software as fans enter the venue at Columbus Crew and Cleveland Browns home games. You will be interacting with fans by helping them enroll in the express entry solution, while also setting up and taking down equipment.

 

Benefits:

  • Competitive hourly wage
  • Valuable experience working with cutting edge technology and premier professional sports teams

job.title: IT Intern
job.html_description:
Job Summary

The Columbus Crew is seeking a tech-savvy, service-oriented Support Services Intern to serve our fans, staff, and coaches. This role is ideal for someone passionate about IT support, eager to learn, and ready to provide hands-on assistance in a fast paced, team-oriented environment. Candidates must be a problem solver, have the capacity to work independently, and be a team player. Strong verbal and written communication skills are a must along with the ability to interact professionally with executives, managers, coaches, and partners. The ability to prioritize multiple projects is critical. The successful candidate will serve as the first point of contact for all Front Office technology support questions or issues. The ability to manage projects, coordinate with multiple departments, work with a sense of urgency and diplomacy, and take the initiative to contribute to the overall success of the club is paramount.

 

Job Responsibilities

·       Provide first and second level technical support to staff in a timely manner.

·       General IT Knowledge - Installing and configuring computer hardware, software, and printers.

·       Laptop and desktop troubleshooting (Windows and Mac).

·       Provide A/V support where and when as needed. 

·       Setup and tear down of event related functions as needed. 

·       Provide mobile device support with iOS, Android, and Microsoft products.

·       Troubleshoot network communication issues and end user network connectivity. 

·       IT support at various locations including ScottsMiracle-Gro Field, Historic Crew Stadium, Ohio Health Performance Center, and Municipal Light Plant.

·       Help desk support and event support which may include nights and weekends. 

·       Creates technical documentation of support issues and user guides.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

·       Currently enrolled or completed in a relevant degree program (e.g., Information Technology, or related field).

·       Strong understanding of computer hardware, software, and networking fundamentals.

·       Basic knowledge of operating systems (e.g., Windows, MacOS, Linux) and productivity tools.

·       Excellent problem-solving skills.

·       Strong communication, customer service and interpersonal skills.

·       Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

·       Willingness to learn and adapt in a dynamic environment.

Preferred Skills and Qualifications:

·       Coursework or experience in areas such as cybersecurity, network administration, or database management.

·       Experience with ticketing systems (e.g. ServiceDesk Plus).

·       Familiarity with Active Directory, Office 365, and remote support tools (e.g. NinjaRMM).

·       Previous internship or relevant work experience in IT support.

·       Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, or Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals.

job.title: Chief of Staff
job.html_description:
Position Summary

Haslam Sports Group is seeking a highly organized, strategic, and execution-oriented Chief of Staff to support the President of Soccer across all HSG soccer properties, including the Columbus Crew, HSG's NWSL Expansion Team, Academy and Development Pathways, and broader global soccer initiatives. The Chief of Staff will serve as a trusted partner to the President of Soccer, helping execute the organization's operational and strategic plans, coordinate key initiatives across both clubs, and oversee day-to-day priorities across the soccer portfolio to ensure the achievement of club objectives. This individual will act as a central point of coordination between the technical, operational, and administrative functions of both clubs. He or she will also help liaise with business-side functions to ensure organizational alignment, communication, and execution across the broader HSG organization, including ownership and HSG executives. A primary focus during the first 18–24 months of the role will be supporting the launch of HSG's NWSL expansion club ahead of its inaugural season in 2028. This will include helping coordinate major milestones such as the recruitment of senior NWSL leadership; supporting the President and General Manager in the hiring of technical and operational staff; opening a new training facility; player acquisition planning; league office coordination; and overall organizational readiness efforts.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Planning & Execution
  • Assist the President of Soccer to develop, implement, and monitor strategic objectives across all soccer properties.
  • Facilitate annual and multi-year strategic planning processes across both clubs.
  • Conduct research and analysis on industry trends, competitive benchmarks, and best practices to support executive decision-making and strategic planning.
  • Establish organizational OKRs, KPIs, and reporting frameworks.
  • Track progress against strategic priorities and ensure accountability across departments.
  • Coordinate quarterly sporting reviews and strategic planning sessions.
  • Prepare executive presentations, ownership materials, board presentations, and strategic reports with the President
  • Oversee the implementation of AI to improve workplace efficiency.
  • Lead special projects and cross-functional initiatives.

Chief of Staff Responsibilities
  • Drive alignment across technical, performance, academy, operations, administrative, and coordinate with business functions to support organizational effectiveness and execution of strategic priorities.
  • Manage priorities, meetings, action items, key events, and follow-up processes for the President of Soccer.
  • Review department budgetary goals with the finance dept and review expense requests, including those tied to strategy and operational goals.
  • Coordinate weekly communication, planning, and alignment across the leadership teams of the Columbus Crew and NWSL club.
  • Ensure decisions, priorities, and action items are documented, communicated, and executed effectively across the organization.
  • Prepare briefing materials, presentations, and executive summaries for ownership meetings, HSG executive meetings, league meetings, and external engagements.
  • Support organizational planning processes and leadership meeting cadence across all soccer properties.
  • Coordinate logistics, executive travel, stakeholder engagement, and cross-functional projects on behalf of the President of Soccer and senior leadership team.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor and thought partner to the President of Soccer on organizational matters, strategic initiatives, and executive decision-making.
  • Serve as a key liaison with MLS, NWSL, U.S. Soccer, and other soccer stakeholders. Prepare briefing materials, reports, and recommendations related to league meetings, committees, and industry developments.
  • Prepare briefing materials, reports, and recommendations related to league meetings and industry developments.

NWSL Expansion Team Launch
  • Support the President of Soccer, President of Business Ops and club leadership in the successful launch of HSG's NWSL expansion club, including organizational planning, executive hiring, and operational readiness.
  • Coordinate key expansion initiatives, timelines, league requirements, and cross-functional projects to ensure successful execution of launch objectives.
 

Qualifications

Required
  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in professional soccer or the sports industry.
  • Demonstrated success supporting senior executives, leading cross-functional projects, and executing strategic initiatives.
  • Strong organizational, project management, communication, and relationship-building skills.
  • Skilled with software, including Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel), and familiar with AI tools, including Claude and ChatGPT.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and influence stakeholders across departments.
  • High level of professionalism, discretion, and attention to detail.
  • Willingness to travel as required.
Preferred
  • Experience within MLS, NWSL, U.S. Soccer, FIFA, CONCACAF, or other professional sports organizations.
  • Experience supporting club launches, expansion projects, or major organizational initiatives.
  • Experience in women's sports through playing, coaching, administration, league operations, club management, or related leadership roles.
  • Previous experience in a Chief of Staff, Strategy, Operations, Consulting, or Executive Leadership support role.
  • Familiarity with professional soccer operations, player recruitment, and roster construction.
  • Strong understanding of the North American men's, women's, and global soccer landscape.

job.title: Crew School Coordinator
job.html_description:
Overview
The Crew School Support Coordinator will integrate themselves into the weekly rhythm of Crew School and offer support to students in attendance and staff of the Education Department. Crew School is an academic support system for players within the Columbus Crew Academy. It occurs each Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday from 8:00AM-3:30PM. Students range from 8th-12th grade and are enrolled on online schooling platforms. 
 
 
Essential Duties & Responsibilities 
  • Build positive relationships with students 
  • Monitor student progress 
  • Assist students in completion of assignments, projects, test preparation 
  • Individualize and deliver instruction for grade levels 8-12 
  • Help students grow their executive functioning skills 
  • Learn differing online platforms to best help students stay organized & on task 
  • Contribute to building an atmosphere that consistently represents the Columbus Crew values of passion, accountability, high work ethic, and growth mindset 
 
Desired Experience
  • Preferred Ohio teaching license or degree in education
  • Prior experience working with kids in an educational or leadership capacity 
  • Ability to monitor student progress and intervene when students fall behind 
  • Strong organizational skills with experience tracking performance data, attendance, or academic progress 
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with students, families, and staff 
  • Experience building positive relationships with adolescents and motivating reluctant learners 
  • Experience using spreadsheets or data tracking tools to monitor student performance 
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating as part of an instructional team 
 
Position Opportunities
  • Support the academic and personal growth of Crew Academy students 
  • Engage in the daily rhythm of the Crew Academy  
  • Contribute to a positive environment that offers students proper social and academic engagement during their journey through the Columbus Crew Academy 
  • Be a valued member of a small department where your voice and perspective can impact the growth of the quickly expanding Crew School Program

job.title: Matchday Steward (casual contract)
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Casual Contract

Salary/ ROP:       £13.15 per hour


Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

You want to be a part of the buzz and excitement of a match day by being the face of Crystal Palace Football Club and providing excellent service to the customers of our many bars and kiosks.

 

Our match days are typically on Saturdays with some weekday evening and Sunday matches and the typical shift day is 6-8 hours depending on the game.


Responsibilities:

  • Take initiative and participate in the set-up of kiosks and bars, stock and supplies

  • Welcome guests and taking orders

  • Process payments on POS devices in an efficient manner

  • Maintain counters and fridges with sufficient supplies of stock throughout the service period, as guided by your manager.

  • Ensure stock rooms and areas are organised and clean, to ensure easy stock rotation and reconciliation.

  • Where necessary, assist in the back of house areas: kitchen and food preparation, pot wash and stock deliveries

  • Perform clean-up duties after each shift and ensure that concession stand is sanitized and tidied to a high standard

  • Serving alcohol responsibly and following the club’s Challenge 25 Policy

  • Adhering to all Health & Safety policies including the club’s Food Safety Management Systems

  • Carrying out any other reasonable duties asked of you from within your team and management including being flexible in covering tasks outside of your role-specific duties.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.

Crystal Palace Football Club are looking for a self-motivated, detail orientated and hardworking cleaner to join our team. You will be responsible for making sure that the site is clean, presentable. This can entail dusting, polishing, mopping, sweeping, vacuuming, and cleaning smudges off windows and doors.


Responsibilities:

  • Being responsible for all basic cleaning in and around the building.

  • Cleaning floors and rooms - including dust mopping, damp mopping, sweeping, vacuuming, dusting, picking up objects off the floor, and spot cleaning glass and windows.

  • Cleaning restrooms, including restocking dispensers, emptying trash, cleaning and sanitizing fixtures, cleaning mirrors, spot cleaning partition doors and walls, sweeping and mopping tile floors, and cleaning toilets and urinals.

  • Emptying trash, cleaning vacuums and replacing liners

  • Setting up, stocks, and maintains cleaning equipment and supplies.

  • Monitoring and maintaining sanitation and organization of assigned areas.

  • Assisting other departments when needed to ensure optimum service to guests.

  • Liaising with the line manager to ensure that you have sufficient cleaning products at all times.

  • Reporting any breakages that occur during the cleaning process.

  • Informing the line manager of repairs that need to be done.

  • Reporting any large objects obstructing fire exit.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.

Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience in professional cleaning with exceptionally high standards

  • Attention to detail

  • High standard of discretion and confidentiality

  • Have a strong work ethic, be loyal, passionate, and friendly.

  • Team player – expected to work well and communicate effectively with the team

  • Checkable reference

  • Ability to work with high profile professionals

  • Understanding that our commercial premises may contain confidential paperwork etc

  • Ensuring compliance to sanitation, hygiene, health and safety legislation and organisational and quality requirements and working policies and procedures.

  • Flexible and adaptable at all times

Responsibilities:

  • Understanding all menus, product offerings, packaging and pricing

  • Responsible for preparing and cooking all the hot food such as burgers, pies, hot dogs nachos and specialty items for a unit on match day and meeting peak periods with appropriate food levels

  • Maintain high standards of food presentation and quality with regular controls

  • Ensure all products are accounted for, prepared and distributed according to cook-off numbers and instructions from your manager

  • Restock and ensure the food prep area is clean at the end of your shift

  • Ensure all kitchen unit equipment (electrical or otherwise) is cleaned down and properly maintained at the end of every shift

  • Adhere and keep up to date records for food and health and safety standards such as food temperature control levels and following the club’s Food Safety Management System

  • Adhering to all Health & Safety policies and Security policies

  • Carrying out any other reasonable duties asked of you from within your team and management including being flexible in covering tasks outside of your role-specific duties.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Food Safety Level 2 certificate and strong knowledge of proper food handling procedures

  • Experience grilling or cooking food in mass quantities, particularly in a busy or similar environment

  • A can-do attitude and be prepared to help the rest of the team out with a positive attitude

  • Immaculate grooming standards and overall appearance

  • Always look for ways to improve

  • Can work in high pressure situations

job.title: Maintenance Operative
job.location: Copers Cope Road, Beckenham, London, BR3 1NZ, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:     Academy Training Ground, BR3 1NZ

Contract Type:   Full-time


Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

Crystal Palace Football Club are looking for an experienced and skilled Maintenance operative to perform and upkeep tasks such as repairs, inspections, plumbing, carpentry, painting, decorating, general maintenance and planned improvement services to our facilitates. The individual will be responsible for assisting other trades when required to ensure the highest level of service across our sites.


Responsibilities:

  • Undertake the day-to-day general maintenance repairs in-house for all our facilities but mainly at our Academy Training Ground.

  • Undertake painting work, such as preparing painting surfaces, removing old paint, mixing and matching paints, and to use correct utilities to prepare the surrounding areas in order to prevent messes.

  • Undertake plumbing work, such as fixing leaks, unblocking drains and gutters, shower fitting, and more.

  • Undertake tiling and decorating work, such as, preparing surfaces by levelling off with the correct material, measuring and applying tiles, repairing/removing old surfaces, add more.

  • Undertake carpentry work, such as taking measurements and installing shelves, cabinets, handles, locks and more.

  • Preparation of the facilities for home matches

  • Regular checks and repairs on lights, toilets, and seats.

  • Completing work in accordance with the Crystal Palace specifications and in compliance with the relevant Legislation and industry best practices

  • Working to operational procedures, safe working practices and Health and Safety procedures as required.

  • Providing general support and assistance to the Maintenance Manager

  • Inspecting the Training ground and Academy and it’s adjoining structures on a daily and weekly basis to ensure they are all well-kept and in order.

  • Completing works at other Crystal Palace Football Club grounds and facilities including the Academy Training Ground.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience in a maintenance environment.

  • Experience in plumbing, painting, decorating, carpentry, and general maintenance.

  • Basic knowledge of maintenance systems such as HVAC, plumbing, electrical etc.

  • Ability to read manuals and drawings.

  • Experience using hand and electrical tools.

  • Experience working in large scale stadiums/ buildings.


Benefits:

  • Complimentary match day ticket

  • Reward and Discount Scheme through our Tech Scheme and Simple Health app

  • Health and Wellbeing benefit scheme

  • 20% Discount in our Retail Stores

  • Discounts in various gyms through GymFlex

  • Volunteering Day - 1 Workday off to support a charity of your choice.

  • Travel Season Ticket loan

  • Holiday allowance: 25 Days

You are approachable, hardworking and enjoy helping others with a smile; whist also keepings safety and security at the forefront of everything you do.

Responsibilities:

  • Providing an excellent service to Home/Away supporters.

  • Attending the match briefing as given by the Head of Ticketing, and Turnstile Supervisor to understand the ticketing arrangements for each fixture

  • Ensuring that the area around the turnstile where deployed is clear of obstructions and operates freely.

  • Any obstructions, hazards or found articles must be reported to the Stand Supervisor immediately

  • Reconciling turnstile admits taking numbers from turnstile counter and complete the turnstile docket

  • Correctly operating the respective ticket scanning device

  • Attending the required counting procedures following closure of the turnstile

  • Complying with any instruction given by the Stand Supervisor.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • A can do attitude and be prepared to help the team

  • Immaculate grooming standards and overall appearance

  • Excellent interpersonal skills and be polite and courteous

Our commitment to Equality

At Crystal Palace Football Club, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion is spirited and continues to grow due to the working environment, which makes all staff feel appreciated and welcomed. We are committed to attracting, recruiting, and retaining the most talented candidates and the club intends to ensure that everyone who wishes to engage with the club, whether as matchday fans, staff, players, board members, participants in Foundation programmes and any other person engaged with the club's activities, has a real and equal opportunity to do so.

job.title: Logistics & Fulfilment Operative (Casual Contract)
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Casual Contract

Salary/ ROP:       £13.15 per hour

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

The Logistics Operative plays a vital role in supporting the successful delivery of matchdays and events across Selhurst Park. Responsible for the movement, storage and organisation of food, beverages, equipment and disposables, the role ensures kiosks, bars and hospitality areas are fully stocked, organised and operational.

Working as part of the Public Catering team, the Logistics Operative helps maintain high standards of cleanliness, food safety and operational efficiency, ensuring an exceptional experience for supporters, guests and clients.

Responsibilities:

  • Receive, check and store food, beverage and equipment deliveries.

  • Ensure stock is rotated and stored in accordance with company procedures.

  • Support stock counts and stock reconciliation activities.

  • Report shortages, damages and discrepancies to management.

  • Maintain accurate stock records where required.

  • Prepare kiosks, bars and catering areas for operation.

  • Distribute food, beverage, equipment and disposable stock throughout the stadium.

  • Support premium areas and event spaces with operational requirements.

  • Ensure units are replenished efficiently throughout service.

  • Respond quickly and effectively to operational requests during matchdays and events.

  • Maintain cellar areas to a high operational standard.

  • Support beer line cleaning procedures where required.

  • Ensure food stores, disposable stock rooms and chemical storage areas are clean, organised and compliant.

  • Assist with the movement and handling of kegs and heavy stock items using safe working practices.

  • Complete HACCP, delivery, temperature and cleaning records accurately.

  • Follow all Health & Safety, Food Safety, COSHH and manual handling procedures.

  • Maintain high standards of cleanliness throughout operational areas.

  • Report maintenance issues, hazards and incidents promptly.

  • Work closely with the Stock Controller, Hub Leaders and management team to ensure operational requirements are met.

  • Support colleagues across the department where required.

  • Communicate shortages, equipment failures and operational issues promptly.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience working within hospitality, catering, logistics, warehouse or customer-facing environments.

  • Flexible approach to working hours, including evenings, weekends and matchdays.

  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.

  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to work independently and use initiative.

  • Previous experience within logistics, cellar operations or stock control. (Desirable)

  • Experience working in a stadium, arena or large-scale event environment. (Desirable)

  • Experience handling food and beverage stock. (Desirable)

  • Level 2 Food Safety Certificate. (Desirable)

  • Manual Handling Certificate. (Desirable)

  • Counterbalance Forklift Licence. (Desirable)

  • Personal Licence Holder. (Desirable)

  • First Aid qualification. (Desirable)
