Für das Bistro 09 der BVB Event & Catering GmbH suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkteinen Küchenchef (m/w/d) in Rahmen einer Vollzeitanstellung (40h/Woche).
Deine Aufgaben
- Planung, Koordination und Organisation des täglichen Küchenablaufs - Leitung des Küchenteams incl. zugehöriger Tätigkeiten wie Mitwirkung bei der Einstellung und Einarbeitung von neuem Personal, Erstellung der Dienstpläne etc. - Sicherstellung der Qualitätsstandards von zubereiteten Speisen sowie Überwachung und Einhaltung der Hygienevorschriften nach dem HACCP-Konzept - Aktive Mitarbeit bei der Zubereitung der warmen und kalten Speisen - Kalkulation und Planung des kulinarischen Angebots sowie eigenständige Betreuung des Wareneinkaufsprozesses für das Bistro 09 - Wirtschaftlichkeitsanalyse des Angebots sowie Weiterentwicklung der Speisekarte in enger Abstimmung mit dem Küchendirektor - Verantwortung für die Durchführung von Inventuren - Ansprechperson für Lieferanten und interne Fachbereiche
Dein Profil
- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Koch (m/w/d) incl. Ausbilder-Eignungsverordnung (AEVO) - Einschlägige Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Position im à la carte-Bereich, idealerweise innerhalb der Systemgastronomie - Führungsmotivation sowie Begeisterung im Umgang mit Lebensmitteln und für das à la carte-Geschäft - Sicher im Umgang mit den gängigen MS Office-Anwendungen (z.B. Outlook) sowie Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit einem Warenwirtschaftssystem - Eigenverantwortliche, proaktive und strukturierte Arbeitsweise - Hohes Maß an Qualitätsbewusstsein sowie Lösungsorientierung - Ausgeprägte Kontaktstärke sowie ein herzliches und authentisches Auftreten - Hohe Einsatzbereitschaft, Ambition und Leidenschaft - Stilsichere Kommunikation in deutscher Sprache sowie gute Englischkenntnisse
Das erwartet Dich
- Einen Platz in einem dynamischen Team, das sich stark mit seinen Aufgaben identifiziert - Spannende und vielseitige Tätigkeiten in einem einzigartigen Arbeitsumfeld - Kurze Entscheidungswege und viel eigenverantwortlicher Gestaltungsspielraum - Persönliches Mitarbeiter-Ticket für unsere Heimspiele - Individuelle Maßnahmen zur beruflichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung - Kostenfreie Mitgliedschaft im Fitnessstudio sowie Unterstützung für einen gesunden Arbeitsalltag - Weitere Mehrwerte, wie z. B. flexible Arbeitszeiten, Dienstrad-Leasing, Team-Events, Altersvorsorge etc.
Jetzt bewerben
Wir freuen uns auf Deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung mit Motivationsschreiben, Lebenslauf und Zeugnissen. Bitte bewirb Dich online über den "Jetzt-bewerben-Button".
BVB Event & Catering GmbH

job.title: Casual Primary Education Coach (Primary Stars)
job.location: Everton in the Community, Liverpool L4
job.html_description:
Who are we:  

Since 1988, Everton in the Community has become a dynamic force for good, harnessing the unifying power of football to drive social change and addressing societal challenges across Liverpool City Region. Supported by a team of over 130 full-time staff and over 200 volunteers, the independently governed and independently financed charity offers an extensive array of more than 60 programmes and initiatives that tackle a diverse range of social issues including health, employability, anti-social behaviour, crime, exploitation, education, dementia, and disability.  

Everton in the Community stands firmly beside the most at-risk and most in need members of its local communities, but the needs of the city are ever-growing and ever-evolving and the official charity of Everton Football Club is committed to helping as many people as possible.

    

About the opportunity:  Everton in the Community is seeking to appoint a number of Casual Primary Education Coach(es) who will deliver and monitor high quality primary school programmes to schools throughout Merseyside, to increase participation among participants of all abilities.  

As a Primary Education Casual Coach, you will deliver and evaluate high quality classroom interventions in math’s, English and PSHE alongside upskilling and developing teacher subject knowledge when delivering the PE National Curriculum. This may include whole class support, targeted group or targeted individual support.  

You will inspire and empower young people to pursue positive change, live healthier lives and transition and contribute towards creating ‘stronger communities and brighter futures’.  

Please be advised this is not a football coaching role. 

Other key responsibilities will include:   

  • Delivery of lessons pre-planned for Primary Stars program to children aged 5-11 

  • Support teachers in enhancing PE and school sport skills 

  • Deliver the following to a variety of ages and individual needs including; Maths, English and PSHE targeted interventions/mentoring. Football focused delivery, Girls football ASC, Social action, SEN/D provision, Transition from KS2 to KS3 and Attendance. Ensuring that all activities delivered reflect the national curriculum and OFSTED guidelines 

Safeguarding    

  • To understand the Club’s Safeguarding policy, procedures, and best practice guidelines    

  • To use this understanding to ensure safe working practices, appropriate reporting of concerns and contribute positively to an Anti-bullying environment    

   

Who we are looking for: We are looking for individuals who have previous experience of working in schools and community settings specifically within the 5-11 age group and who have been identified as SEND and who have good knowledge and understanding of the fundamentals skills of a number of sports. 

Essential qualifications include:   

  • NGB level 2 in at least one sport  

 

This position will be offered on a Casual basis working as and when required to suit the needs of the programme. 

The main location for this role will be within the Everton in the Community campus. However, the postholder will be required to be mobile across schools and community venues across Merseyside 

The closing date for applications is Thursday 17th Sedptember 2026 however, we reserve the right to close this vacancy early should we receive a substantial amount of applications 

 

Everton Family Safer Recruitment Practices    

    

The Everton Family is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment.    

    

As a requirement of our safer recruitment practices, this role will require an Enhanced DBS check or evidence that you are subscribed to the DBS Update Service information of which can be found here     

    

This role is subject to both evidence and verification of relevant qualifications including proof of eligibility to work in the UK which will be discussed with you if your application is successful.     

    

Equity & Inclusion      

Everton Football Club is committed to ensuring everyone is respected, celebrated and empowered for who they are, regardless of their identity. We welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds, and underrepresented communities. We are dedicated to supporting the physical and mental/emotional wellbeing of all our people. Should you have a disability or long-term health condition and require reasonable adjustments to be made to the application/interview/onboarding process, please let us know by contacting the Talent Acquisition Team via email - careers@evertonfc.com          

To support our pledge to diversify our organisation and through our commitment to the Football Association’s, Football Leadership Diversity Code, Everton welcomes applications from people of all walks of life. As part of our commitment to Disability, Inclusion and Accessibility we are more than happy to make reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process should you require.

job.title: Matchday 'Together Against Suicide' Support Worker
job.location: Everton in the Community, Liverpool L4
job.html_description:
Who are we:  

Since 1988, Everton in the Community has become a dynamic force for good, harnessing the unifying power of football to drive social change and addressing societal challenges across Liverpool City Region. Supported by a team of over 130 full-time staff and over 200 volunteers, the independently governed and independently financed charity offers an extensive array of more than 60 programmes and initiatives that tackle a diverse range of social issues including health, employability, anti-social behaviour, crime, exploitation, education, dementia, and disability.  

Everton in the Community stands firmly beside the most at-risk and most in need members of its local communities, but the needs of the city are ever-growing and ever-evolving and the official charity of Everton Football Club is committed to helping as many people as possible.

About the opportunity:  As part of the Premier League Suicide Prevention Project Everton in the Community (EitC), working in partnership with Everton Football Club, is seeking caring, approachable and proactive Casual Matchday ‘Together Against Suicide’ Support Workers to be part of our matchday mental health and suicide prevention team.  

This role is central to our mission of supporting the mental health and wellbeing of fans and the wider community. You will help create a safe, welcoming presence around the stadium, offering compassionate listening, information, and signposting to those who may be struggling or seeking help.  

In your role you will help deliver visible and meaningful support on matchdays and help connect individuals into ongoing EitC wellbeing programmes such as The People’s Place. 

Safeguarding    

  • To understand the Club’s Safeguarding policy, procedures, and best practice guidelines.     
  • To use this understanding to ensure safe working practices, appropriate reporting of concerns and contribute positively to an Anti-bullying environment. 

Who we are looking for: We are looking for individuals who have experience of supporting or working with adults around mental health and wellbeing and who have the ability to engage with people from all backgrounds in a friendly and non-judgemental way. 

This is a matchday role, therefore flexibility to work evenings and weekends according to fixtures is essential. 

Essential qualifications include:   

  • Qualified in Mental Health First Aid 

  • Suicide prevention trained (ASIST, SafeTALK, or equivalent) 

This position will be offered on a Casual basis working as and when required. Please note this is a matchday role, therefore flexibility to work evenings and weekends according to fixtures is essential. 

The main location for this role will be at Hill Dickinson Stadium.  

The closing date for applications is Monday 21st September 2026 however, we reserve the right to close this vacancy early should we receive a substantial amount of applications.

job.title: Event Experiences Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Event Experiences Coordinator provides day-to-day administrative, planning and coordination support to the Event Experiences / Experiential Marketing team, with a particular focus on FIFA Fan Festival™ and FIFA Trophy Tour FWWC2027 deliverables and other experiential marketing activations. 
 
The role helps the team stay organized by maintaining SharePoint management, documentation administration, tracker updates including WeTrack, meeting notes and agenda preparation, action tracking, calendars, reporting support, project planning and presentations and budget tracking. Working closely with the Zurich-based team, local teams and internal and external stakeholders, the coordinator ensures that actions, deadlines, decisions and dependencies are clearly captured and followed up. 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Project Coordination & Administration 
    • Provide day-to-day coordination and administrative support across FIFA Fan Festival™ and FIFA Trophy Tour FWWC2027 and related experiential marketing workstreams. 
    • Maintain all SharePoint folders, project documents and records, ensuring files are correctly saved, updated, organized, and easy to access. 
    • Support project planning by updating timelines, milestone trackers, deliverables lists, approval logs, action trackers, and status documents. 
    • Monitor deadlines, deliverables, risks and dependencies, escalating delays or blockers when required. 
  •  Meetings, Calendars & Follow-ups 
    • Coordinate meeting calendars, schedule meetings, send invitations, prepare agendas, and ensure the right stakeholders are included. 
    • Attend key meetings, take clear meeting notes, capture decisions, and circulate summaries with actions, owners, and deadlines. 
    • Follow up with internal teams, Host Cities, agencies, suppliers and stakeholders to ensure agreed actions are completed on time. 
    • Maintain action trackers and ensure progress is visible to the Zurich-based team, and local team. 
  • Reporting, Budget & Procurement Support 
    • Support weekly reporting by gathering updates, consolidating inputs, and preparing clear status summaries. 
    • Assist with reports, presentations, project updates, and post-event documentation for FIFA27, Host Cities, and relevant stakeholders. 
    • Support budget tracking by maintaining budget files, spend trackers, PO updates, and invoice logs. 
    • Assist with procurement administration, supplier onboarding, purchase orders, invoices, and approvals. 
  • Strong experience in project coordination, event administration, marketing operations, client account coordination or a similar role. 
  • Experience supporting projects within an event, marketing, communications, or operations environment. 
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks, trackers, deadlines, and stakeholders at the same time. 
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate documentation, reports, meeting notes, and project records. 
  • Experience taking meeting minutes, preparing action lists and following up with teams, agencies, suppliers, or stakeholders. 
  • Good understanding of project planning tools, including timelines, action trackers, status reports, and reporting templates. 
  • Comfortable supporting budget tracking, procurement administration, invoice logs and related financial documentation. 
  • Proficient in Office 365, including Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint; excellent knowledge of MS Teams, SharePoint / OneDrive and Monday.com or similar tools. 
  • Experience working in a multi-national, multi-cultural, and multi-stakeholder environment is desirable. 
  • Flexible, adaptable, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with fixed deadlines and changing priorities. 
  • Team player with a positive attitude, strong follow-up skills and willingness to go the extra mile. 
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

- Strong experience in project coordination, event administration, marketing operations, client account coordination or a similar role. - Experience supporting projects within an event, marketing, communications, or operations environment. - Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks, trackers, deadlines, and stakeholders at the same time. - Excellent attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate documentation, reports, meeting notes, and project records. - Experience taking meeting minutes, preparing action lists and following up with teams, agencies, suppliers, or stakeholders. - Good understanding of project planning tools, including timelines, action trackers, status reports, and reporting templates. - Comfortable supporting budget tracking, procurement administration, invoice logs and related financial documentation. - Proficient in Office 365, including Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint; excellent knowledge of MS Teams, SharePoint / OneDrive and Monday.com or similar tools. - Experience working in a multi-national, multi-cultural, and multi-stakeholder environment is desirable. - Flexible, adaptable, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with fixed deadlines and changing priorities. - Team player with a positive attitude, strong follow-up skills and willingness to go the extra mile. - Right to work in Brazil. - Fluent in English (spoken and written) - Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written) - Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Data Protection Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Head of Technology, the Data Protection Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Technology team and will work in close collaboration with FIFA's Data Protection Office and other key stakeholders to ensure that all data protection and privacy requirements for the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ are implemented in accordance with FIFA policies and applicable privacy legislation. The Data Protection Manager will lead the delivery of the tournament's data protection and privacy programme, providing expert guidance on privacy compliance, embedding privacy by design across operations and projects, and ensuring the secure, lawful, and responsible processing of personal data throughout the tournament lifecycle. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Serve as the primary privacy and data protection lead for FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™. 
  • Ensure compliance with LGPD and other applicable privacy and data protection requirements. 
  • Develop, implement, and maintain privacy policies, standards, procedures, and controls aligned with FIFA's global privacy framework and Brazilian legal requirements. 
  • Provide practical, risk based privacy guidance to business stakeholders and promote privacy by design across projects, systems, technologies, vendors, and business initiatives. 
  • Lead privacy-by-design reviews for projects, technologies, systems, events, products, and business initiatives, ensuring privacy requirements are embedded from inception. 
  • Conduct Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), including Relatórios de Impacto à Proteção de Dados Pessoais (RIPD), privacy reviews, and risk assessments. 
  • Monitor developments in Brazilian privacy laws and regulations and advise on their impact on business operations. 
  • Manage data subject rights requests in accordance with LGPD and support the investigation and management of privacy incidents and personal data breaches. 
  • Review and negotiate privacy and data protection provisions in contracts and support third-party privacy risk assessments. 
  • Maintain records of processing activities and support privacy compliance reporting and documentation. 
  • Develop and deliver privacy training and awareness initiatives. 
  • Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders and support interactions with regulatory authorities where required. 
  • Partner closely with FIFA's global data protection team to ensure consistent implementation of enterprise-wide privacy standards while addressing Brazil specific requirements. 

Education 
  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Compliance, Information Management, Information Security, Business Administration, or a related field. 
 Experience 
  • Strong experience in data protection, privacy, compliance, legal, information governance, or a related field. 
  • Expert knowledge of Brazilian data protection laws and regulations, particularly the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD), is required, including practical experience advising on compliance, data subject rights, privacy risk assessments, and incident management. 
  • Good understanding of international privacy frameworks, including GDPR and cross-border data transfer requirements. 
  • Experience conducting PIAs, DPIAs, privacy reviews, and privacy risk assessments. 
  • Experience reviewing privacy provisions in contracts and managing third-party privacy risks. 
  • Experience working in multinational or matrixed environments is desirable. 
 Skills & Competencies 
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. 
  • Ability to provide pragmatic, business-focused, and risk-based advice. 
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. 
  • Strong organizational and project management capabilities. 
  • Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across cultures and functions. 
 Certifications & Requirements 
  • Privacy certification(s) such as CIPP, CIPM, CIPT, CDPO/BR, or equivalent. 
  • Experience supporting major international events, sports organizations, or large-scale projects. 
  • Familiarity with information security and cybersecurity principles. 
  • Right to work in Brazil  
  • Fluent in English 
  • Native or Fluent in Portuguese 
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset 
 Various 
  • Willing to travel within Brazil (up to 30%), with some trips with a long duration (15 days or more)

job.title: Venue Technology Manager (Fortaleza)
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Venue Technology Manager is responsible for supporting the Technology team with venue specific technology related deliverables for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 TM (FWWC 2027) within Brazil. The role entails coordinating with all relevant parties the planning, implementation, readiness and operations of all Event Technology services pertinent to the tournament and / or associated events within Brazil.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Responsible to ensure all aspects of Technology, Telecommunications and Broadcast Technology Services are implemented in accordance with the pre-agreed FIFA Technology requirements at the assigned venue(s)
  • Manage a strong diverse Venue Technology team composed of paid staff, contractors and volunteers for operating the technology services at the assigned venue(s) 
  • Collaborate with stakeholders’ groups, clients, providers, and government entities in relation to ensuring the delivery of technology services across all venues, in accordance with the defined governance structure
  • Manage and contribute to the venue technology working groups in accordance with the agreed governance structure across all aspects of the tournament programme (planning, implementation, readiness and operations) 
  • Manage the technology demand / needs requirements for technology services across the tournament space (Technology Equipment Allocation Process) 
  • Plan the delivery of suitable end user technology equipment and services to all FWWC 2027 departments and FIFA constituent groups, including hardware, services and consumables 
  • Facilitate the collection and distribution of technology requirements of all client groups involved in the FWWC 2027 across all client groups, including, Media, Broadcast, Commercial, Football Technology etc. 
  • Ensure that all information pertaining to infrastructure, services and spaces needed for the delivery and support of all technology services are communicated to, and understood by, venue/site authorities and respective delivery teams 
  • Provide guidance and direction to relevant teams on matters relating to the structural build-out and technology services implementation, including the commissioning and final decommissioning of tournament venues  
  • In collaboration with assigned personnel and Stadium partners, relevant parties (private and governmental) enable / support the timely delivery of venue technology services. 
  • Identify and report on the progress of all critical dependencies in accordance with the reporting methodologies. 
  • Manage the asset tracking and management of deployed technology equipment 
  • Track the progress of structural build-out and IT implementation leading up to the timely availability of components and services and including the commissioning and final decommissioning of the venues. 
  • Develop regular progress, risk and issue management reports in accordance with the governance structure / reporting methodologies and, or PMO systems 
  •  Follow-up with various stakeholders, providers, and government entities in relation to ensuring delivery of technology services / dependencies as per agreed requirements, service levels etc. 
  • Support and ensure the team adhere to the IT Service management protocols 
  • Ensure positive attitude from the Venue Technology teams and good relationship with all the parties, including FIFA teams, Local FIFA Subsidiary (LFS) areas/projects, end-users, suppliers, Host Country/ City counterparts
  • Manage the on-site IT Technicians and support teams during tournament time operations, including end-of-day reporting and incident escalation to Technology Command Centre. 
Education
  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field
Experience
  • Overall IT experience and in a similar role
  • Experience in the Sports / major event industry is a must
  • Proven track record of successful delivery of complex IT programs and projects
Skills & Competencies
  • Manager with proven track record in similar projects
  • Good knowledge of venue technology services across major sporting events 
  • Have up to date knowledge and project management expertise in all event related technologies, including, all types of technology business solutions, community access TV (CATV), radio communications, wired communication, printing, broadcast contribution network, spectrum, audio and visual. 
  • Ability to always maintain a professional demeanor. Consistently interacts professionally and works productively with all levels of employee. 
  • Excellent cross group collaboration skills and demonstrated ability to lead virtual teams across groups, conflict management and driving consensus to deliver on program milestones  
  • Good Leadership skills and able to manage and motivate other team members 
  • Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Ability to adapt speech to audience coming from a broad spectrum of disciplines and with various levels of technical knowledge
  • Leadership and accountability across all areas of relevance  
  • Strong political acumen and adaptable to a wide range of working environments
Certifications & Requirements
  • Right to work in Brazil 
  • Fluent in English
  • Native or Fluent in Portuguese
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset
Location: Fortaleza (CE) - Brazil

job.title: Host Broadcast Operations Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Host Broadcast Operations Coordinator supports the planning, coordination and delivery of Host Broadcast operations across all venues and central broadcast facilities, including the International Broadcast Coordination Centre (IBCC).

Working under the direction of the Head of Broadcast and in alignment with the FIFA Zürich Project Lead – Senior Host Broadcast Production Manager, the role contributes to the implementation of broadcast operations and IBCC-related activities. 

The position supports coordination between FIFA project requirements, Host Broadcast Production delivery, and IBCC operations, ensuring aligned planning, consistent communication, and effective service delivery across all operational areas. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Support the planning, coordination and implementation of Host Broadcast operations across all FIFA Women's World Cup™ venues and central broadcast facilities. 
  •  Assist the Head of Broadcast and FIFA Zürich Project Lead – Senior Host Broadcast Production Manager in coordinating operational planning, tracking project milestones and monitoring key deliverables. 
  • Support the Host Broadcast Operations Managers with venue planning activities, ensuring consistency of operational standards, documentation and implementation across all competition venues. 
  • Coordinate operational information, documentation and planning activities between FIFA departments, Host Broadcast partners and key service providers. 
  • Support the planning, coordination and operational readiness of the International Broadcast Coordination Centre (IBCC), including facilities, operational workflows, logistics and service delivery.
  • Assist with the development and maintenance of IBCC operational documentation, layouts, operational procedures and planning schedules. 
  • Coordinate information relating to Host Broadcast and IBCC requirements, ensuring timely communication and alignment between all stakeholders. 
  • Support planning meetings, workshops, venue inspections and operational readiness activities, including preparation of agendas, minutes, action tracking and follow-up. 
  • Assist in monitoring project risks, dependencies and operational issues, escalating where appropriate and supporting the implementation of agreed actions. 
  • Contribute to the preparation of operational reports, presentations and management updates for internal and external stakeholders. 
  • Support planning for tournament-time operations, ensuring operational documentation, staffing plans and broadcast requirements are maintained and up to date. 
  • Work collaboratively across FIFA, FIFA27, Host Broadcaster and service providers to ensure an integrated approach to Host Broadcast and IBCC operations. 
  • Undertake additional operational duties as required to support the successful delivery of the FIFA Women's World Cup™. 
  • Experience in broadcast, media and/or sports event environments
  • University degree in broadcast, media, event management or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience in project planning, broadcast operations, event operations, or coordination roles
  • Experience supporting multi-disciplinary teams across functional areas such as accommodation, logistics, accreditation and travel
  • Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail, particularly when working under pressure
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong administrative and reporting capabilities
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build and maintain effective working relationships across multiple teams and levels
  • Good problem-solving skills with the ability to use sound judgement and support operational decision-making
  • Knowledge of local markets and cultural environments is an asset
  • Familiarity with broadcast and/or IBC/IBCC operations is a strong advantage
  • Experience in major international sporting events is desirable
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Content Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organisationally to the Head of Marketing, Brand and Promotion / Senior Digital Marketing Manager (FIFA27, Rio de Janeiro), the Content Production Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Marketing, Brand and Promotions team, and work in close collaboration with the FIFA Zurich Digital Marketing team and other key individuals responsible for delivering best-in-class design solutions.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The main responsibilities and oversights of the Content Production Manager for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ include:  


  • Managing a high volume of video edits and requests to capture content for the largest tournaments in the world.
  • Storytelling visionary that brings perspective to each visual piece to deliver error-free final product.
  • Collaborating with the creative team to plan shot lists, location scouting, and necessary equipment based on the project needs. 
  • Setting up and operating cameras to capture various angles and perspectives, ensuring proper lighting and framing. 
  • Capturing high-quality audio using microphones and sound recording techniques. 
  • Adapting to unexpected situations during filming and making adjustments to capture the best footage and adapting to short notices. 
  • Importing, organizing and managing raw footage in a structured way for efficient editing based on deliverable needs and stakeholder feedback,
  • Review all footage necessary to choose the most impactful clips for videos to help tell the story and goals of each project.
  • Adjusting color profiles to achieve a consistent visual aesthetic across the video.
  •  Cleaning up audio, adding music, sound effects, and voiceovers provided by team and as needed.
  • Incorporating visual elements like titles, lower thirds, and animations to enhance the video.
  •  Reviewing the final edit to ensure consistency and high production value. 
  • Understanding the project vision and incorporating feedback from directors, producers, and clients throughout the process.

Education & Qualifications

Related bachelor’s degree or a similar level of higher education

Work Experience
  • Strong experience in a similar role
  • Experience in creating work of outstanding video standards, for high end brands, sports teams, and large advertising campaigns
  • Strong client management skills and sports background advantageous
  • Digital savvy with experience in social & digital marketing strategies
  • Demonstrated excellent editing skills – both conceptual and executional
  • Brand storytelling experience
  • Experience in entertainment, motion and sport advantageous
  • International or experience working in organizations with international offices/staff
  • Mid-level management experience
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Senior Campaigns Manager
job.html_description:
As the organiser of some of the biggest and most iconic sport events in the world, we lead the way in the sport and event industry.

The Senior Campaigns Manager will play a key role in delivering FIFA’s social impact campaigns by sharing the lead in the overall conception, creation, delivery and management of results-driven and multiplatform initiatives, in line with FIFA’s Strategic Objectives for the Global Game: 2023-2027.

Reporting to the Team Lead Corporate Communications, the postholder will own and oversee the portfolio of FIFA social impact campaigns, serving as the main point of contact between functional areas and leading and managing the relationship with external stakeholders.

Join the team and support us on our mission.
These are your key tasks:
  • Plan and implement compelling social impact campaigns related to FIFA’s corporate mission
  • Project-manage all stakeholder involvement by acting as the main point of contact in relation to social impact campaigns, developing content proposals, agreeing on budgets and managing feedback
  • Project-manage all deliverables involving internal and external partners and execute campaign requirements with an emphasis on digital communication to promote individual stakeholder activities across FIFA’s platforms and events
  • Project-manage all requirements in terms of content production
  • Project-manage all campaign reporting and debriefs according to pre-agreed key performance indicators
  • Support the further promotion of social impact campaigns with plans, messaging and content around key milestones
  • Support the further promotion of social impact campaigns through the creation of multilingual toolkits for Member Associations and other stakeholders
  • Provide on-site support in relation to the implementation of social impact campaigns at FIFA events
  • Manage campaign-related content on owned FIFA channels
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • Passion for football
  • Proven experience (at least six years) working at an international and/or media organisation, with a specific campaign background
  • Solid experience coordinating successful campaigns
  • Media communications or public relations expertise and the ability to build and maintain interest over time
  • Ability to see the bigger picture and think not just for Corporate Communications but for the FIFA Communications Division and the organisation as a whole
  • Ability to liaise and communicate with and present to key stakeholders (internal and external)
  • Excellent communicator and listener
  • Willing to learn new skills and take on challenges
  • Cooperative team player
  • Bachelor’s degree in languages/communications/journalism/social studies (a master’s degree is a plus)
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills and management of messaging and the media
  • Ability to work to tight deadlines
  • Thorough understanding of global football activities and key football stakeholders
  • Excellent command of communications platforms
  • Expertise in video production and social media, as well as standard messaging and content creation
  • SAP knowledge would be an asset (for the purposes of finance/budgeting, procurement, governance and RFP process management)
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.

Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
  • Health and fitness: Regular football sessions for all abilities, plus on-site gym.
  • Home office: Up to two days of home office per week if work permits and home office allowance for all.
  • Language courses: Offered to all staff to aid personal and professional growth.
  • Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
  • Pension: Flexible pension benefits with generous employer contributions.
  • Relocation assistance: A dedicated team will be on hand to support your relocation.
  • Sustainability: We support all employees using public transport.
  • Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.
  • Volunteering: Make an impact beyond your regular role and bond with colleagues by volunteering with one of our partners.

job.title: Digital Product Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Digital Product Manager will be the driving force behind FIFA’s digital direct-to-consumer experiences for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Whilst the role will be based in Rio, the successful candidate will act as an integral member of the global Product & Design team, defining fans’ digital journey across FIFA’s owned and operated platforms, notably including FIFA.com and FIFA’s official mobile app.

Reporting to Head of Brand & Marketing, the primary responsibility will involve taking the lead in evolving FIFA’s fan-facing websites and apps specifically for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. This will include developing digital activations that support tournament goals and objectives, as well as delivery of commercial value for FIFA’s partners.

With the biggest, most ambitious FIFA Women’s World Cup™ on the horizon, this is your chance to help shape the next generation of digital experiences and grow the Women’s game!


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Strategic Vision: Play a leading role in defining and developing FIFA’s digital consumer-facing proposition, specifically ensuring products and experiences reflect local fan behaviours and consumption habits, as well as aligning cultural nuances and emerging trends across Brazil and South America.
  • Fan Engagement: Support FIFA’s audience growth goals by optimizing acquisition, engagement and retention journeys across owned platforms, as well as contributing to first-party data strategies.
  • Value Generation: Partner closely with Commercial and Marketing teams to develop scalable digital activations and integrations that deliver measurable value to fans and partners alike.
  • Tournament Planning & Delivery: Become an integral enabler of tournament-time digital operations, delivering high-traffic match moments, live content publishing, rapid issue resolution and cross-functional coordination during competition periods.
  • Collaboration: Operate as an integral member of Digital Delivery, working alongside Product Managers located across Europe and acting as the department’s key representative within FIFA27.
  • Governance & Communication: Providing clear, consistent updates to senior management and key stakeholders. Participation in cross-functional steering groups to maintain a balance between critical tournament milestones and product scope delivery.
  • Drive Innovation: Champion a consumer-first mindset; exploring opportunities for innovation and application of AI-driven solutions to enhance content personalization and discovery, improve operational efficiency and create new fan engagement experiences that resonate with fans globally and locally.
  • Data-driven Performance:  Establish and track key performance indicators, using a blend of behavioural insights and user research to inform product development priorities, optimise product performance and exceed tournament goals and objectives.

Education & Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer sciences, business management or related discipline
  • Relevant product development philosophies, e.g. Agile, are essential
  • Relevant project management qualifications, e.g. PRINCE2, highly beneficial
Work Experience:
  • Product management experience, demonstrating end-to-end experience across the digital product lifecycle; from UX/UI design and roadmap development to rigorous testing and release management.
  • Experience working in a direct-to-consumer business, ideally within sports, media or related industries.
  • Experience leading complex projects will be highly beneficial, demonstrating aptitude for balancing personal development of others with empowerment to “get the job done”.
  • Exceptional communication skills - both written and verbal – to succinctly and confidently interact with a wide range of stakeholders up to and including senior FIFA management.
  • Demonstrable experience working autonomously and/or with ambiguity; with an ability to adapt swiftly to organisational change or leverage short-term opportunities.
Competencies:
  • Confidence leading multiple projects with autonomy, often with colleagues and/or suppliers located in different territories and time zones.
  • Passion for developing consumer experiences and thinking big picture; complimented with a demonstrable understanding of digital product development and design principles.
  • Data-driven with an aptitude for harnessing data, forming KPIs, and leveraging consumer insights to make informed decisions.
  • Comfortable working with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams across FIFA, each with varying degrees of digital maturity and technical understanding.
  • Willingness to travel to other FIFA offices and venues, typically in Zurich, as well as relocating to another location for a period of time, e.g. during FIFA Women’s World Cup in 2027.
Languages:
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Proficiency in another official FIFA language, such as Spanish, is a benefit.
Technology:
  • Strong knowledge of digital direct-to-consumer ecosystems, including mobile and video.
  • Solid understanding and passion for digital innovation, including application of AI
  • Experience with industry-standard solutions, e.g. Figma, Asana and Confluence
Requirements:
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Senior Brand Manager
job.html_description:
As the organiser of some of the biggest and most iconic sport events in the world, we lead the way in the sport and event industry.

Join the team and support us on our mission.

The Senior Brand Manager contributes to shaping and executing a sustainable and profitable plan for FIFA’s tournament brands, aligned with the overarching FIFA Brand Strategy and designed to support the organisation’s global vision and strategic objectives, under the leadership of the Head of Brand & Creative Services.
The candidate is the brand project lead of Tier 1 Men tournaments, responsible for developing and delivering the tournament brand platform and full suite of assets as well as supports on the comprehensive integration of the brand partners across the 360-activation plan. Notably, the candidate will be responsible of leading the brand development and deployment for the FIFA World Cup 2030.

These are your key tasks:
  • Champions the strategic development of integrated brand positioning and tournament narratives, ensuring each major competition reflects FIFA’s global vision while resonating with diverse audiences and markets.
  • Partners closely with internal stakeholders, and local organising partners to create distinctive brand platforms that are insight-driven, future-focused, and aligned with FIFA’s overarching identity system.
  • Integrates brand strategy with audience intelligence and market data, leveraging research, fan insights, and performance metrics to shape brand narratives, guide creative direction, and optimize campaign effectiveness across global markets.
  • Develop the tournament brand assets full suite in close collaboration with tournament project teams, commercial and media partnerships, various stakeholders across the organisation and local organizing/hosting stakeholders. Ownership over process and timelines, from brief to execution.
  • Manages the delivery of brand tournament related assets (including official marks, official event look of the games, official mascots, official trophies …), printed/digital materials, and brand manuals to the highest standards of quality and consistency.
  • Ensures adequacy and brand consistency of any brand development across touchpoints. Expertise in Brand Events dressing (event look management) is mandatory.
  • Anticipates and proposes commercially relevant branded propositions to enhance commercial offering to partners. Anticipates partners delivery timelines and supports partners rights delivery needs.
  • Translates brand strategy into compelling creative direction hand in hand with senior creative partners both in house and in agency, overseeing the articulation of core themes and storytelling frameworks that drive consistency and emotional impact across all activation channels.
  • Safeguards and evolves FIFA’s brand equity across internal and external partners, ensuring strategic alignment, creative integrity, and cross-functional execution excellence throughout the brand lifecycle.
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • Experience in a global brand management & brand delivery function, preferably in large sports organisations
  • Proven experience leading brand development and strategic planning process
  • Adjacent experience in partner rights delivery, event dressing operations preferred
  • Experience in leading go-to-market, 360 brand launch plans
  • International experience in global sports events delivery is a strong plus
  • Note: This is not a creative role – this is a brand management role
  • University degree or equivalent in business, sports or events management
  • Fluent in English
  • Proficient in Word / PowerPoint / Excel
  • Events Branding deep understanding
  • Partnership rights delivery deep understanding
  • Business driven with strong analytical skills
  • Goal oriented and result-driven, strong decision making skills
  • Has a sense of creativity and aesthetic sensitivity
  • Well-structured and great organizational skills
  • Ability to manage multiple projects in cross-functional collaboration
  • Strong written and verbal skills, able to present strategy and concept to partners and
  • management
  • Entrepreneurial spirt with innovative mind-set
  • Flexibility
  • Self-Motivation
  • Empathy
  • Negotiating skills
  • Political savvy
  • Teamwork abilities
  • Ability to travel as required (30%)
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.

Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
  • Health and fitness: Regular football sessions for all abilities, plus on-site gym.
  • Home office: Up to two days of home office per week if work permits and home office allowance for all.
  • Language courses: Offered to all staff to aid personal and professional growth.
  • Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
  • Pension: Flexible pension benefits with generous employer contributions.
  • Relocation assistance: A dedicated team will be on hand to support your relocation.
  • Sustainability: We support all employees using public transport.
  • Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.
  • Volunteering: Make an impact beyond your regular role and bond with colleagues by volunteering with one of our partners.

job.title: Uniforms Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA27 established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”). 


The Uniforms Manager is responsible for the planning and operational delivery of the corporate FIFA27 Business Casual uniform as well as the FWWC2027 Tournament Dedicated and FIFA Formal uniform programmes in line with the overall FIFA Uniform Strategy and the approved usage and entitlement matrix. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Responsible for project management and implementation of the FWWC2027 uniform programme including issuance operations that support both workforce and volunteers
  • Ensure all FIFA27 workforce have uniform according to the entitlement and usage matrix
  • Effectively collaborate with key FIFA Zurich and FIFA27 stakeholders including Workforce Planning, Volunteer Management, Host City Management, Logistics, Accreditation and Partnership Rights Delivery
  • Create strategy, process and flows for the full project plan for FWWC2027 uniform programme capturing risks and mitigations throughout
  • Develop the operational plan, setting up affiliated systems, identify functional distribution spaces, engage with stakeholders, contract local suppliers to deliver the FWWC2027 uniform programme, across all the Uniforms Distribution Centers
  • Oversee FIFA27 uniform budget, including creating accurate forecasts for each FIFA27 related event e.g. FWWC2027 Draw
  • Manage relationships with external uniform suppliers that may be required, ensuring compliance in line with Framework Agreement and enforcing contractual obligations 
  • Recruit and effectively train and manage the uniforms team (both workforce and volunteers) during planning and delivery periods ensuring best practices are clearly defined and the service level provided across all Uniform Distribution Centers is consistent
  • Manage stock levels and keep up-to-date records of each uniform item during pre-tournament (e.g. Business Casual uniform/ formal items that may be required for side events) and tournament time.
  • Communicate the agreed FIFA27 Uniform Guidelines and Usage Policy at each FIFA tournament and event 
  • Ensure the uniform guidelines are upheld and enforced across all client groups including FIFA Formal Uniform eligibility
  • Plan uniform distribution to all related FWW2027 additional events, e.g. Final Draw, 
  • Work with relevant FIFA27 stakeholders to agree and provide guidelines to Suppliers who are not entitled to Tournament Dedicated Uniforms Other duties as necessary to ensure the smooth running of the FWWC2027 Uniform operations. 
  • Experience in Uniform Management; preferably with experience in mega (sports) events and corporate organisations  
  • Excellent people manager, motivating, inspiring and seeing results through others
  • Knowledge of event planning and event project management processes 
  • Strong IT skill including MS Office (Word, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint) 
  • Fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English. Other languages are an added benefit  
  • Strong written and oral communication 
  • Proven track record in administering uniform projects across complex quantity structures 
  • Team Player, willing to work to tight timelines 
  • Positive attitude, patience and persistence, with a pragmatic approach to solving problems
  • Excellent time management skills and ability to balance competing priorities 
  • Demonstrate initiative and a strong focus on providing a high level of service 
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Wayfinding and Signage Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Wayfinding and Signage Manager reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders.

The FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Wayfinding and Signage Manager is responsible for leading the wayfinding and signage implementation, operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites.
This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world class wayfinding and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the wayfinding and signage is up to FIFA quality standards. 
They will be initially responsible for the technical development of wayfinding signage guidelines and principles in collaboration with the contracted provider(s), department senior team and the other Cluster Managers. Subsequently, the candidate will be responsible for directly overseeing the wayfinding signage planning and implementation at stadiums and other official sites. 

In all aspects of their role, they will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team.  They will oversee contracted provider operations, ensuring that they are managed efficiently while monitoring budgetary spend within agreed limits.  In addition, they will take guidance from other cluster managers to ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Contributing to the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. 
  • Providing expertise in assisting in the compilation of technical wayfinding signage guidelines, principles and templates. 
  • Inputting into the development of the wayfinding signage system(s) used to assist with the planning of the project. 
  • Providing strategic input into the development and implementation of the wayfinding signage kit of parts to be utilized at all official sites. 
  • Overseeing the wayfinding signage planning and implementation at the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ stadiums in Brazil. 
  • Working with other Cluster Managers ensuring that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums. 
  • Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all sites within the sites.
  • Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of allocated wayfinding operations and reporting updates to senior department members.
  • Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department.
  • Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project. 
  • Liaising with site owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans. 
  • Attending department-specific and organization site visits at both assigned sites and potentially additional official sites. 
  • Acting as the main wayfinding point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers during the implementation phase of the project. 
  • Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required.
  • Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against. 
  • Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities.
  • Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods.
  • Relevant experience in delivering wayfinding and signage projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. and experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive wayfinding and signage related activities. 
  • Experience in devising technical guidelines and wayfinding signage kit of parts for large-scale events. 
  • A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.)
  • Strong understanding of stadium wayfinding and signage requirements and large-scale temporary installations.
  • Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects. 
  • Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events.
  • Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events.
  • Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments. 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education).
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential.
  • The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period.
    Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Ticketing General Public Customer Care Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting to the Ticketing Customer Relationship Senior Manager, the Ticketing General Public Customer Care Manager owns the design, implementation and performance of the customer care strategy for General Public ticket buyers across the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™ ticketing and hospitality operation.  

The role translates FIFA's ticketing requirements and the tournament's sales strategy into a working service model (service levels, escalation paths, vendor standards) and leads the resources responsible for delivering it. Given the tournament's international buyer base, the role carries direct accountability for service quality to overseas clients, including language coverage, time-zone alignment and cross-border payment and fraud edge cases.


  • Define and own the customer care strategy and operating model across every channel (contact forms, call center, chatbot, email, and any added over time), setting the direction that Coordinators, Specialists and outsourced teams execute day to day. 
 
  • Own the end-to-end relationship with outsourced customer care and call center providers — contract terms and SLAs, onboarding and setup, ongoing performance management, and renewal or renegotiation decisions when service falls short. 
 
  • Define the training curriculum and certification standards for customer care and call center staff, aligned to the sales strategy and FIFA ticketing regulations, and hold providers and team leads accountable for delivery quality and pass rates. 
  • Step into direct customer care delivery (back office and onsite) only for cases requiring Manager-level authority — media-sensitive escalations, VIP-adjacent complaints surfacing through the General Public channel, or capacity gaps during peak on-sale periods and match days. 
 
  • Design and own the escalation governance framework across channels and teams, and act as the final internal escalation point before matters reach the Senior Manager. 
 
  • Set the quality control framework and standards and own the corrective-action decisions when the QA team flags deviations from service requirements. 
 
  • Own the case management strategy inside the CRM — workflow design, automation rules, and the logic for what's handled automatically versus manually — partnering with the CRM/Digital team on system configuration. 
 
  • Build the business case for, and drive adoption of, productivity and satisfaction improvements — tooling, process redesign, agent enablement — across customer care and call center operations. 
 
  • Identify and report patterns and risks to the Senior Manager and relevant FIFA stakeholders, own the mitigation processes, and escalate anything beyond the team's authority to resolve. 
 
  • Act as Customer Care's point of accountability toward FIFA functional areas (Legal, Sustainability, Data Protection, Finance, etc.), translating their requirements into operational process and owning any compliance gaps that surface. 
 
  • Define the KPI framework for customer care and call center performance, and use CRM and other systems' output to make staffing, resourcing and vendor-performance decisions — reporting outcomes to the Senior Manager. 
 
  • Lead the Quality Assurance team: set methodology and standards, and use QA findings to drive corrective action across the wider operation, in-house and outsourced. 
 
  • Own the governance model for the multilingual customer care knowledge base — standards, versioning, ownership — with day-to-day administration executed by the team. 
SKILLS FRAMEWORK  
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyse one’s behaviour, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes. 
 
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculate risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.    
 
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts. 
 
INITIATIVE: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents.  
  
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans. 
 
EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS 
 
Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent in relevant areas.      
 
WORK EXPERIENCE 
 
  • Minimum five years experience in leading large teams, including in-house staff and external service providers, with international and different cultural backgrounds under the same goal.   
  • Minimum three years experience in leading Ticketing Customer Care teams on major international sports events, including recruitment, training, and the delivery of the project.  
  • Planning, managing, and conducting ticketing customer care strategies and processes for world-scale projects, experience in International Sports Events, including previous FIFA World Cups.  
  • Venue and onsite operations experience for ticketing and/or Sport Events.   
  • Experience in similar role during previous FIFA World Cups.  
  • Team-leading skills, able to lead multicultural teams.   
  • Communication and problem-solving skills.   
 
LANGUAGES 
 
Fluent in English and Portuguese, spoken and written. 
Spanish and/or additional languages is highly advantageous. 
 
TECHNOLOGY 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Monday) and planning software and online collaboration tools   
  • CRM software for case management, including automatic and manual management of the cases.    
Certifications & Requirements 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Right to work in Brazil
