job.title: Senior Business Intelligence Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Senior Business Intelligence Manager will lead the intelligence and performance measurement agenda for Brand, Marketing & Promotions, transforming data, research and consumer insights into actionable recommendations that support the growth and success of the tournament.

Reporting to the Head of Brand & Marketing in Brazil and to the Team Lead Business Intelligence & Marketing Strategy in Zurich, the role will act as a strategic business partner to Marketing leadership, building a comprehensive view of tournament performance across audience growth, brand health, fan engagement, digital behavior, marketing effectiveness and ticketing conversion. The role will serve as the primary link between the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ local business and FIFA’s central Business Intelligence office , which acts as the repository and governance hub for research, data, reports, methodologies and performance insights. The central Business Intelligence will ensure that relevant central intelligence is effectively translated and shared with local stakeholders, while also capturing local business needs, market context and emerging information requirements and communicating them back to the central office. 

The successful candidate will connect multiple data sources and business perspectives to understand not only what is happening, but why it is happening and what FIFA should do next. The role will establish clear measurement frameworks, identify growth opportunities and performance gaps, and provide senior leadership with the intelligence required to make faster and better-informed decisions.

With the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ set to become a landmark sporting event in Brazil and South America, this role will be central to understanding fan behavior, optimizing investment and turning audience interest into meaningful engagement, participation and attendance.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Strategy: Make sure that the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Marketing and Communication Strategy will be accordingly translated to Brand, Marketing & Promotions.
  • Business Intelligence: Using the strict connection with the FIFA’s central Business Intelligence office, establishing the data, research, KPIs and measurement frameworks required to assess tournament growth and marketing performance.
  • Tournament Performance Framework: Build and maintain an integrated measurement framework connecting the department’s strategic objectives to measurable KPIs across awareness, consideration, excitement, fan engagement, audience growth, registration, conversion and ticket sales. 
  • Audience & Fan Intelligence: Develop a deep understanding of existing and potential FIFA Women’s World Cup audiences in Brazil, starting with the general key audience segments as already defined, and identifying niches, motivations, barriers, behaviors and consumption patterns to inform marketing, content and fan engagement strategies
  • Ticketing & Conversion Intelligence: Partner closely with Ticketing, Digital and Marketing teams to analyze the fan journey from awareness and interest through registration and ticket purchase, identifying conversion opportunities, friction points and audience segments requiring additional marketing support. 
  • Marketing Effectiveness: Evaluate campaign and channel performance across paid, owned, earned and partner activity, establishing clear methodologies to assess reach, engagement, incremental impact, conversion and return on marketing investment. 
  • Research & Consumer Insights: In conjunction with the central BI office , lead the local research and insights agenda for Marketing, combining FIFA global research, brand tracking, quantitative and qualitative studies, social listening and behavioral data to identify emerging trends and support strategic decisions. 
  • Forecasting & Scenario Planning: Develop forecasts, scenarios and early-warning indicators to identify potential performance gaps and opportunities, particularly around audience growth, campaign effectiveness, fan acquisition and ticketing demand. 
  • Media & Communications Intelligence: Collaborate with Communications and Media teams to integrate earned media, PR, broadcast, social and cultural impact indicators into the broader assessment of tournament awareness and momentum. 
  • Digital & Fan Journey Analytics: Work closely with the central BI office, Digital Delivery and CRM teams to understand behavior across FIFA's digital ecosystem and optimize acquisition, engagement, registration and conversion journeys using first-party and behavioral data. 
  • Dashboards & Executive Reporting: Develop intuitive dashboards and executive-level reporting that highlight performance against targets, emerging trends, risks and opportunities. Ensure reporting prioritizes actionable insights rather than data volume. 
  • Investment Optimization: Provide data-driven recommendations to support marketing budget allocation, helping identify which audiences, channels, campaigns and initiatives are generating the greatest impact against tournament objectives. 
  • Leadership Communication: Present insights, opportunities, risks and recommendations clearly and confidently to senior FIFA leadership, translating analytical complexity into concise and compelling business narratives.
Education & Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Statistics, Data Analytics, Engineering or a related discipline. 
  • Postgraduate degree or MBA in Business, Marketing, Analytics or related fields is highly beneficial. 
  • Relevant qualifications in data analytics, consumer insights, market research or business intelligence are beneficial. 
Work Experience
  • Strong experience in Business Intelligence, Marketing Analytics, Consumer Insights, Growth Analytics, Strategy or related disciplines, ideally within complex consumer-facing organizations. 
  • Strong experience transforming data and research into strategic business recommendations, with demonstrated influence on marketing, commercial or customer decisions. 
  • Demonstrable experience designing KPI frameworks, performance measurement systems and executive dashboards across multiple business objectives and data sources. 
  • Experience analyzing consumer journeys, audience acquisition, engagement and conversion, ideally within sports, entertainment, media, ticketing, e-commerce or other direct-to-consumer environments. 
  • Strong experience in marketing effectiveness and campaign measurement across digital, paid media, CRM, social, content and/or brand activity. 
  • Experience working with consumer and market research, including brand tracking, audience segmentation and quantitative and qualitative methodologies. 
  • Experience combining multiple sources of information — including behavioral, transactional, digital, media and research data — into an integrated business perspective. 
  • Experience with forecasting, scenario modelling and performance target setting is highly desirable. 
  • Proven experience communicating complex analysis to senior executives and turning analytical outputs into clear recommendations and compelling business narratives. 
  • Experience working in large-scale events, sports, entertainment, media or culturally relevant consumer brands will be highly beneficial. 
  • Demonstrable ability to operate autonomously in fast-moving and ambiguous environments, balancing long-term intelligence strategies with immediate business needs. 
Competencies
  • Strategic Thinker: Able to connect data and analysis to broader business priorities and identify the implications behind the numbers. 
  • Commercial & Consumer Mindset: Strong understanding of the relationship between audience behavior, marketing investment, engagement and conversion. 
  • Insight Driven: Naturally curious and focused on identifying the “why” behind performance, rather than simply describing results. 
  • Storytelling with Data: Exceptional ability to translate complex information into simple, persuasive narratives for senior decision-makers. 
  • Business Partnering: Comfortable challenging assumptions, asking difficult questions and providing evidence-based recommendations to senior stakeholders. 
  • Big Picture & Detail: Able to move between executive-level strategy and granular analysis depending on the business requirement. 
  • Proactive & Action-oriented: Anticipates questions, identifies potential issues before they become critical and actively proposes solutions. 
  • Collaborative: Strong ability to work across functions, markets and levels of technical sophistication, creating alignment around common KPIs and business objectives. 
  • Curious & Innovative: Constantly explores new data sources, analytical approaches, AI capabilities and methodologies that can improve understanding of fans and tournament performance. 
  • Results-oriented: Focused on using intelligence to influence measurable outcomes rather than producing analysis as an end in itself. 
Technology
  • Advanced experience with Business Intelligence and data visualization platforms, such as Power BI, Tableau or Looker. 
  • Strong understanding of digital analytics platforms, such as Google Analytics 4 and/or Adobe Analytics. 
  • Strong working knowledge of SQL and experience working with large and diverse datasets. 
  • Experience with CRM, CDP, marketing automation and first-party data environments is highly beneficial. 
  • Familiarity with paid media, social analytics, media monitoring and social listening platforms. 
  • Experience with market research, brand tracking and consumer intelligence platforms. 
  • Knowledge of statistical analysis and modelling tools such as Python or R is beneficial, but not essential. 
  • Strong understanding of AI and its application to analytics, insight generation, forecasting and marketing optimization.
Requirements
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Ensure reporting prioritizes actionable insights rather than data volume. - Investment Optimization: Provide data-driven recommendations to support marketing budget allocation, helping identify which audiences, channels, campaigns and initiatives are generating the greatest impact against tournament objectives. - Leadership Communication: Present insights, opportunities, risks and recommendations clearly and confidently to senior FIFA leadership, translating analytical complexity into concise and compelling business narratives.
Education & Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Statistics, Data Analytics, Engineering or a related discipline. - Postgraduate degree or MBA in Business, Marketing, Analytics or related fields is highly beneficial. - Relevant qualifications in data analytics, consumer insights, market research or business intelligence are beneficial.
Work Experience
- Strong experience in Business Intelligence, Marketing Analytics, Consumer Insights, Growth Analytics, Strategy or related disciplines, ideally within complex consumer-facing organizations. - Strong experience transforming data and research into strategic business recommendations, with demonstrated influence on marketing, commercial or customer decisions. - Demonstrable experience designing KPI frameworks, performance measurement systems and executive dashboards across multiple business objectives and data sources. - Experience analyzing consumer journeys, audience acquisition, engagement and conversion, ideally within sports, entertainment, media, ticketing, e-commerce or other direct-to-consumer environments. - Strong experience in marketing effectiveness and campaign measurement across digital, paid media, CRM, social, content and/or brand activity. - Experience working with consumer and market research, including brand tracking, audience segmentation and quantitative and qualitative methodologies. - Experience combining multiple sources of information — including behavioral, transactional, digital, media and research data — into an integrated business perspective. - Experience with forecasting, scenario modelling and performance target setting is highly desirable. - Proven experience communicating complex analysis to senior executives and turning analytical outputs into clear recommendations and compelling business narratives. - Experience working in large-scale events, sports, entertainment, media or culturally relevant consumer brands will be highly beneficial. - Demonstrable ability to operate autonomously in fast-moving and ambiguous environments, balancing long-term intelligence strategies with immediate business needs.
Competencies
- Strategic Thinker: Able to connect data and analysis to broader business priorities and identify the implications behind the numbers. - Commercial & Consumer Mindset: Strong understanding of the relationship between audience behavior, marketing investment, engagement and conversion. - Insight Driven: Naturally curious and focused on identifying the “why” behind performance, rather than simply describing results. - Storytelling with Data: Exceptional ability to translate complex information into simple, persuasive narratives for senior decision-makers. - Business Partnering: Comfortable challenging assumptions, asking difficult questions and providing evidence-based recommendations to senior stakeholders. - Big Picture & Detail: Able to move between executive-level strategy and granular analysis depending on the business requirement. - Proactive & Action-oriented: Anticipates questions, identifies potential issues before they become critical and actively proposes solutions. - Collaborative: Strong ability to work across functions, markets and levels of technical sophistication, creating alignment around common KPIs and business objectives. - Curious & Innovative: Constantly explores new data sources, analytical approaches, AI capabilities and methodologies that can improve understanding of fans and tournament performance. - Results-oriented: Focused on using intelligence to influence measurable outcomes rather than producing analysis as an end in itself.
Technology
- Advanced experience with Business Intelligence and data visualization platforms, such as Power BI, Tableau or Looker. - Strong understanding of digital analytics platforms, such as Google Analytics 4 and/or Adobe Analytics. - Strong working knowledge of SQL and experience working with large and diverse datasets. - Experience with CRM, CDP, marketing automation and first-party data environments is highly beneficial. - Familiarity with paid media, social analytics, media monitoring and social listening platforms. - Experience with market research, brand tracking and consumer intelligence platforms. - Knowledge of statistical analysis and modelling tools such as Python or R is beneficial, but not essential. - Strong understanding of AI and its application to analytics, insight generation, forecasting and marketing optimization.
Requirements
- Right to work in Brazil. - Fluent in English (spoken and written) - Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written) - Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Ticketing General Public Customer Care Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Ticketing CRM Senior Manager the Ticketing General Public Customer Care Manager will help serve Ticketing and Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.  

This role will be responsible for the implementation and management of the customer care strategies and processes for General Public Customers, ensuring compliance with the applicable sales strategy and the FIFA ticketing requirements and regulations. The Customer Care Coordinator focuses particularly on the delivery of effective ticketing customer care for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 with a special focus on international clients. FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Implement and effectively manage the customer care strategies and processes across all the communications channels established, including but not limited to the contact forms, call centers, chatbot, emails, etc.      
  • Support the Customer Care Manager in managing the customer care team and the potential outsourced customer care and call center service providers for the implementation and effective delivery of the services, ensuring a proper setup of all the services required.      
  • Support the Customer Care Manager in ensuring proper training of all the customer care staff members and the call center teams, according to the sales strategy and the FIFA ticketing requirements and regulations;   
  • Perform customer care ticketing processes (back office and onsite) whenever required;   
  • Apply the escalation processes and ensure his proper implementation by the different teams;       
  • Plan and implement quality control procedures to ensure that any deviation from the requirements is detected and corrected as soon as possible;       
  • Support the proper implementation of effective processes and strategies for automated and manual case management using the respective CRM systems;    
  • Actively search and implement solutions to pro-actively increase the productivity of customer care and call center agents, and maximize customer information and satisfaction;   
  • Pro-actively identify and report on patterns and risks, and implement processes to mitigate them;     
  • Ensure that all the Customer Care processes are in compliance with the different FIFA functional areas requirements, including but not limited to Legal, Sustainability, Data Protection, Finance, etc.  
  • Analyze and report regularly on KPIs and the effectiveness of customer care and call center services, using CRM and other systems;    
  • Manage and train a small team in charge of performing quality assurance checks. 
  • Ensure an efficient administration and archive of all versions of customer care and call center knowledge base, in all languages.   
SKILLS FRAMEWORK  
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyse one’s behaviour, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes. 
 
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculate risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.    
 
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts. 
 
INITIATIVE: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents.  
  
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans. 
 
EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS 
 
Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent in relevant areas.      
 
WORK EXPERIENCE 
 
  • Minimum three years experience in leading large teams, including in-house staff and external service providers, with international and different cultural backgrounds under the same goal. 
  • Minimum two years experience in leading Ticketing Customer Care teams on major international sports events, including recruitment, training, and the delivery of the project. 
  • Planning, managing, and conducting ticketing customer care strategies and processes for world-scale projects, experience in International Sports Events, including previous FIFA World Cups.    
  • Venue and onsite operations experience for ticketing and/or Sport Events. 
  • Experience in similar role during previous FIFA World Cups. 
  • Team-leading skills, able to lead multicultural teams.   
  • Communication and problem-solving skills.   
 
LANGUAGES 
 
Fluent in English and Portuguese, spoken and written. 
Spanish and/or additional languages is highly advantageous. 
 
TECHNOLOGY 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Monday) and planning software and online collaboration tools   
  • CRM software for case management, including automatic and manual management of the cases.  
Certifications & Requirements 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Right to work in Brazil

job.title: Travel Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Travel Manager leads end-to-end travel operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including flights, accommodation and ground transportation.

The role requires hands-on experience with bookings, quotations, ticket issuance, reissuance, availability checks and fare rules, as well as coordinating complex group travel for major events.

Working closely with FIFA teams, airlines, suppliers and other stakeholders, the Travel Manager must combine strong operational knowledge with flexibility, empathy and a genuine service mindset.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage flight and hotel bookings, quotations, ticket issuance, reissuance, cancellations and refunds using Amadeus.
  • Apply airline fare rules, ticketing conditions, deadlines, penalties and baggage policies.
  • Coordinate travel for groups of over 100 people, including flights, accommodation, visas, ground transportation and itineraries.
  • Build strong relationships with airlines, hotels, travel agencies and transportation providers.
  • Negotiate rates, booking conditions and operational solutions while monitoring budgets and costs.
  • Support travellers during schedule changes, disruptions, emergencies and other unexpected situations.
  • Develop contingency plans and make quick, practical decisions in high-pressure situations.
  • Maintain accurate travel data, reports, passenger lists and operational documentation.
  • Coordinate travel requirements across multiple cities and client groups, including teams, delegations, guests, VIPs and workforce.
  • Provide responsive, patient and solution-oriented service throughout the travel journey.
  • Development of contingency plans for high level client groups
  • Proactive identification and mitigation of operational risks
  • Decision-making under high time pressure to ensure continuity of tournament operations while maintaining service levels and cost control
  • Acting as an advisory interface between FIFA Functional Areas, External Stakeholders, Suppliers, Host Country Authorities, and FIFA/FWWC27 Senior leadership
  • Preparation of executive-level briefings, recommendations, and decision papers related to travel strategy, pricing, and operational readiness
  • Support to FIFA Partnerships in managing expectations with commercial partners in high-demand or capacity-constrained environments

YOUR PROFILE

  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
  • Completed (business) travel agency education or business education with training in the travel industry
  • Further education in tourism, event or general management
  • Strong experience in the business travel industry (travel, accommodation and ground transportation) 
  • Excellent skills in GDS, preferably GDS Amadeus/ticketing and fare rules 
  •  Relevant experience in project and event management

job.title: Workforce Planning & Operations Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Working alongside the FIFA Workforce Management team based in Zurich and reporting to the FIFA27 Head of Workforce, the Manager, Workforce Planning & Operations is responsible for executing all workforce planning phases and processes, ensures the organisation has the right talent in the right roles at the right time.

Workforce Strategy & Planning
• Support the implementation of workforce planning and operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027)
• Coordinate and execute workforce planning activities across all workforce types (paid staff, freelancers, tournament-time hires, secondees, etc.)
• Work closely with the FIFA Workforce Management team to support an integrated planning process, ensuring resources align with operational needs and service levels
• Assist in defining workforce categories and supporting the development of entitlements for each group
• Maintain and update the centralised headcount plan, ensuring data accuracy and accessibility
• Support change management activities to enable continuity in workforce planning and execution
• Contribute inputs to workforce budgets, timelines, and planning cycles

Workforce Operations & Management
• Help develop and execute operational plans for workforce delivery during tournament time, including supporting site operations
• Assist in defining requirements for physical spaces, overlay, technology, and other workforce-related needs on site
• Develop workforce policies & procedures with key operational stakeholders (transport, accommodation, catering etc.) and core central business areas such as HR, technology, finance. 
• Define and map out key workforce planning & operational processes, understanding the cross-functional collaboration required.
• Support the coordination of business processes and system requirements for workforce operations tools
• Deliver role-specific and venue-specific training for workforce operations teams
• Support the day-to-day supervision, scheduling and coordination of workforce operations teams, including workforce and volunteers
• Provide operational support to venue managers during event delivery

  • Work Experience
    • Experience in workforce planning or operations, ideally within international events and/or the sports industry
    • Good working knowledge of workforce planning systems, tools, and practices
    • Experience supporting or coordinating operational venue teams at large-scale events
    • Understanding of data-driven decision-making and workforce planning processes in complex environments
    • Demonstrated ability to manage projects, prioritise tasks effectively, and work with a level of independence
    • Experience supervising team members and contributing to team performance through positive leadership and collaboration
    • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
    • Demonstrated adaptability, with experience supporting discussions, problem-solving, and stakeholder coordination
    • Experience working in a multicultural and/or multinational environment
    • Fluent in English, both written and spoken  
    • Fluent/Advanced Portuguese

  • Technology
    • Proficient in MS Office tools (Word, PowerPoint, Visio & advanced Excel) 
    • Proficiency in using project planning tools such as WeTrack and Monday.com
    • Experience with workforce system implementations advantageous

job.title: Head Coach – Afghanistan Women’s National Team (Freelancer)
job.html_description:
As the organiser of some of the biggest and most iconic sport events in the world, we lead the way in the sport and event industry.

Join the team as a freelancer and support us on our mission.

The Head Coach will lead the technical, tactical and cultural development of the Afghanistan Women’s National Team. The role is responsible for preparing the team to perform competitively on the international stage while creating a safe, inclusive and high-performance environment for players and staff.

Reporting Line: The Head Coach will report directly to the Technical & Sporting Lead.

This role is funded through the FIFA Women’s Football Division and will be contracted under the following terms:

Start Date: ASAP
Location: Remote
Contract Type: Freelancer

Further details regarding payment structure, deliverables, and support services will be included in the official contract and onboarding documentation.
These are your key tasks:
  • Lead the technical and tactical delivery of the Afghanistan Women’s National Team programme.
  • Develop and implement a clear playing style, training methodology and match strategy.
  • Prepare and deliver high-quality training sessions, match plans and in-game tactical adjustments.
  • Build a united, disciplined and cohesive team environment.
  • Lead squad selection in coordination with the Technical & Sporting Lead and relevant staff.
  • Build player profiles covering technical, tactical, physical, medical and psychological with relevant staff.
  • Create and monitor individual player development plans.
  • Support player identification and provide input into recruitment, scouting and talent pathway decisions.
  • Recruit, onboard and manage assistant coaches and technical and performance staff where required.
  • Create a positive, collaborative and accountable working environment.
  • Coordinate closely with medical, safeguarding, operations, logistics, analysis and communications staff.
  • Work with the Medical and Performance Lead to support player fitness, injury prevention, return-to-play and recovery plans.
  • Ensure player welfare, safeguarding and duty-of-care standards are embedded in all team activities.
  • Foster an inclusive and respectful environment that values the diverse backgrounds and experiences of players and staff.
  • Provide strong leadership, role-modelling and emotional intelligence across camps, matches and team environments.
  • Build trust with players and staff through clear communication, consistency and cultural sensitivity.
  • Lead pre-match preparation, opposition analysis and post-match reviews.
  • Conduct post-camp and post-match debriefs, identifying lessons and priorities for future improvement.
  • Support communications activity where required, ensuring messaging is culturally sensitive and aligned with programme objectives.
  • Contribute to regular performance reports and updates for FIFA leadership and relevant stakeholders.
  • Travel internationally for camps, matches, scouting and programme activities as required.
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • Pro Licence preferred.
  • A Licence essential.
  • Minimum five years’ coaching experience in football, ideally within a club, federation or national team environment.
  • Proven coaching experience in women’s football.
  • Experience working with elite, semi-professional or international-level players.
  • Strong understanding of technical and tactical principles of the game.
  • Ability to design and deliver high-quality training sessions and match preparation.
  • Proven ability to build a positive, inclusive and high-performing team culture.
  • Strong leadership, communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to manage players and staff with professionalism, empathy and authority.
  • Experience working as part of a multidisciplinary team, including performance, medical, analysis, operations and safeguarding staff.
  • Strong understanding of player development, performance feedback and individual development planning.
  • Ability to work sensitively with players from diverse cultural, social and football backgrounds.
  • High level of integrity, discretion and emotional intelligence.
  • Flexible, resilient and adaptable in fast-paced or complex environments.
  • Willingness to travel internationally and work across different contexts.
  • Excellent spoken and written English.
  • Valid safeguarding certification.
  • Valid police/background check or willingness to complete one before appointment
  • Strong IT skills, including video analysis tools, PowerPoint, Word and Excel.

Desirable Qualifications
  • Experience working with diaspora player groups or geographically dispersed squads.
  • Experience supporting players in complex or sensitive cultural environments.
  • Knowledge of Afghan football, Afghan culture or the Afghan diaspora.
  • Additional languages such as Dari, Pashto, French or Spanish.

- Pro Licence preferred. - A Licence essential. - Minimum five years’ coaching experience in football, ideally within a club, federation or national team environment. - Proven coaching experience in women’s football. - Experience working with elite, semi-professional or international-level players. - Strong understanding of technical and tactical principles of the game. - Ability to design and deliver high-quality training sessions and match preparation. - Proven ability to build a positive, inclusive and high-performing team culture. - Strong leadership, communication and interpersonal skills. - Ability to manage players and staff with professionalism, empathy and authority. - Experience working as part of a multidisciplinary team, including performance, medical, analysis, operations and safeguarding staff. - Strong understanding of player development, performance feedback and individual development planning. - Ability to work sensitively with players from diverse cultural, social and football backgrounds. - High level of integrity, discretion and emotional intelligence. - Flexible, resilient and adaptable in fast-paced or complex environments. - Willingness to travel internationally and work across different contexts. - Excellent spoken and written English. - Valid safeguarding certification. - Valid police/background check or willingness to complete one before appointment - Strong IT skills, including video analysis tools, PowerPoint, Word and Excel.
Desirable Qualifications
- Experience working with diaspora player groups or geographically dispersed squads. - Experience supporting players in complex or sensitive cultural environments. - Knowledge of Afghan football, Afghan culture or the Afghan diaspora. - Additional languages such as Dari, Pashto, French or Spanish.

job.title: Legal Counsel Commercial Legal
job.html_description:
We govern the beautiful game and ensure it's run with transparency and integrity.

Join our team in Miami and support us on our mission.
The Legal Counsel will be an active member of the Commercial Legal Team working with various Senior Legal Counsels, the Head of Content & Media and the Director of Commercial Legal to
support the delivery of legal services relating to FIFA’s global operations.

The role of Legal Counsel will support some, or all, of the business functions within FIFA’s global operations, such as the following:

  • Assisting the commercial teams by advising on their everyday operations
  • Assisting in drafting, negotiating and advising on a broad range of commercial and media partnerships matters connected with FIFA’s revenue generating activities
  • Providing support regarding the interpretation of a range of media, rights, marketing, IP, retail and licensing, agency appointments, consumer promotions and technology agreements
  • Assisting in providing legal support related to Web3 activities, social media, digital content, gaming and e-sports related matters
  • Providing legal and contractual support to FIFA’s strategic and corporate development activities
  • Providing legal and contractual support on the exploitation of commercial opportunities on FIFA’s digital platforms
  • Supporting FIFA’s subsidiaries, including the FIFA Museum and the FIFA Foundation regarding the exploitation of commercial opportunities within FIFA’s commercial framework
  • Providing advice, guidance and support for all legal, regulatory and governance matters relating to FIFA’s commercial media activities
  • Providing legal support and counsel on development and production deal structures and documentation for internal and third-party projects, including advising on pre-production and coproduction deals
  • Assisting in managing, developing and maintaining FIFA's portfolio of non-live content related templates
  • Assisting and providing support for the FIFA Technology team in support of the upcoming major FIFA tournaments worldwide
  • Assisting and providing support for the FIFA Innovation team in support of the upcoming major FIFA tournaments worldwide
  • Providing legal support for music related matters (both live and recorded music)
  • Instructing and liaising with external counsel in connection with local law matters in various jurisdictions
  • Developing and maintaining FIFA’s template agreements
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

This role would suit someone with great communication skills who is a dedicated team player and excels in being professional with excellent legal skills.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • Ability to participate and be part of a high-performing team, fostering collaboration, driving results, and ensuring the successful achievement of organizational goals
  • First class written and spoken English language skills, consistent with drafting and negotiating complex, high value and nuanced English language agreements
  • Ability to provide and communicate effectively practical and solutions-based legal advice
  • Excellent understanding of the sports marketing, sports merchandising, licensing, retail, digital marketing, sponsorship, licensing, e-commerce and business intelligence industry landscapes
  • Excellent negotiation, drafting, problem solving and analytical skills
  • Structured, reliable, with a strong eye for detail
  • Ability to perform consistently within a high-performing team, fostering collaboration, driving results, and ensuring the successful achievement of organizational goals
  • Strong commercial acumen with an ability to transfer legal knowledge into commercially and operationally oriented solutions
  • Proactive, with a strong sense of personal responsibility and an ability to work autonomously on a wide variety of projects
  • Resilient with an ability to competently handle a large workload amid rapidly shifting priorities
  • Open-minded team player with an affinity for working within a variety of cultures and excellent communication skills
  • High degree of professionalism and confidence
  • Ability to be a good ambassador for FIFA in all manner of external facing situations, including during contractual negotiations, external workshops and during FIFA competition-related assignments
  • Ability to create, develop and maintain strong and reliable relationships with FIFA senior management as well as external legal and commercial counterparts
  • Willingness to operate outside of comfort zone
  • Takes initiative to reflect on how to improve and develop working styles and methods to assist internal clients
  • Juris Doctor (JD) degree from an accredited law school
  • Active bar membership is required
  • 4-6 years expertise in an in-house legal department or a top-tier law firm focusing on technology, media, sports or IP matters
  • Native level English (or equivalent), consistent with requirement to draft and negotiate complex and nuanced English language agreements and advice
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (French/Spanish/Portuguese) is an asset but not required
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Outlook / Word / PowerPoint / Excel / Teams
  • Comfortable with international travel
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.
 
Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
 
Health insurance: We offer generous medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage.
Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
Retirement: We offer generous 401(k) employer contributions.
Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.

job.title: Ticketing General Public Customer Care Analyst
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Reporting organizationally to the Ticketing CRM Senior Manager and the Ticketing General Public Customer Care Coordinator, the Ticketing General Public Customer Care Analyst will support Ticketing and Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™. 

This role will be responsible for the implementation, monitoring and continuous improvement of the customer care strategies and processes for General Public Customers, ensuring compliance with the applicable sales strategy and the FIFA ticketing requirements and regulations. The Customer Care Analyst focuses particularly on the analysis and performance optimization of ticketing customer care for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027, with a focus on both national and international clients. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Support the design and monitor the performance of customer care strategies and processes across all communication channels established (contact forms, call centers, chatbot, emails, etc.), flagging adjustments needed for consistency and effectiveness. 
  • Support the Customer Care Manager in overseeing outsourced customer care and call center service providers, monitoring service setups and delivery against agreed requirements and service levels. 
  • Support the design of training content and monitor training completion and effectiveness for customer care staff and call center teams, in line with the sales strategy and FIFA ticketing requirements and regulations. 
  • Review and validate customer care ticketing processes (back office and onsite) on a sample basis to ensure adherence to standards. 
  • Monitor adherence to escalation processes across teams and report on deviations for correction. 
  • Design and implement quality control procedures to detect deviations from requirements early and flag them for timely correction. 
  • Support the design, implementation and ongoing optimization of automated and manual case management processes within the CRM systems in use. 
  • Analyze customer care and call center performance data to identify opportunities to increase agent productivity and customer satisfaction, and support the implementation of resulting solutions. 
  • Proactively identify and report on patterns and risks, and support the design of processes to mitigate them. 
  • Monitor and report on Customer Care process compliance with FIFA functional area requirements (Legal, Sustainability, Data Protection, Finance, etc.), flagging gaps for resolution. 
  • Analyze and report regularly on KPIs and the effectiveness of customer care and call center services, using CRM and other systems. 
  • Coordinate the quality assurance checks performed across the customer care operation and consolidate findings into regular reporting. 
  • Maintain version control and archiving of the customer care and call center knowledge base, across all languages, ensuring accuracy and accessibility. 
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
SKILLS FRAMEWORK  
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyse one’s behaviour, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes.
 
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculate risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.   
 
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts.
 
INITIATIVE: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents. 
 
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans.
 
EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent in relevant areas.     

WORK EXPERIENCE 
 
  • Experience working within large, multicultural operational structures (in-house staff and external service providers), collaborating toward a shared operational goal. 
  •  Experience supporting Ticketing Customer Care operations on major international sports events, with exposure to recruitment, training and project delivery processes. 
  •  Experience planning, monitoring and analysing ticketing customer care strategies and processes for world-scale projects; prior exposure to International Sports Events, including previous FIFA World Cups, is an advantage. 
  •  Venue and onsite operations experience for ticketing and/or sport events. 
  •  Experience in an analytical or customer care operations role during previous FIFA World Cups or comparable major international sports events is advantageous. 
  •  Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, able to work effectively within multicultural teams. 
  •  Strong communication, analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 
LANGUAGES

Fluent in English and Portuguese, spoken and written.
Spanish and/or additional languages is highly advantageous.

TECHNOLOGY 
 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Monday) and planning software and online collaboration tools   
  •  CRM software for case management, including automatic and manual management of the cases.

job.title: Senior Legal Counsel Ethics
job.html_description:
We govern the beautiful game and ensure it's run with transparency and integrity.

Join our team in Miami and support us on our mission.
These are your key tasks:
  • Conducting autonomously ethics proceedings in accordance with the FIFA Code of Ethics;
  • Investigating ethics proceedings, including the review and analysis of financial records, the use of forensic audit techniques, and the development of financial investigative strategies;
  • Drafting communications and request for information to the interested/accused parties within an ethics proceeding;
  • Supporting the preparation of witness interviews and witness statements, and, when necessary, coordinating such tasks with other departments or external experts within the context of ethics proceedings;
  • Liaising with FIFA departments and subject-matter experts to secure support for FIFA Ethics Committee matters;
  • Supporting the relevant chairperson and members of the Ethics Committee by preparing case files, legal analyses, and draft decisions to facilitate effective deliberations;
  • Assisting the relevant chairperson of the FIFA Ethics Committee in the preparation of meetings;
  • Assessment of legal aid requests, witness protection, witness/victim’s psychological support, and when necessary, coordinating such tasks with other departments or external experts within the ethics proceedings;
  • Drafting final Reports within an ethics proceeding;
  • Analyzing testimonials and other documentary evidence, including financial and audit records, to weigh its credibility and probative value within the context and standards of the FIFA Code of Ethics;
  • Conduct legal analysis of FIFA precedent and CAS jurisprudence to support the drafting of final investigation reports and Ethics Committee decisions;
  • Drafting decisions of the Adjudicatory Chamber;
  • Contributing to the ongoing development of workflows, templates, and best practices to ensure efficiency and consistency;
  • Identify and recommend measures to prevent violations of the FIFA Code of Ethics and promote the safeguarding and integrity of football worldwide;
  • Close collaboration and support to the Head of Department in creating efficient ethics proceedings (i.e. determining processes, workflow, template creation, etc.);
  • Ensuring a worldwide recognition of the activity of the Investigation Department and the Judicial Bodies Subdivision;
  • Assistance in preparing any report related to the activities of the ethics department, including newsletters, status reports, etc.
  • Holding and participating in workshops with FIFA employees, member associations or confederations on Judicial Bodies-related issues.
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • Excellent legal drafting and presentation skills in English;
  • Proficiency legal drafting in Spanish or French is an asset;
  • Good knowledge of football governance as well as of FIFA’s regulations, and proven experience in FIFA’s Disciplinary and Ethics proceedings;
  • Ability to conduct analysis and draw out conclusions;
  • Strong ability to analyze financial data, audit findings, and forensic accounting reports to detect and understand irregularities;
  • Excellent editorial skills;
  • Good planning and organisational skills;
  • Solid IT-know how;
  • Ability to work unsupervised and precisely;
  • Ability to work well under pressure and to respect deadlines;
  • Good analytical skills;
  • Conscientiousness, accuracy and quality;
  • Punctuality;
  • Proactive approach;
  • Rigorous and consistent, particularly when handling large amounts of documents;
  • Team player with good interpersonal relations;
  • Excellent communication skills;
  • Cooperative and team-oriented mindset, fostering transparent communication and knowledge sharing;
  • Motivated, autodidact, dynamic and proactive personality;
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities;
  • Agility;
  • Ability to adapt to an international and multicultural environment;
  • Pleasant and empathetic;
  • Law University degree (Bar Exam);
  • Post-Graduate in Sport law is an asset;
  •  Training or certification in white-collar investigations (including forensic accounting, CPA, CFE, etc.) or prior experience in an audit firm is an asset;
  • Minimum 6-8 years of experience in similar positions, dealing with disciplinary and ethics regulations matters in a sports governing body;
  •  Experience handling cases of misappropriation of funds, bribery and corruption, and working alongside compliance, finance teams, or external auditors, is a strong asset;
  • Native/C2 in English;
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (F / ES) is an asset;
  • Proficient in Word / PowerPoint / Excel/Jira;
  • Ability to leverage AI tools to enhance investigative efficiency while ensuring accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance with applicable legal and ethical standards.
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.
 
Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
 
Health insurance: We offer generous medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage.
Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
Retirement: We offer generous 401(k) employer contributions.
Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.

job.title: Hospitality Operations & Infrastructure Venue Manager - 6 Host Cities (Brazil)
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. 

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Sitting within the Ticketing & Hospitality Department, Hospitality (along with Ticketing) aims to deliver the most engaging and innovative FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™ experience for all commercial partners, customers, guests and the FIFA football family.  

Reporting organizationally to the Head of FWWC27 Hospitality Operations, the Hospitality Operations & Infrastructure Venue Manager will help serve Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ that is hosting 32 teams across 8 venues.   

This role will be responsible for the supervision of the implementation of all stadium Hospitality infrastructure requirements and technical operations across all stadiums of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, and later assuming a fixed position as Rio de Janeiro Stadium Hospitality Operations & Infrastructure Venue Manager during tournament time. She/he will work closely with the Official Hospitality Provider and FIFA’s stadium operations and infrastructure functional areas to ensure contractual and requirements compliance. 

The main responsibilities and oversights of the Hospitality Operations and Venue Services Manager for the FIFA Women´s World Cup 2027™ include: 

  • Responsible for the management and operational readiness and delivery of the Affiliates and Commercial Hospitality programmes, reporting duties, maintenance/creation of operational and infrastructure documentations, etc;
  • Ensuring Infrastructure readiness and maintenance services of Hospitality areas, in close cooperation with the FIFA other functional areas, the Official Hospitality Provider (OHP) and Stadium Authorities;
  • Responsible for the on-site management of the Official Hospitality Provider (OHP) and their suppliers, and Hospitality Volunteers;
  • Checking and validating the Operational plans from the service-providing departments to Hospitality (Cleaning and Waste, Security, Medical, Signage, Transport, Fan Operations, Accreditation, Power, IT, TV, ticketing, etc.);
  • Ensuring excellent service to the FIFA Affiliates on site, overlooking the set-up and readiness of their facilities, monitoring service delivery from the Official Hospitality Provider (OHP) from the set-up phase through to match day delivery of services;
  • Ensuring contractual deliverables to the FIFA Commercial Affiliates and to the Official Hospitality Provider (OHP);
  • Overall on-site hospitality guest management;
  • Ensure service consistency throughout the different hospitality programmes across all matches in the venue;
  • Validating all on-site hospitality directional signage;  
  • Ensuring Health and Safety regulations are strictly observed and respected by the Official Hospitality Provider (OHP);
  • Ensuring Hospitality guest numbers are updated and shared with all relevant FIFA stakeholders;   
  • Ensuring that all stakeholders are appropriately accredited. Manage the distribution of SADs (supplementary access devices) to all relevant functional areas, restricting access to hospitality areas as needed;
  • Ensure the catering service runs as expected in the Affiliates and Commercial Hospitality programmes;
  • Handling all hospitality related issues on Match Day;
  • Attend the FIFA Daily Coordination Meeting at the Venue and hold daily Hospitality Team Meetings with the Official Hospitality Provider (OHP); 
  • Reporting on a daily basis to the FIFA HQ, reporting issues in good time.
Education & Qualifications 
  • Bachelor’s Degree or similar level of education in Event Management, Sports Hospitality Management, Project Management, etc.
Work Experience 

  • Minimum of 5 years of work experience in stadium hospitality or venue management, managing several venues simultaneously, preferably for major sports or entertainment events;
  • Proven experience with event overlay (including provision of temporary power and water), ticketing, dressing and signage, catering,  logistics and security operations;
  • Proven experience managing multiple service providers, particularly for Technical services, Cleaning and Waste services, Security Services, Access control Services, Accreditation, etc;
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills;
  • Strong customer-service attitude, even when under pressure;
  • Ability to work independently and in a team across simultaneous work streams;
  • Exquisite organizational skills;
  • Ability to lead, manage, and motivate a team.
 Languages 

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English. Additional languages considered an asset. 

Technology 

  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools;
  • Excellent knowledge of AutoCAD and literacy of architectural drawings.

job.title: Ticketing System Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting to Senior Ticketing Operations Manager, and working alongside the FIFA Ticketing team in Zurich, the Ticketing System Manager configures the ticketing system to ensure best in class solutions are available to sell and manage tickets for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027. The role offers support to ticketing system users, promotes the use of information management systems and carries out quality assurance measures.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
· Managing the configuration of the ticketing system to offer frontend and backend solutions for ticketing system users, B2C and B2B clients
· Coordinate backend operations in the ticketing system such as batch processes
· Coordinate 1st level support and liaise with the FIFA Ticketing team and the service provider for 2nd and 3rd level support
· Consult ticketing system users, review and prepare user manuals
· Conduct functional and user acceptance tests of frontend and backend solutions including for ticketing system improvements
· Manage regular meetings, trainings and other forms of learning/collaboration opportunities to support the local ticketing team in using the ticketing solution
· Carry out quality assurance measurers to ensure error-free delivery of ticketing system solutions
· Promote the use and continuous improvement of information and knowledge management systems
· Support general ticketing operations for FIFA events
Education
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent level of education.

Experience
• Strong experience in operating / managing ticketing systems
• Proven experience working in similar roles at big scale sporting events
• Experience working in international and multicultural environments

Skills & Competencies
• Strong ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams.
• Detail-oriented, with focus on delivering high-quality projects.
• Excellent communication skills, both within and across multiple functional areas.

Certifications & Requirements

job.title: Project Coordinator Administration
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Administration Project Coordinator will support the Executive Director of Administration in the planning, coordination, and day-to-day management of operational activities related to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.

This role is critical to ensure effective internal organization, structured follow-up of strategic priorities, and seamless coordination across functional areas under the Administration Division. The position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple workstreams in a dynamic and high-performance environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Provide direct operational and administrative support to the Executive Director of Administration.
  • Manage and coordinate the Director’s agenda, including scheduling meetings and prioritizing commitments.
  • Prepare meeting materials, including agendas, presentations, and briefing documents.
  • Draft and distribute meeting minutes, ensuring accurate documentation of decisions, action items, and next steps.
  • Track follow-up actions and ensure timely progress with functional area leaders.
  • Monitor ongoing projects and support coordination across areas under the Administration Division.
  • Facilitate communication and alignment between departments to ensure operational efficiency.
  • Support the development of reports, dashboards, and internal documentation.
  • Assist in organizing workshops, coordinating meetings, and planning sessions.
  • Ensure proper document management and information flow within the Administration Division.
  • Effective Communication and Trust Building: Skilled in fostering open communication and creating an environment of trust. Capable of understanding and addressing the needs and expectations of others, identifying and resolving conflicts, and delivering impactful presentations in a matrix organization.
  • Client-Centric Approach: Consistently demonstrates respect and professionalism toward clients (colleagues, superiors, other stakeholders). Clearly defines and aligns on expectations, ensuring client needs are met and exceeded. Receives positive client feedback, builds strong, trusting relationships, and anticipates client needs. Maintains a flexible and innovative mindset in service delivery.
  • Proven project management skills, with experience coordinating multi-stakeholder initiatives.
  • Planning and Resource Management: Skilled in developing detailed, chronological plans, setting priorities, and allocating resources effectively. Implement systems for tracking progress and control, and adapt plans as needed to achieve objectives. Maintains a strong focus on reporting and accountability.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (additional languages are a plus).
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint), understanding of Power BI would be appreciated.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, international environment with high levels of responsibility.
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and solution-driven mindset.
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Legal Assistant (Freelancer)
job.html_description:
We govern the beautiful game and ensure it's run with transparency and integrity.

Join our team and support us on our mission.
These are your key tasks:

As part of the Disputes team, the role supports team members in administrative and procedural aspects of the contractual disputes before the FIFA Football Tribunal by:  
  • Carrying out the initial analysis of claims received by FIFA via the Legal Portal and ensuring the completeness of case files.  
  • Supporting other members of the Disputes team in the preparation of case files for decision by the FIFA Football Tribunal. 
  • Assisting the Disputes team in their daily administrative and business activities. 
  • Handling of administrative matters, such as drafting communications based on pre-existing templates, ensuring deadlines are met, and addressing queries from interested parties. 
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific requirements/competencies we require for this position are:
  • University degree; degree in law, legal studies or related field an asset 
  • Good planning and organizational skills 
  • Knowledge of basic principles of law 
  • Knowledge of sports law and, specifically, football law
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant experience with good administrative background 
  • Fluent in English 
  • Proficiency in Spanish and/or French
  • Proficient in MS Office 
  • Experience with the Transfer Matching System (TMS), FIFA Legal Portal and/or JIRA an asset 
  • Detail-oriented 
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and oral 
  • Autonomy and excellence, positively impacting the efficiency and quality of work, resulting in an optimal service to stakeholders 
  • Self-confidence and diplomacy 
  • Proactive and solution-driven
  • Innovation skills, with a great ability to embrace change and new technologies/processes 
  • Flexibility and adaptability 
  • Ability to set priorities effectively 
  • Ability to work under pressure 
  • Team player 
  • Professional, approachable, and empathic 
  • Cooperative

job.title: Ticketing Digital Communications Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Ticketing Customer Relationship Senior Manager and working closely with the Ticketing Digital Communications Manager, the Ticketing Digital Communications Coordinator will help serve Ticketing and Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™. 

This role will coordinate the planning and execution of all customer communications and collaterals across the ticket sales process, in line with the applicable sales strategy and ticketing requirements, working closely with all other sub-teams and Functional Areas to ensure consistent delivery. 

The Ticketing Digital Communications Coordinator focuses particularly on the delivery of accurate, consistent, and relevant outputs to ensure that the customer has all the relevant information needed before, during, and after the purchase process for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™, within the right timing, the correct format and the appropriate language for each customer.

  • Coordinate the creation and delivery of all ticket sales collateral and customer communications, including drafting, reviewing, translating, implementing, and maintaining them to meet quality and timing requirements, in line with the established strategy and processes. 
  • Draft and review the sales collaterals and customer communications, which include but are not limited to: content for online ticketing portals and mobile apps, FIFA.com pages, FAQs portal, Standard Responses, Chatbot scripts, ticketing guides, call centre and IVR scripts, transactional emails and customer communications. 
  • Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to execute the review and translation of all content into relevant languages, following established processes and ensuring quality and timeliness. 
  • Maintain the ticketing glossary and respective translations, ensuring their correct and consistent implementation. 
  • Regularly liaise with the Customer Care team to review the effectiveness of the sales collaterals and the customer communications. 
  • Support the identification and implementation of solutions to proactively communicate with customers and contribute to customer information and satisfaction goals. 
  • Monitor and continuously update all sales collaterals and customer communications, to ensure accuracy, relevance, and consistency at all times during the ticketing customer journey process. 
  • Support the team to ensure timely and effective content management of online ticketing portals and mobile ticketing apps, including the execution of applicable user acceptance tests. 
  • Ensure all sales collaterals and customer communications are accurate, consistent, relevant, and compliant with the applicable sales strategy and ticketing requirements. 
  • Support the use of a CRM system and a Marketing Automation Tool to send transactional emails and mass communications to customers, including building and sending of audiences, workflows, emails, communications, and respective reporting of results. 
  • Ensure an efficient administration and archive of all versions of sales collaterals and customer communications, in all languages. 
  • Ensure adherence to specific operational deadlines and compliance with ticketing policies and regulations. 
SKILLS FRAMEWORK  
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyse one’s behaviour, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes. 
 
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculated risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.    
 
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts. 
 
INITIATIVE: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents.  
  
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans. 
 
EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS 
 
Bachelor's or master's degree or equivalent in a relevant area such as Digital Marketing, Communications, or similar.    
 
WORK EXPERIENCE 
 
  • Minimum three years of experience creating and coordinating content for ticketing processes/solutions for events, ideally in the sports industry. 
  • Experience using content management and Marketing Automation Tools within large-scale projects, ideally inside ticketing and/or sports events, requiring strong communication and organizational skills. 
  • Coordinating projects related to content creation and/or translations that require attention to detail, ensuring accuracy and consistency. 
  • Venue and onsite operations experience for large-scale events, ideally in the sports industry, is nice to have. 
  • Communication and problem-solving skills. 
  • Translation experience, translating digital content and documents from English to Portuguese and vice-versa, would be an advantage. 
 
LANGUAGES 
 
Fluent in English and Portuguese, spoken and written.   
 
A native level of at least one of the following: French, Spanish, German or Arabic is nice to have. 
 
TECHNOLOGY 
 
Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools.
 
Marketing Automation Tools and Content management platforms.   
 
Experience with Ticketing Systems is nice to have.

Certifications & Requirements 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Right to work in Brazil
