job.title: Access Management Systems & Applications Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Reporting to the Access Management Senior Manager, the Access Management Systems & Applications Manager will be a key member of the FIFA WOMEN´S WORLD CUP 2027 Access Management team. You will be responsible for developing and managing a range of tools to assist in the planning and delivery of access operations of the FWWC2027 at all stadiums and the IBCC.  Such tools will include:


•             Access Management System (AMS).


Working closely with the Access Management Senior Manager, FIFA Corporate Access Manager and IT, help develop the AMS in its functionalities, reporting systems and set up. 


The Access Management Systems & Applications Manager will manage 1 Coordinator, whose primary function will be to support the Manager. Together you will train and provide support to the venue team in each Host City as well as deal with the system provider, Fortress.   


The Access Management Systems & Applications Manager will be an active member of the Access Management (ACS) HQ team throughout the planning phases and the tournament period.

The main responsibilities and oversights of the Access Management Systems & Applications Manager for the FIFA WOMEN´S WORLD CUP 2027 include: 

•             Help develop the AMS. 
•             Setup the AMS for the Tournament 
•             Provide training and training materials on the system to ACS, ACR and SEC staff.
•             Be the central focal point for issue resolution on the AMS system. 
•             Oversee the distribution and collection of the AMS physical devices. 
•             Provide central support as part of ACS Main HQ team during the tournament.
Education:
·        Bachelor’s degree or similar level of higher education in IT & Systems, Sport Venue Management, Safety and Security or similar. 
·        Qualifications or extensive experience in access management systems. 
·        If experience is compensating, lower degree is welcome to apply.
·        Qualifications in IT systems.
·        FIFA access management knowledge is a plus. 
·        Effective interpersonal communication, influencing and negotiation skills.
·        Strong problem solving and analytical skills.
·        Stature and professional experience necessary to interact as tough partner with senior colleagues.
·        Good judgement, superb integrity, maturity, and fairness in dealing with people.

 Experience:

·        Minimum experience of 4 years in the sport event industry, with access management systems, ticketing systems or similar for large scale events.
·        Experience in delivering training.  
·        Single-sport, multi-venue event experience.
·        Management and leadership of a team in high pressure tournament operations. 
·        Demonstratable ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and under pressure

 
Skills & Competencies:
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyze one’s behavior, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes.
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculated risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts.
INITIATIVE: Capacity to do things on one’s own initiative and to influence the course of events, assume responsibilities, and achieve objectives with a minimum of supervision and control.
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.
LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents.
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans.

Certifications & Requirements

·        Access Management Systems, Ticketing Systems. 
·        Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools

Requirements
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Reporting organizationally to the Ticketing Customer Relationship Senior Manager the Ticketing Member Associations Customer Care Manager will help serve Ticketing and Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.  
This role will be responsible for planning and management of the customer care strategies and processes for Group Sales Customers to specifically fulfil all FIFA’s Member Associations ticketing requirements and ensure a smooth and successful ticketing operation for these key FIFA stakeholders. The Customer Care Manager must ensure compliance with the applicable sales strategy and the FIFA ticketing requirements, policies and regulations whilst providing support to all Member Associations with ticketing issues and enquiries. The Customer Care Manager focuses particularly on the delivery of effective ticketing customer care for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. 
 
  • Plan and implement effective customer care strategies and processes across all the established communications channels (email, phone and any other ticketing bespoke systems);         
 
  • Train and manage a small team, in line with the sales strategy and FIFA ticketing requirements, policies and regulations; including regular quality assurance checks;     
 
  • Perform customer care ticketing processes (back office and onsite) whenever required;    
 
  • Build, manage and maintain successful relationships with all FIFA’s Member Associations whilst resolving all issues and enquiries;       
  
  • Manage and monitor the ticket quota and requests allocated to FIFA Member Associations;     
 
  • Issue all necessary ticketing communications and be able to translate into required languages, where applicable;         
 
  • Present ticketing information to Member Associations and other stakeholders both in person and online;       
 
  • Plan effective communication and escalation processes and ensure implementation within the team;   
 
  • Plan and implement quality control procedures to ensure that any deviation from the requirements is detected and corrected as soon as possible;      
 
  • Actively research and implement solutions to pro-actively increase the productivity of the group sales customer care team, and maximise customer information and satisfaction;    
 
  • Analyse and report regularly on KPIs and the effectiveness of customer care being delivered;
 
  • Pro-actively identify and report on patterns and risks, and implement processes to mitigate them; 
 
  • Ensure that all customer care processes are in compliance with the different FIFA functional areas requirements, including but not limited to Legal, Sustainability, Data Protection, Finance, etc.;    
 
  • Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to ensure the relevant customer care information is available and share applicable knowledge;   
 
  • Ensure an efficient administration and archive of all versions of customer care and knowledge base, in all languages;     
 
  • Report on the implementation of sales strategy and ticketing requirements;   
 
  • Ensure adherence to specific operational deadlines and project plans and compliance with ticketing policies, regulations and GDPR.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Ticketing Customer Relationship Senior Manager and working closely with the Ticketing Group Sales Manager, the Ticketing Group Sales Coordinator will help serve Ticketing and Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™. 

This role will support the implementation of the customer care strategies and processes for Group Sales Customers, to specifically fulfil all Group Sales ticketing requirements and ensure a smooth and successful ticketing operation for these customers. The Ticketing Group Sales Coordinator must ensure compliance with the applicable sales strategy and the FIFA ticketing requirements, policies and regulations, whilst providing support to Group Sales customers with ticketing issues and enquiries. 

The Ticketing Group Sales Coordinator focuses particularly on the delivery of effective ticketing customer care for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Implement customer care processes across all established communications channels (email, phone, and any other ticketing bespoke systems), in line with the applicable strategy. 
  •  Support regular quality assurance checks across the customer care operation, in line with the sales strategy and FIFA ticketing requirements, policies and regulations. 
  •  Perform customer care ticketing processes (back office and onsite) whenever required. 
  •  Support and maintain relationships with Group Sales customers, resolving issues and enquiries. 
  •  Monitor ticket inventory, order status and deadlines for Group Sales bookings. 
  •  Issue all necessary ticketing communications and be able to translate into required languages, where applicable. 
  •  Present ticketing information to Group Sales customers and other stakeholders, both in person and online, as required. 
  •  Follow established communication and escalation processes and support their consistent implementation across stakeholders. 
  •  Implement quality control procedures to ensure that any deviation from requirements is detected and corrected as soon as possible. 
  •  Support the research and implementation of solutions to increase the productivity of the group sales customer care team and maximize customer information and satisfaction. 
  •  Analyse and report regularly on KPIs and the effectiveness of customer care being delivered. 
  •  Proactively identify and report on patterns and risks and implement processes to mitigate them. 
  •  Ensure that all customer care processes are in compliance with the different FIFA functional areas requirements, including but not limited to Legal, Sustainability, Data Protection, Finance, etc. 
  •  Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to ensure the relevant customer care information is available and share applicable knowledge. 
  •  Ensure an efficient administration and archive of all versions of customer care and knowledge base, in all languages. 
  •  Report on the implementation of sales strategy and ticketing requirements. 
  •  Ensure adherence to specific operational deadlines and project plans and compliance with ticketing policies, regulations and GDPR. 
SKILLS FRAMEWORK  
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyse one’s behaviour, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes. 
 
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculate risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.    
 
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts. 
 
INITIATIVE: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents.  
  
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans. 
 
EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS 
 
Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent in relevant areas.      
 
WORK EXPERIENCE 
 
  • Experience in the planning and delivery of a similar project for a major international sports event. 
  • Experience in customer care delivery for Group Sales, corporate customers and/or business stakeholders. 
  • Experience working within small, cross-functional teams, with exposure to day-to-day task coordination. 
  • Delivery of user acceptance tests. 
  • Ticketing. 
  • Venue and onsite operations experience for major sports events. 
  • Customer Service. 
  • Excellent communication and relationship management. 
  • Good numeracy. 
  • Courtesy and Cooperation. 
  • Accountability and Transparency. 
  • Analysis and Innovation. 
  • Flexibility and Adaptability. 
  • Perseverance and Dedication. 
  • Proactivity and Organisation. 
  • Time Management and Prioritisation.
LANGUAGES 
 
Fluent in English and Portuguese, spoken and written. 
Fluent in Spanish, French or German, spoken and written.   
 
TECHNOLOGY 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Monday) and planning software and online collaboration tools   
  • CRM software for case management, including automatic and manual management of the cases.   
Certifications & Requirements 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Right to work in Brazil

job.title: Non-Competition Venue Dressing Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Dressing and Signage Manager for non-competition venues reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing and Signage Manager for non-competition venues is responsible for leading the venue branding, look and signage operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all non-competition FIFA Official Sites. 

This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the look and feel is up to FIFA quality standards.  
Non-competition venues are crucial to the successful delivery of a successful FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™, the below list is a non-exhaustive list of venues that the successful candidate may be responsible for: 
  • Team Base Camp Training Sites 
  • Team Base Camp Hotels 
  • VIP Hotels 
  • Accreditation Centres 
  • Ticketing Centres 
  • Volunteer Centres 
  • Airports 
  • International Broadcast Centre (IBC) 
  • Outside Presentation Facility (OPF) 
  • Main Operations Centre (MOC) 
The successful candidate will be responsible for directly overseeing the dressing and signage planning and implementation at all FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ non-competition venues Brazil. They will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met within their cluster and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations within their cluster, ensuring that all are managed successfully and efficiently while monitoring budgetary spend within agreed limits. They will ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. The role will collaborate closely with the wider Dressing and Signage team to maximise creativity and ensure consistency across all non-competition venues. 
There will also be a potential need to relocate to another Host City for up to three months to take the role as Venue Dressing and Signage Managers during event periods at an assigned stadium. 

Key Responsibilities 
  • Contributing to the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups who require the services of non-competition venues at the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™. 
  • Overseeing the turnkey planning and delivery of non-competition venue dressing and signage across the tournament.  
  • Collaborating with the other Venue Dressing and Signage Managers and ensuring that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament official sites.  
  • Working closely with the Stadium Dressing Managers and the Wayfinding and Signage Managers as well as other Functional Area Managers, to maximise efficiencies across the wider project.  
  • Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all non-competition venues. 
  • Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of dressing and signage operations and reporting updates into the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly. 
  • Providing strategic input into the non-competition venue dressing planning process and offering expertise when required.  
  • Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department.  
  • Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimised at all stages of the project.  
  • Liaising with non-competition owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans.  
  • Presenting to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required.  
  • Attending department-specific and organisation site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites.  
  • Inputting into the site-specific dressing and wayfinding signage strategies utilising expertise from previous events and directives from management.  
  • Acting as the non-competition venues point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers during the implementation phase of the project.  
  • Participating in the creative design process for the non-competition venues.  
  • Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required.  
  • Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against.  
  • Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities.  
  • Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods.
  • Strong experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. or a minimum 4 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities.  
  • A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.) 
  • Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects.  
  • Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events. 
  • Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events. 
  • Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments.  
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions. 
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field. 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. 
  • The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential. 
  • The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period. 
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Bilingual – Brazilian Portuguese and English. 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Ticketing CRM Communication Channels Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Ticketing CRM Communication Channels Manager, the Ticketing CRM Communications Channels Coordinator will support Ticketing and Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™. 


This role will be responsible for updating and managing text content, such as (but not limited to) FAQs, standard responses, and chatbot scripts, within our back-office tools.  Ticketing Communication Channels Specialist must ensure compliance with the applicable sales strategy and the FIFA ticketing requirements.  


The Ticketing Communication Channels Specialist focuses particularly on ensuring content accuracy, effectiveness, and alignment with sales communication strategies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.    


  • Maintain and update text-based content, including FAQs, chatbot scripts, and other sales communication materials, within back-office systems. 
 
  • Ensure all content is accurate, up-to-date, and aligned with company messaging and brand guidelines. 
 
  • Regularly review and update content based on CRM sub-teams feedback and business needs. 
 
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales strategy and requirements, sales collaterals and communications, and customer care teams, to gather requirements concerning the content to be updated and respective timeline. 
 
  • Work closely with subject matter experts to ensure content accuracy and relevance. 
 
  • Coordinate content review and approval processes to ensure timely updates and deployments. 
 
  • Support the configuration and testing of FAQs, chatbot and other communication channels within back-office tools, flagging optimization opportunities to the relevant owners. 
 
  • Ensure that the communication channels accurately respond to user queries and provide relevant information or assistance. 
 
  • Monitor communication channel performance metrics and flag optimisation opportunities to improve user experience and engagement. 
 
  • Support training sessions for internal teams on using back-office tools and accessing sales communication content. 
 
  • Share observations and feedback on FAQs, chatbot and other communication channel performance to support best-practice recommendations for sales effectiveness. 
 
  • Conduct regular quality assurance checks on content and functionalities to identify and resolve content-level issues or errors. 
 
  • Identify and escalate technical issues related to the communication channels, collaborating with IT teams to support the implementation of solutions. 
 
  • Any other duties that may be assigned. 
SKILLS FRAMEWORK  
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyse one’s behaviour, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes. 
 
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculate risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.    
 
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts. 
 
INITIATIVE: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents.  
  
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans. 
 
EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS 
 
Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent in relevant areas.      
 
WORK EXPERIENCE 
 
  • 1-3 years’ experience in managing and updating content for various platforms 
  • Familiar with digital marketing tools and analytics platforms 
  • Familiar with HTML, CSS, and basic web development 
  • Experience in planning and delivery of a similar project 
  • Experience in Customer Service  
  • Excellent communication and relationship management 
  • Team player with excellent interpersonal skills 
  • Ability to work with cross-functional teams 
  • Courtesy and Cooperation 
  • Accountability and Transparency 
  • Analysis and Innovation 
  • Flexibility and Adaptability 
  • Perseverance and Dedication 
  • Proactivity and Organisation 
  • Time Management and Prioritisation 
LANGUAGES 
 
Fluent in English and Portuguese, spoken and written. 
Spanish and/or additional languages is highly advantageous. 
 
TECHNOLOGY 
 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and online collaboration tools  
  • CRM software for case management, including automatic and manual management of the cases  
  • Chatbot  
  • FAQs portals  
  • JIRA  
  • Confluence  
  • Ticketing systems 
Certifications & Requirements 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Right to work in Brazil

job.title: Consolidation manager
job.html_description:
As the organiser of some of the biggest and most iconic sport events in the world, we lead the way in the sport and event industry.

Join the team and support us on our mission.
These are your key tasks:
  •  Preparing FIFA’s annual consolidated financial statement including balance sheet, profit and loss, cash flow statement and notes in accordance with the International Financial Reporting Standards
  • Preparing a monthly consolidated financial reporting and quarterly financial forecast to allow management to make decisions in a timely manner and for the purpose of planning, analysis and benchmarking
  • Supporting IFRS-related projects and complex accounting transactions, and corresponding financial audit questions of FIFA’s consolidated financial statement
  • Preparing financial analyses, reconciliations, and management reports to support strategic decision-making and ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial information.
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • Minimum 4 years experiences in an organisation within the finance consolidation/reporting department or a finance consultancy/audit company
  • Proven records in consolidation and IFRS, ideally within a multicultural organisation or IFRS desk review experience within an international audit company
  • University degree in business administration and a higher education within Finance & Accounting, preferably with experience as Certified Public Accountant (CPA) 
  • Pragmatic/solution oriented
  • Team-oriented
  • Self-motivated
  • Critical judgement
  • Discreet/ honest
  • Integral business understanding
  • Innovative, efficient and very communicative 
  • Strong identification with FIFA’s ideals and philosophy
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.

Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
  • Health and fitness: Regular football sessions for all abilities, plus on-site gym.
  • Home office: Up to two days of home office per week if work permits and home office allowance for all.
  • Language courses: Offered to all staff to aid personal and professional growth.
  • Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
  • Pension: Flexible pension benefits with generous employer contributions.
  • Relocation assistance: A dedicated team will be on hand to support your relocation.
  • Sustainability: We support all employees using public transport.
  • Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.
  • Volunteering: Make an impact beyond your regular role and bond with colleagues by volunteering with one of our partners.

job.title: Mitarbeiter/in Ausstellungsbetreuung / Visitor Support, 20%-60% - befristet bis 30.11.2026
job.html_description:
Erzählen Sie mit uns die faszinierende Geschichte des Fussballs!
 

Das FIFA Museum in Zürich bietet einzigartige Exponate, faszinierende Geschichten, multimediale und interaktive Attraktionen, spannende Informationen und besondere Erinnerungen. Mit aussergewöhnlichen Ausstellungen sowie interessanten Kultur- und Lernprogrammen ist das Zuhause der Fussballgeschichte ein lebendiger Treffpunkt für Fans und Interessierte jeden Alters aus der ganzen Welt.


Für unsere Skills Zone-Stationen und die weiteren Spielbereiche im Museum suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine/n engagierte/n und motivierte/n 

Mitarbeiter/in Ausstellungsbetreuung / Visitor Support, 20%-60% - befristet bis 30.11.2026
 
Du begeisterst mit deiner offenen und sympathischen Wesensart unsere Gäste von gross bis klein und bist mit deiner Kreativität und Begeisterungsfähigkeit vor allem verantwortlich für die interaktive Sonderausstellung im Museum. Du trägst dazu bei, dass der Museumsbesuch für alle ein unvergessliches Erlebnis bleibt. 

Die Einsätze sind flexibel auf Abruf, werden im Stundenlohn vergütet und finden von Dienstag bis Sonntag statt. 

  • Betreuung der Besuchenden der Sonderausstellung
  • Begrüssung und Einweisung der Besuchenden in die Nutzung der Sonderausstellung
  • Betreuung der interaktiven Stationen der neuen Sonderausstellung
  • Sicherstellung eines sicheren und angenehmen Erlebnisses für die Besuchenden
  • Überprüfung der Funktionalität und Leistung der Geräte und Systeme
  • Beaufsichtigung der Unterhaltungsmedien, Fehlerbehebung bei kleineren technischen Problemen und Koordination mit dem technischen Support Team
  • Ansprechperson bei Notfällen oder Problemstellungen vor Ort, Krisenmanagement und Weiterleitung an die verantwortliche Person
  • Mit-Betreuung der Pinball-Stationen im Museum bei Kapazität
  • Zusätzliche Einsätze bei Events sind bei Interesse möglich
  • Animierende Persönlichkeit mit Freude an Kontakt mit einem internationalen Publikum jeden Alters
  • Grosses Interesse und Faszination am Fussball und seiner Geschichte von Vorteil
  • Selbstbewusstes Auftreten
  • Kontaktfreudig und belastbar
  • Ausdauer und Fähigkeit ruhig zu bleiben in hektischen Situationen
  • Flexibilität und Spontanität bei der Ausführung der Aufgaben
  • Flexibilität bei den Arbeitszeiten sowie regelmässige und zuverlässige Einsatzbereitschaft; vor allem auch an Wochenenden
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse der deutschen Sprache, gute Englischkenntnisse, jede weitere Sprache ist ein Vorteil
  • Zuverlässigkeit dem Arbeitgeber gegenüber

job.title: Ticketing Commercial Partners & Local Market Customer Relations Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Ticketing Customer Relationship Senior Manager, the Ticketing Commercial Partners & Local Entities Customer Care Manager will help serve Ticketing and Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. This role will be responsible for planning and management of the customer care strategies and processes for Group Sales Customers to specifically fulfil all FIFA’s Commercial Partners and Local Entities ticketing requirements and ensure a smooth and successful ticketing operation for these key FIFA stakeholders.  

The Customer Care Manager must ensure compliance with the applicable sales strategy and the FIFA ticketing requirements, policies and regulations whilst providing support to all FIFA’s Commercial Partners with ticketing issues and enquiries. Focuses particularly on the delivery of effective ticketing customer care for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.   


  • Plan and implement effective customer care strategies and processes across all the established communications channels (email, phone and any other ticketing bespoke systems);    
 
  • Perform user acceptance tests for ticket sales, distribution and communication channels in pre-production and production, concentrating on mobile ticketing processes to ensure effective customer care and management of Commercial Partners and Local Entities’ requirements    
 
  • Train and manage a small team, in line with the sales strategy and FIFA ticketing requirements, policies and regulations; including regular quality assurance checks;  
 
  • Perform customer care ticketing processes (back office and onsite) whenever required;   
  
  • Build, manage and maintain successful relationships with all FIFA Commercial Partners and Local Entities (Partners, Sponsors, Licensees, Host Cities, etc.) whilst resolving all issues and enquiries;     
 
  • Manage and monitor the ticket quota and requests allocated to FIFA Commercial Partners and Local Entities;      
 
  • Issue all necessary ticketing communications and be able to translate into required languages, where applicable;   
 
  • Present ticketing information and deliver training to Commercial Partners and Local Entities, and other stakeholders both in person and online; 
 
  • Plan effective communication and escalation processes and ensure implementation within the team;   
 
  • Plan and implement quality control procedures to ensure that any deviation from the ticketing requirements and system requirements is detected and corrected as soon as possible;   
 
  • Actively research and implement solutions to pro-actively increase the productivity of the group sales customer care team, and maximize customer information and satisfaction;   
 
  • Analyse and report regularly on KPIs and the effectiveness of customer care being delivered 
 
  • Pro-actively identify and report on patterns and risks, and implement processes to mitigate them; 
 
  • Ensure that all customer care processes are in compliance with the different FIFA functional areas requirements, including but not limited to Legal, Sustainability, Data Protection, Finance, etc.; 
 
  • Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to ensure the relevant customer care information is available and share applicable knowledge; 
 
  • Ensure an efficient administration and archive of all versions of customer care and knowledge base, in all languages; 
 
  • Report on the implementation of sales strategy and ticketing requirements; plus results of testing of ticket sales, distribution and communication channels including mobile ticketing;
 
  • Ensure adherence to specific operational deadlines and project plans and compliance with ticketing policies, regulations and GDPR.
SKILLS FRAMEWORK  
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyse one’s behaviour, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes. 
 
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculate risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.    
 
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts. 
 
INITIATIVE: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents.  
  
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans. 
 
EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS 
 
Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent in relevant areas.      
 
WORK EXPERIENCE 
 
  • Planning and delivery of a similar project during a previous FIFA World Cup; 
  • Planning and delivery of Customer Care for corporate customers/business stakeholders; 
  • Leading and managing small teams; 
  • Delivery of user acceptance tests; 
  • Ticketing; 
  • Venue and onsite operations experience for major sports event, including a previous FIFA World Cup; 
  • Customer Service;   
  • Excellent communication and relationship management;  
  • Good numeracy;  
  • Courtesy and Cooperation;  
  • Accountability and Transparency;  
  • Analysis and Innovation;  
  • Flexibility and Adaptability;  
  • Perseverance and Dedication; 
  • Proactivity and Organisation;  
  • Time Management and Prioritisation; 
 
LANGUAGES 
 
Fluent in English and Portuguese, spoken and written. 
Spanish and/or additional languages is highly advantageous. 
 
TECHNOLOGY 
 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Monday) and planning software and online collaboration tools   
 
  • CRM software for case management, including automatic and manual management of the cases.    
 
Certifications & Requirements 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Right to work in Brazil

job.title: Cybersecurity Manager
job.html_description:
As the organiser of some of the biggest and most iconic sport events in the world, we lead the way in the sport and event industry.

Join the team and support us on our mission.
These are your key tasks:
  • Design, build, test, implement and coordinate operation of security systems within the FIFA environment. 
  • Support FIFA Product Managers, as well as other FIFA functions to ensure FIFA’s new and existing digital products comply with cybersecurity standards and guidelines. 
  • Lead vulnerability & patch management, coordinate penetration tests, third party risk management and plan concrete action to remediate the findings. 
  • Provide security architecture expertise and consulting/advisory to support business and IT solutions in designing and implementing secure solutions. 
  • Review AI based solutions, concepts, and processes.
  • Review current security measures, recommend enhancements, identify areas of weakness, and respond promptly to possible security breaches.
  • Lead coordination of Cloud Security standards and compliance monitoring as well as the remediation plan.
  • Coordinate regular system tests and ensure the continuous monitoring of information security.
  • Execute the Cybersecurity Programme as defined in the Roadmap. 
  • Actively participate to investigations on Cybersecurity incidents. 
  • Support incident response and crisis preparedness (incl. simulations and technical exercises).
  • Plan, execute and deliver on time, on scope and within budget on projects directly assigned to her/him.
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • Proven track record in crafting comprehensive security policies and procedures, guiding technology teams through secure and continuous deployment practices.
  • Familiar with compliance initiatives and security frameworks such as NIST, ISO, GDPR, PCI DSS and FedRAMP.
  • Experience in securing Cloud Technologies and in Secure Development Lifecycle Experience with professional execution of cyber security projects as a project manager as well as excellent and step-by-step communication.
  • Client oriented, efficient and effective. 
  • Ability to conform to shifting priorities, demands and timelines Excellent planning, documentation and organizational skills Self-disciplined and self-starter and able to work independently.
  • At ease at working in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field.
  • Professional certifications in the area of cybersecurity (CISSP, CISM, CISA) would be an advantage.
  • 5-7 years of experience in a similar role.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience in: vulnerability scanning and auditing tools; enterprise-scale cloud, network, firewall, endpoint detection and response architectures and products.
  • Broad understanding of Firewalls and Network Security (Palo Alto, Fortigate etc.).
  • Broad understanding of mail security practices (DMARC, DKIM, SPF etc.). 
  • Broad understanding of in cloud security principles and frameworks.
  • Broad understanding of log management and aggregation (SIEM).
  • Broad understanding of cybersecurity incident management.
  • Fluent in English; Proficiency in any other FIFA language (F / ES / GER) is an asset.
  • Willingness to travel to specific events.
  • Readiness for stand-by duties during specific events.
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.

Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
  • Health and fitness: Regular football sessions for all abilities, plus on-site gym.
  • Home office: Up to two days of home office per week if work permits and home office allowance for all.
  • Language courses: Offered to all staff to aid personal and professional growth.
  • Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
  • Pension: Flexible pension benefits with generous employer contributions.
  • Relocation assistance: A dedicated team will be on hand to support your relocation.
  • Sustainability: We support all employees using public transport.
  • Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.
  • Volunteering: Make an impact beyond your regular role and bond with colleagues by volunteering with one of our partners.

job.title: Ticketing Sales & Strategy Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Ticketing Sales Strategy Manager, the Ticketing Sales & Strategy Coordinator will help serve Ticketing and Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™. This role will assist the planning and the definition of the process relative to the creation of all the customer's communications and collaterals across the ticket sales process, under the applicable sales strategy and ticketing requirements, and work closely with all the other sub-teams or Functional Areas.  

The Data Engineer Specialist designs data pipelines and reports to analyze customer behavior using KPI dashboards and ensure data quality. They collaborate cross-functionally to gather and implement requirements for reports that enable the CRM team to monitor the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™ project. 
  •  Design, develop, and maintain efficient data pipelines to support the Sales Strategy team in setting up various reports for monitoring project evolution, including the ingestion, processing, and transformation of large volumes of data from various sources.  
  •  Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Sales Strategy, Sales Collaterals and Communications, and Customer Care, to gather requirements and timelines, and translate them into technical solutions.   
  •  Define and track KPI dashboards with the Sales Strategy team to continuously review and report on customer behaviors, ensuring a comprehensive understanding of the information.  
  •  Liaise with internal and external stakeholders or providers to obtain the necessary data for building required reports.  
  •  Ensure the quality and availability of data, performing data profiling, cleansing, and validation processes.
 SKILLS FRAMEWORK  
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyse one’s behaviour, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes. 
 
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculated risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.    
 
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts. 
 
INITIATIVE: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents.  
  
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans. 
 
EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS 
 
Bachelor's or master's degree or equivalent in a relevant area such as Digital Marketing, Communications, or similar.    
 
WORK EXPERIENCE 
 
Minimum three years of experience creating and managing content for ticketing processes/solutions for events, ideally in the sports industry.   
 
Using content management and Marketing Automation Tools within large-scale projects, ideally inside ticketing and/or sports events, that require strong communication and organizational skills.   
 
Managing projects related to content creation and/or coordinating translations that require attention to the details, ensuring accuracy and consistency.  
 
Venue and onsite operations experience for large-scale events, ideally in the sports industry is nice to have.   
Communication and problem-solving skills.    
 
Translations experience to translate digital content and documents from English to Portuguese and vice-versa would be an advantage. 
 
LANGUAGES 
 
Fluent in English and Portuguese, spoken and written.   
 
A native level of at least one of the following: French, Spanish, German or Arabic is nice to have. 
 
TECHNOLOGY 
 
Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools  
 
Marketing Automation Tools and Content management platforms.   
 
Experience with Ticketing Systems is nice to have 


Certifications & Requirements 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Right to work in Brazil

Bachelor's or master's degree or equivalent in a relevant area such as Digital Marketing, Communications, or similar.
WORK EXPERIENCE
Minimum three years of experience creating and managing content for ticketing processes/solutions for events, ideally in the sports industry.
Using content management and Marketing Automation Tools within large-scale projects, ideally inside ticketing and/or sports events, that require strong communication and organizational skills.
Managing projects related to content creation and/or coordinating translations that require attention to the details, ensuring accuracy and consistency.
Venue and onsite operations experience for large-scale events, ideally in the sports industry is nice to have.
Communication and problem-solving skills.
Translations experience to translate digital content and documents from English to Portuguese and vice-versa would be an advantage.
LANGUAGES
Fluent in English and Portuguese, spoken and written.
A native level of at least one of the following: French, Spanish, German or Arabic is nice to have.
TECHNOLOGY
Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
Marketing Automation Tools and Content management platforms.
Experience with Ticketing Systems is nice to have
Certifications & Requirements
- Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro - Right to work in Brazil

job.title: Academy Driver (Part-Time)
job.plain_text_description:
The Academy Driver is responsible for providing a safe, reliable and professional driving service across. the Academy. Reporting to the Head of Academy Operations, the role includes, management of part-time drivers (exclusively Academy), and to work alongside the Club Driver & Fleet Compliance Manager ensuring all vehicles are maintained and presented to a professional standard. The Academy Driver delivers a consistent, reliable service to ensure safe transport of Academy players, staff and guests.
This will be a part-time (20-hour) role, with hours split across a 7-day week.
Responsibilities
- Provide transport for identified registered players to and from our Motspur Park training site. - Provide transport for trialist players to and from airports, train stations, accommodation, and club activities. - Support the player induction process when identifying players in need of transport support. - Act as a guide for visits to Motspur Park and Craven Cottage. - Assist the club on 1st team match days for corporate driving requirement. - Support the Academy across key events and wider activities. - Promote the work of Fulham Academy amongst the London football community. - Always represent Fulham Football Club to a high standard in line with club values.
Requirements
- Hold a full clean driving licence - Interact with others in a positive manner - Strong understanding of the local area - Positive ability to work within a diverse organisation - Self-starter who takes pride in the delivery of a professional service - Bi-Lingual (Desired) - D1 driving licence (Desired)

job.title: Academy Kit Assistant
job.html_description:
The Academy Kit Assistant supports the smooth day-to-day running of the Academy by preparing, maintaining, and distributing training and match kit for players and staff. 

This role is 20hrs per week.

Responsibilities

Essential and Desirable
  • Organised and reliable.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Positive team player with a flexible approach to working evenings and weekends.
  • Full Driving License
  • Able to work in a fast-paced football environment while maintaining high professional standards.

Requirements

The following is a non-exhaustive list of the responsibilities of the role:  
 
  • Prepare and distribute training and match kit.
  • Ensure all kit and equipment is clean, organised, and ready for use.
  • Assist with stock control, kit issuing, and inventory management.
  • Support academy training sessions, fixtures, and tournaments as required.
  • Maintain high standards within the kit room and storage areas.
  • Work closely with academy staff to meet operational needs.

job.title: HR Business Partner
job.html_description:
People are at the heart of everything we do, and we're looking for a talented HR Business Partner to help us continue building an exceptional workplace culture.
 
Founded in 1879, Fulham Football Club is London’s oldest professional football club and one of the most historic names in English football. Based at the iconic Craven Cottage on the banks of the River Thames, Fulham FC competes in the Premier League and operates at the intersection of elite sport, global entertainment and community heritage. The Club is part of a wider sporting and business group and combines a deep respect for tradition with modern, progressive ambition. Fulham FC is proud of its loyal fanbase, strong community roots and growing international profile.
 
Our Vision is to be a progressive Premier League club that balances sporting success with long-term stability, commercial growth and a positive impact on our people, supporters and community.
 
Working at Fulham FC is fast-paced, collaborative and purpose-driven. Employees are united by a shared passion for football and pride in representing a historic Club. The culture blends the intensity and accountability of elite sport with a supportive, professional working environment. People are expected to be adaptable, resilient and solutions-focused, while leaders are encouraged to empower, develop and inspire their teams. Fulham FC values diversity, inclusion and wellbeing, and is committed to creating an environment where people can perform at their best and feel a strong sense of belonging.
 
You'll be a trusted advisor to leaders, helping them navigate people challenges, develop high-performing teams, and implement initiatives that support both our employees and business goals.
 
We're looking for someone who:
 
  • Builds strong relationships at all levels.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment.
  • Enjoys balancing strategic projects with operational support.
  • Is passionate about developing people and enhancing employee experience.
 
The role will be based across all our sites, with a focus at our Foundation and Fulham Pier.  
 
If you're ready for your next challenge and want to work in a collaborative team in organisation, we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

The HR Business Partner must:

Qualifications & Knowledge
  • CIPD Level 5 Associate Diploma in People Management (or higher). 
  • Demonstrable, progressive experience operating within fast-paced, matrixed environments across sectors such as sport, leisure, luxury retail, or multi-site operations. 
  • Extensive hands-on track record in end-to-end HRIS implementation, data analytics, and digital process optimization. 
  • Proven expertise in independently navigating complex employee relations, high-volume recruitment, and multi-site change management. 

Experience
  • Proven experience in a HR Business Partner, Senior HR Advisor, HR Advisor or equivalent role.
  • Experience building effective relationships with managers and leaders to provide pragmatic people advice and support.
  • Experience managing a broad range of employee relations matters, including complex cases.
  • Experience supporting organisational change, restructures, and service improvement initiatives.
  • Demonstrable ability to influence, challenge, and coach managers to achieve positive people and business outcomes.
  • Experience using HR systems and workforce analytics tools to drive continuous improvement.
  • Experience of implementing new policies, processes, or people initiatives.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced and complex organisational environment.

Skills and Competencies
  • Commercial and strategic acumen: Proven ability to balance people operations with broader commercial objectives, P&L awareness, and budget accountability. 
  • Leadership and influence: Capability to build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, challenge constructively, and upskill line management. 
  • Discretion and resilience: High emotional intelligence with the ability to handle confidential, high-stakes matters with absolute discretion and composure under pressure.
  • Communication and collaboration: Outstanding interpersonal, coaching, and cross-functional collaboration skills tailored to diverse employee groups ranging from corporate staff to casual field teams. 
  • Systems knowledge: Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and HR systems (including HRIS, ATS, LMS).

Note: The HR Business Partner does not need to be a Fulham fan, a football fan or even a fan of sport! We want the best person for the job, not the person who knows the most about football. In any case, we are confident that you will become a Fulham fan before long!

Requirements

The following is a non-exhaustive list of the responsibilities of the role:

Strategic Business Partnering:
  • Build trusted relationships with directors, senior leaders and managers, providing proactive and pragmatic people advice.
  • Partner with heads of department and people managers to ensure people strategies and practices support Academy and Club priorities.
  • Attend and contribute to leadership and management meetings, providing people insight, challenge and recommendations.
  • Influence business decision making through evidence-based people solutions and workforce insight.
  • Support organisational effectiveness by identifying opportunities to improve employee engagement, wellbeing, capability, efficiencies and performance.
  • Provide workforce insight and recommendations to support effective people planning, resource allocation and departmental budget discussions.
  • Analyse people data and trends to provide insight and recommendations that support decision-making.
  • Ensure organisational compliance with employment legislation, internal policies and relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Support internal and external audits relating to people, compliance and governance activities, ensuring accurate and timely documentation is maintained.

Employee Relations:
  • Lead and manage complex employee relations matters across the Club, including disciplinary, grievance, capability, absence management and investigation processes.
  • Provide expert advice and coaching to managers on employment law, policy and best practice, ensuring risks are appropriately managed and the Club is protected.
  • Support the resolution of workplace issues through mediation, conflict resolution, investigations and balanced decision-making.
  • Produce and maintain documentation, templates and guidance relating to formal employee relations and performance management processes.
  • Coach and upskill line managers to handle early-stage employee issues proactively, minimising escalation and fostering a positive feedback-driven culture. 
  • Ensure consistent and equitable application of policies and procedures across the organisation.

Organisational Design:
  • Advise and support leaders in reviewing team structures, role design and workforce effectiveness to meet business needs.
  • Recommend improvements to workforce structures, reporting lines and ways of working to enhance efficiency and employee experience.

Change Management:
  • Support organisational change, restructuring and transformation initiatives, including TUPE transfers where required.
  • Assist in assessing people-related risks and support stakeholder engagement and communication throughout change programmes.

Performance Management and Talent Development:
  • Coach and support managers on performance, probation and capability matters, promoting a consistent and effective approach.
  • Advise on performance improvement plans, probationary reviews and capability processes, supporting managers to address underperformance effectively.
  • Support objective setting and performance review processes.
  • Develop, embed, and deliver structured People Management training programs to elevate line manager capability and foster positive, high-performing team cultures.
  • Coach managers on how to have performance, conduct and wellbeing conversation
  • Ensure managers follow the correct HR process rather than avoiding issues
  • Identify patterns of manager behaviour that create repeated HR issues and escalate where required
  • Coach managers on improving individual and team performance, talent management strategies, and professional development frameworks. 
  • Drive probation period management. Appraisal and performance frameworks

Recruitment and Resourcing:
  • Manage end-to-end recruitment processes across the organisation, including specialist and senior-level appointments working closely with Talent Acquisition.
  • Partner with hiring managers to attract and select high-quality candidates.
  • Participate in interviews and provide recruitment recommendations.
  • Conduct exit interviews and identify patterns to share with leadership. 
  • Oversee onboarding activities to ensure a positive employee experience, while maintaining compliance with the Club's Safer Recruitment Policy.

Policy Development and Governance:
  • Lead the development, review and implementation of people policies and procedures, ensuring they are legally compliant, fit for purpose and aligned with organisational values.
  • Contribute to policy governance activities and benchmarking exercises to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Support the implementation and communication of new policies, procedures and people initiatives across the Club.

HR Projects and Continuous Improvement:
  • Contribute to HR projects that enhance organisational effectiveness, employee experience and people practices.
  • Support the development and continuous improvement of HR systems, processes and technology, including the implementation of new functionality and stakeholder engagement activities.

Benefits

We expect to close applications on 17th September, but if we receive a high level of interest, we may close the vacancy sooner. To avoid disappointment, please submit your application at the earliest opportunity.

job.title: Foundation Safeguarding Manager
job.html_description:
In this role, we’re looking for someone with clear vision and depth of knowledge to support Fulham Football Club Foundation in achieving the objectives of the safeguarding strategy. Someone who will make positive changes that are felt across the Foundation and football industry. To do that, you’ll be well versed in safeguarding best practice, which you’ll then communicate with credibility to the Foundation workforce. 

The post will be responsible for the oversight and direct provision of all safeguarding activities and associated training across the foundation. It is key that there is a Foundation-wide awareness of current football regulations and safeguarding best practice in respect of safeguarding whilst promoting a culture of equality and inclusion. The successful candidate will also be an active advocate of safeguarding for the Foundation internally and externally.


Responsibilities

•  Conduct regular observations of activity and site visits which include working irregular hours, such as evening and some weekends ensuring that safeguarding practices are embedded in delivery.  
•  To support the Head of Safeguarding, ensuring the Foundation and its staff are fully compliant with all safeguarding legislation, Premier League, EFL and FA guidance and to embed safeguarding into the culture of the Foundation. 
•  Work closely with both the Safeguarding and Equality Diversity and Inclusion leads to ensure the Foundation is providing a safe and inclusive environment.
•  Ensure that new staff/ volunteers are embedding safeguarding practices in delivery during induction period 
•  Oversee and develop the Quality Assurance provision in partnership with the Head of Safeguarding and Director of Operations, focusing on the high-risk areas of the Foundation’s delivery to ensure that front line staff are equipped to put safeguarding at the forefront of their delivery and responsibilities. 
•  To support programme leads with the running of Youth Voice, to ensure that children and young people and vulnerable adults are heard and their views on safeguarding and latest trends are taken into account. 
•  Address concerns reported on the Foundations safeguarding reporting system, CPOMS. Lead monthly meetings with senior leaders to review reports. 
•  Support the Head of Safeguarding with the incident and near miss reporting process across the Foundation ensuring thorough investigations are carried out and escalated through appropriate channels.
•  Using CPOMS, track data in relation to incidents, accidents and complaints, identify patterns and trends to inform organisational direction. Act as lead Foundation official and lead on or support the Head of Safeguarding in any investigation of an allegation of abuse or poor practice.
•  Work closely with the Foundation’s participants, coaches and staff (operations, programmes, training, observations)
•  Oversight of safeguarding recording on CPOMS including the monitoring, analysis and evaluation.
•  To work with the Head of Safeguarding and HR to ensure that all staff/volunteers who are working with children and young people are DBS checked and attend a safeguarding induction and regular safeguarding workshops. 
•  Work closely with HR to ensure that the single central record for each activity at the Foundation that involves Children and/or Adults at Risk is maintained, including relevant and permitted Disclosure information, safeguarding training records and any other information relevant to Safeguarding Vulnerable Groups. 
•  Conduct regular spot check audits throughout the year to assess compliance with safeguarding standards. 
•  Provide advice and guidance to the HR Department (and other departments as required) on all safeguarding related legislation.
•  Support staff in the sign-off process of planning off-site activities, trips, residentials and events.
•  Ensure that all third parties and partners that the Foundation engage with are compliant with safeguarding legislation and league standards. 
•  Ensure sensitive information is held securely, is GDPR compliant and all safeguarding and wellbeing concerns are recorded on our electronic case management system. 
•  Contribute to successful relationships with the English Football League, Premier League, FA and support other collaborations with agencies such as schools, education, social services, the Police and Youth Offending Teams. 
•  To advise on Foundation external activities including match day activities in relation to safeguarding.
•  To lead on keeping the organisation up to date and in line with legislation and communications around policies and processes associated with safeguarding activity.
•  To support the Head of Safeguarding and Director of Safeguarding and Inclusion to ensure the Foundation reaches its potential on all relevant safeguarding audits and be accountable for audit recommendations being monitored, reviewed and implemented. 
•  Provide relevant advice and guidance and embed best practice as appropriate.
•  Execute additional tasks as required in order to meet the Foundation’s changing priorities.
•  Champion and provide a vocal presence for Mental Health & Wellbeing within the Foundation;
•  Attend Mental Health & Wellbeing related working groups/action groups and offer operational perspective as and when required, and share information and communicate progress/issues back to colleagues;
•  Attend Foundation forums to share information and promote the safety of young people;
•  Work respectfully, sensitively and empathically with people with poor mental health and/or illness at all times;
•  Support any requests for updates on activities undertaken by the organisation around mental health.


Requirements

Essential
Experience:
•  Experience in social work, teaching or a related field working with children and/or adults at risk. Must have a background/experience in safeguarding preferably in a youth setting.
•  Recent experience of working effectively with external agencies, local community and a governing body.
•  Experienced in managing safeguarding concerns and keeping clear and comprehensive records of incidents.
•  Ability to contribute to the implementation and regular updating of policies and procedures for the safeguarding of children and ‘adults at risk’ across all areas of the club.

Skills, Knowledge & Qualifications:
Knowledge of:
•  The current safeguarding challenges in football/sport.
•  The UK safeguarding best practice.

Skills
•  Exceptional communication skills – both oral and written (presentation skills and delivery of ideas)
•  Commitment to collaborative and consultative working.
•  An understanding of the importance of, and the desire to engage with and inspire young people whatever their challenges.
•  The ability to deal sensitively with complex problems that can arise in child protection issues and/or similar matters.
•  A proven ability to manage change and to establish and maintain good working relationships with staff, children, young people, parents and ‘adults at risk’ – ability to work well with others is vital.
•  Experience of providing training and development for staff.
•  Excellent organisational skills, ability to effectively manage competing priorities and adhere to a range of tight deadlines.
•  High degree of professionalism and integrity, who will uphold the values of the Foundation. 

Qualifications
  • Relevant safeguarding qualification - appropriate experience will be accepted as an alternative.
  • Evidence of on-going CPD.

Desirable
Experience:
  • A track record in overseeing safeguarding arrangements for ‘adults at risk.’

Skills, Knowledge & Qualifications:
Knowledge of:
•  The impact of EDI on Safeguarding practices.
•  ‘Prevent’ including extremist and terrorist groups. 
•  Safeguarding, safer recruitment and equality and diversity practice.

Skills
•  Working in a similar role, ideally in a governing or membership body within sport or other suitable industry.
•  Demonstrable experience of strategies to raise standards; an aptitude and enthusiasm for effective analysis of data and its use in setting targets for improvement.

Qualifications
•  Degree or equivalent level qualification or experience.

• The ability to deal sensitively with complex problems that can arise in child protection issues and/or similar matters.
• A proven ability to manage change and to establish and maintain good working relationships with staff, children, young people, parents and ‘adults at risk’ – ability to work well with others is vital.
• Experience of providing training and development for staff.
• Excellent organisational skills, ability to effectively manage competing priorities and adhere to a range of tight deadlines.
• High degree of professionalism and integrity, who will uphold the values of the Foundation.
Qualifications
- Relevant safeguarding qualification - appropriate experience will be accepted as an alternative. - Evidence of on-going CPD.
Desirable
Experience:
- A track record in overseeing safeguarding arrangements for ‘adults at risk.’
Skills, Knowledge & Qualifications:
Knowledge of:
• The impact of EDI on Safeguarding practices.
• ‘Prevent’ including extremist and terrorist groups.
• Safeguarding, safer recruitment and equality and diversity practice.
Skills
• Working in a similar role, ideally in a governing or membership body within sport or other suitable industry.
• Demonstrable experience of strategies to raise standards; an aptitude and enthusiasm for effective analysis of data and its use in setting targets for improvement.
Qualifications
• Degree or equivalent level qualification or experience.

job.title: Pre-Academy & Development Centre Head Coach (Slough)
job.html_description:
1. To lead on the development of all talent and support Recruitment Managers by providing insight on player progress
  2. To lead on the organisation, management and setup of practices at your relevant centre 

Responsibilities

The following is a non-exhaustive list of the responsibilities of the role:
  • To ensure the high quality co-ordination and smooth operational running of the session you lead at your respective Pre-Academy or development centre session.
 
  • To ensure the deployment of appropriate football & sports coaches onto sessions. 
 
  • To collaborate effectively with the relevant Recruitment Manager manager to ensure a safe and fun programme for our young players.

job.title: Matchday Groundsperson Casual
job.html_description:

• Repair works to the pitch in the form of divoting after warm up’s, half time and post-match use.

job.title: Hospitality Ticketing Executive (Casual)
job.html_description:
As a Hospitality Ticketing Executive (Casual Matchday Role), you will play an important part in delivering an exceptional experience for guests attending Fulham Football Club on matchdays.

This is a casual position, with shifts available on home matchdays and selected event days only. The role offers flexible, ad hoc work and is ideal for individuals looking for occasional employment in a fast-paced sporting environment.

Working from the Hospitality Ticket Office, you will predominantly support hospitality guests while also acting as the first point of matchday support for guests attending through the Club's Authorised Resellers and Group Bookings. From ticketing enquiries and digital ticket support to stadium access and general matchday assistance, you will help ensure every guest receives a friendly, professional and welcoming service from arrival through to kick-off.

Working closely with the Hospitality Sales, Service, Ticketing, Matchday Operations and Security teams, you will help create a smooth and enjoyable experience for every guest visiting Craven Cottage on matchdays.

Responsibilities

  • Welcome hospitality guests, Authorised Reseller guests and Group Booking guests in a friendly, professional and approachable manner
  • Provide first-line support for ticketing enquiries, digital ticket issues, stadium access and general matchday queries
  • Assist with ticket collection, ticket reprints and resolving straightforward ticketing and access issues
  • Support guests attending through the Club's Authorised Resellers, including both Hospitality and General Admission bookings
  • Support Group Booking guests with ticketing enquiries, stadium access and general matchday assistance
  • Resolve standard ticketing and matchday queries, escalating more complex issues where appropriate
  • Direct General Admission enquiries not relating to Authorised Reseller or Group Bookings to the Club's Ticket Office
  • Provide accurate information on hospitality experiences, seating locations, stadium access and matchday operations
  • Work collaboratively with Hospitality Sales, Service, Ticketing, Matchday Operations and Security teams to deliver an exceptional guest experience
  • Follow Club procedures when handling tickets and guest information, maintaining the highest standards of professionalism, accuracy and confidentiality
  • Carry out any other reasonable duties required to support the successful delivery of the Club's hospitality and matchday ticketing operation

Requirements

Essential Skills & Experience
The Hospitality Ticketing Executive (Casual) must have:
  • Excellent customer service skills
  • A friendly, confident and professional manner
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Good attention to detail
  • Confidence using computer systems and digital ticketing platforms
  • The ability to remain calm, organised and solution-focused in a busy environment
  • A positive, proactive and team-focused approach
  • Reliability, punctuality and a willingness to learn
  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends and all home first-team fixtures

Desirable Skills & Experience
Ideally, the Hospitality Ticketing Executive (Casual) will have:
  • Previous customer service experience
  • Experience working within hospitality, retail, sport or live events
  • Experience using ticketing or booking systems
  • An interest in football and live events
