job.title: Retail Sales Associate (Nu Stadium)
job.html_description:
Description

As a Retail Sales Associate, you’ll help fans show their pride and take home a piece of Inter Miami CF. Be part of the energy in our shops and pop-ups at Nu Stadium.


What You'll Do: 

  • Deliver a world-class fan experience in our stadium retail store,on game days only.
  • Engage and assist fans with enthusiasm, sharing your knowledge of the club and merchandise.
  • Operate point of sale systems efficiently to ensure smooth and accurate transactions.
  • Provide product information and communicate in-store promotions clearly.
  • Keep the store organized and visually appealing throughout the shift.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned to support store operations.

Requirements

  • Prior retail experience preferred.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Must be available to work during home matches, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
  • Ability to work approximately 6-to-8-hour shifts on Inter Miami CF match days.
  • Physical ability to lift, move, and organize inventory in both indoor and outdoor settings.
  • Dependable transportation required.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) candidates are a plus.
     

All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check.


Must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States. 


Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law

job.title: Senior Manager, Procurement
job.location: 800 S Douglas Road, Coral Gables, FL, 33134, US
job.html_description:
Description

About the Company: Inter Miami CF (IMCF or the Club) is a Major League Soccer club competing in the Eastern Conference, owned by Miami Beckham United and playing at its newly developed permanent stadium (Nu Stadium) at Miami Freedom Park, a 25,000-seat stadium within a 131-acre master-planned site featuring a 55-acre public park, structured parking, and over one million square feet of mixed-use retail, entertainment, commercial, and hospitality development. The Club operates a growing and complex business spanning professional sports, live events, stadium operations, retail, food and beverage, sponsorships, and media which is supported by a lean Finance and Accounting function responsible for accounting, financial planning and analysis, cash management, procurement, and investor relations across multiple legal entities.


Position Summary:

  

The Senior Manager, Procurement will be the Club's inaugural dedicated procurement leader, responsible for architecting, implementing, and enforcing the end-to-end source-to-pay (S2P) function across Miami Beckham United (MBU). This is a rare opportunity for a seasoned procurement professional to design a procurement operating model from the ground up in a high-growth, high-visibility organization entering its most consequential phase of commercial scale.


The Senior Manager, Procurement will be responsible for enabling cost containment, cost reduction, and cost control across all third-party spend at MBU. This role will design and enforce the Club's purchase order policy, approval authority matrices, vendor onboarding standards, payment governance, and compliance reporting. The Senior Manager, Procurement will operate as the enforcement arm of the Club's Cost Control Policy Framework, with explicit authority relating to non-compliant spend.

In addition to policy authorship and enforcement, this role will build the Club's vendor management infrastructure, including vendor master data integrity, competitive bidding programs (RFI/RFQ/RFP), recurring and periodic contract commercial reviews, insurance and tax compliance validation, and ongoing spend analytics for sustainable cost reduction. The Senior Manager, Procurement will drive the transition to an environment where essentially all spend flows through procedures where competitive sourcing, PO discipline, and vendor accountability are the operating standards.


The role initially covers all MBU operations, with scope expansion into Miami Freedom Park (MFP) contemplated as that business platform matures. The Senior Manager, Procurement will report directly to the MBU Chief Financial Officer, and unify source-to-pay execution under a single accountable owner and function.


The Senior Manager, Procurement will serve as a trusted operational partner across the organization, translating procurement discipline into measurable outcomes: quantified savings, improved control coverage, cleaner vendor data, and defensible spend governance visible to lenders, auditors, and ultimately the ownership group.


Key Responsibilities:


Procurement Policy and Enforcement

  • Author, publish, and enforce the Club's Cost Control Policy Framework, including purchase order requirements, approval authority matrices, vendor onboarding standards, and payment governance.
  • Exercise stop-work and stop-payment authority for any commitment or invoice that does not comply with established procurement policy, escalating exceptions to the Chief Financial Officer on a documented basis.
  • Serve as the Club's primary internal enforcement authority for third-party spend discipline, including formal partnership with cost center leaders on remediation of policy exceptions.
  • Design and administer training programs and materials for department leaders, budget owners, and approvers on procurement policy, personal accountability standards, and system workflows.
  • Establish and maintain the exceptions process, including documentation, review cadence, escalation protocol, and highly visible compliance reporting.

  

Strategic Sourcing and Cost Reduction

  • Design and lead all RFI, RFQ, and RFP activity for the Club, including scope definition, vendor identification, bid evaluation, and award recommendation for new and all existing vendor relationships
  • Build and execute a competitive re-bid program for legacy vendors who have never been formally sourced, prioritized by annual spend and strategic importance.
  • Develop category strategies for the Club's major spend categories, including retail merchandise (inventory), variable matchday operations (e.g., day of game / event), third-party outsourced professional services, marketing, and travel.
  • Identify, quantify, and deliver measurable cost savings through consolidation, competitive bidding, negotiated terms, business back, and category rationalization.
  • Oversee the Club’s corporate credit card, employee reimbursement, and capital expenditure policies and administration. 
  • Partner with department leads (i.e., cost centers) and Legal on commercial term negotiation for material third-party contracts.
  • Design regular enterprise tests to ensure effective control environment around spend.

  

Vendor Management and Master Data

  • Own the vendor master data file, including new vendor onboarding procedures, periodic re-validation, deactivation of dormant vendors, and duplicate vendor resolution.
  • Establish and enforce vendor onboarding standards including W-9 collection, banking verification, insurance and certificate of insurance validation, sanctions screening, and 1099 readiness.
  • Administer the Club's contract and renewal calendar, ensuring proactive engagement on renewals, expirations, and auto-renewal exposures.
  • Monitor vendor performance against contractual service levels and escalate non-performance to the appropriate business owner.

  

Purchase Order Governance

  • Design and administer the Club's purchase order workflow utilizing existing platforms , including approval routing, expense category discipline, and system configuration.
  • Evaluate and determine if existing procurement-related technology stack sufficiently scales to the heighted business complexity and transaction volume of the organization.
  • Drive purchase order compliance from current baseline toward best-practice benchmarks (at or above 90% of spend under PO).
  • Enforce the "no PO, no pay" standard, including formal return-to-requester process for non-compliant invoices.
  • Monitor and report to the executive leadership team and ownership group on PO compliance by cost center, category, and dollar band.

  

Accounts Payable Operations

  • Directly supervise the accounts payable function, providing day-to-day direction, quality review, and supervision.
  • Own AP operations end-to-end, including invoice intake, three-way match, payment run execution, and month-end AP close activities.
  • Administer the Club's rush payment policy, requiring documented business justification and Chief Financial Officer approval for any exception to standard payment timing.
  • Ensure integrity of the AP subledger and its reconciliation to the general ledger, in coordination with the Club’s accounting team.


Spend Analytics and Reporting

  • Establish a recurring spend analytics capability, including monthly PO compliance reporting, quarterly spend-by-category analysis, and annual savings realization tracking.
  • Deliver executive-level reporting on procurement KPIs, vendor risk exposures, and cost containment outcomes.
  • Partner with Financial Planning and Analysis on the annual budget cycle to align procurement sourcing calendars with budget commitments.
  • Support internal and external inquiries (including audit engagements) as the primary point of contact for procurement, AP, and vendor master data inquiries.

  

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as the primary Finance interface with department leads, Legal, and executive leadership on all third-party spend matters.
  • Partner with Legal on contract commercial review, MSA and SOW structuring, and any renewal negotiations.
  • Coordinate with the Senior Director, Controller and the Senior Director, Finance on treasury, budget, and reporting alignment.
  • Support the Chief Financial Officer on ad-hoc initiatives, including cross-entity procurement, MFP scope expansion, executive-level cost management reporting, and cost reduction strategies.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Supply Chain, or a related field required.
  • 6+ years of progressive procurement, sourcing, or category management experience, including 2+ years leading procurement in a high-growth or transformation environment.
  • Demonstrated success authoring and enforcing procurement policy in an organization that previously lacked one.
  • Track record of delivering quantified cost savings through competitive sourcing, vendor consolidation, and category strategy.
  • Deep experience with source-to-pay technology platforms; direct experience with Tipalti and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is helpful but not required.
  • Working knowledge of accounts payable operations, three-way match, and vendor master data governance.
  • Experience managing direct reports, with a demonstrated ability to develop an AP function with procurement staff.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to hold firm on policy in cross-functional and executive settings.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage a high-volume vendor and contract portfolio across multiple entities and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder sourcing initiatives from scoping through implementation and handoff.
  • Strong financial acumen with the ability to identify, quantify, and communicate savings, risk, and exposure to senior leadership.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to define structure, process, and controls where none currently exist.
  • Bias towards initiative, is resourceful and solutions-oriented, and can break down complex problems into digestible, actionable components.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and procurement/project management tools.
  • High degree of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality.

Preferred Experience

  • MBA or other relevant advanced degree or professional certification.
  • Prior experience building a procurement function from the ground up in a scaling organization.
  • Background in professional sports, live events, hospitality, stadium operations, or high-growth consumer brands.
  • Experience with real estate development, construction procurement, or capital project sourcing (relevant to future MFP scope expansion).
  • Familiarity with lender-facing environments where procurement discipline supports covenant compliance and audit readiness.
  • Experience with vendor risk programs, insurance and COI compliance, and 1099 administration.
  • Bilingual English / Spanish given vendor and community mix.

 

Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.


All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check.


Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

- MBA or other relevant advanced degree or professional certification. - Prior experience building a procurement function from the ground up in a scaling organization. - Background in professional sports, live events, hospitality, stadium operations, or high-growth consumer brands. - Experience with real estate development, construction procurement, or capital project sourcing (relevant to future MFP scope expansion). - Familiarity with lender-facing environments where procurement discipline supports covenant compliance and audit readiness. - Experience with vendor risk programs, insurance and COI compliance, and 1099 administration. - Bilingual English / Spanish given vendor and community mix.

job.title: Coordinator, Shipping & Receiving
job.html_description:
Description

The Coordinator, Shipping and Receiving is responsible for managing and distributing mail within an organization. This role is essential for ensuring smooth communication and efficient mail handling within our organization.  


Essential Duties and Responsibilities: 

  • Collect incoming mail from postal workers, sort it by departments, and distribute it accordingly.  
  • Maintain an organized and clean mail room. 
  • Prepare and dispatch outgoing mail, including weighing packages, affixing postage, and ensuring timely delivery. 
  • Maintain accurate records of incoming and outgoing mail, including dates and recipients. 
  • Manage the receipt and delivery of packages, including special deliveries like overnight shipments. 
  • Assist with customer inquiries regarding postal rates, delivery times, and other mail-related questions. 
  • Ensure the mailroom and the business office is stocked with postage stamps, envelopes, packing materials and essential office supplies.  
  • Assist the security team when needed at the security control room desk. 
  • All other duties as assigned. 

Requirements

  • High school degree or GED 
  • Accurate sorting and record-keeping is crucial 
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively 
  • Clear communication with colleagues and postal workers 
  • Ability to lift and move packages, sometimes up to 50lbs
  • Proficiency preferred with mail sorting software and tracking systems, CCTV camera system, 24/7 Incident Management System and Envoy (visitor check in and tracking system)
  • Must be able to work flexible hours including some weekends and/or holidays
  • Ability to speak and understand Spanish is a plus 
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office suite
  • Forklift certification a plus


Physical Demands:

  • Must be able to move and/or lift up to 50 pounds. 
  • This position requires work inside and outside of the building and some exposure to adverse conditions. 
  • Work in various positions, including but not limited to, stooping, standing, walking, bending over, sitting, kneeling, and squatting for extended periods of time. 

 

Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.


All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check.


Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Coordinator, Operations (Academy)
job.location: 1350 NW 55 Street, Fort Lauderdale, FL, 33309, US
job.html_description:
Description

Inter Miami CF is looking for a passionate and dedicated Coordinator, Operations (Academy) to join our Operations team. In this full-time role, you’ll play a vital part in maintaining world-class operations and facilities that meet the highest professional standards.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Assist with all the academy’s operational aspects, including set-up, breakdown, scheduling, communication, event coordination, general maintenance, etc.
  • Assist with managing the department’s equipment inventory, including maintaining accurate records and ensuring the availability of necessary materials
  • Create standard operating procedures, checklists, and training manuals for all areas of oversight.
  • Responsible for event recap notes.
  • Assist with IMCF II matches in the stadium, serving as the POC for the venue.
  • Execute other projects as assigned.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Facilities / Event Management, Maintenance, or related field preferred.
  • Ability or willingness to learn how to operate necessary equipment/software to complete required tasks.
  • Availability for academy matches and other events throughout the season (primarily evenings, weekends, and holidays).
  • Event/operations management in sports & entertainment venues preferred.
  • Very strong communication, organizational, problem-solving, and teamwork skills.
  • Team player able to handle a variety of tasks.
  • Ability to speak and understand Spanish is a plus.
  • A passion for fútbol is a plus.

Physical Demands:

  • Ability to lift 50 pounds of weight frequently throughout the assigned workday.
  • Ability to work in various degrees of outdoor weather conditions, including but not limited to extreme heat or rain.
  • Ability to work in various positions, including but not limited to stooping, standing, bending over, sitting, kneeling, and squatting for extended periods of time.

 

Equal Opportunity Statement 

Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. 


Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.

job.title: Coordinator, Operations (Nu Stadium)
job.html_description:
Description

The Coordinator, Operations is responsible for daily activities required to coordinate, plan, run, maintain and service the stadium and events.


Responsibilities & Duties

  • Responsible for the planning and execution of special events including partner, client, hospitality events etc.
  • Develop a complete understanding of the requirements for every special event.
  • Assist researching vendors and make selections based on their creativity, quality, and cost.
  • Participates and leads client tours, coordinating the event needs with the client, and helping to determine relevant equipment, personnel and services required and estimated costs.
  • Responsible for making all departments aware of special event needs by generating event orders, diagrams, etc. to internal departments and 3rd party providers as needed.
  • Assist in regularly tracking the overall event finances.
  • Ensure all events are ready for guests, clients and teams as required.
  • Support and assist Operations Managers in large scale events and operations projects.
  • Act as the Event Manager on Duty for partner, client, and hospitality events.
  • Carefully supervise load-ins and event preparation activities.
  • Offer solutions to resolve problems in a timely manner.
  • Create event sheets and post-event summaries for partner, client, hospitality events etc.
  • Provide regular feedback to leadership and participates in continuous improvement for efficiency of operations and events.
  • Assist in maintaining the events calendar.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Facilities / Event Management or related field preferred.
  • Event / operations management in sports & entertainment venues preferred.
  • Demonstrate knowledge of practices and procedures related to event planning, set-up and conversions.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and teamwork skills.
  • Team player able to handle a variety of tasks.
  • Ability to speak and understand Spanish a plus.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including but not limited to evenings, weekends and holidays.
  • A passion for fútbol is a plus.

Physical Demands:

  • Must be able to move and/or lift up to 50 pounds.
  • This position requires work inside and outside of the building and some exposure to adverse conditions.
  • Ability to work extended hours, weekends, evenings and holidays as needed.

 

Equal Opportunity Statement

  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and accountable.

job.title: Commercial Matchday Hosts
job.html_description:
Job Title: Commercial Matchday Hosts

Responsible to: Head of Commercial

Apply here: https://forms.office.com/e/12c4GXBGmg

About The Role:

As a host at Elland Road, you will be the first point of contact for many of our VIP hospitality guests. In this role you would be required to act as the face of the Club within your allocated hospitality lounge, creating a seamless link between our hospitality department, our catering department and our VIP matchday guests. This will ensure that our guests receive the highest possible standard of service and have an exceptional hospitality experience.

Allocation Main Responsibilities

  • Positions are offered for matchdays only, with a typical shift lasting approximately seven to eight hours.

  • Attending pre-match hospitality host / hostess briefing prior to each shift;

  • Familiarise yourself with your designated suite (which may change each shift), checking the suite and other guests facilities meet required standards and ensuring corporate lanyards and programmes are set out as per the guests chosen package;

  • Welcoming all guests into your suite, building relationships by using eye contact and escorting guests to their assigned dining area / table;

  • Build relationships with customers pre-match, at half time and full time.

  • Continuously managing the flow of guests in to the suite ensuring all

    guests catering needs are being met and all guests are happy;

  • Be particularly attentive to new guests to ensure they are comfortable in their surroundings whilst being observant towards and engaging with all guests at all times to ensure the highest levels of service throughout the day;

  • Resolving any issues as they arise to ensure the guests' matchday experience is not effected, raising to the next level and / or appropriate departments as required (usually Duty Manager in your allocated lounge)

  • Directing guests to the appropriate match seats;

  • Answering any questions hospitality guests may have about other events

    and fixtures;

  • Report any faults with facilities and any catering issues without delay;

  • Any other reasonable duties

Required Technical Skills

  • Previous experience as a host or hostess, or hospitality waiter or waitress in a hospitality environment, or front of house experience, is preferred.

Required Behavioural Attitudes

  • Strong interpersonal skills

  • Candidates must be well presented, mature, professional and have an outgoing personality

  • The ability to work efficiently in a high pressured and dynamic sporting environment

  • A good approach to teamwork and ability to manage a busy hospitality area

  • Ability to troubleshoot under pressure

  • Excellent customer service skills and spoken English required

  • Ability to use initiative and be creative

  • Strong customer service skills

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Ability to prioritise case load and manage time effectively

  • Confident and assertive

  • Ambition, passion and willingness to learn

job.title: Development Chef
job.html_description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a Development Chef to join our Liverpool FC team.

As Development Chef, you will immerse yourself in a dynamic and innovative environment where culinary creativity and passion are at the forefront of product development. With a strong focus on culinary trends and product innovation, you will have the opportunity to showcase your skills, collaborate with a diverse range of stakeholders, and bring new product ideas to life in the kitchen. By working in the Central Production kitchen, you will be part of a supportive and collaborative culture that values personal growth and development, offering opportunities for training, upskilling, and exposure to a wide range of culinary experiences.

What will you be doing?

  • Develop innovative menu ideas, food concepts and product ranges.
  • Research culinary trends and translate insights into new ideas for menus and products.
  • Present findings, run tastings and deliver product showcases for key stakeholders.
  • Create new and exclusive food concepts that support the club’s wider catering offer.
  • Write clear, consistent recipes that can be followed across relevant teams and food categories.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including the Executive Head Chef and Retail Catering team.
  • Ensure that products align with club goals, customer expectations and operational requirements.
  • Support menu development for matchdays, day-to-day catering and retail food products.
  • Comply with all uniform standards as required by legislation and Liverpool FC.
  • Support the recruitment of the kitchen brigade, including full-time and casual colleagues, in line with company and statutory standards.
  • Carry out annual performance reviews with direct reports, ensuring objectives are clear and well defined.
  • Work closely with the hospitality, tourism and events teams to support the delivery of an excellent customer experience.
  • Inspire and motivate the kitchen brigade to deliver high-quality food in line with specifications, while supporting budgeted sales and profit targets.
  • Attend departmental meetings as required and contribute positively as part of the management team.
  • Regularly review the quality and pricing of food suppliers to build strong partnerships and ensure the right products are in place. Suppliers should be audited before appointment and annually thereafter.
  • Meet prospective and existing clients attending events to support the sales process and build effective relationships.

Who are we looking for?

  • Proven current experience as a professional chef, within a busy, multi-site stadium or sports environment.
  • Ability to create and deliver high-quality, innovative recipes across a range of food categories.
  • Strong knowledge of culinary techniques, flavour profiles, ingredients and food trends, with the ability to turn insights into creative food concepts and menus.
  • Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint, to create engaging presentations that inspire stakeholders and communicate new product development ideas.
  • Excellent organisation, communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and build positive relationships with managers, supervisors, colleagues and customers.
  • Able to work efficiently in a fast-paced kitchen environment, manage time well, work under pressure and use your own initiative when required.
  • High standards of hygiene, presentation and professionalism, with sound recipe-writing practices.
  • Up-to-date knowledge of current food safety legislation, including allergen requirements and Natasha’s Law.
  • Creative approach to problem-solving, with the ability to innovate and stay up to date with changes across the food industry.
  • Ability to plan and lead small events, with flexibility to work occasional evenings when required.

Desirable experience and skills:

  • Experience in a similar role within a football stadium or sports venue.
  • Experience working in a front-of-house environment.
  • Ability to work to strict deadlines in a pressured environment.
  • Budget-writing experience.
  • Ability to speak an additional language.

Why should you apply?

This is a full-time, permanent role working 35 hours per week. Your main base will be our Anfield Stadium. 

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:

  • Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5%
  • Life Assurance Cover
  • Free financial guidance and mortgage advice
  • Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving
  • Cycle to Work scheme to keep you active
  • Purchase season ticket loans for easier commuting
  • Exclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailers
  • Will Writing Service for future planning
  • Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support
  • Medicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needs
  • Volunteering opportunities to give back to the community
  • Special LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts

…and much more! LFC Benefits.pdf

At Liverpool Football Club, we have an unwavering commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion and are always looking to making a positive difference in the communities that we operate within. We are proud of our achievements in this area; maintaining the Premier League Equality Standard Advanced Level, becoming a founding signatory of the Football Association’s Football Leadership Diversity Code and being recognised as a leader in this important area on and off the pitch. We take our responsibilities in this area seriously and through the work being done across the club, we are committed to increasing the diversity of our people and becoming an increasingly inclusive workplace for all. We are committed to hiring great people representative of diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills across our entire business. If you share our enthusiasm and passion for inclusivity, then we want to hear from you.

Liverpool FC is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and vulnerable adults and expects all Colleagues and Volunteers to share this commitment. This role is subject to a satisfactory enhanced DBS check.

By working in the Central Production kitchen, you will be part of a supportive and collaborative culture that values personal growth and development, offering opportunities for training, upskilling, and exposure to a wide range of culinary experiences.
What will you be doing?
- Develop innovative menu ideas, food concepts and product ranges. - Research culinary trends and translate insights into new ideas for menus and products. - Present findings, run tastings and deliver product showcases for key stakeholders. - Create new and exclusive food concepts that support the club’s wider catering offer. - Write clear, consistent recipes that can be followed across relevant teams and food categories. - Work closely with cross-functional teams, including the Executive Head Chef and Retail Catering team. - Ensure that products align with club goals, customer expectations and operational requirements. - Support menu development for matchdays, day-to-day catering and retail food products. - Comply with all uniform standards as required by legislation and Liverpool FC. - Support the recruitment of the kitchen brigade, including full-time and casual colleagues, in line with company and statutory standards. - Carry out annual performance reviews with direct reports, ensuring objectives are clear and well defined. - Work closely with the hospitality, tourism and events teams to support the delivery of an excellent customer experience. - Inspire and motivate the kitchen brigade to deliver high-quality food in line with specifications, while supporting budgeted sales and profit targets. - Attend departmental meetings as required and contribute positively as part of the management team. - Regularly review the quality and pricing of food suppliers to build strong partnerships and ensure the right products are in place. Suppliers should be audited before appointment and annually thereafter. - Meet prospective and existing clients attending events to support the sales process and build effective relationships.
Who are we looking for?
- Proven current experience as a professional chef, within a busy, multi-site stadium or sports environment. - Ability to create and deliver high-quality, innovative recipes across a range of food categories. - Strong knowledge of culinary techniques, flavour profiles, ingredients and food trends, with the ability to turn insights into creative food concepts and menus. - Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint, to create engaging presentations that inspire stakeholders and communicate new product development ideas. - Excellent organisation, communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and build positive relationships with managers, supervisors, colleagues and customers. - Able to work efficiently in a fast-paced kitchen environment, manage time well, work under pressure and use your own initiative when required. - High standards of hygiene, presentation and professionalism, with sound recipe-writing practices. - Up-to-date knowledge of current food safety legislation, including allergen requirements and Natasha’s Law. - Creative approach to problem-solving, with the ability to innovate and stay up to date with changes across the food industry. - Ability to plan and lead small events, with flexibility to work occasional evenings when required.
Desirable experience and skills:
- Experience in a similar role within a football stadium or sports venue. - Experience working in a front-of-house environment. - Ability to work to strict deadlines in a pressured environment. - Budget-writing experience. - Ability to speak an additional language.
Why should you apply?
This is a full-time, permanent role working 35 hours per week. Your main base will be our Anfield Stadium.
Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:
- Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5% - Life Assurance Cover - Free financial guidance and mortgage advice - Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving - Cycle to Work scheme to keep you active - Purchase season ticket loans for easier commuting - Exclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailers - Will Writing Service for future planning - Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support - Medicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needs - Volunteering opportunities to give back to the community - Special LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts

job.title: Partnerships Coordinator, LFC Foundation
job.location: Anfield Sports & Community Centre, United Kingdom
job.html_description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an individual to join our LFC Foundation team as a Partnerships Coordinator. 

The LFC Charity Foundation is the official charity partner for Liverpool Football Club. The Partnerships Coordinator will report to and work closely with the Head of Partnerships to manage the day-to-day relationships with Club Partners who support the work of the LFC Foundation. The role will require excellent stakeholder relationships and effective project and time management skills

What will you be doing?

  • Work closely with the LFC Partnerships Team to build excellent relationships with Club Partners and Stakeholders
  • Ensure the LFC Foundation are delivering all KPI’s in relation to funding provided by Club Partners for programme delivery
  • Support and deliver LFC Foundation specific campaigns and activations for Club Partners
  • Grow trust and confidence within the Partner’s organisation by understanding the Partners’ industry category and their business, marketing, and sponsorship objectives
  • Build strong working relationships within other Club departments
  • Undertake any projects or assignments as required
  • Support in the development of programmes as part of the sales process for new partners
  • Contribute to match day operations and other partnership events/projects where required
  • Ensure all our practices our inclusive and accessible to all

Safeguarding   

  • Ensure LFC Foundation quality and safeguarding standards are achieved and maintained at all times  

LFCF and LFC Policy and Procedures   

  • To support with LFC Foundation programme development across all delivery areas  
  • To ensure compliance with all relevant LFC Foundation policies, including health and safety policies and safeguarding
  • To ensure compliance with all relevant legal, regulatory, ethical and social requirements   
  • To build and maintain good working relationships both internally and externally, maintaining a professional image at all times when representing the LFC Foundation and Liverpool Football Club
  • To keep confidential any information gained regarding the LFC Foundation and its personnel    

Who are we looking for?

Essential Knowledge  

  • Demonstrable experience of working in project and stakeholder management 
  • Excellent time management skills
  • Ability to manage multiple projects
  • Competent in Microsoft Office

Essential Functional / Technical Skills  

  • Educated to relevant degree level – or equivalent  
  • Experience of writing and implementing project plans
  • Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills

Why should you apply?

This is a Fixed-Term Contract opportunity for a period of 12 months, working 35 hours per week on a 5 from 7 day basis. Your main base will be our Anfield Sports and Community Centre.

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:

  • Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5%
  • Life Assurance Cover
  • Free financial guidance and mortgage advice
  • Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving
  • Cycle to Work scheme to keep you active
  • Purchase season ticket loans for easier commuting
  • Exclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailers
  • Will Writing Service for future planning
  • Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support
  • Medicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needs
  • Volunteering opportunities to give back to the community
  • Special LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts

…and much more! LFC Benefits.pdf

We are proud of our achievements in this area; maintaining the Premier League Equality Standard Advanced Level, becoming a founding signatory of the Football Association’s Football Leadership Diversity Code and being recognised as a leader in this important area on and off the pitch. We take our responsibilities in this area seriously and through the work being done across the club, we are committed to increasing the diversity of our people and becoming an increasingly inclusive workplace for all. We are committed to hiring great people representative of diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills across our entire business. If you share our enthusiasm and passion for inclusivity, then we want to hear from you.

Liverpool FC is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and vulnerable adults and expects all Colleagues and Volunteers to share this commitment. This role is subject to a satisfactory enhanced DBS check.

job.title: HR & Corporate Back Office Technology Business Partner
job.html_description:
We are looking for a HR & Corporate Back Office Technology Business Partner to join the team here at Liverpool Football Club. 

You will own and support the technology and systems used by teams including HR, Legal, Procurement and Communications, driving technical change that meets business needs. As the go-to expert for HR and Corporate Back Office technology, you will champion innovation, improve processes, ensure compliance with governance and security requirements, manage key supplier relationships and work across the Club to deliver effective technology solutions. 

What will you be doing? 

Product Leadership & Strategy 

  • Support business leads and the Senior Manager, Finance & HR Systems in shaping and delivering the technology strategy for HR, Legal, Procurement and Communications. 
  • Manage the roadmap and backlog for your business areas, balancing efficiency, commercial value, user experience and innovation. 
  • Drive improvements in partnership with business stakeholders and product teams. 
  • Champion appropriate uses of AI to improve internal processes and systems, in line with Club policies. 
  • Use data to evaluate performance, identify cost-saving opportunities and inform roadmap priorities. 
  • Support the development of business cases and investment proposals for technology change. 

Technology & Vendor Management 

  • Manage day-to-day technical relationships with suppliers across HR and Corporate Back Office systems. 
  • Evaluate and onboard new suppliers, and oversee system integrations. 
  • Identify opportunities to simplify the supplier landscape where appropriate.

Operational Excellence & Compliance 

  • Ensure systems, projects and suppliers meet relevant legal, governance, information security and risk requirements. 
  • Promote responsible and compliant use of AI. 
  • Champion strong data control, organisation and documentation across the system estate. 
  • Create and monitor technical KPIs to measure system performance and effectiveness. 
  • Provide subject matter expertise to help operational teams and business functions achieve the best outcomes. 

Innovation & Cross-Functional Collaboration 

  • Lead technical change and improvements across the Club’s internal HR, Legal, Procurement and Communications technology estate. 
  • Partner with teams across Liverpool FC to align system capabilities with wider business goals. 
  • Work with Digital Product colleagues to incorporate HR and Corporate Back Office requirements into wider projects and improvements. 
  • Support compliance activity and internal audits. 

Who are we looking for? 

Essential Knowledge & Experience 

  • Proven experience in a senior HR technology or product role, ideally within a complex organisation. 
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills, with confidence engaging at all levels. 
  • Ability to understand, document and present complex user journeys and information clearly. 
  • Experience creating reports and using data to generate recommendations and support decisions. 
  • A creative and analytical mindset, with a proactive approach to learning and independent problem-solving. 
  • Experience working in Agile or Scrum environments and using tools such as Trello, Jira, GitLab or similar. 
  • Working knowledge of compliance, governance and security requirements. 
  • An understanding of UX/UI principles and a focus on delivering a strong user experience. 
  • Experience using AI and automation to simplify processes and save time or cost. 

Essential Technical & Functional Skills 

  • Experience setting and monitoring KPIs, targets and performance measures. 
  • Strong analytical capability, with confidence creating and interpreting reports and dashboards. 
  • Experience managing third-party suppliers and collaborating with Scrum teams across multiple locations. 
  • Ability to work independently, self-motivate and lead upwards. 
  • Proven ability to explain the value of Agile ways of working and technical projects to non-technical audiences. 
  • Confidence representing the organisation at industry events, including travel where required. 

Desirable 

  • Experience with systems such as Zellis MyView, Ubeya, Benefex and SharePoint. 
  • Familiarity with analytics tools and business intelligence dashboards. 

Why should you apply?

This is a full-time perm position working 35 hours per week. Your main base will be our city centre office in Liverpool.

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:

  • Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5%
  • Life Assurance Cover
  • Free financial guidance and mortgage advice
  • Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving
  • Cycle to Work scheme to keep you active
  • Purchase season ticket loans for easier commuting
  • Exclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailers
  • Will Writing Service for future planning
  • Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support
  • Medicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needs
  • Volunteering opportunities to give back to the community
  • Special LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts

…and much more! LFC Benefits.pdf

At Liverpool Football Club, we have an unwavering commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion and are always looking to making a positive difference in the communities that we operate within. We are proud of our achievements in this area; maintaining the Premier League Equality Standard Advanced Level, becoming a founding signatory of the Football Association’s Football Leadership Diversity Code and being recognised as a leader in this important area on and off the pitch. We take our responsibilities in this area seriously and through the work being done across the club, we are committed to increasing the diversity of our people and becoming an increasingly inclusive workplace for all. We are committed to hiring great people representative of diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills across our entire business. If you share our enthusiasm and passion for inclusivity, then we want to hear from you.

Liverpool FC is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and vulnerable adults and expects all Colleagues and Volunteers to share this commitment.

job.title: Associate, Finance Technology Business Partner
job.html_description:
We are looking for a Finance Technology Business Partner to join the team at Liverpool FC. 

You will own and support the Finance team's technology and systems, driving system improvements, integrations, and technical change initiatives. Acting as the Finance technology expert, they will lead innovation, enhance processes, ensure compliance with governance and security standards, manage key supplier relationships, and collaborate with stakeholders across the Club to deliver effective technology solutions that meet business needs.

What will you be doing?

Product Leadership & Strategy

  • Support the development and delivery of the Finance Technology strategy.
  • Manage the Finance systems roadmap, backlog, and improvement priorities.
  • Drive system enhancements, integrations, and process optimisation initiatives.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders and product teams to deliver business-focused solutions.
  • Champion AI and innovation opportunities to improve efficiency and performance.
  • Use data and insights to inform decision-making, prioritisation, and cost optimisation.
  • Support business case development and investment proposals for technology change.

Technology & Vendor Management

  • Manage relationships with Finance technology suppliers and partners.
  • Evaluate, onboard, and oversee third-party technology providers.
  • Lead and support Finance system integrations across the Club's technology landscape.

Operational Excellence & Compliance

  • Ensure Finance systems and suppliers comply with governance, security, and regulatory requirements.
  • Promote the responsible and compliant use of AI technologies.
  • Drive high standards of data management, documentation, and system governance.
  • Develop and monitor KPIs to measure Finance system performance and effectiveness.
  • Provide expert guidance on Finance technology to support operational excellence and business outcomes.

Who are we looking for?

Essential Knowledge & Experience

  • Proven experience in a senior Finance Technology/Product role within a complex organisation.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills.
  • Ability to analyse, document, and present complex processes and user journeys.
  • Experience creating reports, dashboards, and communicating insights from data.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive, adaptable approach.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and using tools such as Jira, Trello, or similar.
  • Good understanding of UX/UI principles and process improvement.
  • Knowledge of compliance, governance, and security requirements.
  • Experience leveraging AI and automation to improve efficiency and business outcomes.

Essential Technical Skills

  • Experience with Finance platforms, including Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O) and Microsoft Fabric.
  • Experience defining and monitoring KPIs, targets, and performance metrics.
  • Familiarity with analytics and business intelligence tools.
  • Experience managing third-party suppliers and working with geographically dispersed teams.
  • Ability to work independently, self-motivate, and confidently engage with senior stakeholders.

Desirable

  • Understanding of customer journeys across ticketing, retail, memberships, events, or entertainment sectors.
  • Experience working within a fan-focused, sport, leisure, or entertainment organisation.

Why should you apply?

This is a full-time perm position working 35 hours per week. Your main base will be our city centre office in Liverpool.

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:

  • Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5%
  • Life Assurance Cover
  • Free financial guidance and mortgage advice
  • Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving
  • Cycle to Work scheme to keep you active
  • Purchase season ticket loans for easier commuting
  • Exclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailers
  • Will Writing Service for future planning
  • Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support
  • Medicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needs
  • Volunteering opportunities to give back to the community
  • Special LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts

job.title: Specialist Grounds Person, Anfield Stadium
job.html_description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an individual to join our Liverpool FC team as a Specialist Grounds Person, located at our Anfield Stadium. In this role you will work as part of the grounds team, to help provide the best possible pitch standards for football.  

What will you be doing?

  • Ensure all playing surfaces are maintained to the very highest standard and are playable at all times
  • Carry out daily pitch maintenance duties including mowing, aerating, line marking, divoting, chemical foliar spraying and fertilising.
  • Ensure that all daily maintenance work is recorded accurately and logged in accordance with Company procedures.
  • Be proactive in maintaining grass health and be able to identify problems such as weeds, pests, diseases and report to line manager.
  • Operate irrigation systems, set up irrigation programmes to match requirements. Carry out basic maintenance, report issues, oversee repairs. Understand drainage system and undersoil heating systems.
  • Effectively maintain all synthetic surfaces, following the required maintenance regime, ensuring hygiene and safety standards are met at all times.
  • Support in the completion of all end of season pitch renovation works across all sites within the necessary timeframes, to ensure that all playing surfaces are to the required standards ahead of the new season starting.
  • Ensure that all Club equipment is maintained and cleaned to the highest standard, escalating any equipment issues/damage to the management team where necessary.
  • Ensure all work areas and equipment storage areas are properly cleaned, are accessible at all times and comply with all Company Health & Safety guidelines.
  • Safely use all chemical and fertiliser products as required, in line with Club procedure and all relevant Health & Safety law.
  • Ensure that all Health & Safety responsibilities are adhered to; including goal post safety checks, proper use of all PPE, adherence to manual handling guidelines and attending regular refresher courses on all aspects of Health & Safety and industry best practice.
  • Safely operate a range of horticultural equipment and machinery ensuring all is maintained in accordance with routine operating requirements.
  • Understand Risk and Method Statements and work to these
  • Health and Safety
  • Ensure understanding, awareness and compliance at all times with the Club’s Health & Safety Policy and procedures.

Who are we looking for?

  • Previous experience working within a grounds maintenance role, in particular within a sporting environment.
  • Completed NVQ level 2 in Sports Turf
  • Qualified in safe use of pesticides Pa1 and Pa6
  • Qualified to safely operate mowers, utility vehicle and tractors
  • Excellent Punctuality and Flexibility
  • Ability to demonstrate an awareness of Health and Safety
  • Ability to work in a team and independently
  • A high level of attention to detail.
  • Ability to maintain a high standard of work in a fast-paced, high pressure environment.
  • A flexible and proactive approach to work, with the ability to focus on results and continuous improvements.
  • An ability to effectively communicate with individuals in various roles across a team.

Desirable

  • Continuing professional development keeping abreast of current trends and practices
  • Qualified in the safe use of pesticides PA2
  • 2 years’ experience in working in Sports grounds.
  • Been trained to safely operate relevant machinery such as hedge trimmers,
  • Been trained to maintain artificial surfaces
  • Been trained to maintain reinforced pitches

Why should you apply?

This is a full-time perm position working 40 hours per week. Your main base will be Anfield Stadium.

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:

  • Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5%
  • Life Assurance Cover
  • Free financial guidance and mortgage advice
  • Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving
  • Cycle to Work scheme to keep you active
  • Purchase season ticket loans for easier commuting
  • Exclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailers
  • Will Writing Service for future planning
  • Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support
  • Medicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needs
  • Volunteering opportunities to give back to the community
  • Special LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts

…and much more! LFC Benefits.pdf

job.title: Volunteer Senior Coordinator, LFC Foundation
job.location: Anfield Sports & Community Centre, United Kingdom
job.html_description:
We are looking for a Volunteer Senior Coordinator to join the team at LFC Foundation. 

You will support the design, delivery, and continuously enhance the Foundation’s volunteer journey, ensuring every volunteer receives an exceptional and rewarding experience. This role will be responsible for understanding the Foundation’s volunteering needs and implementing recruitment and onboarding processes that reflect best practice, ensuring a robust and compliant volunteer experience. You will build and nurture engaging, empowering, and meaningful relationships with volunteers, matching individuals to opportunities that align with their skills, interests, and aspirations, while supporting the Foundation to achieve its strategic objectives and maximise community impact.

What will you be doing?

  • Design and continuously improve volunteer recruitment, onboarding, and management processes in line with best practice and Foundation needs.
  • Develop and maintain volunteer role profiles, guidance, and documentation to ensure consistency and compliance.
  • Lead volunteer attraction campaigns and build partnerships to engage diverse volunteers that reflect our communities.
  • Coordinate volunteer onboarding, pre-employment checks, and safeguarding requirements.
  • Create a positive and engaging volunteer experience through ongoing support, development opportunities, and recognition initiatives.
  • Build strong relationships with volunteers and managers, ensuring effective communication, feedback, and continuous improvement.
  • Monitor and evaluate volunteer activity to ensure a high-quality experience while protecting the Foundation’s interests.
  • Act as the Foundation’s subject matter expert on volunteering, supporting the wider people and resource strategy.
  • Manage the Foundation’s volunteer management platform and oversee both internal and external volunteer programmes. 

Who are we looking for? 

  • Previous experience of managing volunteers in an organisation with significant safeguarding needs.
  • Previous experience of providing an infrastructure that aims to satisfy governance standards involving the use of volunteers.
  • A clear understanding of the value volunteers can add and how they should be utilised to maximise impact.
  • Experience as a volunteer.
  • A passion for helping people reach their potential and career aspirations.

Why should you apply?

This is a full-time permanent contract working 5 in 7, 35 hours per week. Your main base will be Anfield Sport and Community Centre. 

This role will require to work evenings, weekend and holiday as and when needed. 

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:

  • Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5%
  • Life Assurance Cover
  • Free financial guidance and mortgage advice
  • Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving
  • Cycle to Work scheme to keep you active
  • Purchase season ticket loans for easier commuting
  • Exclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailers
  • Will Writing Service for future planning
  • Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support
  • Medicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needs
  • Volunteering opportunities to give back to the community
  • Special LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts

…and much more! LFC Benefits.pdf

job.title: Assistant DC, Driver & FLT Operator
job.html_description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an individual to join our Liverpool FC team as a Assistant DC, Driver & FLT Operator. In this role you will be responsible for executing the day-to-day picking, packing, replenishment, and fulfilment of orders.

What will you be doing?

Order Fulfilment

  • Complete daily picking, packing, and preparation of orders in line with SLA and operational standards.
  • Accurately follow pick lists, packing instructions, and quality checks to ensure order correctness.
  • Support outbound flows for B2C, B2B, and retail store fulfilment.

Inbound & Stock Handling

  • Receive goods, perform checks against delivery notes, and process put away accurately.
  • Oversee returns, damaged stock, or quarantined items according to SOPs.
  • Maintain a clean, organised, and safe work area.

Stock Accuracy & Compliance

  • Ensure accurate scanning and recording of stock movements in WMS/ERP systems.
  • Participate in cycle counts or stock reconciliation as required.
  • Report discrepancies, damages, or system errors promptly to Supervisors.

Health & Safety

  • Comply with all H&S policies and procedures, including PPE, manual handling, and safe operation of equipment.
  • Report hazards, near misses, or unsafe practices to Supervisors.
  • Follow site security and operational compliance rules.

Teamwork & Communication

  • Collaborate with colleagues across shifts to achieve daily operational targets.
  • Escalate operational issues, stock discrepancies, or system issues to Supervisors.
  • Support new team members with guidance and sharing of operational knowledge.

Specialist Responsibilities (FLT / CPC Drivers)

  • Operate forklifts (FLT) and/or company vehicles (CPC) safely and in compliance with regulatory and site-specific procedures.
  • Complete daily pre-use checks, maintenance reporting, and safe operation of assigned machinery/vehicles.
  • Support Supervisors and colleagues in moving goods, stock replenishment, or production tasks requiring specialised equipment.
  • Function as a resource for training or mentoring other operatives on safe equipment operation.
  • Follow all relevant H&S procedures and policies in relation to operating a vehicle.

Who are we looking for?

To be successful, you will have a full clean UK Driving License, and a current CPC Driver qualification and ideally a FLT Driver qualification and license.

You’ll be able to demonstrate an excellent knowledge of DC production operations and an excellent understanding and positive approach to customer service and expectations, including experience with LGV vehicle admin management and vehicle safety checks.

Why should you apply?

This is a full-time permanent role working 35 hours per week. Your main base will be our Distribution Centre in Whiston.

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:

  • Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5%
  • Life Assurance Cover
  • Free financial guidance and mortgage advice
  • Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving
  • Cycle to Work scheme to keep you active
  • Purchase season ticket loans for easier commuting
  • Exclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailers
  • Will Writing Service for future planning
  • Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support
  • Medicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needs
  • Volunteering opportunities to give back to the community
  • Special LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts

…and much more! LFC Benefits.pdf

job.title: Casual Experienced Matchday Chefs
job.html_description:
Location: Anfield Stadium, Liverpool

Pay: £16-£18 per hour (depending on experience) + 12.07% holiday pay.

Start: From September 2026

We are looking for experienced Chef de Partie, Sous Chef and Lead Chef level professionals to join our matchday culinary team at Liverpool FC. Opportunities are available for experienced chefs who thrive in fast-paced, high-volume hospitality environments.

This is a casual position, offering variable hours on matchdays, on a flexible assignment basis. It's ideal for experienced chefs looking to pick up additional shifts around existing work or commitments.

Interview Process

We will be reviewing applications as they are received and are looking to hold interviews from the week commencing 14th September 2026. 

What will you be doing?

  • Leading or managing your section to deliver high-quality food service to agreed standards.
  • Preparing and cooking dishes in line with recipes, specifications, and service requirements.
  • Maintaining excellent standards of food quality, consistency, and presentation.
  • Supporting kitchen operations during busy matchday and event service periods.
  • Ensuring full compliance with food safety, allergen, and hygiene standards.
  • Assisting with stock control, wastage reduction, and effective kitchen organisation.
  • Supporting and mentoring junior kitchen team members where required.
  • Contributing to a professional, high-performing kitchen environment.

Who are we looking for?

  • Previous experience as a Chef de Partie, Sous Chef, Lead Chef, or equivalent within a professional kitchen.
  • Experience working in high-volume hospitality, events, stadium, hotel, or restaurant environments.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to perform under pressure during busy service periods.
  • A good working knowledge of food safety and allergen management.
  • Level 2 Food Hygiene Certificate (minimum).

What's on offer?

  • £16-£18 per hour (depending on experience) + 12.07% holiday pay.
  • Weekly pay.
  • Home games only – no away travel required.
  • Casual position offering shifts on a flexible assignment basis.
  • Shifts offered through our app, giving you flexibility to accept or decline work around your schedule.
  • Opportunities available from September 2026.
  • The chance to work behind the scenes at one of the world's most iconic football clubs.

job.title: OL Lyonnes - Juriste (H/F)
job.html_description:
Né en 2004, OL Lyonnes est le club le plus titré de l’UEFA Women’s Champions League avec 8 trophées européens à son actif (dont 5 remportés consécutivement). 

Avec un total de 42 titres, dont 19 de Championnes de France, 11 Coupes de France et 3 Trophées des Championnes et 1 Coupe LFFP, OL Lyonnes possède le plus grand palmarès du championnat féminin français. 

Racheté par Michele Kang en 2023, le club intègre la première organisation multi-clubs de football féminin détenue et dirigée par une femme, aux côtés des clubs Washington Spirit et London City Lionesses.

 

Dans le cadre de la structuration du département administratif et juridique, nous recherchons un(e) Juriste en CDI pour accompagner la Responsable Juridique et Administrative dans ses missions.

 

Son rôle sera d'assurer la gestion courante et le suivi des dossiers juridiques et administratifs. 

 

Vos missions 


Sous la supervision du Responsable Juridique, le/la Juriste aura pour missions :


Support opérationnel et administratif 

  • Préparation et suivi des contrats (rédaction, relecture, mise à jour, archivage) notamment : contrats commerciaux, contrats de prestation de services, contrats d’assurance etc…
  • Gestion des formalités administratives liées aux actes juridiques
  • Suivi des échéances contractuelles et relances à travers la mise en place d’outil de suivi de l’activité
  • Organisation et mise à jour de la base documentaire juridique
  • Veille juridique approfondie (réglementations, jurisprudence en droit social, droit des assurances, propriété intellectuelle, droit du sport)
  • Support administratif de certains dossiers liés à l’environnement sportif (centre de formation, label, licence club …).

    Appui aux missions du Responsable Juridique 
  • Participation à la gestion des contentieux (collecte des pièces, suivi des procédures)
  • Soutien dans les dossiers de conformité et de gouvernance (compliance, process RH, juridique social)
  • Préparation des éléments pour les réunions juridiques internes
  • Interface avec les interlocuteurs internes (RH, académie, finance, opérationnels) pour les demandes juridiques courantes
  • Mise à jour des outils de sécurisation de l’activité (cartographie d’utilisation des données (RGPD), conditions générales de vente (CGV) etc.

 

Votre Profil 


Issu(e) d'un Master 2 (en droit des affaires, droit des contrats, ou équivalent), vous avez une première expérience réussie au sein d'une entreprise ou cabinet (alternance ou poste junior)

vous avez acquis les compétences et savoir être suivants:

Rigueur, sens de l’organisation et discrétion
Bon relationnel et capacité à travailler en équipe
Maîtrise des outils bureautiques (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
Bonne capacité rédactionnelle
Discrétion  
Connaissance en droit des contrats, droit des affaires, droit du sport et droit social 

Par ailleurs, vous avez la capacité d’adaptation dans un environnement juridique multidisciplinaire, 
et maitrisez l’anglais à l'écrit et à l'oral? 

Ce poste est fait pour vous!  

 

 

Convaincu(e) ? N’hésitez plus, postulez !

 

Tous les postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

job.title: ALTERNANCE - Assistant Chef de Projet Marketing
job.html_description:
Envie de rejoindre un Groupe unique et ambitieux ?

 

Grâce à un modèle économique articulé autour du football masculin et ouvert sur l'international, Eagle Football Group, propriétaire de l'Olympique Lyonnais se démarque dans le paysage français du sport professionnel.
Propriétaire de notre Stade, nous avons à cœur de respecter les enjeux socio-économiques tout en étant un acteur responsable et engagé dans la vie locale.

 

Notre dynamisme incarné par notre équipe masculine et notre Academy mixte nous incite à innover sans cesse et à nous adapter aux profonds changements de notre coeur de métier.

 

 

Nous recherchons actuellement notre alternant Assistant chef de Projets Marketing avec pour missions d’accompagner le club à la réalisation de ses objectifs business. L'Assistant chef de projets marketing aura pour missions d'assister la chef de groupe  dans l’élaboration des plans de promotion billetterie/expériences stade et leur exécution :

 

  •  Participer à l’élaboration des contenus des supports et des outils de communication 
  •  Briefs créatifs
  • Rédactionnels (mailings, posts réseaux, argumentaires commerciaux) 
  • Participer au pilotage et à la mise en place des opérations commerciales et plans médias o Veiller à la bonne circulation des informations avec l’ensemble des services (force de ventes, marketing, digital, communication interne…) 
  • Participer au suivi du déroulement des opérations commerciales (reporting, analyse) et à la mise en place d’un calendrier de promotion partagé 
  • Participer à la coordination des shooting photos pour assurer le lancement des nouvelles collections 
  • Participer au développement et à la mise à disposition auprès des boutiques et du ecommerce, des outils pour animer les points de ventes toute au long de la saison 
  • Participer au suivi de l’impact des opérations marketing sur les ventes

 

 Formation et expérience

 

 De formation BAC+4/5 en école de management, commerce ou communication. Dispose idéalement d’une première expérience en marketing opérationnel

 

Compétences et savoir-être

 

  •  Aisance relationnelle
  •  Capacité de synthèse et d’analyse
  •  Autonomie et rigueur
  •  Aptitudes rédactionnelles
  •  Connaissance du monde du foot 

 

 

Tous les postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap

 

Pour vous donner un avant-goût de votre quotidien parmi nous, voici quelques-uns de nos avantages :

  • Une vraie qualité de vie au travail, au cœur de notre politique RH (partenariat avec une salle de sport à proximité des bureaux, nombreux évènements conviviaux organisés tout au long de l’année, une assistance sociale à votre disposition) ;
  • Un parcours d’intégration unique ;
  • La possibilité de s’impliquer dans des actions sociales et solidaires.

 

Convaincu(e) ? N’hésitez plus, postulez !

job.title: OL Lyonnes - STAGE / REDACTION DIGITALE (H/F)
job.html_description:
Né en 2004, OL Lyonnes est le club le plus titré de l’UEFA Women’s Champions League avec 8 trophées eu-ropéens à son actif (dont 5 remportés consécutivement). 

 

Avec un total de 42 titres, dont 19 de Championnes de France, 11 Coupes de France, 3 Trophées des Championnes et 1 Coupe LFFP, OL Lyonnes possède le plus grand palmarès du championnat féminin français. 

 

Racheté par Michele Kang en 2023, le club intègre la première organisation multi-clubs de football féminin détenue et dirigée par une femme, aux côtés des clubs Washington Spirit et London City Lionesses.

 

 

OL Lyonnes recherche son/sa futur(e) Stagiaire en rédaction digitale à pourvoir dès le 1er septembre pour une durée de 6 mois. 

 

Les principales missions rédactionnelles sont les suivantes : 

 

- Production et rédaction d'articles pour le site Internet

- Veille de l’actualité et propositions de sujets

- Uniformisation des articles et contenus

- Mise en place des bonnes pratiques SEO

- Mise à jour et gestion du site Internet

- Actualisation des effectifs, pages fixes

 

Les compétences requises pour ce poste sont : 

 

· Etudiant (e) en journalisme, communication

· Excellentes aptitudes rédactionnelles

· Très bonne connaissance du sport et du football féminin ;

· La maîtrise de l’anglais (oral et écrit) est un plus.

 

Vous êtes motivé(e), autonome et force de proposition. Vous faites preuve de rigueur dans l'exécution de vos missions et savez vous adapter à différentes situations grâce à votre débrouillardise.

 

Doté(e) d'un bon relationnel, vous appréciez le travail en équipe et contribuez activement à une collaboration efficace et constructive. 

 

Des déplacements sont à prévoir. Le poste nécessite une certaine flexibilité horaire, avec une disponibilité ponctuelle en soirée et le week-end en fonction de l'actualité et des événements.

 

 

Convaincu(e) ? N’hésitez plus, postulez !

 

Tous les postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

job.title: Stage - Assistant Chef de Projet Evénementiel (H/F)
job.html_description:
Envie de rejoindre un Groupe unique et ambitieux ?

 

Grâce à un modèle économique articulé autour du football masculin et ouvert sur l'international, Eagle Football Group, propriétaire de l'Olympique Lyonnais se démarque dans le paysage français du sport professionnel.
Propriétaire de notre Stade, nous avons à cœur de respecter les enjeux socio-économiques tout en étant un acteur responsable et engagé dans la vie locale.

 

Notre dynamisme incarné par notre équipe masculine et notre Academy mixte nous incite à innover sans cesse et à nous adapter aux profonds changements de notre coeur de métier.

 

Notre grande famille rouge et bleue recherche son/sa futur(e) stagiaire - Assistant(e) Chef(fe) de Projet Evénementiel à partir de septembre 2026 pour une durée de 6 mois.

 

En quoi cela consiste ?

 

Le stagiaire dans le cadre du fonctionnement du service Séminaires, devra travailler en collaboration avec l’équipe sur les tâches suivantes : 

 

Commercialisation d’événements : 

  • Réception des demandes clients
  • Réalisation des offres commerciales
  • Suivi des offres et relances commerciales 

 

Organisation d’évènements :

  • Organisation en amont de l’évènement avec le client et avec les différents services
  • Présence le jour J sur l'évènement

 

Prospection commerciale :

  • Phoning
  • Participation à des opérations de promotion , et présence sur les réseaux sociaux 
  • Renseignement d'une base CRM

 

Participation à la coordination du service : 

  • Création de plannings
  • Suivi du reporting CA 

 

 

De formation Bac+3/5, vous justifiez d'une première expérience dans le secteur événementiel (stage/alternance). 

Compétences et savoir-être :

 

  • Autonomie
  • Rigueur
  • Relation client
  • Aisance Orale 
  • Force de proposition 
  • Maitrise du pack Office

 

 

Tous les postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

 

Pour vous donner un avant-goût de votre quotidien parmi nous, voici quelques-uns de nos avantages :

  • Une vraie qualité de vie au travail, au cœur de notre politique RH (partenariat avec une salle de sport à proximité des bureaux, nombreux évènements conviviaux organisés tout au long de l’année, une assistance sociale à votre disposition) ;
  • Un parcours d’intégration unique ;
  • La possibilité de s’impliquer dans des actions sociales et solidaires.

 

Convaincu(e) ? N’hésitez plus, postulez !
