job.title: Stage - Assistant commercial merchandising GMS
job.html_description:
Envie de rejoindre un Groupe unique et ambitieux ?

 

Grâce à un modèle économique articulé autour du football masculin et ouvert sur l'international, Eagle Football Group, propriétaire de l'Olympique Lyonnais se démarque dans le paysage français du sport professionnel.
Propriétaire de notre Stade, nous avons à cœur de respecter les enjeux socio-économiques tout en étant un acteur responsable et engagé dans la vie locale.

Notre dynamisme incarné par notre équipe masculine et notre Academy mixte nous incite à innover sans cesse et à nous adapter aux profonds changements de notre coeur de métier.

 

 

Notre grande famille rouge et bleue recherche son/sa futur(e) stagiaire - Assistant(e) Commercial(e) GMS pour une durée de 6 mois à partir de septembre. 


En soutien au Responsable Commercial GMS, l'Assistant(e) Commercial(e) aura notamment pour missions premières de savoir gérer le quotidien administratif, commercial et logistique du service VHC-GMS.
L'Assistant(e) Commercial(e) aura un vrai rôle stratégique au bon fonctionnement du service.
Véritable interface entre les clients et les équipes internes (commerce, logistique, ADV), il/elle assure la fluidité des opérations commerciale au quotidien.

 

MISSIONS PRINCIPALES 


Gestion commerciale

•    Connaître les offres et produits, répondre aux demandes d'informations et réceptionner les commandes 
•    Saisir et envoyer des devis/commandes aux clients
•    Gérer les litiges clients et SAV
•    Créer et mettre à jour le catalogue et les grilles tarifaires
•    Participer à la préparation de rendez-vous commerciaux et, ponctuellement, accompagner le Responsable Commercial en rendez-vous clients 

 

Gestion logistique
•    Suivre les expéditions et livraisons en lien avec le service logistique et les transporteurs
•    Participer à la gestion de la facturation (émission, contrôle et suivi des factures)

 

Gestion administrative
•    Créer les nouveaux comptes clients GMS
•    Mise à jour des fiches clients existantes.
•    Faire évoluer le fichier client 

 


Support opérationnel au développement de l’activité
•    Contribuer à l’amélioration des outils interne de reporting
•    Proposer des analyses pertinentes des ventes réalisées 
•    Participer à l’élaboration d’offres personnalisées BtoB

 


QUALITES REQUISES 

 

Esprit d'équipe
Aisance relationnelle physique et téléphonique.
Bonne élocution ; bonnes qualités rédactionnelles.
Avoir le sens de l'écoute.
Esprit d'analyse et de synthèse. Avoir le sens de l'organisation.
Bonne autonomie
Maîtriser les outils bureautiques et informatiques (Word, Excel, Power Point).

 

 

Tous les postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

 

Pour vous donner un avant-goût de votre quotidien parmi nous, voici quelques-uns de nos avantages :

  • Une vraie qualité de vie au travail, au cœur de notre politique RH (partenariat avec une salle de sport à proximité des bureaux, nombreux évènements conviviaux organisés tout au long de l’année, une assistance sociale à votre disposition) ;
  • Un parcours d’intégration unique ;
  • La possibilité de s’impliquer dans des actions sociales et solidaires.

 

Convaincu(e) ? N’hésitez plus, postulez !

job.title: JURISTE CDD (H/F)
job.html_description:
Envie de rejoindre un Groupe unique et ambitieux ?

Grâce à un modèle économique articulé autour du football masculin et ouvert sur l'international, Eagle Football Group, propriétaire de l'Olympique Lyonnais se démarque dans le paysage français du sport professionnel.

Notre dynamisme incarné par notre équipe masculine et notre Academy mixte nous incite à innover sans cesse et à nous adapter aux profonds changements de notre coeur de métier.

 

Nous recherchons un(e) Juriste (H/F) en CDD de remplacement à pourvoir dès à présent.

 

Vous serez rattaché(e) à la Direction Juridique, sous la responsabilité de la Responsable Juridique.

 

Véritable acteur de la sécurisation juridique des activités du Groupe, vous intervenez sur un périmètre varié couvrant la gestion des assurances, les contrats commerciaux et techniques, ainsi que le suivi des contentieux.

 

Votre objectif sera donc de protéger et d'accompagner le développement du Groupe en assurant le pilotage des contrats d'assurance et des sinistres, la rédaction et la négociation des contrats liés à l'exploitation des infrastructures, ainsi que la gestion des pré-contentieux et de la veille juridique.

 

Dans ce cadre, vos missions seront les suivantes :

 

  1. Assurances
  • Suivi des contrats d’assurance Groupe (RC, multirisques, cyber, construction flotte auto…) ;
  • Lancement et suivi des appels d’offres, revue et négociation des polices ;
  • Souscription de nouveaux contrats selon les besoins opérationnels ;
  • Déclarations et suivi des sinistres en lien avec les services internes et les assureurs.

 

  1. Contrats commerciaux
  • Rédaction, révision et négociation de contrats en particulier : contrats techniques en lien avec la gestion des infrastructures, tels que des contrats de prestations de services, contrats d’exploitation/maintenance, baux, NDA… ;
  • Suivi de l’exécution des contrats en coordination avec les équipes métiers, gestion des relations contractuelles et des renouvellements.

 

  1. Contentieux et veille juridique
  • Préparation des mises en demeure, rédaction de protocoles transactionnels ;
  • Suivi des pré-contentieux et contentieux en lien avec le périmètre d’activités ;
  • Veille juridique et réglementaire en droit des affaires et des assurances.

 

  1. Support transversal
  • Participation aux projets juridiques du Groupe ;
  • Actualisation des ressources documentaires.

Vous justifiez d’un Bac +5 (Droit des Assurances ou Droit des Affaires) et d’une expérience de 5 à 10 ans en entreprise, cabinet ou courtage, avec une forte composante commerciale.

 

Nous recherchons les compétences techniques suivantes :

 

  • Maîtrise du droit des assurances et du droit des contrats ;
  • Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles et de négociation ;
  • Maîtrise des outils bureautiques (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) ;
  • Appétence pour les outils digitaux de gestion contractuelle et IA juridique ;
  • Anglais juridique courant (écrit et oral).

 

Nous apprécierons également vos qualités personnelles telles que votre agilité intellectuelle, votre esprit d’analyse et de synthèse ainsi que votre sens du relationnel et du travail en équipe, permettant de vous adapter à des environnements/métiers divers et d’avoir une véritable orientation business.

job.title: CONTROLEUR DE GESTION (H/F)
job.html_description:
Envie de rejoindre un Groupe unique et ambitieux ?

 

Grâce à un modèle économique articulé autour du football masculin et ouvert sur l'international, Eagle Football Group, propriétaire de l'Olympique Lyonnais se démarque dans le paysage français du sport professionnel.
Propriétaire de notre Stade, nous avons à cœur de respecter les enjeux socio-économiques tout en étant un acteur responsable et engagé dans la vie locale.

 

Notre dynamisme incarné par notre équipe masculine et notre Academy mixte nous incite à innover sans cesse et à nous adapter aux profonds changements de notre coeur de métier.

 

Nous recherchons un(e) Contrôleur de Gestion (H/F) en CDI à pourvoir dès à présent.

 

Véritable acteur du pilotage financier du Groupe, votre objectif sera de contribuer à la performance financière du Groupe en assurant le pilotage financier de l'entité OL Féminin, le contrôle de gestion des activités du Groupe, ainsi que la structuration des données, des outils et des processus du département Contrôle de Gestion.

 

Dans ce cadre, vos missions seront les suivantes :

 

  1. Pilotage financier de l'entité OL Féminin (prestation de services dédiée)
  • Production et analyse des comptes de l'entité (P&L, bilan, masse salariale, trésorerie), en lien étroit avec la Direction Comptable ;
  • Elaboration du budget de l'entité et des reportings budgétaires règlementaires (DNCG) selon le calendrier applicable ;
  • Production du reporting à destination du management de l'entité et de l'actionnaire, en français et en anglais ;
  • Interlocuteur privilégié des équipes opérationnelles et financières de l'entité dans le cadre du contrat de prestation, avec un suivi rigoureux du périmètre et des délais.

 

 

  1. Contrôle de gestion des activités du Groupe
  • Contrôle budgétaire périodique des activités confiées et des directions du Groupe, et analyse des écarts (réel vs budget et n-1) ;
  • Elaboration des comptes de résultat par activité et des analyses de marge à destination du Management ;
  • Contribution aux cycles budgétaires du Groupe et aux analyses mensuelles de comptes consolidés et statutaires ;
  • Participation aux clôtures mensuelles en collaboration étroite avec la Direction Comptable (provisions, rapprochements, contrôles de cohérence) ;
  • Participation à la production des liasses règlementaires DNCG du club professionnel sur les sections confiées : liasses budgétaires (mai et octobre) et liasses réelles semestrielle et annuelle, en complément du reporting DNCG mensuel de l'entité OL Féminin.

 

 

  1. Données, analytique et amélioration des outils et processus
  • Structuration et exploitation des données de gestion : requêtage, fiabilisation des bases, automatisation des travaux récurrents ;
  • Maintien et développement des reportings existants ; participation active au projet data du Groupe, en lien avec les équipes IT et métiers ;
  • Identification et déploiement d'usages d'intelligence artificielle appliqués au contrôle de gestion : automatisation des contrôles, détection d'anomalies, accélération des analyses d'écarts et de la production des reportings ;
  • Pilotage de projets d'amélioration des processus et de développement de nouveaux outils de contrôle de gestion.

 

PROFIL :

 

De formation supérieure Bac +5 (Ecole de Commerce, Université, Master, etc.) avec une spécialisation en Finance d'Entreprise, Contrôle de Gestion, Comptabilité ou Audit, vous justifiez d'une expérience de 2 à 5 ans au sein d'un cabinet d'audit ou de conseil, ou d'une première expérience en contrôle de gestion, idéalement acquise dans un environnement multi-entités.

 

Nous recherchons les compétences techniques suivantes :

  • Très bonne maîtrise de la comptabilité générale et analytique ;
  • Maîtrise des règles comptables françaises ; la connaissance des normes IFRS est un plus,;
  • Très bonne maîtrise des outils bureautiques de modélisation financière, notamment d'Excel ;
  • Solide culture analytique et appétence marquée pour les usages de l'intelligence artificielle appliqués à la finance et au contrôle de gestion ;
  • La pratique courante de l'anglais dans un cadre professionnel est un atout.

 

Nous apprécierons également vos qualités personnelles telles que votre rigueur, votre méthode et votre sens de l'organisation, ainsi que votre esprit critique, votre curiosité et votre sens relationnel développé, permettant de vous adapter à des environnements/métiers divers.

 

Tous les postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

 

Pour vous donner un avant-goût de votre quotidien parmi nous, voici quelques-uns de nos avantages :

  • Une vraie qualité de vie au travail, au cœur de notre politique RH (partenariat avec une salle de sport à proximité des bureaux, nombreux évènements conviviaux organisés tout au long de l’année, une assistance sociale à votre disposition) ;
  • Un parcours d’intégration unique ;
  • La possibilité de s’impliquer dans des actions sociales et solidaires.

 

Convaincu(e) ? N’hésitez plus, postulez !

job.title: OL LYONNES - Responsable billetterie (H-F)
job.html_description:
Né en 2004, OL Lyonnes est le club le plus titré de l’UEFA Women’s Champions League avec 8 trophées européens à son actif (dont 5 remportés consécutivement).


Avec un total de 42 titres, dont 19 Championnats de France, 8 Ligues des Champions, 11 Coupes de France, 3 Trophées des Championnes et 1 Coupe LFFP, OL Lyonnes possède le plus grand palmarès du football féminin français.
Racheté par Michele Kang en 2023, le club s’inscrit dans une dynamique internationale ambitieuse en intégrant la première organisation multi-clubs de football féminin détenue et dirigée par une femme, aux côtés de Washington Spirit et London City Lionesses.

 

Dans un contexte de forte croissance (billetterie, sponsoring, hospitalités, merchandising) et avec l’organisation de tous ses matchs au Groupama Stadium, OL Lyonnes recehrche un(e) Responsable Billetterie pour structurer, piloter et accélérer la performance billetterie du club.

Ce poste combine vision stratégique, pilotage commercial, analyse de données et management, avec une forte orientation data-driven.

Le Responsable Billetterie pilote la performance commerciale et analytique de la billetterie afin de soutenir la croissance du club, l’occupation du Groupama Stadium et l’expérience fan.

 

MISSIONS PRINCIPALES :

 

1.    Stratégie & revenus billetterie


-    Définir et piloter la stratégie de commercialisation des matchs, abonnements et offres packagées
-    Construire les politiques de pricing, yield management et fidélisation
-    Développer des actions d’acquisition et de remplissage en lien avec le marketing, le CRM et le digital
-    Maximiser le taux de remplissage, le revenu moyen par spectateur et les revenus billetterie

 

2.    Data & Revenue Analytics


-    Piloter la performance billetterie à travers des KPI clés : remplissage, revenu moyen, conversion, réachat, no-show, segmentation, performance des campagnes
-    Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le/la Data Analyst pour automatiser les dashboards et fiabiliser les données de pilotage.
-    Exploiter les données CRM, ticketing et marketing afin d’identifier des opportunités de croissance et d’optimisation
-    Formuler des recommandations business basées sur les données (pricing, ciblage, timing des campagnes, allocation des stocks, segmentation des audiences).

 

3.    Management & coordination


-    Manager la Coordinatrice Billetterie
-    Structurer les processus et faire monter en compétence la fonction billetterie.
-    Superviser le paramétrage, les mises en vente et la qualité de l’expérience d’achat.
-    Coordonner les sujets billetterie avec les équipes marketing, CRM, data, service client, hospitalités, opérations stade et finance.

 

4.    Matchday


-    Superviser le dispositif billetterie les jours de match 

 

PROFIL SOUHAITE : 


Vous justifiez d'au moins 5 d’expérience dans un poste similaire, au sein d’un club professionnel, d’un opérateur de salle de spectacles, d’un parc de loisirs ou d’un environnement comparable. Vous maîtrisez les enjeux liés à la billetterie du pricing, de l’analyse de données et du pilotage commercial.


Doté(e) d’un excellent sens de l’analyse, vous êtes capable d’interpréter les données de vente, de suivre les tendances du marché et de formuler des recommandations concrètes.

Votre aisance avec les outils de reporting et de visualisation de données (Power BI, Tableau ou équivalent) vous permettront de transformer la donnée en décisions commerciales concrètes et mesurables.

 Vous êtes rigoureux(se), organisé(e), et démontrez une forte capacité à travailler en équipe que ce soit dans le management ou en transverse.


Engagé(e), autonome et orienté(e) résultats, vous souhaitez contribuer activement à faire du Groupama Stadium une référence de fréquentation du football féminin.

 

Convaincu(e) ? N’hésitez plus, postulez !

 

Tous les postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

- Piloter la performance billetterie à travers des KPI clés : remplissage, revenu moyen, conversion, réachat, no-show, segmentation, performance des campagnes - Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le/la Data Analyst pour automatiser les dashboards et fiabiliser les données de pilotage. - Exploiter les données CRM, ticketing et marketing afin d’identifier des opportunités de croissance et d’optimisation - Formuler des recommandations business basées sur les données (pricing, ciblage, timing des campagnes, allocation des stocks, segmentation des audiences).
3. Management & coordination
- Manager la Coordinatrice Billetterie - Structurer les processus et faire monter en compétence la fonction billetterie. - Superviser le paramétrage, les mises en vente et la qualité de l’expérience d’achat. - Coordonner les sujets billetterie avec les équipes marketing, CRM, data, service client, hospitalités, opérations stade et finance.
4. Matchday
- Superviser le dispositif billetterie les jours de match
PROFIL SOUHAITE :
Vous justifiez d'au moins 5 d’expérience dans un poste similaire, au sein d’un club professionnel, d’un opérateur de salle de spectacles, d’un parc de loisirs ou d’un environnement comparable. Vous maîtrisez les enjeux liés à la billetterie du pricing, de l’analyse de données et du pilotage commercial.
Doté(e) d’un excellent sens de l’analyse, vous êtes capable d’interpréter les données de vente, de suivre les tendances du marché et de formuler des recommandations concrètes.
Votre aisance avec les outils de reporting et de visualisation de données (Power BI, Tableau ou équivalent) vous permettront de transformer la donnée en décisions commerciales concrètes et mesurables.
Vous êtes rigoureux(se), organisé(e), et démontrez une forte capacité à travailler en équipe que ce soit dans le management ou en transverse.
Engagé(e), autonome et orienté(e) résultats, vous souhaitez contribuer activement à faire du Groupama Stadium une référence de fréquentation du football féminin.
Convaincu(e) ? N’hésitez plus, postulez !
Tous les postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

job.title: Alternance - Cadreur/Monteur (H/F)
job.html_description:
Envie de rejoindre un Groupe unique et ambitieux ?

 

Grâce à un modèle économique articulé autour du football masculin et ouvert sur l'international, Eagle Football Group, propriétaire de l'Olympique Lyonnais se démarque dans le paysage français du sport professionnel.
Propriétaire de notre Stade, nous avons à cœur de respecter les enjeux socio-économiques tout en étant un acteur responsable et engagé dans la vie locale.

 

Notre dynamisme incarné par notre équipe masculine et notre Academy mixte nous incite à innover sans cesse et à nous adapter aux profonds changements de notre coeur de métier.

 

Société reconnue dans le domaine sportif et événementiel, l’Olympique Lyonnais recherche actuellement son Alternant(e) CADREUR-MONTEUR (H/F).

MISSIONS PRINCIPALES

 

Dans le cadre de son alternance, l’alternant(e) vidéaste participera à la création de contenus audiovisuels pour répondre aux besoins du club, tout en développant ses compétences techniques et créatives. En collaboration avec l’équipe audiovisuelle, il/elle sera amené(e) à :

 

  • Contribuer à la réalisation de productions audiovisuelles en s’appuyant sur les techniques et outils de prise d’image, de son, de montage vidéo et de postproduction, sous la supervision des professionnels de l’équipe.
  • Participer à la production de contenus pour les différents supports du club (magazines, documentaires pour OLPLAY et YouTube, programmes courts pour les réseaux sociaux, publicités, films partenaires…), en veillant à l’adaptabilité des formats selon les plateformes de diffusion.
  • Assister le suivi technique des projets vidéos afin d’en garantir la qualité technique et artistique, et, le cas échéant, participer aux ajustements nécessaires avant diffusion ou publication.
  • Être force de proposition pour de nouveaux concepts de contenus, en apportant des idées créatives dans le cadre de brainstormings ou de projets en développement.
  • Participer à l’analyse de la qualité des rendus, au respect des processus de production et à l’optimisation des ressources internes (matériel, logiciels, ressources numériques), en appui de l’équipe en place.

 

PROFIL REQUIS

 

Compétences techniques :

 

  • Bonne compréhension du processus de captation d’images et de toute la chaîne de production.
  • Maîtrise des principaux outils ADOBE (Première Pro, Media Encoder, After Effect, Photoshop, Illustrator...) 

 

Compétences et savoir-être :
 

  • Un sens artistique développé
  • Des compétences techniques audiovisuelles
  • Une bonne culture cinématographique
  • Flexibilité
  • Sens de l’organisation et de l’autonomie.
  • Veille permanente des tendances et des innovations en termes de réalisation

 

Tous les postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

 

Pour vous donner un avant-goût de votre quotidien parmi nous, voici quelques-uns de nos avantages :

  • Une vraie qualité de vie au travail, au cœur de notre politique RH (partenariat avec une salle de sport à proximité des bureaux, nombreux évènements conviviaux organisés tout au long de l’année, une assistance sociale à votre disposition) ;
  • Un parcours d’intégration unique ;
  • La possibilité de s’impliquer dans des actions sociales et solidaires.

 

Convaincu(e) ? N’hésitez plus, postulez !

job.title: Stage - Assistant(e) E-shop
job.html_description:
Rejoins l'aventure avec l'Olympique de Marseille et deviens notre Assistant(e) E-shop !

Votre feuille de Match :

Dans le cadre d’un stage de 6 mois, vous intégrerez l’équipe E-shop de l’Olympique de Marseille, acteur majeur du sport français. Votre mission principale consistera à soutenir la gestion et l’optimisation de notre boutique en ligne, tout en contribuant à son développement commercial.

Vos missions seront les suivantes :

  • Assister l’équipe dans la gestion opérationnelle de l’e-shop (mise à jour des fiches produits, gestion des stocks, suivi des commandes, etc.) ;

  • Participer à l’analyse des performances commerciales (taux de conversion, panier moyen, etc.) et proposer des axes d’amélioration ;

  • Contribuer à la stratégie de category management en identifiant les tendances du marché et en optimisant la présentation des produits ;

  • Participer à la mise en place de campagnes marketing (emailing, promotions, partenariats) pour booster les ventes ;

  • Collaborer avec les équipes marketing, communication et logistique pour assurer la cohérence des messages et des actions ;

  • Assurer une veille concurrentielle et sectorielle pour anticiper les évolutions du marché e-commerce ;

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration de l’expérience utilisateur (UX) et de l’ergonomie du site.

  • Création du planning newsletter & brief newsletters.

  • Initier & participer à la création du plan d'animations.

  • Brief créa des visuels eshop en fonction du plan d'animation.

  • Organisation du shooting photo.

Enjeux :

Ce stage est une opportunité unique pour découvrir les coulisses d’un club emblématique et contribuer à son rayonnement digital. Vous développerez des compétences clés en gestion de projet, en marketing digital et en analyse de données, tout en évoluant dans un environnement dynamique et passionnant.

Vous serez amené(e) à travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes commerciales, marketing et logistique, ce qui vous permettra de comprendre les enjeux globaux d’une boutique en ligne performante.

Ton palmarès :

  • Étudiant(e) en formation supérieure (Bac+4 minimum) en e-commerce, marketing digital, commerce, gestion ou dans un domaine connexe.

  • Une première expérience en gestion de boutique en ligne, en marketing digital ou en gestion de projet est un plus.

  • Excellente maîtrise des outils bureautiques (Excel, PowerPoint)

  • Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale, en français et en anglais.

  • Esprit analytique et curiosité pour les tendances du e-commerce et du marketing digital.

  • Rigueur, organisation, autonomie et sens du travail en équipe sont des qualités essentielles.

  • Intérêt marqué pour le sport et, plus particulièrement, pour l’Olympique de Marseille est un atout non négligeable.

Autres informations :

  • Début du stage prévu ASAP.

job.title: Assistant(e) Commercial(e) Partenariat
job.html_description:
Rejoins l’aventure avec l'Olympique de Marseille et deviens notre Assistant(e) Commercial(e) Partenariat!

Votre feuille de Match :

Dans le cadre d’un stage de 6 mois, vous rejoignez la direction des Partenariats de l’Olympique de Marseille et entrerez en jeu au poste d'Assistant(e) Commercial(e) Partenariat.

Vos missions seront les suivantes :

  • Assister l'équipe commerciale dans la gestion des partenariats existants et le développement de nouveaux partenariats.

  • Participer à la prospection et à la négociation avec les partenaires potentiels.

  • Rédiger des propositions commerciales et des contrats de partenariat.

  • Assurer le suivi administratif dans l'outils CRM et administration de ventes et financier des partenariats.

  • Participer à l'organisation d'événements et d'activités promotionnelles avec les partenaires.

  • Analyser les performances des partenariats et proposer des améliorations.

  • Collaborer avec les différents services du club (marketing, communication, etc.) pour assurer la cohérence des actions menées.

  • Assurer une veille concurrentielle et sectorielle.

Enjeux :

Ce stage offre une opportunité unique de découvrir l'univers du sport professionnel et de développer des compétences en gestion de partenariats, en négociation et en gestion de projets.

Ton palmarès :

  • Etudiant(e) en cursus commercial ou dans un domaine connexe.

  • Niveau Bac+4 minimum

  • Tu as une première expérience en commercial, idéalement dans le domaine sportif.

  • Tu es organisé(e), rigoureux(se), et doté(e) d'un excellent sens du relationnel. Tu fais preuve de réactivité, de polyvalence et d'un bon esprit d'équipe.

  • Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et oral, en français et en anglais.

  • Tu as une bonne maîtrise des outils bureautiques (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) et des logiciels CRM (Dynamics)

Autres informations :

  • Stage de 6 mois à pourvoir dès que possible 

  • Disponibilité les week-end et en soirée

job.title: Academy- Lead Athletic Development Coach
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
NO PHONE CALLS OR EMAILS, PLEASE.  Thanks for your interest! Due to the volume of applications, we’re unable to respond to individual status inquiries. If selected to move forward, you’ll hear from our HR team at Nashville Soccer Club.

POSITION OVERVIEW
The Athletic Development Coach will lead the Long-Term Athletic Development (LTAD) program for the Nashville SC Academy in alignment with the High Performance philosophy. This role works closely with High Performance staff across NSC and HCFC to design and implement team and individual programs, both in the gym and on the field, to optimize youth athlete development.
The ideal candidate has coaching or strength & conditioning experience, formal education in exercise physiology or a related field, and expertise in load management for youth soccer.
This position reports to the Director of High Performance and the Head of Athletic Development for the First Team, and collaborates with the Academy Director, Athletic Trainers, and performance staff to support a collaborative, high-performance environment.
This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the development of elite youth soccer players!
 
RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Lead and oversee on-field warm-ups, cool-downs, strength training, and prehabilitation sessions, as well as individualized training for targeted or rehabilitating players in collaboration with medical staff.
  • Design and implement individual and team off-season training programs.
  • Foster strong relationships with players and staff to effectively deliver performance programs.
  • Develop educational materials to promote best practices in athletic development and sport performance, aligning with the High Performance department’s initiatives.
  • Organize and maintain field and gym equipment.
  • Travel with the team to games and events as needed.
  • Stay current with the latest research and best practices for future program implementation.
  • Contribute to and enhance LTAD programming, including data collection, testing, analytics, and reporting to optimize youth player performance.
  • Manage player performance data, including distributing devices, processing and inputting data, wellness monitoring, testing administration, RPE collection, analysis, and reporting.
  • Utilize performance monitoring tools and technologies to track player performance and support injury prevention strategies.
MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
  • Undergraduate (Bachelor’s) Degree from a 4-year accredited University in related field of study such as Kinesiology, Exercise Science, Sport Science, Biomechanics, Strength & Conditioning, and/or similar
  • NSCA-CSCS (Certified Strength & Conditioning Specialist)
  • CPR Certification

PREFERRED

  • Graduate (Master’s) Degree from an accredited University in related field of study
  • 2-3 years experience working with youth soccer within the United States
  • NSCA-CPSS (Certified Performance and Sport Scientist)
  • Functional Movement Screening (FMS) and Selective Functional Movement Assessment (SFMA) Level 1
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish
 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Team Operations - Performance Scientist
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
NO PHONE CALLS OR EMAILS, PLEASE.  Thanks for your interest! Due to the volume of applications, we’re unable to respond to individual status inquiries. If selected to move forward, you’ll hear from our HR team at Nashville Soccer Club.

Position Title: Performance Scientist

Department: Team Operations- High Performance

Reports to: Director of High Performance

 

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Performance Scientist supports player availability and performance by leading sport science data operations, monitoring, reporting, and applied insights that inform training, recovery, and return-to-performance decisions. This role reports directly to the Director of High Performance and works in close collaboration to define the path forward for key initiatives. The Performance Scientist will be provided autonomy to determine the best execution plan, while ensuring alignment with coaching, performance, and medical priorities.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own end-to-end sports science data operations (collection, QA/QC, documentation, and governance) across performance data streams.
  • Lead training and match monitoring systems (e.g., STS) and related technologies (GPS, heart rate, VALD, 1080 and others), ensuring reliable workflows and clean outputs.
  • Build and maintain dashboards, models, metrics, and reports that track workload, readiness, and physical performance across the season.
  • Deliver clear, actionable insights to coaches, performance/medical staff, and players (including real-time training feedback when needed).
  • Plan and execute performance testing and assessment protocols (field and gym-based); maintain benchmarks and individualized targets.
  • Collaborate with Athletic Development and Medical on activation, strength/regeneration, and end-stage return-to-performance support as needed.
  • Partner with analytics and scouting on performance questions tied to player evaluation, transactions, and projections.
  • Lead integration of second team and academy performance data into centralized systems, standards, and reporting.
  • Ensure compliance with all MLS medical manual requirements and club policies and procedures.

KEY DELIVERABLES

  • Readiness/availability updates aligned with training plans and performance/medical direction.
  • Stakeholder dashboards and reports with clear KPI definitions and refresh cadence.
  • Testing battery execution and reporting with benchmarks, targets, and action steps.
  • Multi-squad integration outputs (first team/second team/academy) using shared standards and longitudinal tracking.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s degree in Exercise Science or related field.
  • Certified Performance and Sport Scientist (CPSS).
  • Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist (CSCS).
  • Minimum 2 years experience in an elite sport environment.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with GPS systems, heart rate, force plates, and current performance technologies.
  • Experience in a coach-facing role explaining monitoring outputs and real-time GPS results.
  • Proficiency in R, Python, and Power BI for data analysis and reporting.
  • Current CPR/AED certification (or ability to obtain promptly).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience querying cloud databases and supporting automated/real-time reporting (e.g., SQL, ETL, APIs).
  • Comfortable conversing in Spanish.
  • Experience scaling sport science systems across multiple squads (first team + second team + academy).
  • Strong data QA habits and reproducible workflows (e.g., documentation, version control).

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Ticketing - Box Office Representative PT
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
POSITION OVERVIEW
The Ticket Office Representative is a part-time, event-day position responsible for providing exceptional customer service and assisting fans with ticket purchases and inquiries at GEODIS Park. This role plays an important part in delivering a seamless matchday experience by supporting ticket sales, processing transactions, and resolving ticket-related questions. Applicants must reside in the Nashville area.

RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Process ticket sales through Ticketmaster and assist guests with ticket purchases and ticketing issues.
  • Provide clear, friendly, and professional customer service throughout all interactions.
  • Address general inquiries related to seating options, pricing, stadium policies, and event information.
  • Accurately complete credit card and cash transactions in accordance with Club procedures.
  • Reconcile and balance cash drawers at the end of each shift.
  • Support Box Office leadership with additional duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS
  • Prior customer service or ticketing experience preferred, but not required.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to remain professional in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to learn and navigate ticketing software quickly (experience with Ticketmaster is a plus).
  • Reliable, punctual, and able to work Nashville SC home matches, special events, nights, weekends, and holidays as needed.
  • Must be detail-oriented and comfortable handling cash and sensitive customer information.
  • Candidates without a degree are encouraged to apply.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Backup Mascot
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
Nashville SC is looking for highly motivated individuals interested in being a part of the Major League Soccer team in Nashville. The ideal candidates will demonstrate initiative, the ability to multi-task, a willingness to learn and a positive attitude. Please note: This is a part-time, as needed Backup position.

Employment Type: Part-Time

 

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

· Study and learn Tempo the Coyote's mannerisms and characteristics

· Assist Tempo the Coyote at home matches

· Provide support at select appearances, including birthday parties, parades, school visits, hospital visits, charitable events, and other events coordinated by Tempo the Coyote

· Assist in maintaining the condition of costumes and props

· Other duties as assigned by Tempo the Coyote

· Please note this is a part-time, as needed Backup position.

 

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

· Knowledge and interest in sports.

· Knowledge and interest in mascots.

· Computer proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

· Proficient in social media.

· Strong communication skills and telephone etiquette.

· Mascot Experience (College or Professional)

 

REQUIREMENTS:

· Available as needed for Tempo the Coyote appearances.

· Available to assist with home matches.

· The understanding that working in sports is different than being a fan. This position does not guarantee candidates will be able to watch games. Many valuable positions within the organization are behind the scenes, and they provide little ability to watch the games.

· Tempo the Coyote Height Range: 5'7 - 5'10.

 

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Youth Soccer Coach - Part Time
job.html_description:
Position Summary
Nashville Soccer Club is seeking energetic, reliable, and knowledgeable coaches to support the delivery of its Youth Soccer Programs. This role focuses on camps, clinics, grassroots programming, Academy pathway programs and coach education initiatives across the Nashville community. The role is centered on player development programming within the Youth Soccer Department. Coaches will represent Nashville SC while delivering high-quality soccer experiences that are fun, inclusive, and developmentally appropriate. This position is part-time, with flexible scheduling based on program needs, including evenings, weekends, and seasonal peak periods. Strong performers may be considered for expanded responsibilities or future full-time opportunities within the club. This is not an academy coaching position.

Duties & Responsibilities
  • Deliver engaging and age-appropriate coaching sessions at camps, clinics, and grassroots programs.
  • Implement Nashville SC Youth Soccer curriculum and session plans across all youth programming.
  • Create a positive, safe, and inclusive environment for all participants.
  • Support event operations including setup, check-in, and breakdown of sessions.
  • Serve as a club ambassador, maintaining professionalism with players, parents, and partners.
  • Assist with coaching education sessions and mentorship initiatives when required.
  • Provide feedback on player development and program delivery when requested.
  • Ensure all safety, risk management, and safeguarding standards are followed.
Qualifications
  • Previous coaching experience in youth soccer (recreational, grassroots, or club level required).
  • Passion for working with children and developing players of all ability levels.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work flexible hours including evenings and weekends.
  • Reliable transportation to program locations across the Greater Nashville area.
  • US Soccer Grassroots (or equivalent) License or higher (or willingness to obtain).
  • Experience working in a youth development environment (Rec, Club, Academy or camps).
  • Background in player development models.
  • Ability to be active for extended periods (standing, running, demonstrating drills)
  • Ability to lift and carry equipment up to 30 lbs

job.title: Soccer Squad (Part-Time)
job.html_description:
Position Summary:
Nashville SC Soccer Squad will serve as community ambassadors for the Club at key community-based events and programs throughout Nashville. This group will be integral to executing community outreach through soccer programming. The Soccer Squad will also serve as an extension of the Community Engagement department by assisting with our core youth soccer programs including Grassroots Soccer, IMPACT Soccer, MNPS P.L.A.Y.S., and more.
Essential Duties & Responsibilities:
  • Facilitate soccer-specific activations at community engagement events while providing superb customer service and displaying excitement about the organization.
  • Act as an extension of the club’s community engagement department by providing information on various soccer programs.
  • Assist with program set-up and breakdown. 
  • Collect and report valuable feedback and insights after each event to provide back to the team supervisors.
Shift Information:
  • Must be able to work flexible hours including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
  • Some shifts will require picking up materials to transport to the event site, plus setting up and taking down materials.
Qualifications:
  • A general interest and working knowledge of the sport of soccer. 
  • Should be able to answer basic questions about the game, NSC’s schedule and roster, etc.
  • Experience playing the game and coaching youth is preferred but not required.
  • Strong people and communication skills. 
  • Comfortable promoting and interacting with new people at NSC events with a fun and positive attitude.
  • Collaborative personality who works well with others on their team. 
  • Enjoys engaging with team members and is responsive to messages.
  • Must have transportation, a good driving record, and valid driver’s license.
  • Reliable and punctual, being on-time is important to you.
  • Bilingual (English & Spanish) is helpful but not required.
  • Must be able to move and lift a minimum of 50 pounds.
  • Background check is required.

job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
NO PHONE CALLS OR EMAILS, PLEASE.  Thanks for your interest! Due to the volume of applications, we’re unable to respond to individual status inquiries. If selected to move forward, you’ll hear from our HR team at Nashville Soccer Club.

POSITION OVERVIEW:
The Academy Part-Time Goalkeeper Coach will be responsible for the U14 and U15 academy goalkeepers. The goalkeeper coach will be tasked with constructing and executing individualized goalkeeper sessions as well as assisting head coaches on the field where necessary. This person will work closely with the Academy Goalkeeper coach, as well as academy staff and must adhere to all club and league requirements. The ideal candidate must have previous experience in the role of goalkeeper both as a player and coach.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Be able to work roughly 20 hours per week, mainly afternoon sessions with our younger age groups- U14 and U15 boys.
• Construct and execute individualized goalkeeper sessions geared towards our style of play and model
• Assist with Head coach needs during a training session
• Actively participate in player individualized meetings and communicate with academy goalkeepers
• Availability to attend home matches on the weekend on a need basis
• Complete Club and League registration requirements including background checks, SafeSport, Heads up.
QUALIFICATIONS:
• Playing and coaching experience in the Goalkeeper position
• Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Strong ability to communicate and work under pressure.
• Passion for youth soccer and knowledge of MLS
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferred.
• Ability to speak Spanish is a plus.

job.title: Academy- Assistant Performance Coach PT
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
NO PHONE CALLS OR EMAILS, PLEASE.  Thanks for your interest! Due to the volume of applications, we’re unable to respond to individual status inquiries. If selected to move forward, you’ll hear from our HR team at Nashville Soccer Club.

POSITION OVERVIEW
The part-time Assistant Performance Coach for the Nashville SC Academy will be responsible for supporting and assisting the club by providing an integrated High-Performance LTAD program for it’s Academy players, in line with the Club and Performance department philosophy. This position will work closely with the Academy Director, Academy Performance Coach, and Academy Medical Department to create team and player-specific programs and administer those programs on the field and in the gym for developing youth athletes within the Academy. The person in this role should have prior playing and/or coaching experience and be expected to comfortably facilitate soccer-centric programs.  In addition, they should also have a formal educational background in exercise physiology (or similar degree) and load management across a variety of metrics as it relates to the development of youth soccer athletes.  This role will report directly to the Head of Performance for the First Team and will work closely with the Academy Director, Academy Performance Coach and Academy Athletic Trainer, as well as various other key coaches/staff.

RESPONSIBILITIES
  • This position will direct and/or assist in the following areas:
  • Assisting, managing and directing on-field warm up and cool down sessions, strength training, prehabilitation, as well as individual sessions for targeted or rehabilitating players in conjunction with medical staff
  • Distribution of player devices and processing data into club systems on a daily basis, along with wellness monitoring, testing administration, RPE collection, compiling, analysis, and reporting
  • Utilizing various monitoring software, tools and technologies to report on player performance and injury prevention
  • Direct and/or assist with the delivery of scientifically based optimal recovery strategies post trining and post-match
  • Help develop and implement individual and/or team off-season programs
  • Help develop strong interpersonal relationships with players and staff to effectively administer programs
  • Help producing educational materials for players to guide towards best practices in the development and optimization of sport performance
  • Organizing and maintaining field and gym equipment
  • Surveying literature and best practices for future implementation
  • Contribute to and advance LTAD programming and curriculum, data collection, testing, analytics, and reporting to develop high-performance in youth players
  • Occasional travel with team to games/events

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
  • Undergraduate (Bachelor’s) Degree from a 4-year accredited University in related field of study such as Kinesiology, Exercise Science, Sport Science, Biomechanics, Strength & Conditioning, and/or similar
  • NSCA-CSCS (Certified Strength & Conditioning Specialist)
  • CPR Certification
PREFERRED
  • Graduate (Master’s) Degree from an accredited University in related field of study
  • 2-3 years experience working with youth soccer within the United States
  • XPS-EXOS Performance Specialist
  • Functional Movement Screening (FMS) – Certified Level 1/2
  • Bilingual in Spanish and English
HOURS
  • 15-20 hours per week
  • Nights and weekend availability
 

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Safety & Security - Venue Security Officer PT
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
NO PHONE CALLS OR EMAILS, PLEASE.  Thanks for your interest! Due to the volume of applications, we’re unable to respond to individual status inquiries. If selected to move forward, you’ll hear from our HR team at Nashville Soccer Club.

POSITION OVERVIEW:
The Venue Security Officer will provide prevention activities and contribute to the building safety and security by monitoring and reporting physical security and safety conditions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Assist with controlling access to the Stadium including registering and directing visitors.  Visually inspect the ID card of each person entering the building and verify that the individual and the cardholder are the same.
  • Help with writing reports on all accidents or potential problems that shall occur, as well as notifying the Security management team.
  • Issue temporary access badges to authorized personnel as required by procedures.
  • Escort visitors and other personnel as required by procedures.
  • Inspect packages and other designated items as required (including assignment as a searcher).
  • Conduct foot patrol and Stadium security checks.
  • Visually inspect and monitor designated post area(s).
  • Assist with monitoring performance of security/safety equipment.
  • Investigate and report any unusual or unauthorized activity within the area.
  • Verify credentials to control access in restricted areas.
  • Assist with inspecting bags and purses at all entry points for prohibited items, as well as operate a walk-through metal detector (WTMD) or Evolv machine. 
  • Be observant for fires and suspicious packages.
  • Be observant for spills and alert to odors and unusual sounds.
  • Check and report condition of area, exit, and emergency lighting.
  • Check external access to vital areas of the facility.
  • Monitor access through designated doors as required.
  • In the event of alarm conditions, assist in the safe and orderly evacuation of facility personnel if warranted.
  • Respond to local audible alarms on HVAC and electrical equipment.  Report and silence alarms as instructed by procedures and Facility Operations personnel during after-hours operations.
  • Identify and turn-off electrical appliances such as space heaters, fans, coffee pots, etc., that might be left on after normal work hours and could pose a source of heat and ignition for fire.
  • Be observant for trespassers and unauthorized persons.
  • Inspect designated areas for unauthorized activity.
  • Operate and monitor CCTV and access control systems where required.
  • Operate computer-based security/safety-related software and applications as required.
  • Assist with controlling access to the Stadium utilizing access control system.
  • Complete required testing of security and fire systems-related equipment as required by security procedures.
  • Operate and monitor alarm systems where required.
  • Initiate appropriate response as required for various alarms.
  • Initiate and maintain 24/7 communication with the Security management team. 
  • Dispatch other Security Force personnel and/or check alarms as required.
  • Additional duties as assigned. 
 
QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Minimum of a high school education or have passed a General Educational Development (GED) equivalency test.
  • Ability to be trained to operate a golf cart, magnetometer wand, and walk-through metal detector and Evolv machine.
  • Able to obtain a State of Tennessee Security Guard License.  
  • Previous security, law enforcement and/or military experience strongly preferred.
  • Effective verbal and written communications skills.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment and remain calm during times of stress.
  • Ability to lift, pull, push and/or carry 25-60 lbs. as necessary.
  • Ability to work in outdoor weather conditions to include extreme heat, cold and rain.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including but not limited to days, nights, weekends and holidays.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Event Operations - Event Operations Associate PT
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
NO PHONE CALLS OR EMAILS, PLEASE.  Thanks for your interest! Due to the volume of applications, we’re unable to respond to individual status inquiries. If selected to move forward, you’ll hear from our HR team at Nashville Soccer Club.

Department:  Event Operations
Reports to:  Director, Event Operations

ABOUT NASHVILLE SC:
Nashville is America’s “It City” and one of the fastest-growing soccer hubs in the country. From hosting the CONCACAF Gold Cup to FIFA World Cup Qualifiers and the FIFA Club World Cup, Music City has quickly become a destination for some of the sport’s most prominent events. Nashville SC has the largest soccer-specific stadium in Major League Soccer and in 2025 made Tennessee state history by becoming its first professional sports team champion! 
Position Summary:
Nashville Soccer Club is currently seeking an Event Operations part-time associate. This position will support the GEODIS Park Event Operations team in the planning and execution of Major League Soccer matches, as well as other major events, while also providing day-to-day support to the club's operations.  
Duties & Responsibilities:
  • Assist the Event Operations department on the planning and execution of Major League Soccer games, third-party ancillary events, and other major events.
  • Ensure Club and Stadium standard operating procedures are compliant with Major League Soccer’s operational regulations.
  • During Major League Soccer events:
  1. Ensure locker room set-ups meet MLS standardization requirements.
  2. Assist in servicing the needs of visiting teams and league officials on game day.
  3. Provide support for the referee crew before, during and after the game.
  4. Assist with match credential production and distribution.
  5. Lead, brief, and oversee ball retrievers during the event.
  6. Assist various departments with match day responsibilities.
  • During third-party/major events:
  1. Assist in ensuring that client needs, and expectations are met.
  2. Work with the Event Management Team in planning operational details of the event.
  3. Help with the movement and storage of the department’s equipment.
  4. Setting event day spaces to meet needs of various departments.
  • Other duties as assigned.
DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Knowledge and interest in sports and entertainment.
  • Computer proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Strong communication skills and professional etiquette.
  • Strong worth ethic with a positive, team-oriented approach.
REQUIREMENTS
  • Available 20-25 hours per week, including nights and weekends and often under extreme weather conditions. A typical game day can require early hours and late nights amounting to a 12 hour event day commitment.
  • Ability to lift and carry at least 50 pounds.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Marketing - Street Team PT
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
Position Summary
Nashville SC Street Team members serve as key community ambassadors for the Club throughout the 2025 season. This role supports fan engagement at public appearances, home matches, away watch parties, and community events across the Nashville area. Street Team members play a vital role in strengthening fan loyalty by enhancing the matchday and event experience, while also serving as an extension of the Club’s Marketing and Entertainment teams.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities
  • Facilitate on-site activations and promotional events while delivering exceptional customer service and representing the Club with energy and professionalism.
  • Serve as an extension of the Marketing Department by promoting club initiatives, ticket programs, and brand messaging.
  • Assist guests as part of the GEODIS Park guest experience team when needed.
  • Actively engage with fans to encourage participation in activations, distribute giveaways, and provide event-specific information.
  • Assist with the setup, operation, and breakdown of interactive displays, promotional booths, and event materials.
  • Distribute marketing collateral in an organized and professional manner.
  • Collect and report feedback, observations, and insights following events to supervisors.
  • Support pre-match activities, including Opening Act activations (e.g., Kick Wall, premium tailgate).
  • Serve as a matchday runner for the Nashville SC Entertainment team as needed.
  • Assist with matchday entertainment management, hospitality, and game presentation needs.
  • Support production logistics, including entertainment personnel arrival, load-in, and load-out.

Shift Information
  • Shifts include all home matches, the majority of away matches, and additional off-site community events throughout the season.
  • Hours vary by event schedule, with an expected commitment of approximately 5–15 hours per week during the season.
  • Some shifts require transporting materials to and from event locations and assisting with setup and teardown.

Qualifications
  • Ability to commit to all Nashville SC matchdays (home and away) with minimal scheduling conflicts.
  • General interest in and working knowledge of soccer, including basic understanding of Nashville SC’s schedule and roster.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a positive, outgoing attitude.
  • Comfortable engaging with fans and promoting club initiatives in public settings.
  • Team-oriented, collaborative mindset.
  • Willingness to learn club promotions, ticket programs, and soccer-related information (training provided).
  • Reliable transportation, valid driver’s license, and a good driving record.
  • Availability to work evenings, weekends, and select holidays.
  • Dependable, punctual, and professional.
  • Ability to lift and move materials exceeding 50 lbs.
  • Ability to maintain professionalism when interacting with VIP-level personnel.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred but not required.
  • Prior experience in promotions, events, or brand ambassador roles preferred.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Housekeeping - Housekeeping PT
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
About Nashville SC & GEODIS Park:
 Nashville is America’s “It City” and one of the fastest-growing soccer hubs in the country. From hosting the CONCACAF Gold Cup to FIFA World Cup Qualifiers and the FIFA Club World Cup, Music City has quickly become a destination for some of the sport’s most prominent events. Locally, Nashville SC is in its sixth season and continues to thrive both on and off the field, highlighted by the opening of GEODIS Park in May 2022—the largest soccer-specific stadium in Major League Soccer. 
 
What we are looking for:
  • Individuals available for 6-8 hours, 15-20 times per year, and available to attend all necessary in-person and virtual training as a prerequisite for employment
  • Someone who enjoys speaking and interacting with others in a warm, and respectful manner
  • Must enjoy helping others and working within a team environment
  • Ability to lift, pull, push and/or carry 25-60 lbs. as necessary
  • Must be able to stand for long periods of time and be exposed to different types of weather 

Primary roles & responsibilities:
  • Maintain stadium cleanliness, emptying trash cans, replacing trash cans with a new liner, wiping down countertop areas, tops of trash cans; sweeping/mopping the concourse as necessary; squeegeeing standing water to provide a safe environment for our guests; picking up and throwing away trash left in the stadium and outside perimeter that cannot be swept.
  • Responsible for providing a clean and safe facility before, during, and after all events
  • Responsible for picking up trash and emptying trash and recycle receptacles
  • Maintain all aspects of restroom cleanliness and preparedness by stocking and wiping down dispensers; cleaning and disinfecting all fixtures (toilets, urinals, sinks, baby changing tables); keeping the floor clean, dry and free of debris; and emptying trash cans
  • Respond to and resolve guests’ questions, concerns, complaints or suggestions in a professional and polite manner. Recognize and respond effectively in emergency situations
  • Supervisory positions available

job.title: Performance Nutritionist
job.html_description:
Position Summary

Under the direction of the Director of High Performance, the Performance Nutritionist is primarily responsible for the development and execution of nutrition services for the first team, providing individualized and team-based nutrition support that optimizes player health, adaptation, recovery, and performance. This role requires a high level of organization and communication to facilitate collaboration with team operations, high performance staff, and the culinary team.

 

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and evaluate a comprehensive nutrition program designed for optimal performance: the evaluation, interpretation, and monitoring of the nutritional status and nutritional needs of the team, using established standards of care and practice guidelines.
  • Conduct nutrition assessments, care planning, education, and counseling of athletes and staff, including personalized nutrition services and medical nutrition therapy for athletes with clinical nutrition needs and food allergies, integrated with the individual athlete’s nutrition goals as indicated.
  • Design, implement, and oversee an evidence-based supplementation program, prioritizing NSF Certified for Sport (or equivalent third-party banned-substance-tested) products, with ongoing education and monitoring to ensure compliance with MLS rules, regulations, and nutrition-related bylaws and to minimize inadvertent doping risk.
  • Order, interpret, and act on blood biomarker panels (e.g., iron/ferritin, vitamin D, complete metabolic and lipid panels, CBC, inflammatory markers) in collaboration with team physicians, translating findings into individualized lifestyle, fueling, and supplement recommendations that optimize athlete performance and health.
  • Leads and conducts individual and team nutrition counseling and education sessions; development of effective individual nutrition prescriptions and educational materials for athletes.
  • This position will require strong communication skills, both verbal and written and the ability to collaborate with Coaches, Sports Medicine staff, Strength and Conditioning staff, physicians, and other support staff to ensure a collaborative and comprehensive approach to training, nutrition and recovery, as well as aiding in the treatment of diet and nutritional related medical issues.
  • Coordinate and implement nutritional recovery process through pre- and post-competition menus with training ground chefs; oversee and implement catering and meals during team travel with hotels. Coordinate/manage quantity food production, inventory and distribution, of other food products, supplements and beverages. oversee ordering, vendor relationships, procurement of goods and payment of purchases.
  • Body Composition testing (DEXA and other) including assessment, education, and programming regarding the nutritional needs. Conduct body composition assessments by utilizing and maintaining appropriate technology (i.e. DEXA, BodPod or InBody) and other manual anthropometric testing (i.e. ISAK).
  • Implementation of hydration testing and strategies.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

 

 

Requirements

  • Registered Dietitian, by the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics, must be Registered and Licensed by the Accreditation Council for Education in Nutrition and Dietetics (ACEND) of the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics and licensed in the state of Tennessee of a minimum of 2 years. 
  • Master’s degree from an accredited college or university in Dietetics, Kinesiology, Exercise Science, Biology, or other Health Sciences related field.
  • Excellent multi-tasking and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including: evenings and weekends, with possible travel.  Must be available for in-person work/team interaction at an average of 15-25 hours per week.
  • Candidate should possess strong computer knowledge including proficiency utilizing Microsoft Office and other relevant software.
  • Professional, collegiate or club level sport nutrition experience.
  • Demonstrated proficiency interpreting blood biomarker panels and translating results into actionable lifestyle, fueling, and supplement recommendations, with working knowledge of third-party supplement testing/certification standards (e.g., NSF Certified for Sport) and anti-doping regulations relevant to professional sport.

 

Preferred but not required:

  • Bilingual in English and Spanish
  • Eligible to be Board Certified as a Specialist in Sports Dietetics (CSSD).
  • Soccer experience
  • Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist, through NSCA (National Strength & Conditioning Association)
  • ISAK certified 
  • Certified in Sports Nutrition (CISSN, ISSN) or comparable applied supplementation credential
  • Experience partnering with physicians on blood panel-driven nutrition and supplementation protocols
  • Experience in research, data collection, analysis of monitored stats, and evaluation of technology used by Sports Science/Performance department.

job.title: I.T. Network Administrator
job.html_description:
POSITION OVERVIEW

The IT Network Administrator supports Nashville SC’s technology infrastructure across the Club’s facilities, with a primary focus on maintaining a reliable, secure, and well-documented network environment. This role requires a hands-on technical operator who can support network administration, infrastructure troubleshooting, end-user needs, and event technology in a small IT team. The ideal candidate brings strong network infrastructure experience, practical troubleshooting ability, clear communication skills, and sound judgment around security, confidentiality, and escalation.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Install, configure, monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot network equipment and infrastructure across Club facilities
  • Maintain and document network assets, configurations, procedures, and escalation paths to support operational continuity
  • Support end-user helpdesk needs as part of a small IT team
  • Diagnose and resolve issues related to wired/wireless networks, VLANs, firewalls, and related network services
  • Contribute to technology planning and execution for matchdays, concerts, international matches, and other major events
  • Work closely with IT staff, end users, external stakeholders, and technology partners to identify issues, implement solutions, and support system improvements
  • Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating issues and next steps as needed
  • Work nights, weekends, and holidays as required, including matchdays and stadium events
  • Perform other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Administration, a related field, or equivalent combination of education, training, certifications, and relevant experience
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in IT administration, network administration, or related technical support
  • Strong hands-on experience administering, troubleshooting, and maintaining Cisco-based enterprise network environments
  • Working knowledge of IP networks, routing protocols, LAN/WAN configurations, firewalls, VPNs, Microsoft 365, Windows Server, and VMware
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and customer-service skills
  • Comfortable working in a small IT team where priorities can shift quickly between helpdesk requests, network issues, event support, and longer-term project needs
  • Sound judgment in handling network access, systems, credentials, confidential information, and appropriate escalation practices

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Professional certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA Network+, Microsoft, or VMware certifications
  • Experience with Cisco Meraki, enterprise wireless environments, and advanced VLAN troubleshooting
  • Experience supporting technology operations across multiple facilities or event-based environments
  • Experience working with external vendors, managed service providers, or technology partners

- Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Administration, a related field, or equivalent combination of education, training, certifications, and relevant experience - Minimum of 5 years of experience in IT administration, network administration, or related technical support - Strong hands-on experience administering, troubleshooting, and maintaining Cisco-based enterprise network environments - Working knowledge of IP networks, routing protocols, LAN/WAN configurations, firewalls, VPNs, Microsoft 365, Windows Server, and VMware - Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and customer-service skills - Comfortable working in a small IT team where priorities can shift quickly between helpdesk requests, network issues, event support, and longer-term project needs - Sound judgment in handling network access, systems, credentials, confidential information, and appropriate escalation practices
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Professional certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA Network+, Microsoft, or VMware certifications - Experience with Cisco Meraki, enterprise wireless environments, and advanced VLAN troubleshooting - Experience supporting technology operations across multiple facilities or event-based environments - Experience working with external vendors, managed service providers, or technology partners

job.title: Financial Analyst
job.html_description:
Nashville SC is seeking a full-time Financial Analyst to join the club. The Financial Analyst is responsible for supporting financial planning, analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting activities across the organization. The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, capable of translating financial data into actionable business insights.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports and variance analyses.
  • Assist with development of budgets, forecasts, and long-range financial plans.
  • Analyze financial performance and key business metrics to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Support management’s strategic initiatives with ad hoc financial modeling and business case analyses.
  • Maintain and improve financial reporting tools, dashboards, and KPI tracking.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance financial performance.
  • Assist with accounting and month end close as needed.

 

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of proven experience as a financial analyst or similar role.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, lookups, and modeling.
  • Understanding of GAAP and basic accounting principles.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

 

Preferred Skills:

  • CPA, CMA, CFA, or progress toward a professional certification is a plus.
  • Experience with NetSuite, Vena, Power BI, Tableau, or other business intelligence and automation tools is a plus.

job.title: Manager, Special Event Sales
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
As the Manager, Special Events Sales at GEODIS Park, home of Nashville SC, you will play a critical role in driving revenue through the sales and coordination of special events. This position is focused on developing new business, maintaining strong client relationships, and creatively packaging GEODIS Park’s unique venue spaces. You will work collaboratively with internal stakeholders to maximize venue usage and ensure an exceptional client experience from initial outreach through event execution.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities through networking, cold outreach, client referrals, trade publications, and database research.
  • Build relationships with local event planners, corporate planners, and decision-makers to promote GEODIS Park’s event offerings.
  • Schedule and lead venue tours for prospective clients, showcasing features and amenities.
  • Prepare and deliver professional proposals and presentations using data, visuals, and client-focused storytelling to secure bookings.
  • Maintain and grow relationships with existing clients to drive repeat business and long-term partnerships.
  • Conduct market research to uncover new leads and cross-departmental tie-in opportunities.
  • Collaborate with internal scheduling and booking teams to secure venue availability.
  • Partner with operations, marketing, ticketing, sponsorship, and premium sales teams to support event execution and maximize revenue.
  • Work with sponsorship and premium sales teams to package special event opportunities with partner or hospitality activations.
  • Assist in the ideation and execution of internal special event series and venue-driven initiatives.
  • Develop innovative sales strategies and social event packages to increase visibility and overall revenue.
  • Attend industry events and networking functions as a representative of GEODIS Park to generate new leads and stay connected to local trends.
  • Provide regular reporting on sales activity, pipeline updates, and performance metrics to the Senior Director of Special Events.
  • Ensure a seamless handoff and continued communication with operations teams to execute event logistics successfully.
  • Support the Senior Director in strategic initiatives, special projects, and other duties as assigned.

 

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Hospitality, Marketing, or related field; or 3+ years of relevant sales experience in events, hospitality, or corporate settings.
  • Experience working in a stadium, sports, entertainment, hotel, or convention center setting in an event sales role preferred.
  • Proven success in prospecting, negotiating, and closing diverse event sales.
  • Strong knowledge of the event/hospitality industry; familiarity with the Nashville market is a plus.
  • Strong Food and Beverage Knowledge
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Detail-oriented multitasker with experience managing fast-paced projects.
  • Advanced experience in CRM and venue management tools (e.g., Tripleseat, Momentus, VenueOps) and proficiency with Microsoft Office.
  • Creative in developing tailored event packages.
  • Self-driven, collaborative, and results-driven.
  • Availability for evenings, weekends, and holidays, as required by event schedules.

job.title: Groundskeeping - Groundskeeper
job.html_description:
The Groundskeeper, in conjunction with the Groundskeeping staff, will be responsible for maintaining the natural grass and synthetic fields at a designated Nashville SC facility. This is a full-time position with majority of the hours worked at the academy facility (Currey Ingram Academy). During busy periods at either Geodis Park or the first-team training facility (Vanderbilt Health Training Center), this position, with ample notice, may be assigned to work for extended periods of time at either of those locations as needed.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assist with maintenance of natural grass, as well as synthetic fields at Nashville SC facilities - including but not limited to Nashville SC’s trainings, home matches, concerts, football games, rugby matches, and field-related private events at Geodis Park.
  • Complete preventive maintenance on various pieces of equipment and ensure all equipment remains in working and operational condition.
  • Repair and maintain exterior grounds (in conjunction with landscaping services), including snow and ice removal.
  • Perform daily field maintenance.
  • Perform other duties to support the Nashville SC facilities.

 

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 2 years relevant work experience in maintaining sports fields, golf courses or home lawn/landscape (preferred).
  • Must have high level of interpersonal skills to handle sensitive and confidential situations and information.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills, detail oriented, and deadline driven.
  • Hours are variable and will include early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays in addition to the traditional Monday through Friday hours.
  • Ability to perform physical labor in various degrees of outdoor weather conditions, including but not limited to, extreme heat and cold or rain for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to lift 50 pounds of weight frequently throughout assigned workday.
  • Ability to work in various positions, including but not limited to, stooping, standing, bending over, sitting, kneeling, and squatting for extended periods of time.
