job.title: Account Executive, Premium Sales
job.html_description:
The Premium Sales, Account Executive is responsible for generating new revenue through the sale of premium seating products, including luxury suites, club seats, and VIP hospitality packages for Nashville SC matches and GEODIS Park events and concerts. This position is ideal for high-performing sales professionals with a proven track record of selling to high-net-worth individuals and corporate decision-makers.

This role will have a primary focus on outbound prospecting, networking, appointment setting, and executing sales presentations face-to-face or virtually to close multi-year membership agreements.

The Account Executive, Premium Sales, will report directly to the Sr. Director, Premium Sales.  

Key Responsibilities:  

  • Develop and implement a proactive sales strategy to generate new revenue from premium seating products, including suites, club seats and VIP experiences.
  • Identify and cultivate new business opportunities through cold calling, prospecting, networking, referrals and in-person meetings.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with C-level executives, corporate partners and high-net-worth individuals to drive premium sales.
  • Conduct face-to-face and virtual sales presentations, tailoring premium seating options to meet the specific needs of each prospect.
  • Manage the entire sales process from lead generation to contract execution, ensuring seamless and professional customer experience.
  • Consistently meet or exceed individual and team sales goals, including new business revenue.
  • Maintain an updated pipeline of potential buyers in the CRM system, accurately tracking interactions, follow-ups and deal progress.
  • Collaborate with the premium service team to ensure a high level of customer satisfaction and long-term client retention.
  • Attend networking events, client meetings and industry functions to build brand awareness and generate leads.
  • Work game days and special events to engage with premium clients, host prospects and provide top-tier service.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned to support the overall sales strategy.

Qualifications:  

  • Minimum, 2 years of B2B sales experience, preferably in sports, entertainment, or a related industry preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, sports management, or a related field preferred.  
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to build lasting relationships.  
  • High energy, self-motivated, and team-oriented with a passion for driving results.  
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); experience with Salesforce and Archtics preferred.  
  • Flexible work schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as required.  
  • Soccer knowledge is a plus but not required.  
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish strongly preferred.

job.title: Facility Operations - Facility Operations Associate PT
job.html_description:
POSITION OVERVIEW:
Nashville Soccer Club is looking to hire ambitious individuals with an interest in event and facility management to join our operations team. This position is responsible for assisting with daily operations of all Geodis Park events. This is a part-time position, working on an as-needed basis only and expected to work an average of 15-20 hours of work per week.  

RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Assist with venue setup and breakdown for Major League Soccer Events.
  • Ensure locker room and field set-ups meet MLS standardization requirements.
  • Assist with setup and breakdown of parking equipment pre and post match.
  • Accurately execute setup and teardown of event spaces throughout the stadium and surrounding campus.
  • Create and deploy event and stadium signage.
  • Operate heavy machinery and maintain inventory for logistical operations.
  • Collaborate with other departments during the preparation and execution of events. 
  • Help with the movement and storage of stadium equipment.
  • Complete other duties as assigned.
 
 SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Available for all (most) of Nashville SC home matches
  • Must be able to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends and holidays, as necessary.
  • Must possess strong communication (verbal and written) and organizational skills.
  • Dependable and team-oriented with a service attitude
  • Ability to lift a minimum of 50 pounds.
  • Ability to stand or walk for long periods of time.
  • Willingness to work in extreme conditions of different weather elements.
  • Outgoing personality, highly energetic, and enthusiastic
  • Experience in athletics, event planning execution or leading a small team preferred. 
  • Ability to work comfortably both independently and in a team environment.
  • Must be able to interact with all levels of the organization and represent the Stadium Operations Team in a professional manner.
 
 WORK ENVIRONMENT:
  • The noise level in the work environment is sometimes loud.
  • Ability to work in all types of weather, including extreme heat and cold.
  • Fast-paced work environment with many moving parts
 
CERTIFICATIONS AND LICENSES:
  • Driver’s license required.
  • Forklift certification preferred but not required.

job.title: NUW U21 Head Coach
job.html_description:
U21's Head Coach

Newcastle United Women Academy 

Permanent 

Competitive Salary

Closing Date: 16th September

Turn potential into performance  - helping young players thrive on and off the pitch.

We are the heartbeat of the city. Newcastle United Women (NUW) is proud to be part of a progressive and ambitious football club with a clear vision  for the women’s and girls’ game. Our Academy plays a vital role in developing talented young players within a safe, inclusive and high‑performance environment

About the role

We’re looking for an experienced and passionate U21’s Head Coach to lead the development of our next generation of elite female footballers at Newcastle United Women.

This is a key role within our Academy, responsible for delivering a high-performance environment that supports players’ technical, tactical, physical and psychological progression, while preparing them for transition into the first team.

What you'll do

Lead the delivery of the NUW Academy playing philosophy, aligning closely with first team principles and style of play.Plan, deliver and review high-quality coaching sessions in line with the Academy curriculum.
Manage the team on matchdays, including tactical planning and in-game decision making.Monitor player development, providing feedback, setting targets and supporting progression pathways.
Contribute to performance reviews and maintain accurate player records via club systems.Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary staff to support player performance, injury prevention and rehabilitation.
Support the transition and development of players moving into first team environments.Drive performance outcomes across the pathway, including progression into senior football.

Experience and Qualifications

Essential:

FA Level 3 / UEFA A Licence

Experience coaching talented young female players within a professional environment

Strong understanding of youth player development, including physical and psychological needs

Excellent communication, organisation and interpersonal skills

Knowledge of safeguarding, welfare and equality standards

The team

You will work closely with the NUW Academy Manager and wider Academy leadership team, contributing to a collaborative and high-performing coaching and development function.

United As One

We’re committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and believe in equal opportunities for all. We recognise that the diversity of our people is one of our greatest strengths. We work together to reflect the communities we serve and to maintain an inclusive environment in which everyone can be their authentic self and is enabled to achieve their full potential.

Safeguarding

We’re committed to being a place where everyone is safe, heard, valued and able to thrive so we place high value on the safeguarding and welfare of everyone we engage with.

To Apply

To view the full job description for this role, please Click here

This position is UK based and requires proof of the right to live and work in the UK. All job offers are conditional upon background checks, including reference history, DBS checks, and verification of your eligibility to work. Please note, we do not sponsor applicants without the right to work in the UK.

Recruitment Agencies – please note that we do not accept unsolicited candidate details. Any candidates submitted without request will be considered direct applicants.

job.title: Retail Supervisor
job.html_description:
Retail Supervisor

Newcastle Upon Tyne - St James Park

Permanent

Competitive Salary

Closing Date: 20th September 2026

We are the heartbeat of the city. Come and be a part of a long and proud history where we strive to be the best in everything we do, on and off the pitch. Bringing the people and communities together, join the Newcastle United Family, as we embark on the next steps of our exciting journey.

About the role

We’re looking for a Retail Supervisor to work alongside the management team to support building a driven, positive and hard-working team.

Working in our fast paced, high footfall store, you will manage sales and services with the aim to exceed commercial targets whilst delivering a best in class, premium retail experience for every visitor.

Your impact

You will have previous retail supervisory experience, ideally within a fast-paced sports retail environment but this is not essential.

You will have significant experience within customer service, ensuring you and the team deliver a ‘best in class’ service.

You will be flexible to work variable patterns including regular evenings and weekends.

About the team

You will work for our Store Manager and Assistant Store Managers, with responsibility for the store associates.

United As One

We’re committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and believe in equal opportunities for all. We recognise that the diversity of our people is one of our greatest strengths. We work together to reflect the communities we serve and to maintain an inclusive environment in which everyone can be their authentic self and is enabled to achieve their full potential.

Safeguarding

We’re committed to being a place where everyone is safe, heard, valued and able to thrive so we place high value on the safeguarding and welfare of everyone we engage with.

job.html_description:
Grounds Staff

Permanent 

Newcastle upon Tyne 

Competitive Salary 

Closing Date: 21st September 2026

We are the heartbeat of the city. Come and be a part of a long and proud history where we strive to be the best in everything we do, on and off the pitch. Bringing the people and communities together, join the Newcastle United Family, as we embark on the next steps of our exciting journey.

About the role 

We’re looking for an individual to join our Grounds Maintenance team where you will help us prepare and deliver the very best surfaces for our players to play and train on. You will operate machinery and equipment associated with sports pitch and grounds maintenance as instructed and will undertake maintenance of grass areas hedgerows, outside boundaries and other areas as directed.

Your impact 

You will have substantial experience in a similar role with knowledge of all aspects of ground maintenance machinery. It is essential you hold GCSE English & Maths at grade 3 or above as well as NVQ level 1 and 2 in Grounds Maintenance or equivalent.

About the team 

You will report into the Head Grounds Staff and join a welcoming and enthusiastic team who are committed to ensuring our teams have the best environment in which to play and train. Due to the nature of this work applicants must be prepared to work outdoors in all weather conditions, work weekends / unsociable hours and maintain confidentiality at all times.

United As One 

We’re committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and believe in equal opportunities for all. We recognise that the diversity of our people is one of our greatest strengths. We work together to reflect the communities we serve and to maintain an inclusive environment in which everyone can be their authentic self and is enabled to achieve their full potential.

Safeguarding 

We’re committed to being a place where everyone is safe, heard, valued and able to thrive so we place high value on the safeguarding and welfare of everyone we engage with.

How to apply 

To access the full job description for this role please click here.

For further information on this role and about the club and our values please visit our careers page.

Please apply as soon as possible as this vacancy may close early should we receive a high volume of suitable candidates. 

Recruitment Agencies – please note that we do not accept unsolicited / speculative candidate details or applications. Any candidates supplied, unless formally requested, will be taken as a direct / free candidate.

job.title: NUW Head of Goalkeeping Coach
job.html_description:
NUW Head of Goalkeeping Coach   

Newcastle upon Tyne 

Permanent

Salary: Competitive

Closing Date: 22/09/2026

We are the heartbeat of the city. Come and be a part of a long and proud history where we strive to be the best in everything we do, on and off the pitch. Bringing the people and communities together, join the Newcastle United Women's family, as we embark on the next steps of our exciting journey.

About the role

We’re looking for an experienced and passionate individual to join our Women’s Team as the Head of Goalkeeping. In this role, you will lead the development and delivery of our goalkeeper coaching philosophy, working closely with the NUW Head Coach and Women’s Director of Football. You’ll be responsible for shaping and implementing tailored training programmes, managing goalkeeper coaching staff, and supporting the development of goalkeepers across all age groups.

Your impact

You will bring a wealth of experience in goalkeeper coaching, with a deep understanding of modern trends in the game. Your ability to lead, mentor, and innovate will be key in:

  • Designing and delivering high-quality, individualised training programmes.
  • Managing and developing goalkeeper coaching staff.
  • Integrating performance analysis and data into coaching strategies.
  • Supporting recruitment and succession planning across the women’s goalkeeping pathway.
  • Monitoring and enhancing the performance of NUW First Team goalkeepers.

About the team

You will work within the Newcastle United Women’s (NUW) coaching and performance team, collaborating with the Head Coach, Director of Football, Academy staff, and multi-disciplinary teams to ensure a unified and progressive approach to goalkeeper development.

Location

This role is based in Newcastle upon Tyne. Please note, if you are not located in the Northeast and unable to relocate, we regret that we will not be able to progress your application.

United As One

We’re committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and believe in equal opportunities for all. We recognise that the diversity of our people is one of our greatest strengths. We work together to reflect the communities we serve and to maintain an inclusive environment in which everyone can be their authentic self and is enabled to achieve their full potential.

Safeguarding

We’re committed to being a place where everyone is safe, heard, valued and able to thrive, so we place high value on the safeguarding and welfare of everyone we engage with.

How to apply

job.title: Part-Time Assistant Athletic Trainer (Academy)
job.html_description:
Morristown, NJ, USA
Part-time
Travel: 0-10
Benefits Eligible: No
Organization: Red Bull New York Academy
Job type: Permanent

Company Description
Red Bull New York (“RBNY”) are one of 30 teams in Major League Soccer (MLS) and one of the league’s ten original charter clubs. Founded in 1996, RBNY has competed in MLS since its inception. RBNY’s First Team plays its home matches at Sports Illustrated Stadium in Harrison, New Jersey, and its Second Team plays its home matches at Montclair State University. RBNY are owned by the Austrian beverage company Red Bull GmbH, after which the team is named.

RBNY’s First Team is a three-time MLS Supporters’ Shield winner and a two-time Conference Champion, while the Second Team is the 2025 MLS NEXT Pro Champion. RBNY also operates one of the nation’s premier youth soccer development programs, spanning local partnerships across New York and New Jersey. RBNY’s Academy is ranked among the top development organizations in the country.

POSITION SUMMARY
In this part-time role, you will assist the Athletic Trainers and Physical Therapists at RBNY in the delivery of treatment and rehabilitation of all Academy players. Additionally, you will assist the Athletic Trainers and Physical Therapists in the implementation of injury reduction screening protocols and the delivery of their individual programs.

Job Description
RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Provide on-field medical coverage during Academy training sessions and matches as assigned.
  • Assist with the assessment of new injuries on the field of play and in the treatment room.
  • Initiate communication chain of initial findings to athletic trainers and physical therapists, and, when appropriate, communicate findings to coaching staff, fitness staff, and team physician.
  • Assist in the creation and execution of short-, medium-, and long-term rehabilitation plans for players as assigned.
  • Assist in the development and delivery of individualized injury reduction measures within the RB2 setting.
  • Assist in the creation and execution of end-stage rehab testing and assist performance staff with execution of return-to-play programming when appropriate.

Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Athletic Training
  • NATABOC Certified Athletic Trainer
  • Strong communication skills
  • Experience with evaluation and treatment of lower extremity injury
  • Flexible schedule for both weekday and weekend coverage
  • The ability to regularly lift up to 75lbs, in addition to being physically capable of performing general athletic training duties

Additional Information
You must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Due to the cyclical nature of the entertainment industry, the employee may be required to work varying schedules to reflect the business needs of the company. Red Bull New York is an equal opportunity employer and we will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality or any other classification protected by law.

The hourly rate for this position is $28/ hour. The hourly rate is subject to change and may be modified.

Red Bull New York is an equal opportunity employer and we will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality or any other classification protected by law.

job.title: Coordinator, Academy Operations
job.html_description:
Morristown, NJ, USA
Full-time
Travel: 30-40
Benefits Eligible: Yes
Organization: Red Bull New York Academy
Job type: Permanent

Company Description
ABOUT THE NEW YORK RED BULLS
The New York Red Bulls are one of 30 teams in Major League Soccer (MLS). RBNY, one of the ten charter clubs of MLS, have competed in the league since its founding in 1996. The Red Bulls play home matches at Sports Illustrated Stadium (SIS) in Harrison, New Jersey. The three-time MLS Supporters' Shield Winners are owned by the Austrian beverage company Red Bull for which the team is named. The New York Red Bulls offer one of the nation's premier youth soccer development programs, from local soccer partnerships across New York and New Jersey to Regional Development Schools and the Red Bulls Academy teams.

POSITION SUMMARY
The Coordinator, Academy Operations executes the day-to-day operations of the Academy, ensuring smooth logistical and administrative execution across all age groups. This role is critical in delivering a high-performance environment by managing scheduling, compliance, and equipment needs for players, families, and staff. The Coordinator supports the overall efficiency and professionalism of the Academy through consistent communication, planning, and collaboration across departments.

Job Description
RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Lead and execute all matchday logistics and on-site operations for RBNY home matches, including team arrivals/departures, locker rooms, field and bench set-up, warm-up areas, hydration, medical spaces, and overall facility readiness.
  • Lead scheduling and communication of training, matches, and events through Teamworks.
  • Serve as primary administrative and operational liaison among coaches, staff, players, and families.
  • Manage all player and staff kit and equipment operations, including sizing, distribution, collection, gear washing, storage, and replenishment to ensure all training, matchday, travel, and event needs are met.
  • Manage inventory tracking and ordering, maintaining accurate stock levels, monitoring usage and equipment requirements, forecasting future needs, and placing timely orders to ensure essential kit and equipment are always available and aligned with team requirements.

Qualifications
  • Minimum of three years of experience working in an elite sporting environment
  • Strong understanding of youth player development and the operational needs of an academy setting
  • Experience with team management platforms (e.g., Teamworks)
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage complex travel, scheduling, and equipment logistics

Additional Information
You must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Due to the cyclical nature of the entertainment industry, the employee may be required to work varying schedules to reflect the business needs of the company. Red Bull New York is an equal opportunity employer and we will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality or any other classification protected by law.

Red Bull New York provides comprehensive benefits offerings to all full-time employees. Our benefits include medical and dental insurance, 401(k) plan, flexible spending accounts, tuition reimbursement, life insurance, health and wellness benefits, and a paid time-off program.

The salary range for this position is $54,000-$56,000. Actual salary offers may vary based on work experience. The base pay is subject to change and may be modified.

Red Bull New York is an equal opportunity employer and we will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality or any other classification protected by law.

job.title: Netball Community Coaches
job.location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ, GB
job.html_description:
Engagement: Variable hours available

Location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ

Department: Netball

About the Role:

To deliver high-quality coaching sessions, planning training programmes, and supporting administrative tasks to ensure the smooth running and development of each squad, working across a range of age groups and performance levels within the Netball Community Programmes.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Plan and deliver high-quality netball coaching sessions to players of all ages and abilities.

  • Foster a positive and inclusive environment that encourages participation and enjoyment of netball.

  • Develop and implement training programs that cater to the individual needs of players.

  • Monitor and evaluate player progress, providing constructive feedback to help them improve.

  • Ensure the safety and well-being of all participants during coaching sessions.

  • Promote Nottingham Forest Netball and its programs within local communities.

  • Assist in organising and running local netball events, tournaments, and competitions.

  • Maintain equipment and ensure it is used safely and effectively.

  • Attend CPD events organised by Nottingham Forest.

  • Committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of young people

What are we looking for:

  • Netball coaching qualification for Head Coach (LEVEL 2 or ABOVE)

  • Netball coaching qualification for Assistant Coach (LEVEL 1 or ABOVE)

  • ·Previous coaching experience, preferably within a community setting.

  • Excellent communication.

  • Ability to inspire and motivate players of all ages and abilities.

  • Strong organisational and time management skills.

  • Commitment to promoting equality, diversity, and inclusion in sports.

  • Valid driver's license and access to a vehicle for travel between locations.

  • First Aid certification

  • Safeguarding certification

Forest For Everyone

We aim to create a culture which embraces and celebrates our differences, enables individuals to feel comfortable, maximise their potential and eliminate discrimination.

Nottingham Forest Football Club is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified persons, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital / civil partnership status, pregnancy / maternity leave, race, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Nottingham Forest Football Club is a signatory of the FA’s Football Leadership Diversity Code. We are committed to developing policies to promote equal opportunities and diversity within our workforce. To monitor our progress against these commitments, we require all applicants to provide accurate diversity data during the application process.

Disability Confident Committed Employer

We are a Disability Confident Committed employer. We encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions. If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a "disabled person" according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment selections.

Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity & Inclusion

Nottingham Forest Football Club is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified persons, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital / civil partnership status, pregnancy / maternity leave, race, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Nottingham Forest are committed to developing policies to promote equal opportunities and diversity within our workforce. To monitor our progress against these commitments, we require all applicants to provide accurate diversity data during the application process.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

As part of the Club’s commitment to safeguarding, the successful applicant may be required to undergo a Disclosure Barring Service (“DBS”) check. The level of check required will depend on the requirements of the role. Individuals will be asked to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, warnings or bind-overs that they are required to disclose for the level of check applicable to the role, in accordance with the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 (as amended) and the DBS filtering rules. The results of any check will be considered on an individual basis, and the Club will act proportionately in deciding whether to proceed with the appointment. The Club reserves the right to carry out risk assessments where content has been disclosed if it feels that it is relevant to the job requirements of the role. Failure to satisfy the Club, FA’s and the PL's safeguarding requirements may lead to the job offer being withdrawn or, if they have already started employment, summary termination of the employment, in accordance with the Club's disciplinary procedures

job.title: Netball Performance Pathway Coaches
job.location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ, GB
job.html_description:
Engagement: Variable hours available

Location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ

Department: Netball

Reporting to: Netball Pathway Lead

About the Role:

To deliver high-quality coaching sessions, planning training programmes, and supporting administrative tasks to ensure the smooth running and development of each squad, working across a range of age groups and performance levels within the Netball Pathway.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Support with the implementation of the vision and culture of the Nottingham Forest Netball Pathway.

  • To work with the various coaches across the pathway in creating high performance environments enabling each athlete to develop their technical, tactical, physical and psychological competences.

  • To work closely with the Pathway Head Coach & Sport Science Sports Medicine team to support delivery of a high quality periodised training and competition programmes for targeted players.

  • Experience of coaching netball within a performance environment

  • Experience of working with athletes aged between 14-19 within a performance environment

  • Experience of planning & implementing a high-performance program

  • An ability to inspire individuals, build trust and a create a positive & ambitious team culture

  • An ability to balance Nottingham Forest Netball responsibilities with other commitments

  • An ability to articulate tactical changes and technical improvements to athletes in a pressurised situation in a concise and meaningful manner

job.title: Host Family Provider
job.location: The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR, GB
job.html_description:
Contract: Temporary engagement

Location: Within three miles (15 minutes), easy access to The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR

Working Arrangements: Remote

Closing Date For Applications: INSERT

About the Role:

We are recruiting for host families who can provide accommodation for our Academy players to support them living away from home. This is a unique and rewarding opportunity to make a real difference to their experience and provide vital support to the players as they develop as young people alongside their football.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Provide a homely and friendly environment for our young people

  • Support with the development of our young people in your care with their independent living and self-care skills

  • Include our young people in family life as much as they feel comfortable with

  • Provide access to a private bedroom, bathroom, laundry facilities, and communal areas of the house

  • Provide a nutritious evening meal 

  • Report any welfare concerns to the Safeguarding and Welfare team should they occur.

  • Allow access from the Club for regular inspection and visits throughout the season.

  • Adhere to any further and ongoing requirements of Host Families, as outlined in the application process, guidance will be provided by the Club on this. 

What are we looking for:

  • Provide a warm, welcoming and safe environment for our young person

  • Provide the young person with their own private bedroom and relevant amenities 

  • Excellent communication and listening skills

  • Ability to cope with the young person's flexible schedule throughout the football season

  • Previous experience of working with young people

  • Ability to promote and demonstrate anti-discriminatory practice 

As part of the recruitment process the Club would need to conduct a number of home visits to determine suitability and ensure the home meets the requirements for hosting young people within the Academy.

Forest For Everyone

At Nottingham Forest Football Club we are committed to creating an environment where differences are respected, individuality is celebrated, everyone feels valued, supported, and included. Our goal is to ensure every member of our team can be themselves, contribute fully, and reach their potential without barriers.

Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion and Mental Wellbeing

As an equal opportunities employer, we welcome applications from talented people of all backgrounds regardless of age, disability, gender identity or reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We continue to develop policies and practices that promote equality, diversity, inclusion and mental wellbeing across our workforce. To help us measure progress and hold ourselves accountable, we ask all applicants to provide accurate diversity information during the recruitment process.

Disability Confident Committed Employer

As part of the Club’s commitment to safeguarding, the successful applicant may be required to undergo a Disclosure Barring Service (“DBS”) check. The level of check required will depend on the requirements of the role. Individuals will be asked to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, warnings or bind-overs that they are required to disclose for the level of check applicable to the role, in accordance with the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 (as amended) and the DBS filtering rules. The results of any check will be considered on an individual basis, and the Club will act proportionately in deciding whether to proceed with the appointment. The Club reserves the right to carry out risk assessments where content has been disclosed if it feels that it is relevant to the job requirements of the role. Failure to satisfy the Club, FA’s and the PL's safeguarding requirements may lead to the job offer being withdrawn or, if they have already started employment, summary termination of the employment, in accordance with the Club's disciplinary procedures

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

As part of the Club’s commitment to safeguarding, the successful applicant may be required to undergo a Disclosure Barring Service (“DBS”) check or an enhanced DBS check. The results of a DBS check will be considered on an individual basis, and the Club will act in a proportionate manner when deciding whether or not to proceed with the appointment.

An FA Enhanced DBS disclosure is required for all relevant new appointments to the Club. Individuals will be asked to declare any convictions, cautions or reprimands, warnings or bind-overs that may have been incurred. The Club reserves the right to carry out risk assessments where content has been disclosed on a DBS disclosure if it feels that it is relevant to the job requirements. Failure to satisfy the Club and the PL's safeguarding requirements may lead to the job offer being withdrawn or, if they have already started employment, summary termination of the employment.

Health and Safety

At Nottingham Forest Football Club, we are committed to ensuring a safe and healthy working environment for all employees. In accordance with the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974, you are required to take reasonable care for your own health and safety and that of others who may be affected by your actions or omissions at work. You must also cooperate with the Club's health and safety policies and procedures. Should you identify any health and safety concerns, please report them promptly to your manager or a member of the Health and Safety/Facilities team.

job.title: Academy Driver
job.location: The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR, GB
job.html_description:
Salary: Please state your expectations within your application

Contract: Part Time, 28 hours a week

Location: The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR

Department: Academy Operations

Reporting to: Academy Operations Manager

Closing Date For Applications: 18th September 2026

About the Role:

As an Academy Driver you will provide a safe, efficient and friendly service to our players on the Academy Full Time Training Model ensuring safety is at the fore.

This is a Monday–Friday role working split shifts, with occasional weekend work available. The usual working hours will be approximately 6:00am–9:00am and 4:30pm–7:30pm. Please note that working hours may vary depending on operational requirements.

The Perks of the Job:

  • Opportunity to access tickets for events at The City Ground.

  • Employee Assistance Programme.

  • Access to high street and gym discounts.

  • Discount within our Club shop.

  • Free on-site parking.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

Driving

  • You will perform driving tasks on a fixed daily schedule provide safe, timely and friendly transport to players on the Academy’s Full Time Training Model who are of secondary school age. Driving requirements are for three hours in the morning and three hours in the afternoon/evening.

  • Drive in compliance with the Rules & Regulations of the Highway code.

  • Ensure passenger safety at all times whilst undertaking driving duties for the Academy.

  • Additional driving tasks as required by the Academy programme.

  • Ensure any incidents are reported immediately in the correct timely manner.

Vehicle Management

  • On a daily basis conduct maintenance checks.

  • Conduct regular safety checks of academy vehicles ensuring any defects are reported and followed up.

  • Ensure that the vehicles are maintained to a level of cleanliness expected of the Academy.

  • Adhere to Club safety protocols at all times.

What we are looking for:

  • Strong communication skills with excellent attention to detail.

  • A proactive, solution-focused mindset and the ability to adapt.

  • Knowledge of transport regulations and safeguarding procedures related to youth travel.

  • Valid UK driving license.

  • Have a flexible approach to availability and the ability to respond to transport emergencies as needed.

  • To create successful and professional relationships with players and staff whilst maintaining professional distance from playing staff at all times.

  • To act, at all times, in a manner appropriate to a representative of Nottingham Forest FC

  • All staff are responsible for the wellbeing and safeguarding of children and vulnerable adults on all Club sites. If you have a concern or witness a Safeguarding matter, you must report it to the department’s Designated Safeguarding Officer (DSO) or the Club’s Lead DSO or Senior Safeguarding Manager. If It’s an emergency, you are to call the relevant emergency service such as Police or CAMHS.

We are committed to developing policies to promote equal opportunities and diversity within our workforce. To monitor our progress against these commitments, we Invite all applicants to provide diversity data during the application process.

Disability Confident Committed Employer

We are a Disability Confident Committed employer.  We encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions.  If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a "disabled person" according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below.  The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment selections.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

As part of the Club’s commitment to safeguarding, the successful applicant may be required to undergo a Disclosure Barring Service (“DBS”) check. The level of check required will depend on the requirements of the role. Individuals will be asked to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, warnings or bind-overs that they are required to disclose for the level of check applicable to the role, in accordance with the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 (as amended) and the DBS filtering rules. The results of any check will be considered on an individual basis, and the Club will act proportionately in deciding whether to proceed with the appointment. The Club reserves the right to carry out risk assessments where content has been disclosed if it feels that it is relevant to the job requirements of the role. job.location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ, GB
job.html_description:
Engagement: Casual position offering variable hours on a flexible basis

Location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ

Department: Retail

Reporting to: Store Manager

Closing Date For Applications: 18th September

About the Role:

To assist customers with purchases in store and over the telephone offering the highest levels of customer service all the time working to maintain high store standards.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Serve and advise customers and help to find the goods they want.

  • Handle payments by cash or card.

  • Professionally handle complaints, even when working with difficult situations.

  • To exceed customer expectations by going the extra mile in unique situations.

  • Ability to demonstrate a friendly style and work effectively under pressure.

  • Advise on the availability of stock and any special promotions.

  • Give information on products and prices.

  • Replenish stock and make sure goods are attractively displayed.

  • Shirt printing.

  • Some warehouse duties during peak periods: picking and packing products with accuracy, arrange customer orders and deliveries, comfortable to take inbound calls to process orders and deal with queries and complaints.

What are we looking for:

  • Be able to work as part of a team

  • Ability to listen carefully and effectively communicate with different types of customers

  • Enjoy working with the public

  • Have a polite, helpful manner

  • Be confident when dealing with difficult situations

  • Have basic mathematical skills, for dealing with payments and stock checks

  • Be comfortable using computerised equipment such as tills and data entry systems

  • Have plenty of stamina

  • Be flexible and adaptable

  • Be reliable and trustworthy

  • To have a strong work ethic

job.title: Facilities Associate
job.html_description:
JOB TITLE: Facilities Associate  
DEPARTMENT: Infrastructure                                                               
LOCATION: Orangeburg, NY

POSITION OVERVIEW:
This position will be responsible for supporting the New York City FC Infrastructure & Facilities department in many capacities, ranging from project and office work to consumer facing facility management. Additionally, this position will work closely with both the Facility Manager and Facility Coordinator from the Infrastructure department to plan, develop, and maintain the physical assets of New York City FC. 
 
WHAT YOU’LL DO:
  • Assist with day-to-day facilities operations of New York City FC Training Facility
  • Work with external contractors to ensure upkeep and safety of facility
  • Assist with setup and breakdown of events held at Training Facility
  • Project Management support & administration 
  • Support club-wide infrastructure development projects
  • Other duties as assigned
 
WHAT YOU’LL BRING:
  • A passion for project management, construction and experience of facility management preferred 
  • Interest or experience in facility management and/or project management
  • Experience showing professionalism expected around professional sports teams
  • Ability to meet deadlines; accomplish work in order of priority; professionally maintain composure and effectiveness under pressure and changing conditions
  • High level of organization and attention to detail
  • Highly motivated and ability to work long days and non-traditional hours
 
ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:
  • Applicant must be able to comply with MLS Next Safety and Well-Being policy and any other applicable child safety policies provided to applicants by NYCFC
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as necessary

WHAT WE OFFER:
  • Two complimentary tickets to select NYCFC home match
  • Team outings, happy hours, and annual staff gatherings to celebrate our co-workers
  • A dynamic, ambitious, and fun work environment
 
NEW YORK CITY FOOTBALL CLUB OVERVIEW:
At New York City FC, we are on a mission to build this city into one of the soccer capitals of the world. The Club was announced as Major League Soccer’s 20th franchise and is the first and only MLS team located within the five boroughs of New York City. The Club has qualified for the Audi MLS Cup Playoffs nine times over the past 10 seasons, winning MLS Cup in 2021. Games are available to stream via an Apple TV subscription, providing every match of the MLS regular season, the Audi MLS Cup Playoffs, annual Leagues Cup tournament, the MLS All-Star Game, the Campeones Cup, and more all in one place and with no blackouts. New York City FC is building New York City’s first-ever soccer-specific stadium, Etihad Park, which is set to open in 2027. For more information, please visit: www.newyorkcityfc.com.
 
New York City FC is also one of 12 clubs comprising City Football Group and counts Manchester City FC, Melbourne City FC, Yokohama F-Marinos, Girona FC, Montevideo City Torque, Shenzhen Peng City FC, Lommel SK, ESTAC Troyes, Palermo FC, Bahia, and Club Bolívar among its sister clubs.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

By clicking "Apply Now", you agree to the terms of the MLS Privacy Policy.
https://www.mlssoccer.com/legal/privacy-policy

job.title: Media Relations Gameday Associate
job.html_description:
TITLE: Media Relations Gameday Associate 
DEPARTMENT: Communications        
LOCATION: New York City, NY 
COMPENSATION: $18.50/ hour (part-time) 
 
POSITION OVERVIEW: 
New York City FC is seeking part-time seasonal Media Relations Gameday Associates who are looking to start their career in Sports Communications. These individuals will assist the Communications Department to execute the media operations at New York City FC (First Team) and New York City FC II (Second Team) home games. The Media Relations Gameday Associate will report to the Director, Media Relations and Manager, Media Relations and assist with gameday responsibilities which include media information distribution, press box operations, media credentialing assistance, stat keeping, photo marshaling, facilitating post-match press conference and player availability, quote transcriptions and compiling post-match notes.  
 
Individuals chosen for this role must be available to work a majority of home games, including nights, weekends and odd hours as assigned, based on the First Team and Second Team regular season and postseason schedule across all of the Club’s home venues. This is an opportunity to gain valuable sports communications experience while working in a dynamic matchday environment. 
 
WHAT YOU’LL DO: 
  • Assist the Communications staff on gamedays in various roles while helping promote the Club’s brand through the media 
  • Assist in press box preparation and management before and after games to ensure a fantastic matchday experience for all attending media and broadcasters 
  • Operate and staff the media check-in, managing credential distribution to media, photographers and guests   
  • Compile key storylines and player milestones throughout the match for the post-match notes, in addition to working with the League to track and keep stats to input into the database 
  • Act as an on-field photo marshal for broadcasters and photographers  
  • Facilitate post-match press conference and player availability, gather audio and transcribe for the inclusion of the post-match notes that are distributed to media  
  • Other duties as assigned by the Director and Manager, Media Relations in preparation for a home match such as publicity recaps, gameday notes, stats, and support at New York City FC Communications activations  
 
WHAT YOU’LL BRING: 
  • College graduate or currently enrolled in an accredited College or University, working towards a bachelor’s degree in public relations, Communications, Sports Management, or related field  
  • An understanding of media and soccer, with the desire to learn about Communications and sports media operations 
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills 
  • Self-motivated with a high degree of integrity; takes personal responsibility for accomplishing tasks in a way that positively and professionally represents the Club 
  • Excellent attention to detail, organizational & time management skill 
  • Excellent work ethic and ability to learn quickly, with ability to multi-task and prioritize workload 
  • Flexible schedule, with availability to work nights, weekends and odd hours as assigned, based on the NYCFC and NYCFC II regular season and postseason schedules 
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite  
  • Knowledge of Spanish and Portuguese is a plus, but not required  
 
ADDITIONAL REQUIRMENTS:  
  • Applicant must be able to comply with MLS Next Safety and Well-Being policy and any other applicable child safety policies provided to applicants by NYCFC  
  
WHAT WE OFFER:  
  • Two complimentary tickets to each home match  
  • Medical benefits through a third-party provider  
  • Team outings, happy hours, and annual staff gatherings to celebrate our co-workers   
  • A dynamic, ambitious, and fun work environment

The Media Relations Gameday Associate will report to the Director, Media Relations and Manager, Media Relations and assist with gameday responsibilities which include media information distribution, press box operations, media credentialing assistance, stat keeping, photo marshaling, facilitating post-match press conference and player availability, quote transcriptions and compiling post-match notes.
Individuals chosen for this role must be available to work a majority of home games, including nights, weekends and odd hours as assigned, based on the First Team and Second Team regular season and postseason schedule across all of the Club’s home venues. This is an opportunity to gain valuable sports communications experience while working in a dynamic matchday environment.
WHAT YOU’LL DO:
- Assist the Communications staff on gamedays in various roles while helping promote the Club’s brand through the media - Assist in press box preparation and management before and after games to ensure a fantastic matchday experience for all attending media and broadcasters - Operate and staff the media check-in, managing credential distribution to media, photographers and guests - Compile key storylines and player milestones throughout the match for the post-match notes, in addition to working with the League to track and keep stats to input into the database - Act as an on-field photo marshal for broadcasters and photographers - Facilitate post-match press conference and player availability, gather audio and transcribe for the inclusion of the post-match notes that are distributed to media - Other duties as assigned by the Director and Manager, Media Relations in preparation for a home match such as publicity recaps, gameday notes, stats, and support at New York City FC Communications activations
WHAT YOU’LL BRING:
- College graduate or currently enrolled in an accredited College or University, working towards a bachelor’s degree in public relations, Communications, Sports Management, or related field - An understanding of media and soccer, with the desire to learn about Communications and sports media operations - Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills - Self-motivated with a high degree of integrity; takes personal responsibility for accomplishing tasks in a way that positively and professionally represents the Club - Excellent attention to detail, organizational & time management skill - Excellent work ethic and ability to learn quickly, with ability to multi-task and prioritize workload - Flexible schedule, with availability to work nights, weekends and odd hours as assigned, based on the NYCFC and NYCFC II regular season and postseason schedules - Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite - Knowledge of Spanish and Portuguese is a plus, but not required
ADDITIONAL REQUIRMENTS:
- Applicant must be able to comply with MLS Next Safety and Well-Being policy and any other applicable child safety policies provided to applicants by NYCFC
WHAT WE OFFER:
- Two complimentary tickets to each home match - Medical benefits through a third-party provider - Team outings, happy hours, and annual staff gatherings to celebrate our co-workers - A dynamic, ambitious, and fun work environment
NEW YORK CITY FC OVERVIEW:
At New York City FC, we are on a mission to build this city into one of the soccer capitals of the world. The Club was announced as Major League Soccer’s 20th franchise and is the first and only MLS team located within the five boroughs of New York City. The Club has qualified for the Audi MLS Cup Playoffs nine times over the past 10 seasons, winning MLS Cup in 2021. Games are available to stream via an Apple TV subscription, providing every match of the MLS regular season, the Audi MLS Cup Playoffs, annual Leagues Cup tournament, the MLS All-Star Game, the Campeones Cup, and more all in one place and with no blackouts. New York City FC is building New York City’s first-ever soccer-specific stadium, Etihad Park, which is set to open in 2027.
New York City FC is also one of 12 clubs comprising City Football Group and counts Manchester City FC, Melbourne City FC, Yokohama F-Marinos, Girona FC, Montevideo City Torque, Shenzhen Peng City FC, Lommel SK, ESTAC Troyes, Palermo FC, Bahia, and Club Bolívar among its sister clubs.

job.title: Individual Development Lead
job.html_description:
JOB TITLE: Individual Development Lead
REPORTING TO:  Academy Director
DEPARTMENT: Academy
LOCATION:  CFA New York (Orangeburg, NY) & St. John’s University (Queens, NY)

 
POSITION OVERVIEW:
New York City FC is seeking an Individual Development Lead. This role will lead and coordinate the Academy's individual player development program, ensuring every player receives a structured, intentional and aligned development experience. The role is responsible for designing, implementing and monitoring Individual Development Plans (IDPs), whilst providing enhanced support for the Academy's highest potential players through targeted coaching, mentoring and multidisciplinary collaboration.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:
Individual Player Development 
  • Lead the Academy Individual Development Program across all age groups.
  • Design, implement and continually refine the Academy IDP framework.
  • Ensure every Academy player has an Individual Development Plan aligned to the Academy Game Model and Methodology.
  • Identify individual learning priorities through observation, training and match analysis.
  • Create clear objectives and action plans for players throughout the season.
  • Ensure development is intentional, measurable and aligned across departments.
High Potential Player Program
  • Lead the Academy High Potential Player Program.
  • Prioritize enhanced support for the Academy's highest projected players.
  • Coordinate additional technical, tactical and position-specific interventions.
  • Provide regular one-to-one mentoring and career guidance.
  • Monitor player trajectory and recommend progression opportunities.
  • Liaise with player families, and other pertinent stakeholders, to ensure alignment between the player and the club
Coaching & Player Interventions
  • Deliver on-field individual coaching sessions.
  • Lead individual and small-group technical development clinics.
  • Deliver video analysis sessions and feedback.
  • Support coaches in embedding individual objectives into team practice.
  • Ensure interventions complement team training.
Mentoring & Evaluation
  • Maintain accurate player development records and IDPs.
  • Lead regular multidisciplinary player reviews.
  • Monitor progress against agreed KPIs.
  • Provide reports and recommendations to the Academy Director and Academy Technical Director.
  • Support retain/release and pathway decisions.
Multidisciplinary Coordination
  • Coordinate collaboration between coaching, performance, medical, psychology, education and player care.
  • Ensure accountability for agreed player action plans.
  • Maintain regular communication with players and families regarding development where appropriate.
  • Drive consistency of individual development throughout the Academy.
General Responsibilities
  • Attend Academy training, matches and tournaments as required.
  • Contribute to Academy leadership meetings.
  • Remain current with best practice in elite player development.
  • Maintain strong links with City Football Group and relevant stakeholders.
  • Undertake any additional duties as directed by the Academy Director.

WHO YOU ARE: 
At New York FC, we are committed to upholding our core club values and our values guide how we show up and work together every day.  If you share our values listed below, please consider NYCFC as a great place for you to work (and play):
Acts Honorably: listens and communicates respectfully, without judgement
Engages Collaboratively: provides and seeks constructive feedback to and from peers, proactively sharing appreciation for quality contributions of others
Champions Inclusion: celebrates the value of differences recognizing the value in the unique backgrounds and lived experiences of every team member
Drives Forward: embraces new opportunities with curiosity and a focus on improvement and innovation
Shows Heart: demonstrates passion for the Club and sport, operating as an NYCFC ambassador in encouraging and inspiring that passion in others

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:
Essential Requirements  
  • UEFA A License (or equivalent US Soccer license)
  • Extensive experience within an elite academy or high-performance football environment.
  • Demonstrable experience designing and leading individual player development programs.
  • Excellent understanding of long-term player development.
  • Experience working within multidisciplinary environments.
  • Strong planning, organizational and communication skills.
  • Valid driver’s license
  • Knowledge of Microsoft office; PowerPoint, Word, and Excel
 Personal Characteristics  
  • Player-centered and development focused.
  • Excellent communicator and relationship builder.
  • High standards with strong attention to detail.
  • Collaborative leadership style.
  • Innovative, proactive and committed to continuous improvement.
  • Able to influence and challenge positively.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:
  • Applicants must be able to comply with MLS Next Safety and Well-Being policy and any other applicable child safety policies provided to applicants by NYCFC  
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as necessary  

COMPENSATION:
This exempt position has an estimated annual base salary range of $65,000-$70,000 and is not overtime eligible. Final compensation offer amounts are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to demonstrated skill set, years and depth of relevant experience, and some role-dependent factors such as certifications and software expertise. We welcome direct conversations with each candidate about compensation in all of our initial calls.

WHAT WE OFFER:
  • Excellent health, dental & vision insurance, with options to fit you and your family’s needs
  • Comprehensive and competitive benefit programs, including maternal & paternal leave
  • Ancillary benefits: Commuter, and Citi Bike discounts
  • Your health is important! Our wellness strategy focuses on mental and physical wellbeing through in-office and virtual programs
  • Four complementary tickets to every NYCFC home match
  • Team outings, happy hours, and annual staff gatherings to celebrate our co-workers
  • A dynamic, ambitious, and fun work environment

The essential functions of this position must be performed with or without reasonable accommodation. NYCFC will consider reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local law.

NEW YORK CITY FOOTBALL CLUB OVERVIEW:
At New York City FC, we are on a mission to build this city into one of the soccer capitals of the world. The Club was announced as Major League Soccer’s 20th franchise and is the first and only MLS team located within the five boroughs of New York City. The Club has qualified for the Audi MLS Cup Playoffs nine times over the past 10 seasons, winning MLS Cup in 2021. Games are available to stream via an Apple TV subscription, providing every match of the MLS regular season, the Audi MLS Cup Playoffs, annual Leagues Cup tournament, the MLS All-Star Game, the Campeones Cup, and more all in one place and with no blackouts. New York City FC is building New York City’s first-ever soccer-specific stadium, Etihad Park, which is set to open in 2027. For more information, please visit: www.newyorkcityfc.com.

New York City FC is also one of 12 clubs comprising City Football Group and counts Manchester City FC, Melbourne City FC, Yokohama F-Marinos, Girona FC, Montevideo City Torque, Shenzhen Peng City FC, Lommel SK, ESTAC Troyes, Palermo FC, Bahia, and Club Bolívar among its sister clubs.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

By clicking "Apply Now", you agree to the terms of the MLS Privacy Policy.

job.title: Stadium Operations - Sports Turf Specialist
job.html_description:
TITLE:  Sports Turf Specialist, Stadium

DEPARTMENT:  Stadium Operations 
REPORTS TO:  Grounds Supervisor

FLSA:  Full-time Hourly; Non-Exempt 

  

WHAT SETS YOU APART  

Are you a self-motivated individual with physical stamina? Do you love the outdoors and maintaining aesthetically pleasing outdoor space? If so, our Sports Turf Specialist role could be for you. You will be responsible for mowing, fertilization, edging, irrigation troubleshooting and repair, top dressing, aerating, painting, sodding, and record keeping for the Inter.co Stadium. You will get a chance to use a variety of practical skills which are valuable and essential to the overall Club.   

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:  

  • Assist with all operations of field maintenance at Inter.co Stadium to include painting, mowing, irrigation, aerification, chemical application and any special projects as needed 
  • Proactively identify turf grass diseases, weeds, pests, and work with Director of Turf & Grounds and Grounds Supervisor to take corrective action as needed 
  • Assist in equipment and irrigation repair and maintenance 
  • Work MLS games, NWSL games and third party events based on business needs 
  • Create and maintain good working relationships with all MLS and NWSL coaches and soccer operations staff 
  • Participate in procuring equipment and supplies as needed for the facility 
  • Provide coverage at the training facilities as needed 
  • Other duties as assigned 

   

QUALIFICATIONS  

It’s never just a job at Orlando City SC and Orlando Pride.  It’s a way of life. We live and breathe soccer and entertainment. We believe each role is as unique as the person who does it. To join our team, you will also possess these qualifications:  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Turf Grass Science, Horticulture, or related field preferred. 
  • 1-3 years of grounds maintenance related work experience in soccer 
  • Candidate should possess or have the ability to obtain the Florida Commercial Pesticide Applicator License. 
  • Ability to operate turf related equipment (i.e., tractors, mowers, aerifiers, field paint machine). 
  • Possess excellent written/verbal communication skills, be detail-oriented and highly organized with the ability to simultaneously handle multiple tasks and adapt to change. 
  • Ability to resolve concerns expeditiously and independently. 
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.). 
  • Fluency in Spanish is preferred but not required. 
  • Experience with hosting field events including sporting and concerts, using various field protection systems is a plus. 
  • Ability to perform physical labor for extended periods of time and in various weather conditions. 
  • Able to work flexible hours including nights, weekends, and holidays. 
  • Ability to walk and stand for short periods of time. 
  • The ability to attain and maintain Safesport certification. 
  • The ability to pass a background screening. 


About Orlando City SC & Orlando Pride: 

 

In November 2013, Orlando City Soccer Club was awarded a Major League Soccer (MLS) franchise, becoming the league’s 21st franchise. The team began play in March 2015, with 62,510 fans packing the then-Orlando Citrus Bowl for the Club’s MLS debut.  

The Lions have reached the postseason in five-consecutive seasons (2020-24), qualified for the Concacaf Champions Cup (formerly Concacaf Champions League) in both 2023 and 2024, and reached their first final in 2020 during the MLS is Back Tournament. In 2022, Orlando City won its first championship of its MLS era, lifting the Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup trophy, which also marked the first championship by any professional team in the City Beautiful. Prior to its time in MLS, Orlando City boasted a decorated history in the United Soccer League, winning the league’s championship in both the 2011 and 2013 seasons. 

In October 2015, the Orlando Pride was announced as the 10th team in the National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL), bringing professional women’s soccer to the state of Florida for the first time. The team began play in April 2016, setting a then-league single-game attendance record in its first-ever home game, with 23,403 fans witnessing the Club’s first win.  

The Pride feature a star-studded roster of domestic and international talent and, in 2024, brought the first professional major league title to the city of Orlando, with the Club winning the NWSL Championship. The season saw the Pride complete the double, winning both the Championship and the NWSL Shield as the best team in the regular season, capping off a historic campaign that set numerous league records. Former Orlando City defender Seb Hines serves as the team’s head coach, not only the first Black head coach in the league, but also the first to win both the Championship and the NWSL Shield, and the 2024 NWSL Coach of the Year.

 

In 2017, both teams moved into its privately-owned, soccer-specific venue – Inter&Co Stadium – located in the heart of downtown Orlando.

 

In July 2021, the Club – which includes Orlando City SC, the Orlando Pride, Orlando City B (MLS NEXT Pro) and Inter&Co Stadium – was purchased by the Wilf Family, who also own the Minnesota Vikings of the National Football League.  

For more information on Orlando City SC and Orlando, visit OrlandoCitySC.com or Orlando-Pride.com.

 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

 

Orlando City and Orlando Pride will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation(s) to participate in the job application or interview process and perform critical job functions. Please contact the People and Culture department at Peopleandculture@orlandocitysc.com to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

DEPARTMENT:  Training Facilities 
REPORTS TO:  Head Groundskeeper, OHP 

FLSA: Full-Time, hourly; Non-exempt 

  

WHAT SETS YOU APART 

We are looking for a skilled and proactive Sports Turf Specialist to join our team at the Orlando Health Training Ground at Osceola Heritage Park.  You will be responsible for mowing, fertilization, edging, irrigation, troubleshooting and repair, top dressing, aerating, painting, sodding, and record keeping for the Inter.co Stadium. You will get a chance to use a variety of practical skills which are valuable and essential to the overall Club.   

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Assist with field maintenance of (3) natural grass fields and (1) turf field at the Orlando Health Training Ground at Osceola Heritage Park to include mowing, fertilization, edging, irrigation, troubleshooting and repair, top dressing, aerating, painting, sodding, and any special projects as needed 
  • Proactively identify turf grass diseases, weeds, and pests, and work with the Head Groundskeeper to take corrective action as needed 
  • Collaborate with Director of Turf & Grounds to ensure field conditions are to the team and MLS/MLS Next Pro standards 
  • Work MLS games, NWSL games and third-party events at Inter.co Stadium based on business needs 
  • Assist with Orlando City B game coverage at Osceola County Stadium based on business needs 
  • Create and maintain good working relationships with all MLS coaches and soccer operations staff 
  • Other duties as assigned

  • Must possess a High School diploma or G.E.D. or equivalent

  • 1-3 years of grounds maintenance-related work experience, with soccer-specific experience preferred

  • Ability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

 



About Orlando City SC & Orlando Pride: 

 

In November 2013, Orlando City Soccer Club was awarded a Major League Soccer (MLS) franchise, becoming the league’s 21st franchise. The team began play in March 2015, with 62,510 fans packing the then-Orlando Citrus Bowl for the Club’s MLS debut.  

The Lions have reached the postseason in five-consecutive seasons (2020-24), qualified for the Concacaf Champions Cup (formerly Concacaf Champions League) in both 2023 and 2024, and reached their first final in 2020 during the MLS is Back Tournament. In 2022, Orlando City won its first championship of its MLS era, lifting the Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup trophy, which also marked the first championship by any professional team in the City Beautiful. Prior to its time in MLS, Orlando City boasted a decorated history in the United Soccer League, winning the league’s championship in both the 2011 and 2013 seasons. 

In October 2015, the Orlando Pride was announced as the 10th team in the National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL), bringing professional women’s soccer to the state of Florida for the first time. The team began play in April 2016, setting a then-league single-game attendance record in its first-ever home game, with 23,403 fans witnessing the Club’s first win.  

The Pride feature a star-studded roster of domestic and international talent and, in 2024, brought the first professional major league title to the city of Orlando, with the Club winning the NWSL Championship. The season saw the Pride complete the double, winning both the Championship and the NWSL Shield as the best team in the regular season, capping off a historic campaign that set numerous league records. Former Orlando City defender Seb Hines serves as the team’s head coach, not only the first Black head coach in the league, but also the first to win both the Championship and the NWSL Shield, and the 2024 NWSL Coach of the Year.

 

In 2017, both teams moved into its privately-owned, soccer-specific venue – Inter&Co Stadium – located in the heart of downtown Orlando.

 

In July 2021, the Club – which includes Orlando City SC, the Orlando Pride, Orlando City B (MLS NEXT Pro) and Inter&Co Stadium – was purchased by the Wilf Family, who also own the Minnesota Vikings of the National Football League.  

For more information on Orlando City SC and Orlando, visit OrlandoCitySC.com or Orlando-Pride.com.

TITLE: Sports Turf Specialist, OHP
DEPARTMENT: Training Facilities REPORTS TO:Head Groundskeeper, OHP
FLSA:Full-Time, hourly; Non-exempt
WHAT SETS YOU APART
We are looking for a skilled and proactive Sports Turf Specialist to join our team at the Orlando Health Training Ground at Osceola Heritage Park. You will be responsible for mowing, fertilization, edging, irrigation, troubleshooting and repair, top dressing, aerating, painting, sodding, and record keeping for the Inter.co Stadium. You will get a chance to use a variety of practical skills which are valuable and essential to the overall Club.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
- Assist with field maintenance of (3) natural grass fields and (1) turf field at the Orlando Health Training Ground at Osceola Heritage Park to include mowing, fertilization, edging, irrigation, troubleshooting and repair, top dressing, aerating, painting, sodding, and any special projects as needed
- Proactively identify turf grass diseases, weeds, and pests, and work with the Head Groundskeeper to take corrective action as needed
- Collaborate with Director of Turf & Grounds to ensure field conditions are to the team and MLS/MLS Next Pro standards
- Work MLS games, NWSL games and third-party events at Inter.co Stadium based on business needs
- Assist with Orlando City B game coverage at Osceola County Stadium based on business needs
- Create and maintain good working relationships with all MLS coaches and soccer operations staff
- Other duties as assigned

It’s never just a job at Orlando City SC. It’s a way of life. We live and breathe soccer and entertainment. We believe each role is as unique as the person who does it. To join our team, you will also possess these qualifications:

- Must possess a valid Florida Driver’s License
- 1-3 years of grounds maintenance-related work experience, with soccer-specific experience preferred
- Bachelor’s degree in Turf Grass Science, Horticulture, or related field preferred.
- Candidate should possess or have the ability to obtain the Florida Commercial Pesticide Applicator License
- Ability to operate turf-related equipment (i.e., tractors, mowers, aerifiers, field paint machines).

- Ability to perform physical labor for extended periods of time and in various weather conditions.

job.html_description:
TITLE: Facilities Operations Assistant

DEPARTMENT: Stadium Operations

REPORTS TO: Sr Manager, Stadium Operations

FLSA: Hourly, Part-Time, Non-Exempt

 

WHAT SETS YOU APART

Orlando City SC is seeking hardworking, positive, and passionate individuals looking to gain practical experience supporting key operational functions at a professional soccer stadium and special event venue. The Assistant will have a direct role in supporting the delivery of services, protection and monitoring of facilities, and oversight of vendors providing services. The Assistant will work under the close supervision of the Stadium Operations Manager and facility operations team.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate with the facility operations team while observing the planning and execution of sporting and non-sporting stadium events.
  • Learn about and assist with organizing and inspecting stadium storage areas.
  • Learn about and participate in the Inter&Co Stadium Zero Waste sustainability program.
  • Learn about and collaborate with departments across the organization.
  • Assist with general administrative duties specific to Stadium Operations.
  • Learn and demonstrate excellent customer service when interacting with clients and vendors.
  • Learn how to conduct stadium inspections.
  • Participate in assignments related to inventory tracking, departmental activities, and other Stadium Operations initiatives.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Exceptional reliability, interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills.
