ABOUT THE ROLE
Union Sports & Entertainment is seeking a motivated, organized, and people-focused professional to join our team as Coordinator, People & Culture. This role supports the full employee lifecycle and plays an important part in creating a positive, inclusive, and engaging workplace. The Coordinator will collaborate with employees and managers across the organization to help deliver a consistent, positive, and meaningful employee experience. This position supports the Philadelphia Union (MLS), Union II (MLS NEXT Pro), Philadelphia Union Academy (MLS NEXT U12–U18), Philadelphia Union Foundation, WSFS Bank Sportsplex, and Subaru Park.
 
This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career People & Culture professional to gain broad, hands-on HR experience while supporting employees across a dynamic professional sports organization.

RESPONSIBILITIES
 Employee Lifecycle
  • Support recruitment efforts by posting open positions on career sites and job boards, coordinating interviews, and communicating with candidates and hiring managers.
  • Provide timely, professional, and engaging communication to candidates and new hires throughout the recruitment and onboarding processes.
  • Coordinate all aspects of full-time new-hire onboarding, including welcome communications, background screenings, new-hire paperwork, Form I-9 verification, new-hire orientation, workstation preparation, and equipment setup.
  • Coordinate the onboarding of gameday and event staff, including attending designated games and events to collect and review Form I-9 documentation.
  • Enter and maintain employee information in the HRIS, including new hires, employee changes, transfers, and separations, ensuring information is complete, accurate, and processed in a timely manner.
  • Coordinate the offboarding process for departing employees, including scheduling exit interviews, preparing required documentation, updating internal systems, and communicating with appropriate departments to facilitate a smooth transition.
  • Administer and track new-hire and exit surveys through Lattice, maintaining accurate and confidential records and identifying trends for the People & Culture team.
Employee Experience
  • Create and distribute the Union’s monthly employee newsletter, highlighting organizational updates, upcoming events, employee recognition, birthdays, and People & Culture initiatives.
  • Partner with the Union’s Employee Resource Groups to support their respective missions, coordinate quarterly meetings, and promote employee participation and engagement.
  • Coordinate and administer a robust wellness program that reflects the diverse needs, interests, and backgrounds of various groups of employees.
  • Support the People & Culture team in developing and administering an employee recognition program that reinforces a positive, supportive, and inclusive workplace culture.
  • Coordinate mandatory employee training programs across the organization, including communicating requirements, tracking participation and completion, maintaining accurate records, and following up with employees and managers as needed.
 Employee & People Operations Support
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for general employee questions related to People & Culture, providing timely and professional assistance and escalating sensitive or complex matters to the appropriate team member.
  • Monitor departmental merchandise inventory by maintaining accurate records, coordinating distribution, and assisting with annual inventory forecasting.
  • Coordinate, track, and audit required employee background screenings, state-mandated clearances, and SafeSport certifications for full-time, part-time, and seasonal employees.
  • Assist with periodic audits of employee records, Form I-9 documentation, background screenings, state-mandated clearances, and SafeSport certifications to support organizational compliance and recordkeeping requirements.
  • Support the administration and coordination of the Union’s internship program, including recruitment, onboarding, programming, communication, and offboarding.
  • Build and maintain relationships with local colleges and universities to promote employment and internship opportunities and coordinate informational sessions, career presentations, and campus engagement activities.
  • Maintain accurate and confidential employee records and organizational resources, including the HRIS, organizational charts, and employee directories.
  • Manage routine departmental administrative responsibilities, including monitoring the People & Culture mailbox, processing employment-verification requests, maintaining workers’ compensation files, and organizing other employment-related documentation.
  • Provide day-to-day administrative support to the People & Culture team and perform other related duties as assigned.
 
ABOUT YOU
  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, psychology, business, or a related field, preferred.
  • At least one year of experience in human resources, people operations, or a related administrative role.
  • An interest in the sports and entertainment industry and a passion for creating a positive employee experience.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment while managing sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
  • High emotional intelligence and the ability to build trusted relationships with employees and managers across various levels, departments, and locations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a professional and service-oriented approach.
  • Excellent organizational, administrative, and attention-to-detail skills.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to prioritize responsibilities, manage competing demands, and meet deadlines with limited supervision.
  • Working knowledge of general human resources practices and employment-related recordkeeping requirements preferred.
  • Experience with an HRIS, applicant tracking system, or employee engagement platform preferred; experience with Primepoint or Lattice is a plus.
  • Ability and willingness to adjust working hours, including working select games, evenings, and weekends, to support game-day staff onboarding, high-volume periods, special events, and other organizational needs.
 
WHY THE UNION?
At Union Sports & Entertainment, development is in our DNA. From our world-class academy to our front office, we believe in identifying talent early, investing in it fully, and creating real pathways for growth. If you’re driven, coachable, and willing to put in the work, the Union will match your ambition.

You’ll join a competitive, high-energy environment where:
  • People get better every day as leaders and teammates
  • Winning matters, but how we win matters just as much
  • Coaching, feedback, and accountability are part of the culture, not buzzwords
  • Soccer passion is real and matchdays mean something here

We celebrate effort, creativity, and results. We challenge each other. We have fun. And we take pride in developing future leaders who go on to make an impact across the sports industry.

We are committed to supporting the health, well-being, and professional success of our employees. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes paid time off, multiple medical plan options, dental and vision coverage, flexible spending and health savings accounts, a 401(k) plan with Company match, Company-paid life and disability insurance, paid medical and baby-bonding leave, mental health resources, wellness reimbursements, and employee discounts. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, relevant experience, internal equity, and prevailing business and market conditions.

Employees may also enjoy complimentary or discounted tickets, match-day meals, access to our on-site fitness center and café, complimentary coffee beverages, Summer Friday hours, and employee engagement events throughout the year. Eligibility for specific benefits may vary based on position and employment status.

Our Commitment to Inclusion
Union Sports & Entertainment is committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive workplace where every employee and candidate is treated with dignity and respect. We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. Not sure you meet every requirement? Championship teams are built on diverse strengths. If you’re passionate about sports and excited about this role, we want to hear from you!

job.title: Detail Supervisor, Housekeeping
job.html_description:
WHO WE ARE 
Awarded Major League Soccer’s 16th franchise in 2008, the Philadelphia Union officially took the pitch in 2010 and have been raising expectations ever since. Owned and operated by Union Sports & Entertainment, the Philadelphia Union call Subaru Park home—an 18,500-seat, world-class, soccer-specific stadium set along the Delaware River beneath the Commodore Barry Bridge, just 15 miles from downtown Philadelphia.

On the field, the Union have established themselves as one of Major League Soccer’s most consistent and competitive clubs. The team reached the Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup Final three times (2014, 2015, and 2018), made multiple MLS Cup Playoff appearances, and captured the Supporters’ Shield in 2020 and again in 2025, recognizing the club’s excellence and consistency across the regular season. The Union also hosted the Eastern Conference Final in 2021, were crowned Eastern Conference Champions in 2022, and advanced to the MLS Cup Final that same year in one of the most thrilling matches in league history. The club has continued to represent Philadelphia on the international stage through participation in the Scotiabank CONCACAF Champions League.

Off the field, the Philadelphia Union are defined by a culture that is Young, Fearless, and Challenger-driven. We are unafraid to think differently, push boundaries, and pursue excellence in everything we do. We believe success is built through accountability, collaboration, innovation, and a relentless drive to raise the bar.

Our deep connection to Philadelphia is woven into who we are. From the Club’s crest and colors to the thirteen stars and rallying cry, the Union proudly reflect the city’s revolutionary spirit and its legacy as the birthplace of American independence.  If you’re ready to challenge the ordinary and help shape the future of soccer in Philadelphia, we invite you to join us.

ABOUT THE ROLE
The Detail Supervisor is a hands-on, working supervisor responsible for performing and overseeing detailed cleaning across the Philadelphia Union campus. This role helps ensure that the stadium and related facilities are clean, safe, presentable, and ready to welcome fans, players, employees, and guests during daily operations, Philadelphia Union matches, special events, and private functions.

The Detail Supervisor provides direct shift-level supervision to assigned part-time, temporary, and event-day housekeeping employees. Using independent judgment within established departmental policies, this position assigns and directs work, adjusts staffing and assignments based on operational needs, trains employees, and inspects completed work. The Detail Supervisor works alongside the housekeeping team and regularly performs custodial duties. However, the position remains responsible for the direction, productivity, conduct, safety, and performance of employees assigned to the shift.

RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Perform and oversee detailed cleaning throughout Subaru Park and other assigned facilities.
  • Direct and supervise assigned housekeeping employees, including part-time, temporary, and event-day staff, during daily operations, event preparation, event-time coverage, post-event cleanup, and special cleaning projects.
  • Assign housekeeping employees to work areas and establish cleaning priorities based on event schedules, facility conditions, staffing levels, and operational requirements.
  • Responsibly direct employees and adjust assignments, staffing coverage, break schedules, and work priorities as circumstances change throughout the shift.
  • Exercise independent judgment when responding to immediate housekeeping, staffing, safety, and facility-readiness concerns within the scope of the position's authority.
  • Monitor employee attendance, punctuality, productivity, conduct, safety practices, and compliance with departmental policies and procedures.
  • Train and coach housekeeping employees regarding cleaning techniques, department procedures, equipment operation, chemical handling, workplace safety, productivity, and service expectations.
  • Inspect completed work, identify incomplete or substandard performance, and direct employees to take immediate corrective action.
  • Document employee performance, attendance, conduct, policy violations, safety concerns, and corrective coaching accurately and promptly.
  • Initiate or effectively recommend employee recognition, additional training, schedule or assignment changes, corrective action, discipline, suspension, or discharge based on documented performance, conduct, and operational needs.
  • Participate in interviewing and evaluating housekeeping candidates and provide effective recommendations regarding hiring and placement decisions.
  • Communicate and enforce departmental policies, applicable collective bargaining agreement provisions, safety requirements, and management directives consistently and professionally.
  • Coordinate and oversee the work of event-day employees, temporary labor, and third-party custodial personnel during assigned shifts.
  • Provide shift updates to the Housekeeping Superintendent, including staffing levels, completed assignments, outstanding work, performance concerns, incidents, supply needs, and facility conditions.
  • Serve as the primary housekeeping point of contact during assigned shifts.
  • Address employee performance and conduct concerns within the position's authority; document the circumstances, provide appropriate coaching or direction, initiate or effectively recommend corrective action, and escalate significant matters to management.
  • Reinforce cleanliness, sanitation, presentation, and guest-service standards.
  • Assist with event-day setup, in-event cleaning, spill response, and post-event cleanup.
  • Respond promptly to housekeeping requests from Operations, Security, Event Services, and other departments.
  • Monitor supplies and communicate replenishment needs to management.
  • Properly use and care for commercial cleaning equipment, including floor scrubbers, vacuums, extractors, pressure washers, and related equipment.
  • Identify and report damaged equipment, maintenance concerns, safety hazards, spills, or facility damage.
  • Follow all chemical-labeling, Safety Data Sheet, personal protective equipment, and workplace safety requirements.
  • Maintain housekeeping closets, storage areas, and equipment in a clean and organized condition.
  • Participate in deep-cleaning projects and other stadium operations assignments as needed.
  • Complete cleaning checklists, inspection reports, and other required documentation.
  • Provide professional and courteous service to employees, guests, vendors, and event personnel.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS
  • High school diploma or equivalent preferred.
  • At least two years of commercial housekeeping, custodial, or facility-cleaning experience.
  • Previous experience as a lead worker, shift leader, or working supervisor preferred.
  • Experience working in a stadium, arena, entertainment venue, hospitality environment, or other large public facility is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to supervise employees, assign and responsibly direct work, evaluate performance, and hold employees accountable for established standards.
  • Ability to exercise sound and independent judgment when making shift-level staffing, work-assignment, performance, and operational decisions.
  • Working knowledge of commercial cleaning procedures, chemicals, equipment, and sanitation standards.
  • Ability to safely operate commercial cleaning equipment and properly handle cleaning chemicals.
  • Ability to provide clear instructions, train employees, and respectfully redirect work when standards are not met.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to prioritize assignments and respond effectively to changing operational needs.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to work independently with limited supervision.
  • Reliable attendance and punctuality.
  • Ability to work nights, weekends, holidays, and variable schedules based on event and operational needs.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills.
  • Experience working with union employees, temporary labor, or outsourced custodial providers.
  • Familiarity with recycling and waste-diversion programs.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Ability to frequently bend, stoop, kneel, crouch, reach, push, pull, and perform repetitive movements.
  • Ability to regularly lift and carry up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift, carry, or move up to 50 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Ability to push and maneuver housekeeping carts and commercial cleaning equipment.
  • Ability to climb stairs and work throughout multiple levels of the stadium.
  • Ability to work indoors and outdoors in varying weather and temperature conditions.
  • Ability to work around cleaning chemicals, dust, noise, crowds, and active event operations.

WORK SCHEDULE
This position requires a flexible schedule based on stadium and event needs. The Detail Supervisor must be available to work days, evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours, including pre-event and post-event shifts. Overtime may be required and will be paid in accordance with applicable law.

WHY THE UNION?
At Union Sports & Entertainment, development is in our DNA. From our world-class academy to our front office, we believe in identifying talent early, investing in it fully, and creating real pathways for growth. If you’re driven, coachable, and willing to put in the work, the Union will match your ambition.

You’ll join a competitive, high-energy environment where:
  • People get better every day as leaders and teammates
  • Winning matters, but how we win matters just as much
  • Coaching, feedback, and accountability are part of the culture, not buzzwords
  • Soccer passion is real and matchdays mean something here

We celebrate effort, creativity, and results. We challenge each other. We have fun. And we take pride in developing future leaders who go on to make an impact across the sports industry.

We are committed to supporting the health, well-being, and professional success of our employees. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes paid time off, multiple medical plan options, dental and vision coverage, flexible spending and health savings accounts, a 401(k) plan with Company match, Company-paid life and disability insurance, paid medical and baby-bonding leave, mental health resources, wellness reimbursements, and employee discounts. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, relevant experience, internal equity, and prevailing business and market conditions.

Our Commitment to Inclusion
Union Sports & Entertainment is committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive workplace where every employee and candidate is treated with dignity and respect. We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. Not sure you meet every requirement? Championship teams are built on diverse strengths. If you’re passionate about sports and excited about this role, we want to hear from you!

The Union also hosted the Eastern Conference Final in 2021, were crowned Eastern Conference Champions in 2022, and advanced to the MLS Cup Final that same year in one of the most thrilling matches in league history. The club has continued to represent Philadelphia on the international stage through participation in the Scotiabank CONCACAF Champions League.

Off the field, the Philadelphia Union are defined by a culture that is Young, Fearless, and Challenger-driven. We are unafraid to think differently, push boundaries, and pursue excellence in everything we do. We believe success is built through accountability, collaboration, innovation, and a relentless drive to raise the bar.

Our deep connection to Philadelphia is woven into who we are. From the Club’s crest and colors to the thirteen stars and rallying cry, the Union proudly reflect the city’s revolutionary spirit and its legacy as the birthplace of American independence.  If you’re ready to challenge the ordinary and help shape the future of soccer in Philadelphia, we invite you to join us.

ABOUT THE ROLE
The Assistant Housekeeping Superintendent supports the Housekeeping Superintendent in overseeing day-to-day housekeeping and custodial operations at Subaru Park and other assigned Philadelphia Union facilities. This position helps ensure that the stadium and surrounding facilities consistently meet organizational standards for cleanliness, safety, presentation, and guest experience during daily operations, Philadelphia Union matches, special events, and private functions.

This is a supervisory position with direct shift-level responsibility for part-time, seasonal, temporary, and event-day housekeeping employees. Using independent judgment within established organizational policies and the operating plan established by the Housekeeping Superintendent, the Assistant Superintendent determines shift deployment, assigns and responsibly directs work, adjusts personnel and priorities as conditions change, evaluates performance, addresses conduct and attendance concerns, and makes recommendations regarding hiring, promotion, discipline, suspension, and termination that are given meaningful consideration by management.

The Assistant Superintendent is accountable for the safety, conduct, productivity, work quality, and performance of employees assigned to the shift. Although the Assistant Superintendent may provide hands-on assistance when operationally necessary, the role remains responsible for exercising supervisory authority and directing assigned employees rather than functioning solely as a lead worker.

RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Directly supervise part-time, seasonal, temporary, and event-day housekeeping employees and remain accountable for their safety, conduct, productivity, work quality, and performance.
  • Use independent judgment to determine staffing requirements, establish shift priorities, assign employees to work areas and responsibilities, and responsibly direct the manner and sequence in which work is completed.
  • Reallocate employees, modify assignments, approve routine shift adjustments, and deploy additional resources in response to attendance, workload, event activity, facility conditions, and emerging operational needs without seeking routine approval.
  • Conduct pre-shift meetings; communicate assignments, service standards, event information, safety requirements, and performance expectations; and confirm employee understanding.
  • Monitor attendance, conduct, productivity, and work quality; provide coaching and documented feedback; and require timely correction of deficiencies.
  • Evaluate employee performance and provide substantive input and recommendations regarding hiring, retention, promotion, assignment, recognition, compensation, and continued employment.
  • Address routine employee complaints, scheduling disputes, work-assignment concerns, and interpersonal issues; resolve matters within assigned authority and elevate significant concerns to People & Culture or department leadership.
  • Train and develop supervisors, leads, and housekeeping employees on cleaning procedures, equipment operation, chemical handling, safety protocols, guest service, and departmental expectations.
  • Manage daily housekeeping and custodial operations throughout Subaru Park and other assigned facilities, ensuring spaces are consistently clean, safe, sanitary, presentable, and event-ready.
  • Oversee the cleanliness and presentation of restrooms, concourses, suites and premium areas, offices, locker rooms, event spaces, stairwells, elevators, loading areas, storage areas, exterior entrances, and other assigned spaces.
  • Develop and execute operational plans for routine cleaning, special projects, event preparation, event-time coverage, post-event cleanup, and facility changeovers.
  • Conduct facility walk-throughs and inspections; identify deficiencies; assign corrective work; verify completion; and document recurring or significant issues.
  • Exercise authority to adjust work methods, staffing, sequencing, and resource allocation to meet cleanliness, safety, and event-readiness standards.
  • Oversee waste removal and recycling operations and support organizational sustainability initiatives.
  • Coordinate with Stadium Operations, Engineering, Security, Guest Services, and other departments to resolve facility, event, and service issues.
  • Lead employee check-in, assignment, deployment, and accountability processes for matches, special events, and post-event operations.
  • Monitor staffing levels and labor utilization throughout shifts and events; authorize reassignment, schedule changes, early releases, or extensions consistent with operational needs and Company policy.
  • Determine and communicate housekeeping priorities before, during, and following events, and respond to emerging conditions by redirecting employees and resources.
  • Coordinate post-event cleaning operations to restore the facility efficiently and prepare it for the next scheduled activity.
  • Serve as the on-duty housekeeping supervisor during assigned shifts, matches, and events and make timely operational decisions within the position's authority.
  • Establish, communicate, and enforce consistent cleanliness, sanitation, presentation, and service standards.
  • Ensure employees follow OSHA requirements, Safety Data Sheets, manufacturer instructions, Company safety procedures, and established work practices.
  • Ensure employees are properly trained and authorized to operate commercial housekeeping equipment, including floor scrubbers, buffers, wet vacuums, carpet extractors, and related equipment.
  • Ensure cleaning chemicals are properly labeled, stored, handled, diluted, and used; immediately address unsafe practices or conditions.
  • Investigate and document workplace incidents, employee injuries, equipment damage, safety violations, and service failures, and implement corrective measures within assigned authority.
  • Inspect equipment and coordinate preventive maintenance, repair, replacement, or removal from service as necessary.
  • Maintain appropriate inventory levels of cleaning supplies, chemicals, equipment, uniforms, and departmental materials, and control unnecessary waste and expense.
  • Maintain accurate schedules, timekeeping and attendance records, performance documentation, inspection reports, training records, safety documentation, equipment records, and supply inventories.
  • Review payroll and timekeeping information for accuracy and address discrepancies within established procedures.
  • Monitor vendor and contractor performance, direct corrective action when services do not meet expectations, and communicate significant concerns to department leadership.
  • Prepare reports regarding staffing, labor utilization, facility conditions, supply needs, safety, and departmental performance.

QUALIFICATIONS
  • High school diploma or equivalent required; additional education or training in facilities management, hospitality, operations, or a related discipline preferred.
  • Minimum of three years of housekeeping, custodial, environmental services, facilities, hospitality, or related operations experience, preferably in a stadium, arena, convention center, hotel, entertainment venue, or other large commercial facility.
  • Previous supervisory experience with demonstrated authority for scheduling, assigning and directing work, training, evaluating performance, addressing employee concerns, and recommending employment actions required.
  • Experience supervising a combination of  part-time, seasonal, temporary, and event-based employees strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of commercial cleaning methods, equipment, chemicals, and industry best practices.
  • Working knowledge of workplace safety standards, OSHA requirements, SDS procedures, and safe chemical handling.
  • Strong leadership, judgment, communication, organization, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to make timely decisions, manage competing priorities, and hold employees accountable in a fast-paced, event-driven environment.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills are a plus.
  • Experience in professional sports or a large-scale sports and entertainment venue strongly preferred.

WORK SCHEDULE
This position requires a flexible schedule based on the Philadelphia Union match and event calendar, including days, evenings, overnight hours, weekends, holidays, and extended shifts. Regular attendance at Philadelphia Union home matches and other major events at Subaru Park is an essential function of the position.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
  • Ability to walk and stand for extended periods throughout the stadium and surrounding property and regularly navigate stairs and varied facility areas.
  • Ability to bend, stoop, kneel, crouch, reach, push, pull, and perform physical activities associated with inspecting and supporting housekeeping operations.
  • Ability to safely operate commercial housekeeping equipment and lift and carry up to 25 pounds regularly, with heavier items moved using appropriate assistance or equipment.
  • Ability to work indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions.

WHY THE UNION?
At Union Sports & Entertainment, development is in our DNA. From our world-class academy to our front office, we believe in identifying talent early, investing in it fully, and creating real pathways for growth. If you’re driven, coachable, and willing to put in the work, the Union will match your ambition.

You’ll join a competitive, high-energy environment where:
  • People get better every day as leaders and teammates
  • Winning matters, but how we win matters just as much
  • Coaching, feedback, and accountability are part of the culture, not buzzwords
  • Soccer passion is real and matchdays mean something here

We celebrate effort, creativity, and results. We challenge each other. We have fun. And we take pride in developing future leaders who go on to make an impact across the sports industry.

We are committed to supporting the health, well-being, and professional success of our employees. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes paid time off, multiple medical plan options, dental and vision coverage, flexible spending and health savings accounts, a 401(k) plan with Company match, Company-paid life and disability insurance, paid medical and baby-bonding leave, mental health resources, wellness reimbursements, and employee discounts. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, relevant experience, internal equity, and prevailing business and market conditions.

Our Commitment to Inclusion
Union Sports & Entertainment is committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive workplace where every employee and candidate is treated with dignity and respect. We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. Not sure you meet every requirement? Championship teams are built on diverse strengths. If you’re passionate about sports and excited about this role, we want to hear from you!

job.title: Athletic Trainer – Philadelphia Union Academy
job.html_description:
WHO WE ARE 
Awarded Major League Soccer’s 16th franchise in 2008, the Philadelphia Union officially took the pitch in 2010 and have been raising expectations ever since. Owned and operated by Union Sports & Entertainment, the Philadelphia Union call Subaru Park home—an 18,500-seat, world-class, soccer-specific stadium set along the Delaware River beneath the Commodore Barry Bridge, just 15 miles from downtown Philadelphia.

Union Sports & Entertainment oversees a fully integrated soccer development pathway that includes the Philadelphia Union first team, Union II of MLS NEXT Pro, and Philadelphia Union Academy teams playing in MLS NEXT. Recognized as one of the premier player development organizations in North America, the Club has built a reputation for identifying, developing, and advancing homegrown talent to the highest levels of the game. Players across all levels train and compete at the state-of-the-art WSFS Bank Sportsplex, a world-class training and sports complex that serves as the hub for player development, performance, and community engagement. This commitment to development has produced numerous first-team contributors, professional players, and national team representatives, reinforcing the Union’s position as a leader in the American soccer landscape.

On the field, the Union have established themselves as one of Major League Soccer’s most consistent and competitive clubs. The team reached the Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup Final three times (2014, 2015, and 2018), made multiple MLS Cup Playoff appearances, and captured the Supporters’ Shield in 2020 and again in 2025, recognizing the club’s excellence and consistency across the regular season. The Union also hosted the Eastern Conference Final in 2021, were crowned Eastern Conference Champions in 2022, and advanced to the MLS Cup Final that same year in one of the most thrilling matches in league history. The club has continued to represent Philadelphia on the international stage through participation in the Scotiabank CONCACAF Champions League.

Off the field, the Philadelphia Union are defined by a culture that is Young, Fearless, and Challenger-driven. We are unafraid to think differently, push boundaries, and pursue excellence in everything we do. We believe success is built through accountability, collaboration, innovation, and a relentless drive to raise the bar. Our deep connection to Philadelphia is woven into who we are. From the Club’s crest and colors to the thirteen stars and rallying cry, the Union proudly reflect the city’s revolutionary spirit and its legacy as the birthplace of American independence. 

If you’re ready to challenge the ordinary and help shape the future of soccer in Philadelphia, we invite you to join us!

ABOUT THE ROLE
The Athletic Trainer plays a critical role in the health, safety, and athletic development of Philadelphia Union Academy athletes. Working collaboratively with the Head of Athletic Training, Academy & Professional Development, Head of Health, team physicians, performance staff, and nutrition personnel, this position is responsible for delivering comprehensive sports medicine services that support athlete wellness, injury prevention, performance enhancement, and return-to-play outcomes.

The Athletic Trainer serves as a leader within the Academy's sports medicine department, helping to maintain the highest standards of medical care while fostering a safe, healthy, and performance-driven environment for Academy athletes. The Philadelphia Union is committed to providing a world-class environment that supports athlete health, performance, and development through excellence in sports medicine and interdisciplinary collaboration.

RESPONSIBILITIES
Athlete Care & Sports Medicine
  • Provide comprehensive athletic training services for Philadelphia Union Academy athletes.
  • Deliver first aid, emergency care, injury evaluation, treatment, and rehabilitation services.
  • Design and implement individualized injury prevention and rehabilitation programs.
  • Apply appropriate therapeutic modalities and treatment techniques.
  • Facilitate medical referrals and coordinate care with physicians and healthcare providers as needed.
  • Monitor athlete progress and support safe return-to-play decisions.
Collaboration & Athlete Development
  • Work under the guidance and supervision of the Head of Health and Head of Athletic Training, Academy & Professional Development.
  • Collaborate closely with performance staff, nutritionists, physicians, and other multidisciplinary support personnel.
  • Assist in implementing integrated athlete development strategies that support performance, health, and long-term development.
  • Participate in athlete monitoring and wellness initiatives.
  • Support Academy team physicians with injury management protocols and medical procedures.
Medical Operations & Compliance
  • Maintain accurate medical records and injury documentation in accordance with club policies and applicable regulations.
  • Ensure compliance with all Academy medical policies, procedures, and standards.
  • Assist with the development, implementation, and continual improvement of medical protocols and emergency action plans.
  • Maintain athletic training facilities to ensure a clean, organized, and professional environment.
  • Order, inventory, and manage medical supplies and clinical equipment.
  • Ensure compliance with OSHA standards, including bloodborne pathogen protocols and workplace safety requirements.
Additional Responsibilities
  • Attend Academy training sessions, matches, tournaments, and other events as required.
  • Participate in departmental meetings and continuing education opportunities.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned to support the Academy's sports medicine and athlete development objectives.

QUALIFICATIONS
Required
  • Bachelor's degree in Athletic Training, Sports Medicine, Exercise Science, or a related field.
  • Current Board of Certification (BOC) certification.
  • Current state licensure or eligibility for licensure as an Athletic Trainer.
  • CPR/AED and First Aid certification.
  • Strong knowledge of injury prevention, evaluation, treatment, and rehabilitation techniques.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and travel as required.

Preferred
  • Master's degree in Athletic Training or a related field.
  • Previous experience working with elite youth athletes, academy programs, collegiate athletics, or professional sports organizations.
  • Experience collaborating within multidisciplinary performance and sports medicine teams.
  • Knowledge of soccer-specific injury prevention and rehabilitation strategies.

This position operates in athletic training rooms, fitness facilities, training fields, competition venues, and office environments. The role requires regular attendance at training sessions, matches, tournaments, and Academy events. Flexible schedule required to successfully complete job requirements, including nights, weekends and holidays. Occasional travel may be necessary.

This position requires valid criminal background clearances in the state of PA:
  • PA Child Abuse History Clearance 
  • PA State Police Criminal Record Check
  • DHS Criminal Background Check (via fingerprinting)
  • Annual Safe Sport Certification
 
WHY THE UNION?
At Union Sports & Entertainment, development is in our DNA. From our world-class academy to our front office, we believe in identifying talent early, investing in it fully, and creating real pathways for growth. If you’re driven, coachable, and willing to put in the work, the Union will match your ambition.

You’ll join a competitive, high-energy environment where:
  • People get better every day as leaders and teammates
  • Winning matters, but how we win matters just as much
  • Coaching, feedback, and accountability are part of the culture, not buzzwords
  • Soccer passion is real and matchdays mean something here

We celebrate effort, creativity, and results. We challenge each other. We have fun. And we take pride in developing future leaders who go on to make an impact across the sports industry.

We are committed to supporting the health, well-being, and professional success of our employees. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes paid time off, multiple medical plan options, dental and vision coverage, flexible spending and health savings accounts, a 401(k) plan with Company match, Company-paid life and disability insurance, paid medical and baby-bonding leave, mental health resources, wellness reimbursements, and employee discounts. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, relevant experience, internal equity, and prevailing business and market conditions.

Our Commitment to Inclusion
Union Sports & Entertainment is committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive workplace where every employee and candidate is treated with dignity and respect. We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. Not sure you meet every requirement? Championship teams are built on diverse strengths. If you’re passionate about sports and excited about this role, we want to hear from you!

- Master's degree in Athletic Training or a related field. - Previous experience working with elite youth athletes, academy programs, collegiate athletics, or professional sports organizations. - Experience collaborating within multidisciplinary performance and sports medicine teams. - Knowledge of soccer-specific injury prevention and rehabilitation strategies.
This position operates in athletic training rooms, fitness facilities, training fields, competition venues, and office environments. The role requires regular attendance at training sessions, matches, tournaments, and Academy events. Flexible schedule required to successfully complete job requirements, including nights, weekends and holidays. Occasional travel may be necessary.
This position requires valid criminal background clearances in the state of PA:
- PA Child Abuse History Clearance - PA State Police Criminal Record Check - DHS Criminal Background Check (via fingerprinting) - Annual Safe Sport Certification
WHY THE UNION? At Union Sports & Entertainment, development is in our DNA. From our world-class academy to our front office, we believe in identifying talent early, investing in it fully, and creating real pathways for growth. If you’re driven, coachable, and willing to put in the work, the Union will match your ambition.
You’ll join a competitive, high-energy environment where:
- People get better every dayas leaders and teammates - Winning matters, but how we win matters just as much - Coaching, feedback, and accountability are part of the culture, not buzzwords - Soccer passion is realand matchdays mean something here
We celebrate effort, creativity, and results. We challenge each other. We have fun. And we take pride in developing future leaders who go on to make an impact across the sports industry.
We are committed to supporting the health, well-being, and professional success of our employees. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes paid time off, multiple medical plan options, dental and vision coverage, flexible spending and health savings accounts, a 401(k) plan with Company match, Company-paid life and disability insurance, paid medical and baby-bonding leave, mental health resources, wellness reimbursements, and employee discounts. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, relevant experience, internal equity, and prevailing business and market conditions.
Our Commitment to InclusionUnion Sports & Entertainment is committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive workplace where every employee and candidate is treated with dignity and respect. We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. Not sure you meet every requirement? Championship teams are built on diverse strengths. If you’re passionate about sports and excited about this role, we want to hear from you!

job.title: Accommodation Manager
job.html_description:
Job information
Division/Unit: Services/Travel, Accommodation & Conferences
Contract type: Permanent
Location: Nyon (up to one day working from home per week)
Start date: as soon as possible
Application deadline: 22.09.2026

Main goal

The Accommodation Manager leads the accommodation strategy, planning and delivery for UEFA National Team Competitions (NTC) and related events, ensuring high-quality accommodation solutions for teams, officials, VIP guests, partners and staff.

Acting as the accommodation project lead for major tournaments, including UEFA EURO 2028, the role oversees the full accommodation lifecycle, from hotel sourcing and contracting to operational delivery and event-time execution. The Accommodation Manager leads a dedicated team, manages key hotel and supplier partnerships, and drives accommodation excellence across UEFA's NTC portfolio.

Key responsibilities

Strategic planning and project leadership

  • Defining and delivering accommodation strategies, project plans, budgets and timelines for UEFA National Team Competitions and related events
  • Leading accommodation projects from concept to delivery, managing risks, stakeholders and suppliers to ensure successful outcomes
  • Building strong relationships with internal stakeholders, accommodation agencies, hotels and other service providers

Hotel contracting and procurement

  • Leading hotel sourcing, procurement procedures and contracting processes across the NTC portfolio
  • Negotiating and managing hotel contracts, rates, room inventories and reservation processes
  • Ensuring that accommodation solutions meet the needs of all stakeholder groups and are contractually compliant
  • Overseeing the performance of accommodation agencies, hotel and other suppliers to ensure that they fulfil their contractual obligations, provide the agreed service levels and meet all operational requirements

Operational management

  • Overseeing accommodation planning, operational readiness and delivery standards across the NTC portfolio
  • Ensuring alignment between accommodation operations and other event functional areas
  • Supporting accommodation project leads and monitoring delivery against agreed objectives and service standards
  • Managing accommodation programmes for teams, officials, VIP guests, teams, partners and staff for designated events

Event-time operations

  • Leading accommodation operations during tournaments and related events
  • Managing on-site accommodation teams and resolving operational challenges in a fast-paced environment
  • Monitoring service delivery, reporting to leadership and overseeing financial reconciliation

Leadership and team management

  • Leading, coaching and developing the NTC accommodation team fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement
  • Setting priorities, allocating resources and ensuring effective workload management across competitions and projects
  • Providing guidance and support to accommodation project leads throughout planning and delivery phases
  • Supporting the recruitment, onboarding and development of event-time staff

Requirements

Experience:

  • At least 7 years of experience in accommodation, hospitality, event management or a related field, preferably in the context of international sporting events
  • Proven experience of managing complex projects and accommodation operations in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience overseeing accommodation delivery through agencies, suppliers or hotel partners for large-scale sporting events or similarly complex environments
  • Experience negotiating and managing hotel contracts, supplier relationships and procurement processes.
  • Previous people management experience, including team leadership, coaching and development.

Languages:

  • English: Proficient

Other requirements:

  • Relocation to Switzerland/France is expected
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, deadlines and stakeholders simultaneously
  • Highly organised, detail-oriented and solution-driven, with the ability to anticipate risks and resolve complex operational challenges
  • Willingness to travel within Europe/UEFA territory and work irregular hours during events

Want to stay updated on our latest job opportunities, events, and behind-the-scenes insights? Join us on LinkedIn.

UEFA welcomes applications from all, actively working to ensure that we are an inclusive employer that finds the best candidate for our positions, regardless of aspects such as sex, gender identification, disability, age, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity or nationality.

job.title: EURO ICT Command Centre Manager
job.html_description:
Job information
Division/Unit: Services/ICT Services & Operations
Contract type: Fixed-term
Location: Nyon (up to one day per week working from home)

This role relates to UEFA EURO 2028 and is based at UEFA’s headquarters in Nyon, Switzerland. If you are looking for roles based in the UK and Ireland, please visit the UK & Ireland 2028 Limited careers page.

Start date: 01.02.2027
End date: 31.07.2028
Application deadline: 11.09.2026

Main goal

The IT Command Centre Manager leads the design, implementation and operation of the IT Command Centre (ITCC) for UEFA EURO 2028, acting as the central point of coordination, communication, escalation and incident management across all ICT streams, venues and tournament operations.

Key responsibilities

Planning and setup phase (February 2027 – May 2028):

  • Reviewing, consolidating and implementing the operational concept for the ITCC as well as governance, communication and escalation frameworks
  • Defining the ITCC's operating model, including staffing, support structure, operational readiness and requirements for the tournament operation centre (TOC)
  • Designing and deploying operational dashboards, reporting tools and service monitoring capabilities in line with tournament needs
  • Coordinating the handover of ICT facilities, infrastructure deployment, milestone tracking and operational rehearsal and simulation exercises

Tournament delivery and operation phase (June – July 2028):

  • Leading and coordinating ITCC operations across physical and virtual environments to support tournament activities
  • Managing daily operational reviews, service status reporting and stakeholder communications to ensure situational awareness
  • Supervising escalation processes and major incident management to minimise service disruption and operational impact
  • Monitoring service performance, operational risks, dashboard effectiveness and change management activities within the ITCC and TOC

Post-EURO:

  • Planning and coordinating the dismantling of the ITCC and IT elements of the TOC

Requirements

Experience:

  • From 4 to 6 years of experience in IT operations or service management or working in a command centre or network or security operations centre
  • Proven experience managing critical incidents and high-pressure operational situations
  • Experience in the sports industry or at major events would be a strong advantage

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in a related area, or equivalent work experience
  • ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent experience
  • Project management certification (e.g. PMI) would be a plus

Languages:

  • English: Proficient

Other requirements:

- Relocation to Switzerland/France is expected

- A solid understanding of networking, IP transport and information security principles

- Proven ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, local IT teams, vendors, partners and consultants to deliver services in line with service-level agreements and operational performance targets

job.title: EURO ICT Technical Solutions Expert
job.html_description:
Job information
Division/Unit: Services/ICT Services & Operations
Contract type: Fixed-term
Location: Nyon (up to one day per week working from home)

This role relates to UEFA EURO 2028 and is based at UEFA’s headquarters in Nyon, Switzerland. If you are looking for roles based in the UK and Ireland, please visit the UK & Ireland 2028 Limited careers page.

Start date: 01.02.2027
End date: 31.07.2028
Application deadline: 11.09.2026

Main goal

The EURO 2028 ICT Technical Expert is part of the ICT infrastructure team based at UEFA headquarters in Nyon, reporting to the ICT Technical Solutions Manager and working in collaboration with various other EURO 2028 and UEFA teams as well as telecoms partners and stadium operators for the tournament.

Key responsibilities

Planning phase:

  • Designing, documenting and developing business-oriented telecommunications solutions in line with UEFA EURO 2028 operational requirements
  • Acting as the subject matter expert for telecoms and the primary liaison between UEFA's ICT unit, technical stakeholders and the tournament's telecoms partner
  • Translating business and operational needs into scalable, reliable and cost-effective telecom service designs and architectures
  • Ensuring that telecommunications solutions are delivered in accordance with the tournament objectives, the ICT Technical Solutions Manager's instructions and all relevant standards

Delivery phase:

  • Monitoring the set-up of all UEFA EURO 2028 venues
  • Supporting the team with the provision of ICT infrastructure for other UEFA competitions
  • Working on-site during UEFA EURO 2028 as part of the IT Command Centre telecoms team to support tournament operations

Post-tournament phase:

  • Contributing to dismantling, debriefing, reporting and closing event operations

Requirements

Experience:

  • Minimum of four years’ experience developing telecoms infrastructure domain supporting services
  • Operational experience as a service owner in a command or network operations centre
  • Experience of successful delivery in line with service level agreements, service constraints and standard operational metrics

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in a related area, or equivalent work experience
  • Telecoms certification (e.g. CCNP Routing and Switching) would be a plus

Languages:

  • English: Proficient

Other requirements:

- Relocation to Switzerland or nearby France is expected

- Strong familiarity with networking, IP transport and radio

- Willing and able to travel and work long and irregular hours

- Excellent collaboration, communication, agility and customer engagement

- Proven organisational, project management, problem-solving and analytical skills

job.title: Ticketing Systems Specialist
job.html_description:
Job information
Division/Unit: UEFA Events SA / Ticketing
Contract type: Max Term
Location: Nyon (WFH up to one day per week)
Start date: ASAP
End date: 31.07.2029

Main goal

The Ticketing Systems Specialist is responsible for configuring, testing and monitoring all ticketing sales platforms and systems. This role involves identifying issues as well as proposing and implementing improvements in preparation for ticket sales across events such as UEFA EURO 2028, UEFA Women’s EURO 2029, the UEFA Nations League finals and UEFA club competition finals.

Key responsibilities

  • Setting up, testing and maintaining all ticketing platforms and systems used for ticket sales
  • Monitoring platforms to ensure smooth and efficient operations
  • Understanding business needs and managing the configuration, set-up and operational delivery of ticket resale platforms
  • Collaborating closely with other members of the ticketing sales team to anticipate business needs, align on specifications, liaise with the system provider, meet deadlines and ensure smooth sales operations
  • Supporting additional ticketing sales activities, including the maintenance of customer communication content on the UEFA.com ticketing page

Requirements

Experience:

  • from 4 to 6 years years’ experience with content management systems

Education:

  • Bachelor's in information technology, web development, web technologies or another relevant area

Languages:

  • Proficient in English

Other requirements:

- Relocation to Switzerland/France is expected

- HTML, CSS and basic JavaScript knowledge would be an asset

- Experience working with ticketing systems, in particular knowledge of SecuTix, would be a strong asset

job.title: UEFA Academy Operations Assistant
job.html_description:
Job information
Division/Unit: National Associations / UEFA Academy
Contract type: Open-ended
Location: Nyon (WFH up to one day per week)
Start date: 01/03/2027

Main goal

The UEFA Academy Operations Assistant contributes to the successful delivery of UEFA Academy programmes by providing high-quality administrative, contractual, financial, and logistical support.

The role helps ensure a consistent and professional participant experience, from initial enquiries and onboarding through to programme completion, feedback collection, and transition into the alumni community.

Working closely with UEFA Academy colleagues, other UEFA divisions, academic partners, and external service providers, the Operations Assistant combines reliable day-to-day administration with a proactive approach to service excellence and continuous process improvement.

Key responsibilities

Administration and logistics

  • Coordinating the preparation, tracking, signature and filing of contracts relating to UEFA Academy activities, in close liaison with UEFA's legal division
  • Maintaining accurate records of all contracts, monitoring deadlines and identifying opportunities to improve contractual workflows
  • Supporting financial administration, including invoicing and following up on payments and liaising with UEFA’s finance division to ensure that all financial records are accurate and all processes completed on time
  • Assisting with the organisation of seminars, workshops and events, including working with UEFA's travel agency to arrange transport and accommodation and handling meeting logistics in collaboration with event support teams
  • Coordinating the administrative follow-up of the UEFA Academy accreditation process, monitoring progress on KPIs and ensuring documentation is complete and accurate
  • Organising and maintaining files, templates, calendars, tracking tools and shared documentation, providing UEFA Academy colleagues with continuous administrative support and collaborating with them to improve team processes

Participant experience and operational support for UEFA Academy programmes

    • Acting as a first point of contact for prospective and accepted participants, providing accurate and timely information about UEFA Academy programmes
    • Contributing to a high-quality participant journey, from onboarding to programme completion and feedback
    • Coordinating visits by partner universities, institutional stakeholders and other guests invited by the UEFA Academy
    • Organising visit itineraries, site access, meeting rooms and catering, coordinating internally to ensure a professional and welcoming experience for the UEFA Academy's guests
    • Providing on-site operational support during seminars held at UEFA or abroad when required
    • Depending on future needs, the role may develop to include supporting seminar facilitation, participant engagement and programme coordination

Requirements

Experience:

  • From 1 to 3 years in programme administration, event operations, education services, customer service or a comparable role
  • From 1 to 3 years in an international, multicultural or service-oriented environment would be an advantage
  • From 1 to 3 years with accreditation, quality assurance or a comparable administrative-review process would be an asset

Education:

  • Relevant education and/or further training in administration, event management, education services, business administration, or a related field.

Languages:

  • Proficient in French & English

Other requirements:

  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office
  • Familiarity with generative AI and automation tools and the ability to use them appropriately and critically to support administrative, communication and coordination tasks
  • Basic ability to use Adobe Creative Cloud, Canva or comparable visual-content tools would be an asset
  • Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage several deadlines, requests and programme calendars in parallel
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues, academic partners, external suppliers and other UEFA staff
  • Adaptability and intercultural sensitivity
  • Ability to remain calm and responsive in time-sensitive situations
  • Occasional travel within Switzerland and abroad is required
  • Some programme activities may require flexibility to work during evenings and weekends

job.title: International Relations Assistant - Maternity Cover
job.html_description:
Job information
Division/Unit: National Associations / N.A. International Relations
Contract type: Max-term
Location: Nyon (WFH up to one day per week)
Start date: ASAP
End date: 15/04/2027

Main goal

The International Relations Assistant supports the daily operations of the National Associations International Relations unit, including the UEFA Together programme. The role requires excellent communication and organisational skills, and involves performing administrative tasks such as processing emails and invoices and organising travel and visas for youth tournaments. UEFA Together is a development programme aimed at strengthening confederations and their member associations through knowledge exchanges, youth football development projects and partnerships with UEFA member associations

Key responsibilities

    • Providing administrative support for the daily operations of the National Associations International Relations unit and the UEFA Together programme
    • Coordinating logistics and visas for youth tournaments

job.title: EURO HB Live Producer
job.html_description:
Job information
Division/Unit: Marketing / Live Production and Editorial Content Services
Contract type: Max-term
Location: Nyon (WFH up to one day per week)

This role is based at UEFA’s Headquarters in Nyon, Switzerland for the UEFA EURO 2028 tournament. If you are looking for roles based in the UK & Ireland, please visit the UK & Ireland 2028 Limited page.

Start date: 01.02.2027
End date: 31.07.2028
Application deadline: 24.09.2026

Main goal

Working as part of the Live Production team to plan and implement the UEFA EURO 2028 host broadcast production plan.

Key responsibilities

  • Working on all aspects of live production for EURO 2028, in collaboration with UEFA's host broadcast venue operations and broadcast engineering teams
  • Coordinating with the appointed production teams and liaising with the technical suppliers during the preparation phase
  • Assisting with production-related documents (e.g. running orders, feeds plans, camera movements, workflows) and production team schedules
  • Preparing content for EURO 2028 workshops, briefings and manuals
  • Acting as live producer with one of the production teams or Quality Control Producer in the international broadcast centre during the tournament, ensuring the on-site delivery of the host broadcast production plan
  • Supporting production and providing editorial assistance across all UEFA competitions
  • Monitoring events from UEFA's match command centre and providing ad hoc on-site support for host broadcasts of matches throughout the season
  • Taking on the role of Host Broadcast Live Producer for one of UEFA's finals, including liaising with the TV domain leader and the host broadcast manager to prepare for the event, ensuring delivery on-site and overseeing all host broadcast elements of the multilateral feed

Requirements

Experience:

  • 4 to 6 years working in a live sport broadcast environment
  • 1 to 3 years working as a live sports producer, director, AP or other relevant live editorial role

Languages:

  • Proficient in English

Other requirements:

  • Solid understanding of all the elements of a sports outside broadcast
  • Good knowledge of new broadcast technologies, camera systems and developments in the broadcast industry
  • Team-oriented approach, with excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to multitask, work under pressure and deal sensitively and confidently with a diverse range of internal and external stakeholders
  • Relocation to Switzerland is expected

job.title: Senior CRM Marketing Manager
job.html_description:
Description

  

U.S. Soccer Overview 


The U.S. Soccer Federation exists in service to soccer. Our aim is to ignite a national passion for the game. Because we believe that soccer is more than a sport; it is a force for good. 


We understand the importance and the power of teamwork, on and off the pitch. That is why we work closely with our Federation partners and members, to inspire, support and guide every level of the game: from the grassroots to the National Teams. We want to bring soccer into every home and every community, right across America. Because we believe that soccer can transform lives like no other sport. Soccer can represent the best of U.S. 


U.S. Soccer is in a period of significant growth, with ambitious plans for U.S. Soccer in the near and far future. We are, therefore, looking for dynamic servant leaders to join us on this journey: in service to soccer. Applicants must be able to demonstrate visionary leadership, analytical decision-making, professional flexibility, and an empathic management style that builds bold teams and delivers globally significant results. 


Position Description 


U.S. Soccer is seeking a data and result-driven Senior CRM Marketing Manager who will oversee the design and execution of data-driven, personalized marketing campaigns that deepen engagement, drive retention, and grow the federation’s audience. Operating at the intersection of technology, marketing, and revenue, the Senior CRM Marketing Manager will set the strategic direction for CRM marketing initiatives, ensure alignment across departments, and drive measurable business outcomes through advanced segmentation, marketing automation, and performance analytics.


As Senior CRM Marketing Manager, you will be experienced in leading audience development and segmentation, working with marketing automation tools, understanding data workflows, and can execute personalized campaigns across email, SMS, push notifications, and digital ads.


As a strategic leader and executional expert, the Senior CRM Marketing Manager will set best practices, establish measurement frameworks, and manage cross-functional collaboration to ensure that U.S. Soccer’s data-driven marketing efforts are maximized. This role will play a key part in revenue growth by leveraging CRM to support ticket sales, membership programs, sponsorship activations, and content monetization.


You will manage the Manager, Lifecycle Marketing, leading understanding our audience needs, behaviors and preferences and using this knowledge to create personalized and impactful marketing efforts that drive results. You’ll also work closely with other Federation teams across Commercial, Advancement, Referring and Coaching with strategic ownership of the CRM marketing roadmap and lifecycle architecture.


This mid-level position is perfect for someone who is a marketing expert, specializing in CRM and marketing technology including Braze and who is looking to take the next step in their career. The ideal candidate can parse technical solutions into tasks quickly, detail-orientated, and brings process management skills to complicated project. 


Primary Responsibilities


Strategic Leadership & Best Practices

  • Define and own the long-term CRM marketing roadmap, ensuring alignment with organization priorities across the Federation including audience development, fan engagement, revenue and brand growth.
  • Lead, establish and implement CRM marketing best practices across the organization, ensuring data-driven decision-making.
  • Act as the central air traffic controller for CRM marketing efforts, balancing multiple priorities across ticketing, membership, sponsorship, and fan engagement.
  • Serve as the go-to expert for marketing automation, leading internal education on CRM marketing capabilities and optimization.
  • Lead, develop and refine measurement frameworks, ensuring campaigns align with key business objectives and drive revenue growth.
  • Collaborate with senior leadership across marketing, sales, partnerships, and analytics to align CRM marketing efforts with organizational goals. Partner with Data, Technology and Marketing leadership to enhance data infrastructure and campaign personalization capabilities.
  • Mentor and support Manager, Lifecycle Communications, fostering a data-drive culture and operational excellence.

Audience Segmentation & Data Management

  • Own and evolve the federation’s audience segmentation strategy, ensuring personalization scales effectively across all channels.
  • Build and maintain audience segments for personalized fan engagement, leveraging first-party, second-party, and third-party data.
  • Lead and manage audience targeting, integrating behavioral, transactional, and engagement data to tailor outreach across CRM, CDP, and digital marketing platforms.
  • Define and execute dynamic audience rules for automated lifecycle campaigns.
  • Partner with analytics and data engineering teams to influence how fan data is collected, unified, and activated across CRM and digital ecosystem.
  • Work closely with the data analytics team to refine segmentation strategies based on campaign performance and fan behavior.
  • Ensure data cleanliness and compliance with CCPA, and other data privacy regulations.

Campaign Strategy, Execution & Automation

  • Oversee campaign strategy and ensure execution excellence by guiding the Lifecycle Marketing team and cross-functional partner.
  • Define CRM contact strategy and oversee orchestration of multi-channel campaigns to ensure alignment, efficiency, and fan-centric engagement. 
  • Build and execute highly personalized, multi-channel campaigns (email, SMS, push notifications, paid media audience targeting) to drive fan engagement and business growth.
  • Create automated workflows for fan onboarding, retention, and win-back campaigns.
  • Conduct A/B testing to optimize subject lines, content, and audience targeting.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot campaign performance, adjusting strategies in real-time.
  • Manage CRM calendars to ensure timely delivery of campaigns supporting ticket sales, events, content engagement, and sponsor activations.

Operational & Technical Execution

  • Oversee and optimize the performance of key marketing technology platforms, ensuring integrations and automations support scalable fan engagement.
  • Ensure operational excellence and governance in CRM marketing execution including across marketing technology platforms, including CRM, Customer Data Platforms (CDP), Mobile Measurement Platforms (MMP), and marketing automation tools to enhance fan engagement.
  • Own day-to-day execution within CRM platforms (Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, or similar).
  • Lead the execution of marketing email campaigns including ensuring compelling copy including editing, proofing, stakeholder approvals, and final deployment.
  • Configure and update campaign templates, customer journeys, and automation triggers.
  • Coordinate with IT and data teams to enhance CRM integrations and resolve technical issues.
  • Oversee UTM tracking, tagging, and attribution for performance analysis.

Measurement, Reporting & Optimization

  • Lead on best-in-class and data driven measurement approach for CRM channels including email, push and SMS, feeding into a multi-channel and multi-touch attribution modelling, and showing performance in engagement, revenue and ROI.
  • Define and own CRM marketing KPIs and measurement frameworks that link engagement to business outcomes such as ticket sales, membership growth, sponsorship value and other business priorities.
  • Optimized based on performance, reacting and responding to data in real-time and depending on the needs of the business. 
  • Track and report on CRM campaign performance, providing insights on key metrics (open rates, CTR, conversion rates, etc.).
  • Identify trends in fan engagement and recommend data-driven optimizations.
  • Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders, ensuring CRM efforts align with broader marketing objectives.

Requirements

  

Minimum Qualifications

  • 7–10 years of progressive experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or marketing automation
  • Proven experience leading CRM strategy and cross-functional execution across marketing, data, and technology teams
  • Expertise in CRM tools (Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign, or similar)
  • Strong leadership skills to influence cross-functional teams and manage competing priorities
  • Strong understanding of audience segmentation, personalization, and data-driven marketing
  • Experience in multi-channel marketing, including email, SMS, and push notifications
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret campaign performance and optimize accordingly
  • Knowledge of data privacy regulations (CCPA) and compliance best practices
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously
  • SQL proficiency for audience querying and reporting
  • Familiarity with paid media platforms and CRM-to-advertising integrations
  • Experience with A/B testing methodologies and lifecycle marketing strategies
  • Experience with digital attribution, conversion tracking, and marketing analytics platforms (Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Tableau)
  • Team-first attitude and excellent interpersonal skills
  • Proven ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Exceptional time management skills
  • Capable of working in fast-paced and demanding environments 
  • Must be able to connect “micro” details to the “macro” vision and mission 
  • Proficient experience with Microsoft Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Outlook) 
  • Able and willing to work non-traditional hours including evenings and weekends as needed (USMNT and USWNT match days)


Desired Qualifications 

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Passion for soccer and a solid understanding of the soccer landscape in the United States



U.S. Soccer offers a comprehensive compensation package, casual work environment, an inclusive culture, and an atmosphere for professional development. 


U.S. Soccer is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind on the basis of race, color, sex, religion, national origin, citizenship, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, military status, political belief, or any other characteristic protected under the law. This policy applies to all our employment practices within our organization. We strongly encourage women, people of color, LGBTQIA, veterans, parents, and persons with disabilities to apply.
